bya ba smos so/ /de ni 7 dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs(lta/ /zhes bya ba ni nges par gzung ( —ba ste de ④nyid ces bya ba'i don to/ /dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs zhes bya ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du bshad pa'o/ /rang bzhin du bshad pa de yang 'di yin te/ mi mnyam pa med pas zur bzhi yin no/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga zhes bya ba ni sgo bzhi yin no/ /bsam gtan rnams la rta babs bzhi/ /zhes bya'o/ /gzugs rnams la kha khyer la brten pa'i lha mo rnams zhes bya'o/ khasam pa thams cad yongs su phyardzogs pa 'dul ba bskyod pa'i rang bzhin ni/ rlung gis dar 'phan bskyod nas sgra sgrogs pa zhes bya'o/ /ye shes me long zhes bya'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya'o/ /mi zad pa'i bde ba dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / rin chen mchog nyi ma dang zla ba zhes bya'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad dkyil 'khor brgyad ces bya'o/ /jeg pa chen po mdo sdes byubaskor ba ni rdo rje theg pa zhes bya'o//'khor lo ni chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ mi mnyam med pas zur bzhi ste/ /dran dang dbang po sgo bzhi yin/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang rta babs yin/ /kha khyer la brten rdo rje mchog /lha mos mchod pas gzungs rnams yin/ /sna tshogs pa yi rgyan rnams kun/ /bsam pa thams cad sdogs pa yinabye/ /gdul bya bskyod pas sna tshogs mchog /dam chos mchog ni kun du 'go/ /rlung gis bskyod nas sna tshogs mchog /dar 'phan dril bu sgra sgrogs ni/ /me long ye shes rtags me togarte /dra ba dra phyed rin chen mchog /nyi ma zla ba yang dag ldan/ /kun grub mi zad bde ba ste/ /34—du82

bde ba chen po zhes bshad do/ /de yi nang rim dag gi thig /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa 'dra ba ni/ /'di na rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde ba ster/ /theg pa chen po byang chub sems/ /mdo sde'i 'khor lo bskor bas na/ /rdo rje thig gis yongs bskor ba/ /rdo rje 'khor lo yang dag bri/ /zhes pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra ba la/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs bcu drug /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang de nyid kyi byang chub sems kyi 'bras bu dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / sems can gyi don la chags pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' kun mgu bar byed pa'i tshul ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang /rgyal po dang / chags pa dang / legs pa'o/ /ji skad du/ byang chub sems kyi 'bras bu ni/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med gang / /de ni rdo rje sems rang bzhin/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / bsdu ba yi ni dngos bo bzhi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang spyad pa/ /sems can 'gugs pa'i thabs zhes pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po yang dag 'byung / /zhes bya ba dang / sems can smin phyir bcom ldan gyis/ /gang tshe byang chub spyod pa spyad/ /byang chub spyod la rjes chags pa/ /rdo rje chags par yang dag 'byung / /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byed cing / /legs so zhes bya rab ster byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun mgu byed/ /de ni rdo rje legs par brjod / /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang mi shes pa'i mun nag 'joms pa dang / chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun dbugs 'byin pa go rims lha bzhin du rdo rje rin chen dang / gzi brjid dang / rgyal mtshan dang 34—583

bzhad 1pa bzhi yin te/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa gang / /mkha' mnyam rin chen lta bu ste/ /rdo rje rin chen skal ba che/ /des na rdo rje rin chen brjod/ /ces pa dang / ma rig ling tog 'khor ba yi/ /mi shes mun pa 'joms byed cing / /thar pa'i snang ba gzi brjid che/ /de ni rdo rje gzi brjid do/ /zhes pa dang / rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /thar pa'i lam 'akro rgyal mtshan de/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan rgyal mtshan che/ /de ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan brjod/ /ces pa dang / rnal 'byor chen po rdo rje bzhad/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bzhad byed cing / /byang chub sems dpa' kun dbugs 'byin / /de ni rdo rje bzhad par brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ④gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid sems can gyis ge rtogs par byed pa'i rgyu dang / shes rab chen po dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dang / tshig dang bral bas smra ba ste/bzhi po go rims 4bzhin du rdo rje chos dang rnon po dang / 'khor lo dang smra ba ste5 / ji skad du/ rnal 'byor chen po sangs rgyas chos/ /sangs rgyas sems can rtogs byed pa/ /dag pa de bzhin gshegs snying po/ /de ni rdo rje chos su brjod/ /ces pa dang / shes rab rnon po ye shes che/ /shin tu snyug pa'i nyon mongs gcod/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa gcod pas na/ /de ni rdo rje rnon por brjod/ /ces pa dang / 'khor lo sangs rgyas gar shes pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu brtan6/ /dam chos sgrol ba'i bcud las byung / /de ni rdo rje rgyu zhes bya/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi chos chen po/ /mkha' mtshungs tshig dang bral ba ste 7/ tshig med tshig las yang dag byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid 5sems can smin pa 34—584

dang grol ba dang theg pa dman tū/pa spong ba dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad zad pa dang de bzhin nyid phyin ci ma log pa ste go rims bzhin du/ rdo rje las dang srung thu ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / khu tshur zhes bya'o/ /ji skad du/sems can smin dang grol ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi las gang dang / /sangs rgyas las ni bdag med pa/ /de ni rdo rje las zhes bya/ /1 byang chub sems dpa' srung ④ba ste/ /theg pa dman pa spang phye/byed cing / /rtse mo nas lcung srung byed pa( —/ /de ni rdo rje srung tsobar bshad/ /sdig pa thams cad zad byed cing / /nyon mongs thams cad nges par gcod/ /srid pa zad byed gnod spyin che/ /de ni rdo rje gnod sbyin brjod/ /ces /byepa dang / bden zhing gzhan min de bzhin nyid/ /'gyur med de kho na nyid gang / /sangs rgyas de bzhin nyid ye shes/ /de ni rdo rje khu tshur brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro//gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyu༄nyid sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang /thabs dang / smon lam rnams ni/ lā gye dang / mā le dang / gīrti tsodang /nitwe ⑪dang / dhū pe dang / puṣ+pe dang / ā lo ke dang / gabye zhes bya ba rnams so/ /ji skad du/ gang phyir mchog tu rol pas na/ /sgeg mo sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /byang chub yan lag 'bras ster bas/ /phreng ba tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /zhes pa dang / zhi ba'i chos la rjes mos pas/ /glu ma bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas mchod la mi skyo bas/ /gar ma brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /zhes pa dang / thar pa mchog ni dga' sgrub pas / /bdug pa shes rab pha rol phyin/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'bras rgyu yin pas//34—585

—me tog bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje mar me thabs chen po / /smon lam rdo rje byug pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid byang chub kyi sems kyi mtshan nyid 'gugs par byed pa dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa'i zhags pa dang theg pa chen por 'ching ba dang /chos thams cad skye ba med par 'bab pa ste go rims bzhin du/ be+egs kyu dang /zhags pa dang / lcags sgog dang / dril bu'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ byang chub sems kyis 'gugs pa ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyur yang dag brjod/ /byang chub spyod pa la spyod gyopa/ /rdo rje zhags par de bshad do/ /theg pa dman pa srung byed pa/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog de bshad do/ /rab tu 'od gsal skye med pa//rdo rje dril bur de bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang gnyis su med pa'i thugs de nyid snying rje dang / byams pa dang / dga' ba dang /btang snyoms dang bzhi ni go rims bzhin du/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgol ma rnams zhes pa ( —bheyin no/ /ji skad du/ sangs rgyas spyan ni byams pa che/ /mā ma kri ni snying rje che/ /dkar mo dga' bar rab tu brjod/ /btang snyoms che dang thabs che bar/ /sgrol ma zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid byang chub kyi sems dang / tshogs dang / shes rab dang /byang chub kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba bzhi go rims bzhin du ngan song sbyong ba dang /rin chen tog dang / shākya'i dbang po dang / me tog cher rgyas so/ /ji skad du/ byang chub tu ni sems bskyed dang / /de bzhin tshogs dang shes rab dang / /byang chub spyod pa rab spyod pa4/ /rgyal po bzhir ༄5ni yang dag 'byung / /3 4—586

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ye shes de nyid chos thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa ni / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad do/ /ji skad du/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad ces/ /chos rnams gcig tu bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dis ni 'bras bu de nyid las ldog pa'i tshul gyis tha dad pa yin gyi ngo bo nyid kyis tha dad pa yod pa ma yin no/ /'dis ni gzhan yang gsang sngags kyi sgo'i sbyad pa spyod par 'dod pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid thog mar shes par gyis shig ces ston to/ /de ltar nang gi dkyil 'khor gzugs med pa gsungs nas/ da ni de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pas phyi'i dkyil 'khor gzugs dang bcas pa bstan to/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni 1bar ma chad pa'o/ /yang zhes bya ba ni sbud pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba'i slad du zhes bya ba ni mi rnams la phan pa'i don du'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba ni/ gzugs dang bcas shing thams cad 'jug tu rung ba'o/ /'di gsungs so zhes pa ni/ mi rnams la phan pa'i don du bshad do/ /gtsug lag khang dang skyed mos tshal2/ /mchod rten lha khang kun ra rngusogs/ /ji bzhin pa yi cho ga yisacho/ /gnas ni byin gyis brlab pa brtsamaphya / /zhes bya ba ni gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten dang lha khang dang kye kun dga' ra ba dang 'bab chu'i 'gram dang / grong khyer gyi shar dang / byang gi phyogs kyi char ram gang du yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su'o//de nas/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i don du ni7/ /tshigs bcad 'di ni bsgrag par bya/ /sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang / /gang zhig sa la brtan pa kun/ /byams pa'i sems kyis gnas nas su/ /sems can kun la dge don du/ /34—587

kun dga'i ri1don du zhu zhing mchis/ /de nas ji ltar 'tsham snyebazhin du pus mo nub tsam 'og tu brkos la/ gyo mo la sogs pa bsal la/ spyan dang rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyi chus bsang gtor bya/ khru tshad kyis che chung brtag par bya/ ba'i chu dang lci bas byug /sa gzung kyib dang sbyang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas gos dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ khrus byas lus dri chus byugs/ rdo rje gnod sbyin du bskyed/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las zla ba dang nyi ma dgod/ rkang pa la a las sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed/ lag pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu bzung ④ste yi ge hūṃ gi sgra sgrogs shing / g.yas nas bskor la dengs zhes brjod/ mtshams dang ra ba dang dra ba dag kyang bya/bdud dang sdang ba bzlog /de nas phur bu byin gyis brlabs la phur bu gdab par bya'o/ /'dis ni/ ji bzhin pa yi cho ga yis/ /zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nas spyor ba dang po dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog bsgoms 5la dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg /lha'i gnas su tsan+dan la sogs pa'i zlum po dang / gru bzhi'i thig le bya/ dkyil 'khor brtags pa 6basbus / lcags kyu la sogs pas dgug gzhug bya/ bgegs bskrad zupa dang /ra ba dang / dra ba bya/ sgo bcad srung ba brtan sdopar bya/ /mchod yon dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod rang rang gi sngags ci mang du bzlas te/ bum pa lhag par gnas pa dang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang / phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin pa dang / nye reg dang / spyin sreg dang / mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa 9 la sogs bya'o/ /'di tsam gyis ni/ gnas ni tsobyin gyis brlab pa brtsam/ /zhes bya ba'i don 34—588

yin no/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der nishā/ /zhes bya ba ni de 2nyid du'o—/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi sgo gnyis pa'o / /phyogs kun mnyam pa grwa dang bcas pas gru bzhi pa la phyogs kyi cha re re zhing sgo bzhi yod pas sgo bzhi pa zhes bya'o/ /rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa dang / /zem skas bzhi yi phreng ba dang / /seng ge ba glang snarnams kyis brgyan/ /zhes bya ba ni/ phyogs re re na rta babs re dang / them skas phreng ba dang /seng ge ba glang chornams kyis mdzes par byas pas de skad ces bya'o/ /dar dang lda ldi spyodo shal phreng / /dril bu dang ni rnga mas brgyan/ /zhes bya ba ni dar gyi lda ldi dang / mu tig gi do shal dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / dril bu g.yer kha la sogs pa dang / rnga mas mdzes par byas pa la de skad ces bya'o/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /rgya gram pa yi phyag rgyas brgyan/ /zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs su rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du rgya gram gyi phyag rgyas brgyan cing sprul pa'o/ /srad bu rgyan 3dang ldan pa dang / /phyi yi sgo khyud rnams kyis brgyan/ /zhes bya ba ni tshangs thig gnyis dang / zur thig gnyis dang / shar phyogs dang / nub dang / byang dang / lho phyogs kyi thig ste brgyad dang ldan pa dang / sgo khyud ni mdzes pa dang / rjes su mdzes pa zhes bya ba ni rtsig par ston pa'i cha gnyis te de rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dgu yi char ni bgos 8pa las/ /zhes bya ba ni nang gi dkyil 'khor gnas gru bzhi pa cha dgu dang ldan par bgos /pa las so/ /sgo dang sgo khyud sum char bya/ /zhes bya ba ni sgo dang sgo khyud la cha chen gcig gnas par byas pas sum cha'i yang sum char 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje srad bus thig gdab po/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje srad 34—589

bur byin gyis brlabs pas shegadab bo/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa/ /zhes bya ba ni dbus kyi yang dbus kyi thig gdab pa'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dra ba la/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje dang mtshon cha'i 'khor lo lta bu ma yin pa chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra ba'o/ /yang na lte ba dang rtsibs rten dang 2 rtsibs dang gsum chos kyi 'khor lo gsum dang 'dra ba'o/ /yang na stong pa nyid bcu drug chos yin la de yang 'khor lo ni 'dra ba'o/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs bcu drug /ces bya ba ni lte ba dang / rtsibs 1rten dang bcas shing / rtsibs bcu drug tu grangs nges pa'o/ /rim pa gsum dang ldan pa la/ /zhes bya ba ni lte ba'i rim pa dang / rtsibs rten gyi rim pa dang / rtsibs kyi rim pa dang ldan pa'o/ /rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ /zhes pa ni/ rtsibs byang chub sems dpa'i gnas yin pas gtso bo'i gnas pas nyis 'gyur gyis chung bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yang lte ba la bskor ba'i rim pa chodang po ni rtsibs rten no/ /gnyis pa ni rtsibs yin pa'i phyir/ rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni don slar yang gsal bar bya ste/ sa yi cha yid du 'ong bar 5dkyil 'khor kyi nyis 'gyur gye tshad la/ mig ( snabyin gyis brlab cing bsgril ba dang rang rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de/ grogs po rdo rje las su bskyed nas / dang po rang shar du bltas te tshangs thig gdab/ de'i 'og tu byang du bltas te tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ me'i gnas su gnas la shar gyi thig gdab—/ rlung gi phyogs su bltas te nub kyi thig kyang gdab/ de nyid du 'dug ste shar du bltas te byang du thig kyang gdab/ me'i mtshams su gnas nas lho phyogs kyi thig gdab/ de nyid du 'dug ste rlung phyogs su bltas te 34—590

tshangs thig gdab par bya/ bden bral gyi phyogs su 'dug ste dbang ldan du kha bltas la zur thig gnyis pa gdab/ de ltar gru bzhir gnas pa la cha chen bcu drug gdab par bya'o/ /tha mar cha chen 1gnyis par bya'o/ /dbus kyi bcu po gnyis 3gnyis gdab/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi dag tu 'gyur / /de nas cha phra mo gdab par bya ba ni/ cha chen dgu ru gnas pa la/ /tha mar lnga pa'i phyed bor ba la lhag ma brgyad la bzhi bzhir bgo gsum pa dang de bzhin du lnga pa la 3yang ngo / /phyi rol gyi sgo dang nang gi sgo khyud dang logs su 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa'i phyed nang du bor nas phyi rol gnyis su gdab/ drug pa la cha bran bzhi btab la bdun pa'i nang rol cha chung gcig gdab bo/ /cha gsum mi gdab/ dgu pa dang bcu pa bcu gcig pa bcu gnyis pa bzhi bzhir gdab bo/ /de nas tshon gye 5thig gdab par bya ste/ lnga pa phyed kyi dang po gdab7/ /de nas gnyis dor gsum pa gdab / / drug pa la yang gdab par bya/ //dgu pa'i nang gi cha 7gcig gdab / /yang gnyis dor la cha 1 gcig gdab/ /yang gnyis bzhag la cha 1 gcig gdab/ /ngos dang 'gram dang ya phubs 'gyur1—// /lhag ma ni ci rigs par sbyar bar bya'o/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa la/ tshangs thig gi phyogs gcig tu bcu gcig pa yongs su bskor bas rtsibs rten du 'gyur ro/ /de'i nang du phyogs gcig gi bzhi pa btab pas ka bar 'gyur ro/ /rtsibs rten gyi phyi rol gsum dor nyu4ba la rtsibs bcu drug tu bya ste/ gtso bo'i gnas pas phyed kyis chung ba nyis 'gyur du bya'o/ /bzhi pa yongs su bskor bas rdo rje'i sa phreng ba'o/ /thig gdab pa'i cho ga'o/ /dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun+da zla 'dra ba/ /zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi phyogs su bcom 34—591

ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad lha kha dog dung dang kun+da dang / zla ba dang 'dra ba la mchog tu phul du byung ba'o/ /dbyibs dang gdan dang rgyan ci zhig ce na/zhal bzhi pa la rdo rje yi/ /seng ge'i gdan la 27bzhugs pa dang / /ting 'dzin phyag rgyar zildan pa dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa bri/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhal bzhi pa la zhes bya ba sgu gcig la zhal bzhi'o/ /de 3yang 'og nas de'i spyan sngar ngan song kun 'dren shar phyogs la gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /seng ge'i gdan la zhes pa seng ge dang pad+ma dang 6zla ba la'o/ /rdo rje'i bzhugs pa dang zhes sbyar ro/ /'dis ni rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par bstan to — / /ting 'dzin phyag rgyar ldan pa dang / /rgyan rnams kun 9snagyis brgyan par bri/ /zhes bya ba ni ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang dbu rgyan la sogs pas brgyan par bri ba dang / gzhag pa dang dgod ces bya ba'i don to/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de'i spyan sngar te/ shar du skyengan song kun sbyong ba'i rgyal po bri ste phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin du bsnol ba shārtekha dog ji lta bu zhe na/ zla ba rgyas dang ba mo'i mdog /rgyan ji lta bu zhe na/ rgyan rnams kun gyes legs rdzogs la / /rgyal mchog skyes bu gang ba bri/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rgyal mchog gang bas mtshan dang dpe byad rang bzhin kyis brgyan par bstan /—la/ snga mas ni gsa'/ ba'i rgyan ston to/ /rgyab tu shākya'i rmerigs dbang po/ /gtso bo thub pa bri bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni nub kyi phyogs su shākya thub pa kha dog dmar po chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can bri bar bya'o/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyogs char ni/ /rgyal mchog rin chen me tog gnyis/ /zhes bya ba ni lho dang byang du'o/ /rin chen me tog kha dog sngon po mchog sbyin gyi saphyag rgya can 7dang / byang phyogs su 34—592

me tog cher rgyas kha dog ljang gu mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya can bri zhing dgod par bya'o—/ /'di dag gi gdan yang glang po che la sogs pa ji skad du bshad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /lo hutsa na dang mā ma shī/ /de bzhin gos dkar sgrol ma rnams/ /rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma bzhin/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun du bri/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas sbyan dang / mā ma gī dang / gos dkar mo dang /sgrol ma rnams rang gi rigs gtso bo'i kha dog dang mtshan ma can dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / ut+pal rnams go rims bzhin du phyag g.yas na 'dzin cing / grwa'i phyogs kun du bri bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' mchog /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /go rims bzhin du bri bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni rtsibs bcu drug pa'i nang thams cad du rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa 'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che ba rnams dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas brtsams te go rims bzhin du bri bar bya zhes bya ba'i don to/ /mkhas pas khā gye la sogs pa/ /mchod pa grwa yi phyogs su bri/ /zhes bya ba 3dkyil 'khor gyi mdog dang / /dbyibs la bya pya bas lā gye la sogs pa 0mchod pa brgyad nang gi grwa dang / phyi rol gyi grwar bri zhes bya ba'i don to/ /sgo yi phyogs ni thams cad du / /zhes bya ba ni shar la sogs pa bzhir / sgo ba bzhi 5ni bri bar bya/ /zhes bya'o/ /rta babs khyams ni thams cad du/6 /zhes bya ba ni kyang zhes bya ba'i don to/ /des ni 3'di ltar 'gyur te/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi rta babs kyi gnas dang / nang gi khyams nyid kyi nang du bri zhes bya ba ste bstan pa'o/ /de nyid bshad pa/ byams pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa 34—3 93

gsungs te nang gi khyams nyid du byams pa la sogs pa bcu drug bri bar bya'o/ /rta babs kyi gnas kyi 1khyams la/ rim pa gsum gyi rang bzhin bri / /zhes te dang po la 'khor ba gcod mdzad la sogs pa bcu drug bri bar bya'o/ /gnyis nga la/ nyan thos rgyal ba thams cad dang / /zhes bya ste/ nyid kyi gcung tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo la sogs pa bcu drug bri bar bya'o/ /gsum pa la nyon mongs 'joms pa 'jigs med gdung ba sel ba la sogs pa bcu gnyis bri bar bya'o / /khro bo mngag pa pho nya rnams/ /bri bya yang na ming yang rung / /zhes bya ba ni khro bo nyid mngag pa yang yin la pho nya yang yin pas de skad ces bya'o/ /bri'am yang na ming 4yang rung / /zhes bya ba ni 'dra muba'am ming de yi ger dgod pa'ang rung ste phyag mtshan du dgod par bya zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'dis ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog bsgom pa ston to/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor 'jig rten gsum snang dang 'jig rten gsum 6'jig go/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor 'jig rten gsum mthar 7byed dang 'jig rten gsum 'dul lo/ /nub phyogs kyi sgor bdud rtsi 'khyel pa dang / be+e con sngon po'o / /byang phyogs kyi sgor mi g.yo mgon po dang rta mgrin bri bar bya'o/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /zhes bya ba ni sngar bstan pa 9de nyid kyi phyi rol du mu ran dkar po bri zhing / de nyid kyi bar du/ gling bzhi po ni bri bar bya/ /'dzam bu'i gling du tshangs pa bri/ /byang phyogs su ni dbang phyug che/ /shar dang nub kyi gling du ni/ /brgya byin gtogs 'dod thams cad kyang / /'khor dang bcas pa bri bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni/ shar phyogs su brgya byin 'khor dang bcas/ lho phyogs su tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas/ nub phyogs su gtog 'dod 'khor dang bcas/ byang 34—59/

phyogs su ma hā de ba 'khor dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gzhan rnams dag kyang de bzhin te/ /zhes bya ba ni/ brgya byin nas brtsams te dbang ldan kyi mthar thug par nye 'khor dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /de nyid kyi 'khor bshad pa lha min zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /lha min zhes bya ba sum brtsegs dang / rab sim dang / te ran ke shu dang / kun du snang ba la sogs pa'o/ /dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung 2la sogs pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding gser mig la sogs pa'o/ /gnod sbyin nor 'dzin la sogs pa'o/ /srin po u ba karni purna 5 dz+wa la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang de bzhin du lto 'phye chen ngo/ dang / yi dwags dang / 'dre rnams dang / klu dang / sbrul dang / ri rnams dang /nga rgyal po chen po /5bzhi rnams dang / gza' dang / 6rgyu skar dang / khro bo mem rungs pa 'tshe ba'i bgegs dang / bi na ya ka rnams dang / sems can kun la phan par 2byed pa'i drang srong skal ba (chen po rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i —bud med rnams dang / srin po / rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / 'byung po bzhi'i nyu lha chen po rnams dang / khyim dang ri dang /kun dga' ra ba dang / nags tshal dang / dur khrod na gnas pa dang /1 grong khyer na gnas pa rnams kyang bri ste ming du gzhag pa dang / phyag rgyar gzhag pa ḍi dang / thig le tsam du bri bar bya ste/ 'khor 'di rnams kyi kha dog la sogs ma bshad do/ /'dis yini 'di skad 7ston pa yin te/ thig btab pa'i rjes thogs la'o/ /tshon gyi las rnams byas nas/ tshon dgye ba sngon du 'gro bas lha rnams gzhag cing 'khor rnams ni ming dang / phyag rgya dang / thig le tsam du bris kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes ston to/ /de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa la 34—595

mkhas pas gzhag ces thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /de yang dkyil 'khor la mchod pa'i phyir/ bla re dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lhab lhub dang /gdugs dang / rnga ma dang / lda ldi dang / 'phan dang / sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang / gser las byas pa'i bya brgyad dang bcu drug gam/ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang rung ba dang / dbang bskur ba'i bum pa rmyechus bkang ba 'a lnga dang / me tog dang / mar me dang / gtor ma'i bum pa dang / mdzes pa'i bshos la sogs pa dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba thulegs par sbyar ba dang / bca' ba sna tshogs pa dang / gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs pa cidang / 'byung po kun dang / klu rnams dang /lha dang / mi dang / mi ma yin gyi kha zas su me tog dang / dri sna tshogs dang / 'o ma dang / mar dang /cho li kha ra dang bcas pa gzhag par bya'o//slob ma dang bdag 6dbang bskur ba'i don du skurnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa 3 dri'i chus rab tu bkang ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyan sngar gzhag par bya'o/ /las thams cad pa'i bum pa ni shar phyogs kyi sgor gzhag par bya'o/ /bum pa lhag ma rnams ni phyi rol gyi 'khor yug rnams la gzhag par bya'o/ /gzhan yang chos klog pa bzhi phyogs bzhir gzhag par bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor kun du legs par bkod nas dgongs ka'i dus nas brtsams te/ de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pas lha rnams mchod pa ston te/ khrus la sogs pa byas nas zhes bya ba ni dang por khrus bya/ gnas bsrung 97rkang pa bkrus te nye reg bya/ sngon du bdag bsrung ba la sogs pa 'gro bas rgyan gdags dris byug /rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas bskor ba bya/ chad pa dang lhag pa zhi bar bya/ sgo phye la zhes 34byed596

bya ba'i don to/ /de nyid dri dang phreng mchog phreng ba can/ /dri zhing tsho/ kha bkang mchog mdzes pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas kyang / /zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ /kyang zhes bya ba'i don ni basbu ba ste/ dang po'i sbyor ba dang /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog bsgoms la/ mchod pa gsang ba bzlas brjod bya/ /hūṃ mdzad thung rgyal kyis kyesgo phye/ /zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yang / me tog thogs te sgo phyogs 'dug /gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi 'khor/ /mang po rnams ni sbyan drangs te/ /zhes bya ba ni gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas dpung par se gol brdab pa byas la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod de spyan drang ngo zhes bya ba'i don to/ /phyag rgya sngags dang bdag ldan pas③/ /lcags kyu la sogs bdag sbyor zhing / /zhes bya ba ni/ bdag phyag rgya dang sngags dang ldan pa'i sgo nas lcags kyu la sogs pa'i 5las bya zhing ngo / /ci zhig spyan drang ༄6zhe na/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ thugs rje'i dza7bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /zhes bya ba gsungs so/ / gsang ba'i bcing ba sabacings nas ni/ /zhes bya ba ni dam tshig dang / chos dang las dang phyag rgya chen po rnams kyis rgyas btab pas / dam tshig gi bcing bas bcings zhes bya ba'i don to/ /phyag rgya gang zhig gis dgug pa la sogs pa'i las bya ba mdzub mo gnyis zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhes rtebya ba ni mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te/ mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ /mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya ba ni lcags kyu'o7/ /mkhrig ma gnyis mdud pa byas pa 1 /zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang / /zhes bya ba'o/ /de la lcags sgrog tshul du bya / /zhes bya ba ni mdzub mo gnyis gdu bur mu bcings pa'o/ /mdzub mo 34—597

gnyis slar nang du bkug nas bskyod par gyur na dbang du 'gyur zhes bya ba ni dril bu'o/ /de nas mtshan ma skyes te mgu nas ni/ /thog ma tha ma med par mngon sum mthong / /zhes bya ba ni/ de nas zhes bya ba ni bar ma chad pa ste/spyan drangs lcags kyu la sogs pas las byas/ bgegs bsal ①mchod pa dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ dbang bskur ba'i rjes thogs nyid la zhes bya ba'i don to/ /mtshan ma byes te zhes bya ba ni/ bsgom 2pa dang bzlas pa bya bar bstan to/ /de'i 'bras bu khyad par mthong nas mgu nas ni/thog mtha' med par dngos po thams cad mngon par shes pa skyes pas mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nas mthong ba la sogs pa'i lha rnams la/ ar+ghas mchog bstabs 4gsang la sogs pa yizhe / /dbyangs snyan pa yi bstod pa'i lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces bya ba ni/ ar+gha khubyin gyis brlabs 0pa dang / gsang ba lā gye la sogs pa brgyad dang / bstod pa rnams dbyangs snyan pas /3'bul zhing / lha rdzas kyi mchog dam pa gong du bshad pa bum pa la sogs pa tshoshernams kyis legs par mchod do zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /'di skad du ston pa yin te/ dang po rdo rje 'dzin ma dang dpal gyi lag / gnyis lta bur bcings nas me tog gi phreng ba thogs te/yid kyis dkyil 'khor du zhugs la chad pa dang lhag pa zhi bar bya/ me tog gi phreng ba dor/ mgo la bcing ngo /11/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ zhes kyang rgyun mi chad par bzlas pa byakhu/ hūṃ mdzad kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas sgo bzhi phye/ khrus byas dri dang phreng ba la sogs pa'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/zhes brjod de stan thog tu 'dug /lce lag pa /snye byin gyis brlab pa nas brtsams 3 4—598

te—/ srung laba'i 'khor lo thams cad rdzogs par bya la/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir nam mkhar 3dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dril bu stong pa'i bdag tu brtag ge pa dang / mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang / sdig pa thams cad bshags pa la sogs pa lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod nas mi snang bar gyur pa dang / bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa mngon du byas nas/ 'og min du byin nas mngon par byang chub pa lngas rdo rje dbyings su bskyed de byin gyis brlab pa dang / dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas te thusnying ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ ngan song sbyong ba pel sogs pa byas nas dkyil 'khor lus la brtags te/ nam mkha'i phyogs su gnas nas/ ri rab dang khang pa brtsegs pa la sogs pa 6bskyed de thabs dang shes rab kyis 1bdag nyid zhu ba las/ kun rig gi skur gyur nas/ thugs ka'i zla ba la lha thams cad bskyed pa las tha mi dad par bsams te bsdu ba sngon du 'gro bas/ phyag dang ched du brjod pa dang / dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas byin gyis brlabs nas yang ched du brjod pa dang / rnal 'byor pas dbang blangs shing 8/ lcags kyu la sogs pas las bya zhing phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab nas/ ngan song thams cad spyong ba'i las la sbyar te/ mchod pa bsangs la bzlas par bya ba brjod cing /hūṃ mdzad kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas sgo phye ste/ gtso bo'i zhusbyor bas sangs rgyas rnams bsdus la/ lcags kyu la sogs pas las byas la/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis bgegs bsal blal/ ra ba dang dra ba byas la— 3 / rdo rje khu tshur gyis sgo bcad de/ bsrung bas brtan 1 par byas la/ mchod yon dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas lha thams cad kyi kredam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / chos kyi phyag rgya dang /34byed599

las kyi phyag rgya dang / phyag rgya chen pos rgyas btab la/ lha thams cad dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya rnams kyis dbang bskur te/ sgom pa dang bzlas brjod mthong 1snang gi bar du byas la mthong ba gsal ba dang / ar+gha a+yo la sogs pa mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang brgyad dang bstod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug la sogs pa rnams kyis sga ra ṇa khaṃ zhes bya bas dbul bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya/ /sems can bkres shing skom —la btung ba dang / /phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /de yi gtor ma ji ltar mthun par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni dngos grub gsol ba'i lha rnams mchod pa de nas 'byung po kun zhes bya ba sems can thams cad kyi dkar gsum gyis 4gtor ma byas te pasems can bkres pa la bza' ba dang zhes sbyar/skom pa la btung ba dang / phyogs skyong phyogs na gnas pa rnams spyan drangs te gtor ma sbyin/ 'khor rnams la de'i gtor ma ji ltar mthun zhing 'tsham par sbyin par bya ste/ de yang phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ 'bras chan me tog chu dang bcas/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ a kā ro zhes bya ba la sogs pas 6byin gyis brlabs nas 'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa las 'byung ba ltar gtor ma sbyin par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nas nye reg dang 'thor 'thung 3byas la/ thab khung du me tog gis 4lha rnams spyan drangs la mar gyi dgang blugs la sogs pa phul la slar spyan drangs te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi 9ba yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub chenyu / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bgyi/ /zhes brjod par bgyi'o / /'di tsam gyes ni slob dpon kyi las kyi cho ga ston to/ /37(—600

de nas sngags pa zhes bya ba la sogs pas kyeslob ma gzhug pa la sogs pa ston to/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /sngags pas bla na med pa'i ge byang chub kyi/ /gnas su slob ma yongs su smin par bya/ /'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub sems/ /de dag byang chub mchog sems bskyed du gzhug /de rnams byin brlab byang chub smon lam gdab/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi chos bsgrags la/ /srung a+yob byas nas brtul zhugs sdom gnas pa/ /zhes bya ba ni 'gro ba la phan pa'i phyir ④myur du byang chub tu 'gyur ba dang 5 / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlab cing bskyed pa dang / sdig pa bshags/ rjes su yi rang bskul/ gsol ba gdab/lam bsgom/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pas smon lam gdab pa dang / lhag par gnas pa'i dus su zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bsgrags la/ srung skud 3btags pas srung ༄8)ba byas nas lhag par gnas pa dang / dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i dus su she1brtul zhugs dang sdom pa la gnas pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rang gi kha nas sngags zlos kyegazhug par bya/ /dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin mar dpal gyi 11lag gnyis sbyar / /me tog rin chen la sogs de brgyan la/ /g.yon gyis lag pa bkang ste gzhug 1 par bya//zhes bya ba ni slob dpon rang gi kha nas sngags brjod cing slob ma gzhug par bya ba dang / dar dang ras dmar pos stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs byas shing mig gnyis g.yogs nas rdo rje 'dzin mar dpal gyi pad+mor lag pa gnyis byas la/me tog la sogs pa'i phreng bas brgyan la yon 'bul du gzhug par bya'o zhes bya 34byed601

ba'i don to/ /gzhug pa'i sngags bstan pa ni sngags ni 'di rnams yin no zhes bya ba nas/ sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar ro/ /de nas sngags 'dis me tog la sogs pa dor bar bya'o zhes bya ba nas sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes bya ba'i bar gyis me tog dang rin po che la sogs pa dor ba bstan to/ /dor nas ci zhig byed ce na/dngos grub tu 'gyur ba ni lha bzung zhing bsgrubs pas 'grub po zhes/ me tog rin chen la sogs pa(1/ /gang la bab pa rigs kyi lha/ /gtso bo'i rigs de bsgrubs nas ni/ /dngos grub 'gyur te the tshom med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas sngags la mkhas pa yis/ /zhes bya ba slob dpon gyis/ sngags 'dis dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sngags 'di rtebarjod pa sngon du 'gro bas sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ zhes bya ba nas/ hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar ro/ /de nas 'dis dam tshig bsgrag par bya'o zhes bya ba nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba'i bar 'di'i don ni/ slob dpon gyi dam tshig bsgrag jepar bya ba dang / 'di ni dmyal ba'i chu yin te/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg 5par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs d+nghan dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ yang cis te dam tshig 'das na sngar zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi sems dpa' gshegs shing khros pas kyang rang gis brtsams pa bu dang tsha bo la sogs pa brlag 7par mdzad de/ skyon de ltar gnas pa de bas na/ rtag tu khyod kyis dam tshig dang bla ma'i bka' mos pas bsrung bar bya'o/ /bsrung bar bya ba de nyid gang yin na srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / brdzun 8dang / 'dod pa log par /shespyod pa dang / chang btung ba dang / sha la sogs pa bza' ba spang / /sems can gnod par sbyor ba rnams kyang mi bya/ dkon 34—602

mchog gsum mi spang / dus kun du byang chub kyi sems dang / snying po dang /sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / lha dang bla ma mi spang / sdig pa'i las mi bya/bla ma'i bka' las mi 'da'/ lha la phul ba'i rnying pa ༄1dang / bla ma'i grib ma dang / phyag rgya'i 2gzugs la mi 'gom/ sngags dang lha la mi smad/gzhan la gnod pa drag po mi bsgul/ mu stegs can la mi smad/ dam pa'i chos la som nyi dang yid gnyis mi bya/ bdag gi de nyid dang snyesngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa la yid gnyis mi bya ba'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'di'i slar yang bsgrub pa'i rim pa thuni 'di yin te/ bslab pa lnga yongs su gzung 5ba'am/dge sbyong ngam dge slong gi sdom pa yongs su gzung 6ba lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du byas pas/ slob dpon gyi zhabs gnyis la phyag byas te 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po de ring bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig chen po de nyid gsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la gsol/ /de nas yol ba'i mthar rdo rje srung 7ba yongs su bzlas pa'i ras shin tu dmar bas stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bskon zhing / sgo srung ru bzlas pa'i dar dkar gyi 1gdong g.yogs bcings la phyag 1 byed du gzhug go/ /mre tog thogs pas yang slob dpon la phyag byas la/ sdig pa bshags pa dang /jes su yi rang ba dang bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa yang byas la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa gsol/ /thub pa'i nyi ma ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba ni/ /slob dpon dpang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las 34—603

byung ba/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i 'byor par ldan/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba'i rigs mtho thams cad du/ /slob dpon bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ /mi ldog pa yi dbang bsgur ba / / skal ba 1chen po bdag la gsol/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rab brgyan cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sgu ni yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol / /dbang bsgur chen po rmad byung 4ba/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ rigs la gsol ba gdab ste/ che ge 5zhes bya 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin pa/ /dam tshig mchog dang gsang ba yi6/ /'khor lo 'dir yang 'jug par 'tshal/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa/ /gsang ba chen po 7'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /des kyang 'tshal zhes 8brjod par bya/ / de nas// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes bya ba nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces bya ba'i bar du brjod par bya'o/ /yang oṃ/ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi zhes bya bas byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho badz+ra sid+dhi 4ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas badz+ra satwa/ zhes zlos shing rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas1 / rdo rje sems dpar byen gyis 1 brlabs la/ rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bzhis 5snying ga la sogs pa bzhir byin gyis brlabs la/ dri dang rnge tog la sogs pas mchod la yon gyi mchog phul te/ phyi rol na gnas pa'i bum pas dbang bskur 34—604

la / sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes bya bas rdo rje 'dzin ma dpal kyi lag pa gnyis su shes par bya ste/ me tog gi phreng ba thogs la/ oṃ badz+ra a bye tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ / oṃ badz+ra pra be+e sha badz+ra hūṃ/ a sa me tri sa me ma hā sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgyas snying gar phye la/ rang gi snying ga na gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus na yi ge a rdo rje dmar po'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba dang ldan par bsams nas/ slob ma'i snying ga na 1gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su blos bcug la lus thams cad gang bar bsams shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byen gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig ces smrar gzhug go/ /de nas sems ma rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med 'di/ /da lta nyid du 'bab par shog /ces brjod du bcug la/ badz+ra a be sha a a a a ā/ lan brgya'i bar du bzlas shing dbab par bya'o/ /de nas snang ba dri bar bya'o/ /me tog gi phreng ba t+t+waṃ pra tīts+tsha ne+ebadz+ra hūṃ zhes bya bas dor5/ yang na/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pas dor ro/ /de nas mgo la bcing ba ni/ /oṃ pra ti kṛt+ta treswa mi saṃ/ satwa ma hā ba la zhes bya'o/ /dam tshig bsgrag tsopar bya ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /zhes bya ba nas/bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba brjod do/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra hā srod gha 8ṭa ya hūṃ zhes bya bas gdong g.yogs dgrol/ oṃ badz+ra pā sh+ya hūṃ zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor bstan/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes bya ba la sogs pas 'jug pa'i phyag rgya 9snying gar dgrol lo1 / /34—605

byedade ltar slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug klepa bshad nas/ dbang bsgur bar bya ba'i phyir mos pa brtan pa 3 dang ldan pas dam bca' zhing / sarba bid kyis ji ltar dbang bskur te/ /bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs pas/ /bcu po rnams kyis dbang bcu ci dgar bskur 4/ /de nas lag tu dril bu rdo rje sbyin / /'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs la/ /mi dbang dbang phyug 'khor lo thogs pa dang / /sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni sdom pa 'dzin pas mos pa brtan pa dang ldan par dam bcas nas//oṃ sarba bid a bye ṣiñca zhes brjod cing / ji ltar gsungs pa'i bum pas dbang bskur zhing / gzhan yang dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs la sogs pa'i phreng ba dang / phyag rgya dang / rdo rje dang / las kyi rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang /thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes rnams kyis dbang bskur ba ji snyed thogs pas/ bcu po rnams kyis dbang bcu ci dgar bsgur ro/ /de nas lag pa g.yon du dril bu g.yas su rdo rje byang chub kyi sems dang stong pa nyid du brtags la sbyin/ 'khor lo rin po che la sogs pa rin po che sna bdun thogs la/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a r+bha ṣiñca zhes brjod cing dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /de'i phan yon ni/ mi dbang dbang phyug 'khor lo ste/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / 'dis ni rin po che sna bdun gyi 'bras bu bstan to/ /thams cad kyi thun mong gi 'bras bu ni/ sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas bka'i dbang bskur ba dang / las kyi dbang bsgur ba yang sbyin te phyis bshad nga ra bya'o/ /de ltar na 5dbang nyi shu rtsa gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir ji lta bu zhig ce na/34—606

'khrud par byed pas brtan par byed pa'i tshobadag nyid kyi ngo bo dang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon la bya'o/ /sngags bsgrub phyi— du mos ldan slob ma la/ /sngags pas bka' ni rab tu bsgo bar bya/ /zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ brtser ldan dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /ces bya ba'i bar gyes sngags bsgrub pa'i phyir slob dpon kyis bka' rab tu bsgo 27zhing / slob mas bla ma la yon phul te dam tshig sbyin pa bstan te go sla ba'i phyir ma bshad do/ /slar yang 'di dag gi don bshad par bya ste/ shar phyogs kyi sgo dang nye bar pad+ma dkar po la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs kyebargyad pa legs par bris la/ de la slob ma rang gis ④lhar bskyed nas/ dri dang / bdug pa dang / me tog dang / lha bshos dang /mar mes yang dag par mchod de/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mo7'don cing / rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa las rdo rje khu tshur gyis chu blangs la/ oṃ sarba bid a bhi ṣiñca saṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis/ spyi bo nas dbang bsgur bar tre bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bum pa dang / shar phyogs kyi ngan song sbyong ba'i bum pas dbang bskur zhing / oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bye ṣiñca hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / gtso bo'i bum pas dbang bskur zhing / budha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ zhes bya ba dang / rin chen tog gi bum pa dang / oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bye ṣiñca t+t+waṃ tsu zhes bya ba dang / shākya'i dbang po'i bum pa dang / oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bye ṣiñca tweḥ(8/zhes bya ba dang / me tog cher 1rgyas kyi bum pa dang / oṃ karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca aḥrngu zhes bya bas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyu las byas pa'i 1 dbu rgyan dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs sam nyu bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gtso bo yin na rin po che'i myu gu/ oṃ badz+ra a bye ṣiñca 34—607

hūṃ / budha oṃ/ rat+na t+t+waṃrmye/ pad+ma hriḥ5/ karma aḥzhes byas pas zhu/ oṃ dang a bye ṣiñca brjod pas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas rin po che la sogs pa'i phreng bas dbang bsgur ba/ oṃ rat+na mā le a bhi ṣiñca tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ oṃ pa ṭa bā lo pa na a bhi ṣiñca tram̐ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya babyungs la/ /rte.oṃ budha mu dra a bye ṣiñca oṃ5tsho/ dbus su'o/ /oṃ badz+ra mu dra a bye ṣiñca hūṃ shar du'o/ /lho nub byang rnams su t+t+waṃ byāḥskye.aḥgazhan 'gre/ phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas dang po'i rdo rje bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra nā ma a bye ṣiñca hūṃ/ oṃ tram̐ hri aḥzhes bya ba brjod de/ ye shes kyi rdo rje'i dbang bsgur ba'o/ /las kyi rdo rje sna tshogs lag tu 3byin la/ oṃ karma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca aḥ8zhes bya bas las kyi rdo rje'i dbang bskur ro/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ rgyuskyo/ oṃ tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ /a bhe ṣiñca oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hri aḥzhes gsum du rigs kyi hwanye /dbye bas brjod par bya'o/ /'khor los dbang bskur ba'o2/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu gnyis 'khyud pa'i tshul du bzung la/ o badz+ra dha ra na thu.a dzha ṣiñca hūṃ/ rin po che'i dril bu rin chen rdo rje dang 'khyud pa/ oṃ rat+na dha ra na a bhi ṣiñca tram̐/ pad+mo'i ⑫rdo rje dril bu dang / pad+ma dha ra na thu.a bhe ṣiñca hri/ sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang / karma dha ra na sa.a bhe ṣiñca aḥ/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i dril bu dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na a bhi ṣiñca oṃ zhes bya ba 1 rigs tha dad pa'i sgo nas thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med par 7dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ zhes brjod de sku'i gsang ba/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñcahūṃ zhes brjod de thugs kyi gsang ba/ oṃ rat+na gu h+ya a bhe ṣiñca tram̐ zhes brjod de/34byed608

yon tan gyi gsang ba/ oṃ pad+ma gu h+ya a bye ṣiñca hri zhes brjod de/ gsung gi gsang ba/ oṃ kadz+re gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca a a a zhes brjod de/ phrin kyelas kyi gsang ba'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang bsgur ba sbyin pa'o/ /de nas chos thams cad ni 3/skye ba med pa nyid bstan cing / oṃ pradz+nyā sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ arngo / zhes bya bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas ras sam gro ga la sogs pa la/ 'khor lo rin po che la sogs pa bdun bris la/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca zhes dbang bskur ro/ /de nas lag pa g.yas par rdo rje byin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /di ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ ④a bye ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes bya bas sbyin par bya'o/ /aḥzhes bya bas dril bu bskyed la sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas gdengs ka'i dbang bsgur bar bya'o—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā dz+nyā te dā si mi kṛṇ+ḍi badz+ra su sidhe ye/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ / rjes su gnang geba'o/ /yang lag tu rdo rje byin la/ las kyi dbang bsgur bar bya ste/ oṃ sarba karma ṇi ku ru bud+dhā nā ma t+t+waṃ zhes brjod de brtul zhugs sbyin no / /de ltar dbang nyi shu rtsa gabyug byin nas slob dpon du 'gyur ro/ /de nas slob dpon dang slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mchod de slob ma rnams yo byad kyis tshim par byas nas bstod cing mchod la dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ste/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bkrol nas gshegs su gsol te/ maṇ+ḍal phyags nas6/ chu bo chen por dor nas bskor ba bya7/ sprul pa'i tshogs 8lus la bsdu 9zhing ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /34byed609

de ltar dbang dang dam tshig thob pa rnams la 7dngos grub la bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don 'di bstan par 3bya ba'i phyir/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zhes bya ba la sogs pa ston to/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin no//bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis/ lha'i 'jig rten dang bcas pa rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig gsungs she na/sgrub — snapa'i cho ga 'di zhes bya ba smos te 'di sgrub pas na bsgrub ③ pa ste/ byed pa'am rgyu'i cho ga zhes bya ba'o/ /ras la zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ ras kha tshar bzang po rin la rtsegs khyapa med par nyos la/ spyin med pa'i tshon rtsi rnams kyis 5bcom ldan 'das kun rig sngar bshad pa bzhin du seng ge'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gye phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bri bar bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs su ngan song spyong ba rgyan kun gyis brgyan pa ba mo'i mdog lta bu ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can bri bar bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs su shākya thub pa mdog —dmar po chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can bri bar bya'o/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i 'og tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mdog zla ba lta bu phyag g.yon na pad+ma bsnam 3pa phyag g.yas pa pad+ma kha ('byed pa bri bar bya'o/ /shākya thub pa'i 'og tu phyag na rdo rje mdog nam mkha' lta bu g.yas na rdo rje bsnams shing thugs kar 'jog la g.yon bsnyems pa'o/ /de gnyis kyi bar du sman gyi lha mdog sngon po phyag g.yon na 'bras bu a ru ra bsnams pa g.yas mchog sbyin can no/ /rta mgrin dang khams gsum rnam rgyal gnyis mdog dmar po dang sngon po rang gi lha la brten 3 4—6sde0

par bri/ de gnyis kyi dzobar du/ lo tsa 3 na dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams rang gi spyan la sogs pa lag tu thogs pa bri/de bzhin gshegs pa ni rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /lha mo ni sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi 'og tu pad+ma'i rdzing bu dang /de'i nang na chu srin dang / nya dang / rus sbal dang / sbal ba dkar po dang / nya 'khar ba dang / dung dang / pir dang / srog chags du ma yod pa dang / de nas chu las skyes pa'i me tog du ma yod pa dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /bdug pa dang / mar me dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang /gos dang / me tog dang/ 'bras bu sna tshogs nga/ bri/ de'i 'og tu sgrub pa po nyid thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul kyis 'dug pa bri/ de nas ri mo'i gzugs de bsnyen pa dang bcas pas mngon par mchod de/ sgrub pa po bdag nyid kyis rab tu gnas par bya zhing mnga' phul/ spyan dbye bar bya ste 'di ni 'di nyid kyi cho ga las shes par bya'o/ /bden pas kyibyin gyis brlab pa dmigs par bya'o zhes bya ba ni bden pa ste spyan dbye ba'o/ /byin gyis brlab par dmigs pa ste mtshan ma la'o/ /de nas ci 4ste mtshan ma zhig mthong na ni myur du dngos grub thob ༄5'gyur ro/ /'on te ma mthong na ni ring mo zhig nas dngos grub tu 'gyur zhes bya ba ni mtshan ma las skal ba 6dang ldan pa dang mi ldan pa'i las so/ /mtshan ma gang zhig yin zhe na/ bzhad pa dang ni rnga sgra dang / /dril bu'i sgra dang 'brug sgra dang / /zhes bya ba mchog gi mtshan ma dang / de bzhin dge slong bram ze dang / /zhes bya ba'i 'bring 7gi mtshan ma dang / 'bras bu mthong na zhes bya ba mtshan ma tha ma las go rims bzhin du myur du mchog dang bar dang 34—611

tha mar 'grub ces bya'o/ /de nas gzugs de zhes bya ba la sogs pas bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa dang dngos grub ston te/ gzugs byin gyis brlabs te zhes bya ba ni / ye shes sems dpa' bcug pas so/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te ༄1dbang bskur nas zhes pa'i 3don to/ /ci bdog pa yis mchod par bya/ /rtag tu mngon sum 'dug nas kyang / /zhes bya ba ni mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod cing / rnal 'byor kyis dus su rgyun mi 'chad par spyan sngar 'dug ces ston to/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag srung 1la sogs byas nas kyang / /bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing / /zhes bya ba ni hūṃ bzhi'i sngags kyis bdag srung sgob dang / khrus kyi cho ga sngon du 'gro bas/dkyil 'khor lus la brtags pa'i mthar thug pa byas la 'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug /dngos grub mtshan ma ma 3 byung bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas 6dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /brgyad brgya nyid du tshang bar bya/ /sngags ni 'khral 'khrul med par bzlas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gnas dbe+en par snga ma nyid kyi cho gas brgyad brgyar sngags gug skyed dang / tsheg bar tsul sogs pa chad lhag med par bzlas zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de ltar bsnyen pa bstan nas/ de nas bzlas pa'i mjug tu ni/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams (cho la/ /mchod pa rgya cher byas nas kyang / /mtshan gcig thog thag bzlas pa shebya/ /zhes bya bas sgrub pa bstan te/ bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i mjug tu dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin du bsams la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang ldan pas mtshan thog thag bzlas brjod byas nas 'bras bu bstan pa ste/ ci saste gtso bo'am de yi sras1 / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas ston to/ /ci ste gtso bo 7dang byang chub sems dpa' 377byed6/2

dang 'jig rten pa mthong ba las dngos grub rab 'bring gsol ba gdab lkupar bya ste / phyag 'tshal nas dngos grub blang bar bya'o/ /gal te 'bring ngam tha ma'i dngos grub mig sman la sogs pa yin na lcebla ma dang dkon mchog la skal ba re re phul nas lhag ma bdag spyad/ dbul ba'i zhing med na bdag nyid kyis spyad/mchog gi dngos grub yin na/ sems can la phan par brtson par ༄ bskal pa du mar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste dngos grub 'thob na las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur te/ gnod sbyin rgyu skar gdon la sogs pa tshig tsam gyis bran bzhin du zhi ba la sogs pa'i las byed par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don to/ /sdig pa chen po byas pas sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa thabs sla bas grol ba bstan pa'i phyir/ de nas zhes pa la sogs pas bstan to / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byen gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sdig pa bgyis pas sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa rnams ji ltar na dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal spang ba'i slad du bsgrub par bgyi zhes bya ba ni shi ba rnams ji ltar sbyang zhes pa'i don to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po nyon cig /sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems can sdig pa chen po byed pa de dag ci nas kyang sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las thabs sla bas grol bar 'gyur ba nyon cig ces bya ba ni nyon la zung shig 5pa'i don to/ /thabs de nyid/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /de ltar yang na bum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni 34—613

rab tu brtag /ces bya ba sngar bshad pa bzhin du/ bsnyen pa dang sa'i cho ga dang / lha rnams mchod pa la sogs pa byas nas/ bum pa la sngags bzlas te/lho sgo'i cho ga sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor du bcug cing sngar bshad pa bzhin du dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de'i 'bras bu/ de nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /dmyal ba la sogs sdug bsngal las/ /de ni myur du thar bar 'gyur / /sdig las rnam par gol bdag nyid/ /dag par gyur pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /rigs su skye bar gyur nas kyang / /de ni rtag tu sangs rgyas dang / /chos 'gro ba ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas/ /rim gyis 1byang chub 'thor bar ge'agyur/ /zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /de yang ci zhig las dbang bskur zhe na/ de yi gzugs brnyan bri ba 1ni/ /gur gum gyis ni ming byang rus/ /zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ngan song kun gyi 'jigs chen las/ /sems can rnams ni dgrol ba'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ su zhig gis she na/ sngags mkhan gzhan la phan brtson zhing / /snying rje can kyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /des ni thabs dang po bstan to/ /gzhan yang / de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas de dbang bsgur/ /lha yi gzugs su brtags nas kyang / /mchod rten dbus su gzhag par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni gzugs brnyan la sogs pa mdun du gzhag la/ lce dang lag pa byin gyis brlab snyepa nas bzung ste srung 5ba'i 'khor lo dang / nam mkhar dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ ji lta ba'i go rims kyis 6mngon par byang chub pa mngon du byas nas/ phab ste dkyil 'khor bsre ba byas la /8 gzugs brnyan la sogs 3 (byed6/4

pa la 'od zer gyis shes pa bcug ste/ sdig pa 'joms pa la sogs sngon du 'gro bas rang gi snying gar ji lta ba bzhin du bcug ste/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas byin gyis brlabs la/ sngags dang phyag rgyas dbang bskur te mchod rten gyi dbus su gzhag par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ / thabs sla ba gnyis pa'o/ /rmyegazhan yang /④ rang gi lha'am lha gzhan kyi/ /snying po snying gar bris nas kyang //lha 'dra bar ni sems bskyed de/ /khyim gyi nang du gzhag par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni dbang dang dam tshig thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa shi bar gyur na/ shes na rang gi lha'i snying po snying gar bri/ lha dang 'dra bas sems kyis brtag /ma shes na lha gang yang rung ba'i snying po snying gar bri/ lha dang 'dra bas kyesems kyis brtag /khyim mam dur khrod dam mchod jepa'i nang du gzhug depar bya ste/ 'di ni thabs sla ba gsum pa'o/ /gzhan yang / de nas smos nas ni/ gur gum bzang pos sngags bris la/ /rim gyis ⑥'bum ni tshad tsam du/ /mchod rten las ni rab tu bya/ /sdig can sdig ni zad bya'i phyir/ /bye ba snyed ni tshang bar bya/ /des ni nges par dmyal gnas nas/ /de byas pas ni grol bar 'gyur/ /yi dwags byol song sdug bsngal las/ /grol nas lha yi nang du skye/ /zhes bya ba ni/de'i ming nas brtsams te/ sngar bshad pa'i sngags/ oṃ sarba bid ces bya ba nas/ bha zhes bya ba'i mthar thug pa gur gum bzang pos ras sam gro ga nag por ne+ebyas pa la 'bum tshang bar rtsa t+ya 9byas te/ mchod rten gyi las bya'o//sdig pa zad —par bya ba'i phyir/ /bye ba snyed du gdab par bya'o/ /de ni dmyal ba dang byol song dang yi dwags las gol te lha'i gnas su skye'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'di'i don ni cho ga nyid las shes par bya'o/ /thabs bzhi pa'o/ /34—615

gzhan yang / de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /'bum phrag stong ngam yang na ni//brgya phrag stong du tshang ba dang / /bye ba snyed du rab bzlas na/ /lha yi gnas su skye bar nges/ /zhes bya ba ni sbyor ba dang po dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las kyi rgyal po mchog dang / sgo dbye ba sngon du 'gro bas de'i ming thog mar smos te/ gong du bshad pa'i sngags 'bum phrag stong dang brgya phrag stong tshang ba dang / bye ba snyed du bzlas te dkyil 'khor chen po la mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas mtshan thog thag bzlas na lha'i gnas su nges par skye zhes bya ba'i don to/ /thabs sla ba lnga pa'o/ /de nas gzhan yang / de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya 'am ni/ /yang na stong phrag brgya snyed du/ /sbyin sreg byas par gyur na ni/ /zhes bya ba ni/ thab 1khung ji lta ba bzhin du brkos te/ rdzas gzhag cing bsang ba byas nas rang lhar bskyed de/chos kyi yi ge las thab khung byin gyis brlabs la/ bha dang sha bkod pa'i gebud shing brtsigs te rgyun bzhag gi me spar nas me lha spyan drang ba sngon du 'gro bas dgang blugs la sogs pa phul te 'bar ba dang tha mi dad par 'gyur ba'i me lha'am / yang na me lha'i snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' la dgang blugs la sogs pa phul ba sngags dang ming spel te/ til kyi sbyin sreg ce mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya'am/ brgya phrag stong snyed du sbyin sreg byas la/ lha rnams gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga byas nas ni zhes bya ba'i 5don to/ /de'i 'bras bu ni / dmyal ba chen por gyur pa yi/ /sdig pa de las thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya'o/ /yang dus ji srid du zhe na/ /ji srid mtshan ma shin tu ni/ /'bar ba'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma yang dag 'byung bar du/ /31byed6/6

zhes bya ba de srid du'o/ /rdzas ci zhig ce na/ til dang yungs kar 'bras rnams dang / /ba yi 'o mar ldan pa dang / /dri yis bskus pa'i yam shing gis/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sdeg pa las thar pa'i mtshan ma ni/ de nas stide ni nges par yang / /lha yi gnas su skyes gyur zu nas//de yi mtshan ma ston par byed/ /yang na lha yi mchog tu 'gyurage/ /yang na hom khung nang du ni/ /me yi ltas ni ston byed cing / /lha yi gnas su skye ba dang / /sdig pa bcom pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /dkar po nyid dang g.yas su 'bar / /gyen du 'bar zhing dri ma med/ /zlum zhing rnam par mi 'phro 'al/ /brtan la glog ⑥ bzhin dri ma med/ /yang na me lha nyid kyis ni/ /bdag nyid de nyid ston dzabyed cing / /zla ba dri med dkar 'dra la/ /gzhan shemadog dkar zhing lham ༄khyemer 'bar/ /des na mtshan ma 'di dag gis/ /dmyal ba la sogs rnam grol zhing / /sdig pa bcom nas bde 'akror ni/ /skyes pa yin par shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni thar pa'i mtshan ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don toge—/ /thabs sla ba drug pa'o/ /gzhan yang / khru bzhi pa yi tshad du ni/ /cho ga bzhin du brkos pa tshel/ /rdo rjes mtha' mar bskor ba /rteyi/ /'khor lo dbus su bri bar bya/ /rigs lnga yi ni phyag rgya rnams/ /ji bzhin pa yi phyogs su bri/ /ji bzhin sems dpa' rnams kyang ni/ /'jig rten rtse la sogs pa bri/ /zhes bya ba ni dang por stegs bu'i tshad khru sum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa brtsigs la/ khru bzhi pa'i smad du zabs su khru do pa'i tshad kyi khung bu brkos la/ sor bcu drug pa'i phyi rol du sor bcu drug yod pa'i mtho dman dang tre ldan pa de la rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phreng bas bskor/ de'i dbus su 'khor 34—617

lo rtsibs brgyad pa rdo rje rtse gsum pas bskor ba kye)bri/ lte ba la sogs pa (2 rnams su rigs lnga'i phyag rgya rnams shar la sogs pa ji bzhin pa'i phyogs su rim pa /1bzhin du bri/ de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi rdo rje la sogs pa bri/ de'i phyi rol grwa dang sgo rnams la/ lā su 4dang lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bri/ khyams kyi nang du byams pa la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bri/ phyi rol gyi khyams la rim pa dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa sal rdo rje la sogs pa dang / par bu dang gseg shang dang / 'khor lo rnams bri bar bya'o/ /sgo rnams la khro bo'i phyag mtshan rnams bri bar bya'o/ /'jig rten gtso dang ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma trernams kyi thig le dang ming du bri bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yang bya dang bum pa gang ba dang / gtor ma'i snod 3rnams bkang ba brgyad dam tsubacu drug snyed tsu)dag gzhag 7 /bza' ba dang bca' ba'i bshos dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / bla re rgyal mtshan dang / dar dang lda ldi rnams gzhag par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor dam par sbyin sreg gi phyir gzhag pa yin no/ /cho ga shes pas bris nas kyang / /lha rnams mang po spyan drangs pa/ /zhes bya ba ni cho ga shes pas phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bris nas te/ thugs kyi rang bzhin ston cing dngos po mtshan ma bsreg ༄ 1pa ni thugs gtsor gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /kyang zhes bya ba ni lhag chad zhi ba sngon du 'gro bas ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / bzlas brjod byed cing sgo dbye ba basbu'o/ /lha rnams mang po spyan drangs pa ni/ bsdu zhing lcags kyu la sogs pas las rgya'os //sngags shes pas ni sngags phyag rgya/ /ar+ghaṃ 7phul ba shes sapas kyang / /zhes bya ba ༄ 7ni mchod yon dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab dbang 3(byed6/8

bskur bas kyang zhes pas ston to/ /mdor na mchod pa byas nas ni/ /zhes bya ba ni sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa bsnyu na mchod par 'dus pas de skad ces bya'o/ /lha yi sbyor bas rab gnas la/ /zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'o/ /de ltar 3 sbyin sreg gi tshe na lha rnams mchod nas rdzas bstan pa'i phyir/ ga bur gur gum la sogs paphya/ /mar dang 'o ma til bsgos la/ /nas — dang yungs kar 'bras rnams la/ /dri yi chus ni legs bkang ste/ /'bras chan spod rgedang la du dang / / sbrang rtsi kha rurar ldan de bzhin/ /brgya phrag du mar yongs bzlas la/ /yam shing la yang de bzhin te/ /rang gi sngags kyis btab pa'i shing / /khung bu'i nang du gzhug par bya/ /zhes bya ba la rdzas de rnams kun la oṃ sat+tha zhe bid ces bya ba nas/ bha zhes bya ba'i bar gyi sngags brgya phrag du mar bzlas shing / sngags de nyid btab pa'i shing la bha dang sha dzabakod pa mchod rten gyi dbus su brtsig par bya ba'i don to/ /kyero'i bya ba bstan pa'i phyir/dang po re zhig ngan 'gro las dgug cing sdig pa sbyangs la/ bye ma dang nyungs kar gyis sbyangs te khrus byas la/ yang sa stegs sngon po'i steng du gzhag pa las bum pa sngon pos bkru zhing mgrin tsuris dang lam bstan te me tog gi char phab la/slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du dkyil 'khor du bcug la bum pa la sogs pa bsdus te/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang kyepad+ma la bzhag nas rang gi lhag pa'i lhar bskyed de/ chu mchog gis ༄ bkrus la dris byug cing rgyan sna tshogs pa btags la sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug pa la sogs pas bdug cing mchod pa'i khyad par gyis mchod pa ni1 / ro la sngags kyis btab nas ni/ /chumachog gis ni bkru bar bya/ /bzlas pa'i dri yis byug par bya/ /gos dang 34byed619

rgyan gyis bklubs 2nas kyang / /sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug pas bdug 4 /me tog phreng ba sogs pas mchod/ /ces bya ba 'dis ༄1bstan to/ /de 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ gtsug phud dpung par de bzhin du/ /sngags bri bas thuni gdags par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni sngags bris pas gdags pa thumador bstan to/ /snying ga lkog ma kha phyogs su/ /sat+tha bid kyis byen gyis brlab/ /ces bya ba ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ sat+tha skyebid badz+ra a bye tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūṃ/zhes bya bas snying ga lkog ma'i phyogs la sogs pa rnams su byin gyis brlab pa ste snye mdor bstan pa'o/ /sngags bri ba dang byen gyis brlab pa gnyis bshad pa ni/dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis/ /mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis/ /sna dang rked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna yi kyertse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba yi/ /dbang po rnams kyi gnas dang ni/ /de ltar gzhan du yi ge sngags / /mchog tu dge ba rnams bshad do/ /zhes bya ba ni/ gnas bco brgyad du 'god pa ste/ /yi ge zhes bya ba bha she7dang sha'o/ /sngags zhes bya ba tsosarba bid la sogs pa'o/ /mchog tu dge bar byed pas na de skad ces bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nas ro bsreg pa'i nyu1rang lhar gyur pa tsam zhig lus pa'i phyir ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir lhar bskyed pa ste/ 'dis ni kun sdob mi 'gag pa dang don dam par mtshan ma las 'das pa shes par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /yang na don dam par shes par bya ba'i phyir/ skra dang thal ba la sogs pa bsreg /— /pa'i rdzas su dbul ba ni/ rgyud phyi ma las ston to/ /de nas lhar bskyed de/ de nas ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir/ /stan dang bcas te thab dbus su/ /bzhagapa nyid du bya ba yin/ /de nas sngags 'chang sngags kyis ni/ /btab pa'i gos 37—620

kyis g.yogs 1par bya/ /zhes bya ba yin no/ /me dang mchod pa'i bya ba bstan pa'i phyir de nas byin rlabs 4zhes bya ༄ la sogs pa smos te ro dbus su bzhag la 4 de nas byen za dge ba rgyun bzhag gi me blangs la/ rlung yab kyis sbar la rang gi chos kyi yi ges chothab khung byin gyis brlabs te mar gyis sbar la/ byin za de yang ji lta bu yin zhe na/ me lce stong gis dkrigs shing sku'abar ba'i lus su gnas pa la zla ba ltar dkar zhi ba'i lus so/ /bsams pa'am zhe na mtha' yas pa'i me bkug la zhes bya ba'o 7/ /de nas ar+ghas mchod/ blo ( 5mchog ldan pa'i mdun du gzugs mchog gzhag /'bras bu 'thob par 'dod pas rnge tog gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs la/ mchod yon sngon du 'go bas mchod pa lngas mchod de/ de nas me lha la bsreg 3bya rnams kyis mchod par bya rtse ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas bsreg ( bya rnams kyis lha thams cad la brgya rtsa brgyad dang ⑫/ gtso bo la nyi shu rtsa gcig brtag /de nas me lha gtso bo la sogs pa gshegs su gsol te yo byad lan gsum gsum dbul/ de nas phyag na rdo rje pad mi dkar zhal/ ar+gha yo/ la sogs pas mchod de/ de yang phyag na rdo rje dang pad+ma 'dzin cing gnyis kyis zhags pa bsnams pa/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi gzugs zhabs kyi pad+mo 57dang ma hā de ba u ma de ba dang bcas pa mnan pa rgyan ༄ sdogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can bsams 1shāsam yid kyis bris pa'ang rung /rte/ de'i snying po hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / tshe 'das pa shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru zhes bya ba dang til gyis na sbyin sreg byas nas/ stong ngam bye ba'i tshad du'am/ mtshan ma byung ba tshode srid kyi bar du sbyin sreg byas la/ sdig can kyi rgyud dag par shes nas me lha'i phyag rgya dgrol de gshegs nas me lha mchod de bzod par gsol 34—621

de nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pa bya ba bstan nas thal ba'i bya ba bstan pa'i phyir/ de nas thal bar gyur pa dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /zhes bya ba saṃ ha ra na lkubadz+ra zhes bya bas so/ /cho ga bzhin du bsdu bar bya/ /thal ba de dang rus pa rdul/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i dri chu dang / /ba skyes 'o ma la sogs lngas/ /spyong ba'i sngags kyi blo ldan gyis/ /'bum du bzlas pa brjod nas ni/ /ga bur dri dang bsgos pa yis/ /'dag pa dang ni bsres nas kyang / /gzugs su bya ba'am yang na ni/ /mchod rten gyi ni lhar byas nas/ /gcig gam gnyis sam gsum mam lnga/ /yang na brgya rtsa brgyad du'am/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas 3 btab nas kyang / /'bum phrag nyis brgya'i bar du bzlas/ /zhes bya ba la gzugs su zhes bya ba sgu gzugs su'o//sngags dang phyag rgyas btab ces bya ba spyan dbye ba byas 1nas zhes bya ba'i don to//de'i mtshan ma ni/ de nas mchod rten 'bar 'gyur tam/ /zhes bya ba la sogs te de lta bu mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don to/ /ci ste mtshan ma de dag ni/ /sdig can blo yis ma mthong na/ /zhes pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa rgyud ma dag pas ma mthong na'o/ /'bum gyi phrag ni brgya stong ngam/ /ji srid mtshan ma byung bar du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod nas ni/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bzla bar bya/ /de yi mthar ni mkhas pas kyang / /mtshan gcig 5thog thag mi nyal bzlasaskye/ /zhes bya bas ni sdig pa shin tu che bas dang po dang gnyis pa la mtshan ma 7ma mthong na 'bum phras brgya bzlas brjod byas te mtshan thog thag mi nyal bar bzlas zhes bya ba'i don rto/ /sgrib pa shin tu chung ba rnams ni ro bsreg pa'i dus su'o/ /sdig pa can rnams ni 'bum phrag nyis brgya'i dus na'o/ /34—622

shin tu sdig che ba rnams ni 'bum phrag stong gi dus na mtshan ma byung na/ de'i rmyesdig pa nyid dag par mthong ste lha'i lus su gyur la rang gi rgyud ngo 5shes na de byams ③pa dang / snying rjer ④ldan pas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don to/ /thabs bdun pa'o/ /de ltar yang phyero yod pa'i dbang du byas pa bshad nas/ da ni ro med pa'i dbang du byas pa'i thabs bstan pa/yang na med par gyur na yang / /bzlas shing bsgom pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /ming tsam legs par bris nas kyang / /mchod rten phreng ba bya ba dang / /yang na gzugs su bris kyang rung / /sbyin sreg mngon par dbang bskur nas/ /zhes bya ba ni bzlas shing zhes pa snebazlas brjod dang / mchod rten phreng ba'i gzugs su bya/ /sa tsha hūṃ dang / sbyin sreg bya ba ming bsreg pa dang / sbyin sreg 3 mngon par dbang bskur na/ /zhes bya ba mchod rten gyi dbus su gzhug pa dang /khyem du bzhag pa dang / dbang bskur ba nyid dang bdun ro hūṃmed kyang 'grub 0 pa'o zhes bya bar ston to/ /snga ma bzhin du 'bras bu ni/ /gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ /zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang thal ba nyungs kar bye ma sogs/ /zhes bya ba thal ba dang nyungs kar dang / bye ma dang me tog la/ rang gi ming smros sngags btab nas/ /zhes bya ba la ming nas thog mar smos te ro la sogs pa la bya ba byas nas/ song nas kyang phyi'i rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de'i 'bras bu/ de ltar na 'ang sdig can yang / /ngan 'gro las ni thar 'gyur na/ /zhes bya ba dman pa 1 yang thar bar gsungs na zhes bya ba'i don to/ / 2mchog rnams smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ / 0 dge ba'i mchog ni bskyed pa dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /sdig pa 34—623

nges pa can rnams ni thabs cis kyang mi grol bar dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed par zhes bya ba nas/ bde gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs/ /zhes bya ba'i bar du ston to/ /de ltar thabs brgyad hūṃ ston to/ /thams cad kyang thabs sla bas grol bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa la brgya byin la sogs pas bka' sprul pa bden pa nyid du byas nas nor bu dri ma med pa thar te dga' ldan du skyes nas grags pa chen po'i lha dang sa7bcas pas de bzhin gshegs pa la tshe 'di nyid la mchod pa'i phyir sems bskyed de/ lha rdzas sna tshogs kyis dga' ba'i tshal kun du gang bar byas so/ /lha'i bu ni ma mthong la /byelha rdzas mthong ba rnams kyis ya mtshan che bar gyur nas/ 'di ci lags thuzhes ngo mtshar che bar zhus pa dang /bka' stsal pa dri ma med pa'i 'od yin no/ /zhus pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /lha rnams kyis kyang zhus pa/ dkon mchog la khyad par can du bsngags khyenas lta bar 'tshal lo / /zhes gsol ba btab nas 'od kyis snying bskul te 'od mi snang bar gyur nas / rdzu 'phrul chen pos dga' ba'i tshal snang bar byas nas/ bla ma gnyis ma gtogs pa zil gyis mnan nas sna ched du brjod do/ /pad+ma sgra snyan pa 'byin pa byung ba dang ya mtshan skyes te/ bsam yas brjod nas lta bar 'tshal rtsozhus pa dang bla ma'i 8sgyu'od kyis snying bskul te 'od mi snang bar gyur nas/ bla ma gnyis ma gtogs pa thams cad g.yos te ngo mtshar che ba'i don zhus pa/ khyad par lnga'i mchod pas mchod de mi snang bar gyur te zhes bya ba ste/ nor bu dri ma med pa dga' ldan du skyes pa bstan to/ /de nas brgya byin dang zhes bya ba la sogs 34—624

nas bag yod par sgrubs 1shig ces bya ba'i bar gyis 2thams cad la phan pa'i phyir rgyud gtad pa bstan/ de ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud phyag rgya chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la sogs pa'i gtso bor gyur pa bstan pa'o/ /ci'i phyir rtsa ba'i rgyud du mdzad ce na/ lha thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs dang / phrin las dang / yon tan dang lnga/ rtsa bar 4dang por ston pa dang 5ldan pas na rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya'o/ /6de yang ji skad du/gsang ba lnga ldan gang yin pa/ /dang po nyid du bstan pas na/ /de ni rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya/ /zhes 7gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir rgyud ces brjod ce na//rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /'khor ba rgyud du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas rgyun chags pa'am/ 'khor ba'i phyir rgyud 8ces bya'o/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan nas / de 9ni de nas zhes bya ba la sogs nga/sa rgyud phyi ma ston te/ 7byu'i phyir phyi ma zhes bya zhe na/ snga ma las byung zhing de nyid gsung ba sbas pa shes pa'i phyir rgyud phyi ma zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ phyi ma snga ma las byung ste/ /de nyid gsungs pa 1 sbas shes pa//rgyud ni phyi mar brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dis rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma ni dga' ba'i tshal 'di nyid du gsungs par shes par bya ste/ mi'i yul du bab 2pa la sogs pa la khyad par ma bshad pa dang / phyis 'dzam bu gling gi ris nyu/'di nyid na zhes gsungs pa rgo/ ri rab kyi lho phyogs la dgongs pa dang / yang phyis ming sadang rjes yi rang ngo zhes bya ba gsungs pa ni/rdzu'aphrul gyi mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa yin pas sprul pa'i sku mthong ba'i phyir 34—625

'gal ba med pa kho na'o/ /la la dag gnas gang du 'chad pa de dag gis bshad pa'i 1lung brjod dgos te/ lung med pa kho na nyid yin te/ de nyid kyis gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs pa ni shin tu sgog tu 2snagyur pa'i phyir mi 'thad —pa nyid do/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni dang po'i spyor ba'i rjes thogs la'o/ /'dir dang po'i spyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgo rtsa ba'i rgyud du bshad pa las phyag na rdo rjes sngar bshad pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par dang bcas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba ni/ ye shes kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyag gi mthil na gnas pa bzhin du 'dzin pa'am phyag na rdo rje nyid 'dzin pas de skad ces bya ste nges so4/ /'di gsungs so zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /ji ltar gsungs she na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus zhes bya ba gsungs te sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 5kyis so/ /ci zhig gsungs she na/ brtag pa'i rgyal po phyi ma 'di/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ brtag pa'i rgyal po pha rol tu phyin pa drug byang chub kyi sems dang bcas pa yin la de ston pa la yang de skad ces bya ste/ji skad du/ sems can kun gyi don bya'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed nas / /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa dag / brtan pa rtogs )pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /brtag pa phyi ma 'di zhes bya ba ni sngar bshad pa 'di lta bu 'di'o/ /gsungs so zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi mthus bka' stsal to//'dis ni phyag na rdo rje bshad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gsungs pa'i phyir bka' nyid du rnam par gzhag pa gsungs so/ /gdul bya rnamasakyi bsam pa la dgongs nas de skad ces bshad kyis don la tha dad pa yod pa ma 3 (—626

yin no1/ /dpa' bo 2gdan la bzhengs nanas kyang / /dgyes shing rdo rje gsor nas ni / /shākya'i bdag po dgyes mdzad pa/ /thub pa'i gtso la phyag btsal nas/ /zhes bya ba ni gnyis su med pa'i dpa' bo gtso bo la gus pas zla ba dang pad+ma'i gdan rang dang 'tsham pa las bzhengs nas byen kyis brlabs pas 5dgyes shing bgegs zhi ba dang / bar chod kyis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje bsor nas kyang / shākya'i bdag po sems can gyi don la dgyes par mdzad pa thub pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal nas zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'dis ni gsang sngags kyi sgo'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis kyang bgegs zhi bar byas nas gnang ba thob nas 'jug pa bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas zhes bya ba ni sgrib pa thams cad de mchod zupa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa'o/ /rnam par dag pa rdo rje zhes bya ba thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin no/ /de la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang de skad ces bya la/ de la snyoms par zhugs pa ni mngon du mdzad pa ste/de lta bur gyur nas zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /'dis ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bsgom 8pas zla ba'i dbus su thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid du zhugs nas gtso bo bskyed de/ phyag rgya brjod pa dang sngags brjod pa dang bcas pa bstan pa'o / /ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i rang gi snying po'i 9'di thugs ka nas phyung ngo zhes bya ba la/ ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyong ba ni 'dir gtsug tor ro/ /rang gi snying po zhes bya ba ni de kho na bskyed pa la bya'o/ /'di nyid kyi thugs ka nas phyung ngo zhes bya ba ni sgra'i rang bzhin 'og 1 nas 'byung ba 'di nyid kyi thugs nges pa can ye shes las bton zhes bya ba'i don to//34—627

'dis ni sgom pa po rnams kyis gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags bkod de 'khor thams cad bskyed do/ /ston pa'i sngags nyid badz+ra hūṃ 1phaṭa ces bya ba ni rdo rje gtsug gi'o/ /oṃ sat+tha pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba nas brtsams nas / oṃ ma te sat+tha tir+ya ka ga ti te rtu hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba bco lngas bteg 5pa'i sngags ston to/ /de nas de dag gi yo byad rnams bshad do zhes bya ba ni/de dag gi zhes pa 7dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi'o/ /yo byad rnams zhes pa gsol ka ba dang bran la sogs pa rnams kyi'o/ /bshad do zhes bya ba bzlas pa'i sngags rnams gsungs so/ /de nyid oṃ sat+tha a pa ya zhes bya ba nas t+t+waṃ phaṭa ces bya bas ston to / /dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bskyed pa ni/ rgyud gzhan dang 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / phyi ma'i bde ba chen po'i 11bshad pa las shes par bya ste/ rasgot+ta ma tram̐ pad+mot+ta ma dīḥ/1 bi shot+ta ma a zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnams kyang / na mo bha ga wa te sat+tha durga ti zhes bya ba la sogs pa rtsa ba'i rig pa dang bcas pa'o/ /des ni 'di skad du ston te/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog sgom pa po rnams kyis ni shākya thub pa'i thugs kar thun mong dang khyad par gyi sngags bkod de/ rdo rje gtsug tor nas brtsams nas rdo rje dril bu'i bar du bskyed ces 1 bya ba'i don to/ /sprul pa'i dus su mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i mthus ji ltar 'dod pa ltar snang ba yin no/ /de nas basbu zhing byin gyes brlab pa sngon du 'gro ba nas brtsams te/las kyi rgyal po mchog ni snga ma bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum bstan zin to / / 537—628

thabs de la 'di nyid du dbang dang dam tshig thob pas 'jug par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don 'di bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pas slob dpon gyi las dang slob ma gzhug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga ston to/ /de nas zhes bya ba ni sngon du bsnyen pa'i rjes thogs la'o/ /gzhan yang sa bzung ba dang lhag par gnas pa dang 1bcas pa yang de nas zhes bya bas ston to2 / /dkyil 'khor bshad de zhes bya ba ni thig gdab pa dang rdul tshon bri ba'i gzugs can gyi dkyil 'khor bshad ces bya ba'i don to/ /'khor lo 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la / /zhes bya ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi gnas gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa kha khyer dang ldan pa la sogs pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor byas la zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'dis ni/ dkyil 'khor la ni 'khor lo bshad/ /ces bya ba legs par /4'gyur ro/ /de'i nang du 5ji ltar bri zhe na/ shin tu mdzes pa'i rtsibs brgyad can/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs rten can/ /nang gi rim pa dz+res nas ni/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa dang lte ba dang rtsibs rten dang sum rim du bris nas rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bskor ba bri zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de'i nang du ci zhig dgod ce na/ lte ba'i nang du shākya yi/ /dbang po thub pa bri bar bya/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen ni/ /dpa' bo de yi spyan sngar bri/ /rgyab tu 'khor los sgyur ba bri/ /g.yas su rgyal po gtsug tor la/ /g.yon par rnam par rgyal ba bri/ /gzi brjed phung po me yi phyogs/ /dbang po'i phyogs su gdugs dkar po/ /rnam par 'thor ba rlung gi phyogs/ /rnam par 'joms pa dz+re tir bri6/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te lte 34—629

ba'i dbus pad+ma'i lte ba la shākya thub pa/ pad+ma re re bor ba'i gzhi she la rdo rje la sogs pa'i shar phyogs su rdo rje gtsug tor/ lho phyogs su rgyal ba'i gtsug tor/nub phyogs su pad+ma'i gtsug tor/ byang phyogs su sna tshogs gtsug tor/ shar lho mtshams su gtsug tor gzi brjid/ lho nub mtshams su gtsug tor rgyal mtshan / nub byang du gtsug tor rnon po/ byang shar mtshams su gtsug tor gdugs dkar bri bar bya'o/ /'khor lo 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /zhes sngar bshad de/ bshad pa phyi rol bri bya ste/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /seng ge rta babs brgyan par bya/ /zhes bya ba gsungs pa ste/ phyi rol gyi gnas 2gru bzhi dang sgo bzhi dang bye seng ge dang glang po che dang rta babs dang kha khyer la sogs pas brgyan par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /phyi rol gyi gnas rnams su dgod pa ni/ dpa' bo lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu snyan rnams gzhag /grwa yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /bdug pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te dpa' bos shar phyogs kyi sgor lcags kyu/ lhor zhags pa/nub tu lcags sgrog /byang du dril bu rnams gzhag /nang gi grwa'i phyogs mtshams su ni lā gye dang phreng ba dang glu mkhan ma dang gar mkhan ma dang bzhi gzhag par tre bya'o / /phyi'i grwa bzhir bdug pa ma dang me tog ma dang mar me ma dang dri chab ma rnams shar lho mtshams nas brtsams te bri bar bya'o/ /khyams la/ byams pa la sogs 5bri bar bya/ /zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor legs par bkod nas chad pa dang lhag pa zhi bar bya ste dkyil 'khor du zhugs la me tog gi phreng ba dor te sgo bzhi phye la/ khrus byas shing lus dri zhim po la sogs pas byugs nas rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan te/9 lce dang lag pa byin gyis 34—630
