snying ga'i dbus su ni/ /btso tsho bo'i rgyal po bsgom par bya/ /de nas rgyal ba'i thugs ka ru/ /zla dkyil dbus su sngags kyi gzugs/ /de las 'od zer 'phros byas pas/ /gdug pa gang yin thams cad la/ /phog pas de dag kun bkug nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas de dag dbrog /de sogs thabs kyi thabs kyis ni/ /khams gsum sdug bsngal sbyang bar bya/ /de las grol zhing thar byas nas/ /'od zer gyis kyang phog byas nas/ /snying gar dgug gzhug byas nas ni/ /rim pas dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba tsam gyis/ /srid gsum sems can ma lus kyang / /rgyal sras kun dang mnyam mthong nas/ /drin lan tshul du mchod par bya'o/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun rig la'o/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin las / /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /ngan song thams cad spyong mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal spyod pa'i rgyal po la'o/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gyis/ /sems can bsam pa skong mdzad pa/ /rgyal mchog rin chen 2khyod phyag 'tshal/ /so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag /gsung rab pad+ma kha rgyas pas/ /khams gsum dbugs 'byin rab mdzad pa/ /shākya'i /1rigs dbang khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nan tan ye shes phrin las bdag /sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus par ni zhi bar mdzad/ /me tog kun rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun du yang / /rigs kyi yum gyi skur bstan pa/ /lha mo spyan dang mā ma tī/ /dkar mo sgol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na/ /34—1043

bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems la sogs/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /'bras bur ldan la rgyud bzhin bstod/ /sgeg mo phreng dang glu dang gar/ /spos dang me tog mar me dang / /dri chab la sogs brgyad mchod pa/ /phyi nang lha mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgo yi khyams kyi nang bzhugs pa/ /byams pa la sogs bcu drug kyang / /dang po dga' sogs sa gnas shing / /'gro ba'i don la rtag gnas pa/ /sems can kun byams rang bzhin can/ /snying rje blo mkhyen 'jam pa'i dpal/ /shes rab blo chen spos glang po/ /nyon mongs 'joms pa'i ye shes tog /rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan bzang skyong / /shugs kyis kun skyong 1don yod mthong / /tshogs gnyis yongs bsags blo mi zad/ /stobs bcus yongs gnon spobs pa brtsegs/ /mi shes ri 'joms mthu chen thob/ /gzung 'dzin kun 'byin 2ngan song 'dren/ /nyon mongs mun sel mya ngan 'joms / /lha yi gzugs 'joms dra ba can/ /lus ngag spyod dag zla ba'i 'od / /bsam pa mngon rtogs bdud rtsi 'od/ /nam mkha'i nor 'chang nam mkha'i mdzod/ /'jig rten kun phan kun du bzang / /rnam thar —bzhi ldan sems dpa'i gtso/ /sa gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /twa ra ṇa 4 yi khyams bar na/ /dpe bral sems dpa' bcu drug ni/ /sa dang pha rol phyin grub pa/ /rigs kyi dbang gis bzhugs pa ni/ /'khor ba gcod mdzad ngan song 'joms/ /mi shes gsal 5byed mun pa sel/ /ngan song 'dren mdzad sdug bsngal 'joms/ /nyon mongs 'joms pa srid mtsho sgrol/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar/ /sems dpa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dgos 'dod skong ba rin chen mdzod/ /dam chos 'phel mdzad dge blo gros/ /chos 34byed10/4

smra don mthun yid du 'ong / /rgyu 'bras kun dran dran 1stobs mchog /yon tan rang bzhin rin chen bsngo/ /re skong 2tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos kyi don 'byung dge 'byung gnas/ /snod bcud 'bras ston legs pa'i tog /khams gsum thams cad srid mtsho sgrol/ /'bras bu kun 'byung bde ba 'byung / /gsung gi rang bzhin pad+ma dmar/ /gsung rab kha 'byed rnams la bstod/ /yid myur brtson 'grus mi ldog pa/ /bskrun med tshad med yon tan mdzod/ /mu stegs rgol 'joms the tshom myur/ /rgyu 'bras shes smra nga ro snyan/ /phrin las rang bzhin rgya gram ljang / /don mdzad rigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rab tu byung nas tshul khrims sdom/ /ston pa'i rtags 'chang nyan thos mchog /phyag na po ti bar sreg/ shang // /sku mdog ma nges tha dad pa/ /nyid gcung tshe ldan dga' bo dang / /sku yi sras gyur sgra gcan zin4/ /shes rab mchog gyur shā ri'i bu/ /'dri zhing lan lon chomachog rab 'byor/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba mod gal bu/ /khyem pa dad skyed 'char ka bzang / /'phrul gye spyan ldan ma 'gags pa/ /dam chos thos mnga' trekauṇ+ḍa byi/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa nye ba 7'khor / /spyod mdzes bdud 'dul rta thul ba/ /ting 'dzin dbang thob ba lang bdag /zhabs sa'abring rtag mdzad kun dga' bo/ /shākya'i skra 'dreg ming chen po/ /bslab pa kun 'dzin nor sbyin 'dzin/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan gang po/ /zhal ta'i sku bgres pa 'od srungs/ /bslab sbyangs yon tan kun ldan pa/ /nyan thos 5/mas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rten 'byel don la brten gnas pas/ /'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis la/ /nyon mongs 'joms byed gdung ba sel/ /ting 'dzin gsal ba snang ba brtsegs9/ /34—1015

'khor ba sreg pa 'jigs 1par byed/ /'khor bas mi bsnyengs dpa' bo 'dul/ /shes pa'i rtsal ldan shes rab mgyogs/ /'khor rlung mi bskyod ri bo rgyal/ /gsung gi sgra dang ldan sgra chen/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig bse ru ba/ /nyon mongs skyon 'joms dug sel 'joms/ /cho 'phrul ldan pa rdzu 'phrul ston/ /'jigs pa kun bral seng ge'i sgra/ /ting 'dzin gsal byed yid myur ba/ /'byung dang bzlog la rab zhugs pa/ /rang rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi rol sgo yi nang gnas pa/ /khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can/ /sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan pa/ /stag lpags kyis ni smad dkris shing / /khams gsum gsal byed 'jig rten snang / /gdul dka' 'dul ba gsum 'dul ba/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dang / /dbyug to 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma rungs sdig byed gsum 'jig pa/ /ma rungs 'joms byed gsum mthar byed / /yon tan rang byung 4rtse gsum dang / /be con bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dgos pa sgrub thumadzad bdud rtsi 'khyilahūṃ/ / srid pa 'joms mdzad be+e con sngo7/ /gsung gi rang bzhin rgya gram dang / /ral gri 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nyon mongs g.yo med mi g.yo mgon/ /dbang gi rang bzhin rta mgrin rgyal/ /phrin las rang bzhin ral gri dang / /pad+ma 7bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /mu ran dkar po'i nang gnas pa/ /gling bzhi po ni bri bar bya/ /shar phyogs lus 'phags zla gam na/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byin ni/ /mchan na bde sogs la sogs 9pa'i/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho phyogs 'dzam gling sog / ka na/ /'jig rten mes po tshangs pa dang / /btsun mo tshangs ma 34byed1046

pho nya mngag /yid 'ong bcas ①la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nub phyogs glang spyod zlum po na/ /lha chen dbang phyug chen po dang / /mchan na dka' zlog la sogs pa'i/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang phyogs che rgyas gru bzhi na/ /lha chen gtogs 'dod khyab 'jug dang / /mchan na dpal ldan la sogs pa'i/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khor yug nyid la gnas pa yi/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po la/ /'khor dang bcas la bstod pa ni/ /mche ba drug pa thumadog dkar ba'i/ /glang chen de ni brgya byin gdan//rol pas 'dug pa gur kum 'dra/ /mchan na sha tsi u pa si/ /dbang phyug chen po biju dang / /z-iṅgi ri ti zudaga' byed dang / /gzhon nu smin drug tshogs kyi bdag /stobs bzang legs ldan la sogs bstod/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i rgyal po ni/ /ma he'i gdan can g.yon dkur brten/ /mchan na nag mo 'chi bdag mo/ /be+e con g.yas na 'dzin pa ste/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ma dang ni/ /nam gru ma dang nag mo dang / /rdo rje lu gu rgyud sogs bstod/ /nub phyogs ngos kyi chu lha ni/ /lus mdog dkar zhing ser ba dang / /sbrul gyis lus brgyan chu srin gdan/ /zhags pa rin chen bsnams pa ste/ /mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang / /karko snyeṭa dang ku zhwali ka /nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong dang / /pad+ma chu bdag la sogs bstod/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin rgyal po ni/ /gser gyi mdog 'dra rin chen dang 3/ /g.yon pa snye ma rta yi gdan/ /mchan na chung mar bcas pa ste/ /yang dag shes dang 'brog gnas dang / /nor bu bzang po dzam+bha la/ /gang ba bzang po ku be ra/ /pa ñci ka dang nor lha'i rgyal/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /me 34—1047

gzugs kha dog drug ldan pa'i/ /dkyil na chung ma dang bcas pathu/ /lus dmar ba la ra skyes gdan/ /gun+dhe dbyug pa 'dzin pa ste/ /me bzhi dang ni nag pa dang / /yang dag shes dang mdun bdar dang / /gya gyur 'gyur med a gur 2dang / /g.yon 'dor la sogs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho nub mtshams kyi bden bral ni/ /yi dwags gdan can dmar nag mdog /me 'bar ba ni g.yon na 'dzin/ /g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin pa ste/ / lang ka 4mgrin bcu me stag dang / /u pa karje pur+ṇa thu dang / /'jigs shing gsod byed la sogs bstod6/ /nub byang rlung lha'i rgyal po ni/ /nam mkha'i mdog can sha ba'i gdan/ /ba dan gyen du bsgreng ba 'dzin/ /g.yon pa rlung sgye'u thogs pa ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad sgra gcan 'dzin/ /sum brtsegs kludang ni rab sim dang / /lha min he ran ke shu dang / /kun du snang sogs pa — phyag 'tshal bstod / /byang shar 'byung po'i bdag po ni/ /thal ba'i mdog 'dra rta yi gdan / /g.yas gnyis rtse gsum a mra dang / /g.yon gnyis gubye rag sha phreng / /ri dwags rgyal dang skem byed dang / /brjed byed dang ni khu tshur can ⑨/ /nam gru srul po dza mi ka /'dod pa can dang ma dga' byed/ /bzhin bzangs sko dang ni gnya' lag can/ /bya gzugs mig 'chang 'joms skyopa po ma mo la sogs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khor yug gi ni phyogs bzhi na/ /bar na gza' tso rnams brgyad gnas pa/ /pa ba sangs dang mig dmar gnyis/ /shar na gnas shing 'khor rnams skyong / /smin drug snar ma mgo dang lag /nab 15so rgyal skag la sogs bstod/ /phur bu dang ni nyi ma gnyis/ /lho na gnas shing 'khor rnams skyong / /mchu dang gre dang dbo 6dang ni/ /me bzhi nag pa sa ri 3 7byed/0/8

dang / /sa ga la sogs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zla ba sgra gcan nub phyogs na/ /gnas shing rang gi 'khor skyong ba/ /lha mtshams dang ni spyon dang snrubs/ /chu stod dang ni chu smad dang / /byi bzhin dang ni gro bzhin tekye/ /nub phyogs gza' skar 'khor bcas bstod/ /gza' lhag spen pa byang phyogs na/ /gnas shing rang gi 'khor skyong ba/ /mon gru dang ni mon gre dang / /khrums stod khrums smad nam gru dang / /tha skar dang ni bra nye dang / /gza' 3skar tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni khor yug gi/ /mtshams na lto 'phye gnas pa ni/ /rab brtan dang ni khyus 'gro dang / /sbrul mgo shar gnas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dge ba'i bar du gcod pa'i bgegs/ /gnye'u thung spyi'u gtsug be+e min kyeta/ /dar dpyangs 4dang ni mu rgan dang / /'dre tshogs lho gnas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' lding rgyal po nub phyogs na/ /mkha' lding gser mig ga ru ḍa/ /g.yog mang du ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'byung ba bzhi yi lha chen po/ /smin par byed pa me yi lha/ /snyud par byed pa chu yi lha//g.yo bar byed pa rlung gi lha/ / brtan par 5byed pa sa yi lha/ /phyogs bzhir gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kun snang dang ba khyem gyi lha/ /rab brtan blo gros ri yi lha/ /kun nas 'od zer shing gi lha/ /kun du blo gros kun dga'i gyelha / /sna tshogs sgo ni nags tshal lha/ /'byung po dge ba dur khrod lha/ /dge ba'i blo gros grong khyer lha/ /lha tshogs sbud pa 3phyag 'tshal bstod/ /las dang mthu stobs cher grags shing / /dri za grul bum klu rnams dang / /gnod sbyin rnams la dbang sgyur ba/ /dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung —/ /gtsug phud lnga pa la sogs shebastod/ /grul bum rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /grul bum 34byed1049

sna dz+wa1mig la sogs bstod/ /klu yi rgyal po spyan mi bzang / /klu chen 'khor dang bcas la bstod(2/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin nor 'dzin sogs phyag 'tshal/ /phyi yi khor yug phyi mtshams na/ /rgyal ma ④ rnam rgyal mi pham pa / / mkha' 'gro ma dang sha za ma/ /༄lta rig sngags 'chang rnams 6phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shin tu mi bzad sdug bsngal ba'i/ /dmyal ba rnams dang yi dwags dang / /byol song mi yi 'gro ris dang tsa/ /khor yug sa steng gnas par bgyis / /de ltar bstod pa'i rgyal po yis/ /sngags pas bdag gi snying ga'am/ /mdun du dkyil 'khor bstod byas te/ /rdo rje dril 'dze+en rdo rje brjod9/ /de nas phyi nas bdag lus las/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /de ltar bsgoms mchod stod ( ༷byed pa/ /dang po'i sbyor ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po'i spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //de nas chos rnams dngos med par/ /thams cad stong pa nyid du ni/ /sems kyis 11bsgom pa byas nas kyang / /gong ma de las ma nyams trepar/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /sa bon dbus su dam tshig rgya/ /bsam zhing de bzhin sgrub pa pos/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul bsgyur te/ /phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin brlabs1 / /rlung dang me chu de dkyil du/ /gser kyi sa gzhi bsgom par bya/ /sum̐ las ri rab chen po bsam/ /rin chen bzhi las grub pa yi / /rgya ni yangs pa gru bzhi la/ /de dbus sdig pa sbyong ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor dge ba bsgom par bya/ /rja salas gzhal yas khang pa ni/ /mdzes pa brtsegs pa bsgom bya ste/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /twa ra na bzhis brgyan pa dang / /mu khyud lte ba rtsibs ldan pa/ /sgo glo sgo khyams thams cad dang / /34—1050

de dag grwa la bsam pa ni/ /rin chen rdo rje mtshan ma dang / /dril bu dar 'phan do shal dang / /phreng bas rab tu klubs pa dang / /dra ba dra phyed mdzes brgyan pa/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis brgyan pa la/ /gru bzhi pa ni bsam par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /pad+ma'i 'og dang seng ge'i gdan/ /de steng zla ba'i dbus gnas pa/ /mi dmigs thugs rje thabs nyid detsho/ /chos sku mi gnas snying rje'i ngang / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas/ /'gro ba bdag sems don du ni/ /'byung ba'i rgyu ni sngags kyi gzugs/ /kun rig rgyal po sprul par bya'o/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha de2/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne+e sna/shudhe bi shur+bhe/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shudhe swā hā/ sngags kyi rgyal po de yis ni/ /gtso bo bdag po rjes dran nas/ /sgrib 'joms rnam thudag ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms 'jug sngags ni ched brjod bya/ /des ni ngan song gsum po yang /pad+ma kha bye mu7bzhin du grol/ /de nas bdag gi snying ga ru/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /sngags rnams rab tu brjod nas su/ /ngan song sbyong ba nas brtsams te/ /rdo rje dril bu'i bar du bskyed/ /bskyed pa'i sngags ni 'di dag go/ /na mo bha ga ba te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya arta te saṃ myak+shi bud+dhā thuya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ne+e 7/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne+e 97swā hā/ zhes sngags de brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rim pa de yis ni/ /lha rnams gang yin dbyung bar bya/ /oṃ sho dha de tsosho dha de11 /sarba a pā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags rang gi snying gar bsgom par bya ste/ kun nas 'od zer sna lnga ni/ /rang gi sgo nas dbyung bar bya/ /sngags kyi 'od zer snang ba yis/ /khams gsum 'gro la phog byas pa/ /ngan song sdug bsngal zhi 34—1051

bar bya/ /'od de slar yang snying gar 'dus/ /sngags dang 'od zer 'dus byas pas/ /gzugs rdzogs bsgred nas dz+re bar bya/ /mdun phyogs pad+ma zla ba la / /de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song sbyong / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi don du / /snying las spros nas gzhag par bya/ /zla ba ltar ni snum pa la/ /ba mo'i mdog ltar dkar ba yi/ /sa gnon phyag rgya yang dag ldan/ /glang po'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /gong gi bye brag thams cad kun/ /'od zer 'phro 'di'i sbyor ba yis/ /thugs las byung ba'i lha tshogs hūṃpa/ /rang rang sngags las sku sprul bya'o/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e 3—sho dha ya/ sarba a pā yā s+t+waṃ / g.yas su rin chen me tog ni/ /mchog sbyin rgya can rta la gnas/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan nyid du/ /mdog sngon thugs las spros nas dgod/ /oṃ sho dha na sho dha ya sarba a —pā ya hriḥtre/ rgyab tu shākya thub pa ste/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya yang dag ldan—/ /rma bya'i gdan la yang dag gnas/ /pad+ma'i dbus thugs spros nas dgod / /oṃ sho dha ne+e 4sho dha ya sarba a pā ya aḥdzo/ /g.yon du me tog cher 5 rgyas te/ /sgu ljang mkha' lding / la gnas lakye/ /skyabs sbyin rgya can pad zla yi//dkyil na thugs las phyung ste gnas/ /hūṃ t+t+waṃ s+thā aḥ17bzhi po las/ /lha mo spyan dang mā ma tī/ /dkar mo sgrol ma rnam pa bzhi/ /rang gi rigs bzhin dbyung bar bya/ /hūṃ dzaḥhoḥ12dhu bzhi po las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po las / 2 / /rdo rje chags pa legs pa bzhi/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' khu tshur/ /pad zla'i dbus thugs la ni dgod/ / t+t+waṃ bye bh+ri hā mibazhi po las/ /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje 'od/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rdo rje bshad/ /pad zla'i tshadabus na rin chen dang / /nyi ma rgyal mtshan so bsnams pa/ /thugs las phyung nas dgod par bya//34—1052

hriḥbyeḥrmyesum̐ bha bzhi po las/ /rdo rje chos dang rjon po dang / /rdo rje 'khor lo smra ba rnams/ /pad+ma ral gri 'khor lo ljags/ /thogs 3nas zla pad gong ltar dbyung / /shaṃ ram̐ k+ṣ-i saṃ bzhi las ni/ /las dang srung dang gnod sbyin brten / /rgya gram go cha mche khu tshur/ /de kun sna tshogs pad+ma dang / /zla ba'i dbus su shes par bya'o/ /hūṃ t+t+waṃ dz+rīḥ.aḥchozhes bya bas/ /sgeg mo la sogs rnam bzhi po/ /phyung nas gra'i chocha rnams la/ /pad gnas zla ba'i gdan la dgod/ /spos la sogs pa bzhi po yang / /sgeg sogs rnams dang mthun pas na9/ /phyag sogs gdan sogs brtag pa'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ s+thā ra pa ri shud+dhā zudharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shudhe ma hā na ya pa ri bā ༄ re swā hā/ sngags de yis ni dbyung bar bya/ /byams pa la sogs sems dpa' rnams/ /pad+ma zla ba'i dbus dag tu/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /byams pa 'jam dpal spos glang po/ /de bzhin ye shes tog dang bzhi/ /klu yi me tog gubye dang / /at+pal spos glang rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /bzang skyong don yod mthong ba dang / /blo gros mi zad spobs brtsegs bzhi/ /rin chen 'bar ba pad+ma bum/ /pad tog rin chen brtsegs pa rnams/ /mthu chen thob dang ngan song 'dren/ /mya ngan kun 'joms dra ba can/ /za ma tog dang lcags kyu dang / /be con rin chen dra ba 'dzin/ /zla ba'i ༄9'od dang bdud rtsi 'od/ /nam mkha' mdzod dang kun du bzang / /pad steng zla tshes bum pa dang / /be con snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /ngan song sbyong dang mun pa sel/ /sdug bsngal 'joms dang srid mtsho sgol/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje dkar 'dzin te/ /pad+ma zla ba'i dbus na bzhugs / /rin chen mdzod dang dge blo gros/ /don mthun yid 'ong dran 37 ‘—1053

stobs mchog /yon tan rang bzhin rin chen 'dzin/ /pad+ma zla ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /dge ba'i 'byung gnas legs pa'i tog /srid pa'i mtsho sgol bde ba 'byung / /gsung gi rang bzhin bde ba 'dzin/ /pad+ma zla ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /brtson 'grus mi ldog yon tan mdzod/ /the tshom yid myur nga ro snyan / /phrin las rang bzhin rgya gram 'dzin/ /pad gnas zla ba'i dbus na bzhugs / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbazhi yis ni/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /dril bu bsnams nas pad zla yi/ /dbus na sems dpa'i skyil lhakrung bzhugs/ /de ltar rnam par bsgom pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ting 'dzin no/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis pa'o// //de nas las kyi rgyal mchog ni/ /gsang ba sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba ngan 'gro las skyabs 3—phyir/ /zhe sdang la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /ye shes lnga yis ngang bcom ste/ /dmyal ba yi dwags byol song sogs/ /dkyil 'khor kun du bzhugs pa yis/ /'bras bu ngan song las thar mdzad/ /rigs kyi dbang gis kun sdob 4pas/ /so so re re gsung ba minamu/ /des na las kyi rgyal mchog go/ /las kyi rgyal mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsum pa'o/ /na mo bha ga ba te sarba durga ti zhwapa ri sho dha ne+e dz+warā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te saṃ myak+shi bud+dhā rwa—ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne+e kyesho dha ne+e sna / bi sho dha ne+e nyu 1bi sho dha ne+es/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne+e 7shudhe bi shudhe sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne+e ⑫swā hā/ lha rnams 7kun gyi sngon du ni/ /sngags de shin tu brjod par bya'o//de nas sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /go rims 7bzhin du bshad par bya/ /thugs rjes bskul ba'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /34byed1054

dam tshig phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /bsdams pa rdo rje las byung ste/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya la gnas pa/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rig pa'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa gung gnyis bsgreng / /mthe bong mthe'u chung gnyis gyen brkyang / /mdzub gnyis pad+ma ltar bkug pa/ /ngan song rnam par sbyong ba po1/ /de las mdzub 1gnyis rin chen byas/ /rin chen tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /mthe'u chung mthe bo so sor mnyam/ /lhag ma brkyang ba shākya thub/ /de las lag g.yon dkur byas la/ /mi 'jigs sbyin par bya ba ni/ /phyag rgya 'di ni cher rgyas kyi'o/ /bcings pa mdzub gnyis mig tu bya'o/ /chung ngu srin lag nang du bsnol/ /gung mo mnyam par bgreng ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni yin par gsungs/ /sbyar ba gung mo gnyis bsgrengs nas/ /mdzub gnyis ngos la sbyar byas nas/ /rtse gsum tshul du byas pa ni/ /mā ma shī yi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa thal mo sbyar ba las/ /gung mo pad+ma 'dra ba lasazu/ /phyag rgya 'di ni gos dkar ma'orja/ /sbyar ba gung mo gnyis bsgreng la/ /mdzub gnyis rgyab nas dkris byas te/ /mthe bong gung sbyar at+pa la/ /phyag rgya 'di ni sgrol ma'o5/ /phyag rgya rdo rje bsnams 6pa las/ /mdzub gnyis rdo rje brkyang ba ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de las mdzub mo g.yas bkug pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de las mdzub mo gnyis mnyam ste/ /dang po bcag pa chags pa'i 'o/ /de las mdzub gnyis slar bkug ste/ /se gol gtogs tsapa legs pa'i 'o/ /de las bar ma'i tshigs bcag pa/ /rin chen rdo rje gang yin pa'o/ /de las sor mo 'od zer ltar / /bkyed 5pa rdo rje gzi brjid do/ /de las spyi bor bzhag pa ni/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan phyag rgya'o/ /de las phab nas kha ru ni/ /bzhag pa rdo rje bzhad ( 34—1055

pa'o / /bcings la mdzub gnyis pad+ma ltar/ /phyag rgya de ni chos kyi'o/ /mdzub gnyis dang po'i tshigs bcag pa/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rnon po'i'o/ /mdzub gnyis gdu bu ltar byas pa/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgyar bshad/ /de las mdzub gnyis pad+ma yi/ /'dab 'dra byas pa smra ba'i'o/ /de las mdzub gnyis bskyed 1byas pa/ /las kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de las mdzub gnyis par bkyed de/ /mgrin par 'khyud pa bye bsrung ba'o/ /de las rtse mo slar bkug ste/ /mche ba ltar byas gnod sbyin no/ /de las mdzub gnyis nang bkug ste/ /rab tu bsdams pa khu tshur ro/ /rdo rje bsdams pa dam byas pa/ /mthe bong gnyis gshibs sgeg mo'i'o/ /de las kha las ④mdun du ni/ /lag pa brkyang ba phreng ba ma'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba kha drung nas/ /phar drang ba ni glu ma'o / /gar las rdo rje thal mo ni/ /spyi bor bzhag pa gar ma'i'o/ /bsdams pa thur blugs bdug pa ma'o/ /bsdams pa gyen gtor me tog go/ /mtheb bsnyams mdun 5'dzin mar me'o/ /rdo rje bsdams kyang 6byug dri'o/ /mdzub gnyis bkug pa lcags kyu'o/ /mdzub bkug rtse sprad zhags pa'o/ /mdzub gnyis 'khyud pa lcags sgrog go/ /rab tu bskyod pa dril bu'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings byas te/ /mdzub mo dbus ma rab mnan nas/ /me tog tshul byas byams pa'o/ /de las 7ut+pal ltar byas pa/ /'jam dpal gyi ni yin par bshad/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur brten nas/ /glang chen po yi tshul lta bur / /g.yas pas 8byas pa spos glang po/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur brten nas / /g.yas pa dku ru bzhag nas su/ /rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ye shes tog /lag gnyis snying ga'i phyogs nyid du/ /pad+ma dgyes 9snapa bzang skyong ngo / /34—1056

bsgreng nas mdzub mtheb 'khyud pa ni/ /don yod spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de las mdzub mo rin po che/ /'bar ba ltar byas blo mi zad1/ /g.yon pa lte bar bzhag nas su/ /de steng g.yas gzhag spobs pa brtsegs / /snye ma rin chen za ma tog /mthu chen thob pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcing ba las/ /mdzub mo brkyang bar byas pa ni/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten nas/ /g.yas pa be con tshul byas pa/ /mya ngan kun 'joms phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gnyis 4bcings te/ /go cha'i tshul du bcings nas su/ /nu ma gnyis la bcings pa ni/ /dra ba'i 'od kyi phyag rgya'o / /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten nas/ /g.yas pa khu tshur glo ru yang / /mthe bo mthe'u chung brkyang byas nas/ /zla tshes tshul byas zla 'od rgya/ /lag pa gnyis kyis bum pa ni/ /'dzin tshul bdud rtsi 'od kyi'o/ /snying gar g.yon pa'i khu tshur gzhag /g.yas pa steng bskor nam mkha'i mdzod/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur brten nas/ /rin chen khu tshur g.yas pa ste/ /kun bzang dam pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa thal mo sbyar ba las/ /gung mo srin lag rtse mnyam bsgreng / /mthe chung gnyis ni nang du gzhug /mdzub mo gnyis ni bkug byas la—/ /mthe bong gnyis ni de ngos la/ /bcar ba byang chub spyi yi'o/ /thal mo mnyam du sbyar ba las/ /snying gar bzhag pa nyan thos kyi'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur nang bstan te/ /mdzub mo mje bong rtse sbyar bsgreng / /g.yas pa srin mjeb sbyar bsgreng sprad/ /rang rgyal rnams kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa dam bcas la/ /mdzub mo mje'u chung gshibs te bsgreng / /mje bong ngos bcar gsum snang gi'o/ /de nyid las ni mje'u chung gnyis/ /bsnol ba 'jig rten 3sgyu7—/057

gsum 'dul gyi'o/ /de gnyis las ni mthe bong gnyis/ /nang du bcug pa gsum 'jig go/ /de nyid las ni mthe'u chung bsgreng / /snga ma bzhin byas gsum mthar byin1/ /de las mtheb gnyis rtse sprad de/ /bgreng ba mi g.yo mgon po'o/ /de las gung gnyis gshibs te bsgreng / /chung gnyis nang du lug rgyud sbrel/ /mdzub mo dang ni srin lag gnyis/ /gshibs te bgreng ba bdud rtsi 'khyel/ /de las mdzub mo gung mo gnyis/ /snga ma bzhin du gzhag byas la/ /lhag ma bsnol ba be con sngo/ /de nas namadzub mo gshibs te bsgreng ༄ / /lhag ma 'od zer 'phro byas pa/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /dam tshig phyag rgya de dag kyang / /phal cher bsdams pa las byung bas/ /bsdams pa las ni bcing bar bya/ /de ni dam tshig phyag rgya'o/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya bsnams4 / /mdor bsnyus rab tu bshad par bya/ /g.yon pa lte bar gzhag pa la/ /g.yas pa rdo rje 'dzin tshul ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /ngan song spyong ba la sogs bzhi/ /sa gnon mchog sbyin ting nge 'dzin/ /mi 'jigs la sogs go rims 5bzhin/ /bsgyings nas rdo rje dril 'dzin dang / /lcags kyu g.yas na 'dzin pa dang / /mda' 'phangs tshul dang se gol dang / /mdzub mjeb phrad par 'dzin pa dang / /khu tshur gshibs pa nyi ma'i'o/ /khu tshur g.yon thogs gru mo gzugs/ /kha yi phyogs su gzhag pa'o/ /g.yas kyis g.yon pa 'byed pa dang / /ral gri gnyis kyis dpung par 'dzin/ /khu tshur gshibs 7te snying gar bskor / /kha yi thad ka nas drangs 9dang / /khu tshur gnyis ni gar byas te/ /'gram pa g.yas g.yon gzhag par bya/ /de nas yang bskor spyi bor gzhag /spyi bor bgrol 1 ba las kyi'o/ /khu tshur go cha'i 11tshul 34byed/038

byas dang / /de las mthe chung mche ba dang / /khu tshur gnyis ni mnan pa'o/ /de las dku g.yas g.yon pa las/ /bzhag nas 'gying kyib sgeg mo'o/ /phreng ba 'dzin pa phreng ma'o5 / /kha nas 'byung tshul glu ma'o/ /gar du byas pa gar ma'o / /de las khu tshur thur du ni/ /blugs ༄ la spos ltar 'dug 4pa'o/ /gyen du 'thor ba me tog go/ /mdun du gshibs pa mar me'o/ /khu tshur rtse sprad brang la ni/ /nyug pa de ni dri chab ma'o/ /khu tshur gnyis kyi rgyab sbyar la/ /mje'u chung mdzub gnyis so so ru/ /'khyud pa de ni lcags kyu'o/ /de las mdzub gnyis rtse sprad la/ /gdu bur byas pa zhags pa'o/ /de las gung mo mtheb sprad la/ /lu gu rgyud ltar byas pa las/ /lhag ma bsnyus pa lcags sgrog go / /de las mdzub gnyis 'khyud pa la/ /khu tshur mnan bskyod dril bu'o/ /de bzhin phyag mtshan med pa dang / /gnyis su phye ba byas pa ni/ /byang chub sems dang nyan thos dang / /rang sangs rgyas pa thams cad kyi/ /las kyi phyag rgyar shes par bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin tshul dbyug to 'phyar/ /rtse gsum be con rgya gram dang / /dgra sta ral gri pad+ma bsnams5/ /khro bo las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lce la pad zla'i dkyil nyid du/ /gong bu /6bstan pa'i sngags de dag /bkod nas bzlas pa byas pa ste/ /chos kyi phyag rgyar bstan pa'o/ /ji ltar bstan pa bsgom pa dang / /phyag rgya phyag mtshan 'dzin pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya che zhes bya ba yin/ /de la 7phyag mtshan med pa ni/ /las kyi phyag rgyar 8shes par bya/ /mthe bong mthe'u chung rtse sprad de/ /lhag ma gsum ni rdo rjer byas/ /de ni brgya byin phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa 9pad+ma kha 'dzums / 7dang / /g.yas pa'i gung mdzub bsgreng bas ni/ /smrang 'don 34byed/059

ltar byas tshangs tshopa'o/ /g.yon pa rab tu bgrad de bsgreng / /g.yas pa rtse gsum gtogs 'dod do/ /pi wang g.yon logs yul 'khor srung / /mthe bong mthe chung sbyar byas 'phags/ /mdzub mo zhags pa srun mi bzang mthe bo ne+e'u le'i sna 2'dra ni/ /rnam thos sras kyi yin par bshad/ /g.yon pa thod pa thogs pa ltar/ /sor mo yid bsdus dbang phyug go/ /thal mo khong stong sbyar ba las/ /gung gnyis bsgreng la mdzub gnyis dgug /mthe bong steng bzhag lha rnams so/ /g.yas pa be+e con ltar byas la/ /g.yon pa mgo thod ces byas pa/ /gshin rje mo yi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa zhags 'dzin tshul byas te/ /g.yon pa sbrul gyi gdengs kar bya/ /chu lha 4'khor bcas phyag rgya'o//g.yas pa snye ma 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon pa mdzub mo bkug pa ni/ /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas thal brkyang byas mje bo dgug /smrang 'don lta bur bya ba dang / /g.yon pa gubye 'dzin pa ni/ /me lha 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin pa dang / /gung mo srin lag mthil bkug pa5/ /bden bral srin po'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa ba dan tshul byas nas / /ga mon pa pi bang thogs pa ni/ /rlung lha 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa phreng ba 'dzin nga/ dang / /g.yon pa zhags mig ltar byas pa/ /dbang ldan 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo mnyam du sbyar ba ni/ /pa ba sangs dang mig dmar ro/ /kha thad 6mdzub bsgreng phur bu'o/ /lag g.yas thal bgrad nyi ma'o/ /zla ba g.yon pa bgrad pa'o/ /glang sna chu srin 'dra sgra gcan / /se gol rtag gtogs lag 3pa la/ /spen pa dbyug pa 'dzin ltar bya / /lag nga/ gnyis kyi mkhrig ma bsnol/ /bkan te g.yas pa steng phyung nas/ /34byed/060

sor mo spro zhing bsdu ba ni/ /rgyu skar spyi yi phyag rgya'o/ /'jig rten pa ni thun mong du/ /thal mo brkyang bar bya ba dang / /yang na thal mo pad+mar bya/ /'jig rten spyi yi phyag rgya'o/ /gong du ji ltar bshad pa yi/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa ni/ thugs kar rdo rje bsgom pa ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i cho ga'o/ /de nas lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /dkyil 'khor sngags ni bstan bya ste1/ /dang por bdag byin brlab pa'i sngags/ /rdo rje phyag rgya bcings nas dgod/ /oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba dang / /smin mtshams mdzod sru rna ba gaganyis/ /mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis/ /sna gu dang rked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu gnyis dang mig gnyis dang / /gsang ba'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs4/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ya 5sarba a pā ya a na 4 ya hūṃ/ ngan song las 'dren pa'o7/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne+e hūṃ/sdig pa dag par bya'oru/ /oṃ sarba bid tra tha9/ sdig pa dral ba'o7/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ne+e/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne+e/ shudhe bi shubye/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shur+bhe swā hā/ kun rig gi'o/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ya/ sarba a pā ya hūṃ/ngan song sbyong ba'i'o 1/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ya/ sarba a pa 2ya/ sarba swa twe bh+yaḥhūṃ t+t+waṃ1na/ rin chen me tog gi'o/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ya/ sarba a pa ya bi sho dha ne+e dhīḥ⑩/ shākya thub pa'i'o/ /oṃ sho dha de sho dha ya/ sarba a pa ya ni sho dha ya/ tra ṭha aḥlke/ me tog cher 7rgyas kyi'o/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e hūṃ/ sangs rgyas spyan kyi'o/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e t+t+waṃ1 / mā ma tī'i 18'o/ /oṃ sho dha ne+e tweḥ19/ na bza' dkar mo'i'o/ /oṃ sho dha ni aḥ / sgol ma'i'o/ /sarba bid badz+ra satwa hūṃ / sarba bid badz+ra satwa dzaḥ sarba bid badz+ra satwa hoḥ / sarba bid badz+ra satwa 34byed/061

yod par mthong ba'i'o/ /oṃ ak+ṣa ya hūṃ karmā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ blo gros mi zad pa'i'o/ /oṃ pra ti bha de pra ti bhān ku re 3swā hā/ spobs pa brtsegs pa'i'o/ / oṃ s+thā ske s+thā me ma hā s+thā me pā ti hūṃ/ mthu chen thob kyi'o//3 oṃ sarba a pā ya dza ha sho dha ne+e hūṃ/ ngan song kun 'dren gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba sho ka ta mo nir gha te na ma ti hūṃ/ mya ngan kun 'joms kyi'o/ /oṃ dz+wa ④//la ni ma hā dz+wa thul ni swā hā/ dra ba can gyi'o/ /oṃ tsan+d+ra bya ba lo ki te swā hā/ zla 'od kyi'o/ /oṃ a mi 6ta pra bha ba ti hūṃ/ bdud rtsi 'od kyi'o/ / oṃ ga ga na lo tsa ne+e hūṃ7 /nam mkha' mdzod kyi'o/ /oṃ sa man+ta bha dra ru)hūṃ/ kun du bzang po'i'o oṃ bo spu/dhi satwa sarba saṃ s+thā ⑩ra pa ri shudhe 4 1dharma te ga ga na 12sa muṅga te swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi'o/ /oṃ sarba mu ne+e bh+yaḥpa ri shur+bhe ga ga na sa ma rgo swā hā//ce nyan thos kyi'o/ /oṃ na mo budha bya ba lo ki te shudha ga ga na sa ma ye ⑫swā hā/ rang rgyal gyi'olke/ /oṃ tre+e lo kya ki ra hūṃ phaṭa/ 'jig rten gsum snang gi'o / /oṃ tre+e lo kya da ma ka hūṃ phaṭa/ gsum 'dul gyi'o/ /oṃ tre+e lo kya nā sha sahūṃ phaṭa/dze+e gsum 'jig gi'o/ / oṃ tre+e lo kya an+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ gsum mthar byed kyi'o/ /o kā na ha ni tsorehūṃ phaṭa/ mi g.yo mgon no/ /oṃ a mṛ nya9te hūṃ phaṭa / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i'o/ /oṃ kā la daṇ+ḍa ( hūṃ phaṭa/ be+e con sngon po'i'o—/ /oṃ tweḥhūṃ phaṭa/ rta mgrin gyi'o/ /oṃ in+d+ra ya ༷ swā hā/ brgya byin 'khor bcas kyi'o/ /oṃ brah+ma ṇi swā hā/ tshangs pa'i'o/ /oṃ ga ṇa 2pa ti hūṃ/gtogs 'dod kyi'o/ /oṃ baiṇ+ḍa bi ye swā hā/ dbang phyug chen po'i'o/ /oṃ de ba ga be+e bh+yaḥ( swā hā/ lha thams cad kyi'o/ /oṃ be+e ba swa da ma tri bh+yaḥ swā hā/gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i'o/ /oṃ bar+ya ṇa ye nā ga ga ṇa 5 gabh+yaḥswā hā/ chu 34byed1063

lha 'khor dang bcas pa'i'o/ /༄1ku be+e ra yak+ṣa ni bh+yaḥswā hā/ gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi sngags so/ /oṃ asna ye ku tsi ku tsi swā hā/ drang srong rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ ne+e dṛ t+ya rāk+ṣa sa 2bh+yaḥswā hā/ srin po 'khor bcas kyi'o/ /oṃ bā thu ya be a sru ra ga ṇi 4bh+yaḥswā hā/ rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa'i'o/ /oṃ ru dra ak+ṣa byu 5 ta ga rte bh+yaḥ swā hā6/ dbang ldan 'khor bcas kyi'o/ /oṃ thra sbri tsubh+yaḥswā hā / sa'i lha mo'i'o/ /oṃ gra he 8pra bhā byo ti sa ya nak+ṣa kye tra ni rtswa da —/ni swā hā/gza' dang rgyu skar spyi'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma ho ra ga ga ṇi bh+yaḥswā hā/ lho 'phye rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ rku bhaṇ+ḍa byuta a dā pa sma ra a ma ostu ra /3ga ṇi bh+yaḥswā hā/'dre spyi'i'o/ /oṃ ga ru ḍa ga ṇa 1 bh+yaḥswā hā/ nam mkha' lding spyi'i'o/ /oṃ asne saswā hā/ me lha'i'o/ /oṃ ba ru rja ya thu swā hā/ chu lha'i'o/ /oṃ bā ⑩ ya be 7swā hā/ rlung lha'i'o/ /oṃ pa ṭa la dziswā hā/ sa bdag go/ /oṃ sarba de ba ta swā hā/ khyem lha la sogs pa thams cad kyi'o/ /oṃ hri swā hā/ mkha' 'go ma'i'o/ /de dag ni sngags su gsungs pa'o/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan/ /nyin re ting 'dzin gsum po /8ni/ /bdag dang lha spyor bsgom par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid der gsal nas/ /rgyas 'debs bzhi dang ldan pa la/ /dkyil 'khor sgo ni dbye byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su bskyed par bya/ /oṃ sarba bid badz+ra tsakra hūṃ/ 'khor lo dang ldan phyag rgya bya/ /dkyil 'khor bskyed sngags phyag rgya'o/ /de nas gtso bor bdag sbyor bas/ /dpung par se gol gdab 1 byas la/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs — spyan drang ngo / /de nas nye reg 'thor 'thung 1dang / /zhabs bsil ba ni dbul bar bya/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs mchod/ /de rjes bstod pa bya ba ni/ /mnyam med mi g.yo 34byed/064

chos mchog snecan/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro sdug sel/ /yon tan dngos grub sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mnyam nyid dam pa bstod/ /yon tan phra mo tshad med de/ /nam mkha' dang yang bskrun yod min/ /dngos grub mnyam med dpe ༄gebral ba/ /'gro la nges par stsol mdzad bstod/ /rtag tu dri med thugs rje 'byung / /smon lam sgrub ④pa 'gag med can/ /'gro ba'i don brtson mtha' yas pa/ /bdag nyid rtag tu snang la bstod/ /tshad med tshad bral yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /bde gshegs go 'phang de brnyes kyang / /thugs rje'i spyod pa 'gag ④med 'gyur/ /bzang po shin tu mchog ldan bstod/ /mchog sbyin nang na mchog brnyes pas/ /kun la dngos grub mchog thob mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib med pa/ /dngos grub dam pa spyod bstod do/ 5/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di dag gis/ /lan cig tsam yang bstod byas pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing / /bde gshegs thams cad 'grub par 'gyur—/ /de ltar ting 'dzin bya ba ni/ /lo'am lo phyed zla 6gcig bya/ /de lhar khegrub nas rdul tshon brtsams/ /de yis 8bsod nams tshogs bsgoms shepa/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas rdul tshon mgo rtsom sterte / /gong du bshad pa'i gnas dag tu/ /sa ni gzung ba'i las bya ste/ /sa bdag sa srung 1la sogs dang / /sa yi lha mo rnams la ni/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni sbyin sreg gi/ /dkyil 'khor bya ba'i don du ni/ / dam tshig 8 'di ni bsgrags par bya/ /sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang / /gang zhig sa la brten kun dang / /byams pa'i sems su gnas pa ni/ /kun 34—1065

dga'i don du zhu zhing gnas/ /de nas ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin/ /pus nub tsam du brko byas la/ /gyo mo la sogs bsal bar bya/ /spyan dang gnod sbyin 'khyel pa yi/ /sngags kyi chu yis 1gtor bar bya/ /de ltar sa ni bzung rngunas su / /slob dpon khru yis brtag byas la/ /che chung rim pa gang yin pas/ /sa de yang dag gzung bar bya/ /de ni sa sbyang ( ba'i cho ga'o// //de nas gos rgyan bgos byas te/ /dri zhim chu yis lus bkrus la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin ting 'dzin du/ /zhugs nas rdo rje 'chang ba'i gtso/ /thugs las phyung 4ste skad cig mas/ /mig la nyi ma zla ba'i 'od/ /rkang pa bor ba rdo rjer bsam/ /lag gnyis rdo rje dril bzung la/ /yi ge hūṃ gi sgra bsgrags te//g.yas nas bskor la deng zhes brjod/ /mtshams dang dra ba ra ba dag /bdud dang sdang ba 5bzlog par bya/ /de nas phur bu byin brlabs nas/ /phur bu sngags kyis gdab par bya/ /de nas skud pa rim lnga yi/ /kha dog bzhin du bsam byas la/ /'khor los sgyur bas g.yog la gtad7/ /de nas thig skud bsgril bar bya/ /de nas gser gyi gzhong pa ru/ /rigs kyi sngags kyis btab nas su/ /mchod dang bstod pa rdzogs par bya/ /de nas thig gdab brtsam pa ni/ /las dang bya bas gdab pa ste/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kye bstan pa/ /oṃ badz+ra sru tra ā kar+ṣa ya maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ zhes so/ /gdab pa'i 'go stangs bskor ba ni/ /rgyud rngu dang man ngag bzhin du bstan/ /byin brlabs byas pa'i gnas de ru/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dbus kyi cha ni gdab bya ba/ /srad bu brgyad dang ldan pa yi/ /lte bar bcas shing 34byed/066

rtsibs bcu drug /rim pa gsum dang ldan pa yi1/ /rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ /sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi ldan pas/ /them skas dang ni 'khor lo dang / /lda ldi la sogs brgyan pa ru/ /seng ge ba glang rnams kyis brgyan/ /de ltar legs par brtags byas nas/ /tshon rtsis bri ba brtsam 2par bya de ltar byas pa'i 'og nyid du/ /de nas sbyor ba gsum bsgoms la/ /lha yi gnas su tsan+dan sogs/ /lha yi gnas ni bya ba'o/ /de la me tog phul byas la//rang rang gsang sngags mang bzlas te/ /de nas mchod pa'i rim pas mchod/ /dbus kyi gtso bo'i gsang sngags kyi5/ /rnam rgyal bum pa gdab par bya de nas phur jebu phyang 5nas su/ /kha dog lngas ni dgang bar bya/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas bri bya ste/ /dkar sngo dmar dang de bzhin ljang / /nang du ser po btang du byas la/ /de nas yang ni mchod pa dbul/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'degs kyepar bya/ /sor mo gyen du rtse sprad 'degasabye / /de yi sngags ni 'di dag go/ /oṃ sarba bid a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ zhes so/ /rdul tshon bri ba'i cho ga'o// //de ltar byas zin 'og tu ni/ /de bzhin mchod pa rnam lnga yis/ /bum pa sta gon gnas par bya/ /bum pa dkar zhing che ba dang / /kha yangs legs shing mgrin pa mtho/ /dri chus yongs su bkang nas su/ /kha rgyan yal ga shing gis byas/ /'bru lnga sman lnga rin chen lnga/ /snying po lnga dang ldan par bya/ /me tog phreng bas bcing byas te/ /ras kyis mgul la dkris byas la/ /ku sha sngo na pos 9gdan byas pa/ /gdugs dkar gyis ni brgyan pa ste/ /rang 34—1067

rtags mtshan ma bri 3byas la/ /ba dan lnga dang ldan pa ni/ /go rims nyabazhin du gzhag par bya/ /til dang so ba spos dang ni/ /tsan+dan me tog dkar po dang / /'o ma yis ni yon chab snod/ /bkang la mdun du gzhag par bya/ /de bzhin spos kyis bdug nas su/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas brtan par bya/ /rang rang sngags kyis btab pa yi/ /de kho na yi phyag rgya bya/ /rgyas 'debs bzhi dang ldan pa la/ /nye reg 'thor 'thung yon chab dbul/ /sngags pa rdo rje dril ldan pa'i/ /lag pa g.yas pas 5reg nas su/ /chu la brgya rtsa brgyad du gdab/ /de nas lha de zhu byas te/ /byang chub ye shes chu ru gyur/ /bum pa sta gon la gnas pa'o// //de nas sngags pa grub 'dod pas/ /sbyin sreg las ni brtsam bya ste/ /bcu phyed mchod par ldan pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar phyogs su/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brtsams 6par bya/ /rab tu dkar ba'i sa gzhi la/ /rgyar dza ni khru gang zabs su yang / /sor ni bcu gnyis brkos byas la/8 /de dbus rdo rje sor brgyad gzhag /thab khung gi ni steng nyid du/ /sor bzhi rab tu dor byas la/ /'phangs 6dang rgyar ni sor bzhi yis/ /mnyam par rab tu byas pa la/ /rab tu rdo rje rtse gsum mtshan/ /ba yi lci ba ma lhung dang / /sa gzhi dkar bas byug par bya/ /rdo rje gnod spyin sngags btab pas/ /bgegs ni bskrad byung gsad par 7bya/ /'o ma yod pa'i yam shing gis/ /gtsubs 11pa'i me yis sbar bar bya/ /ji ltar me lha spyan drangs nas/ /yon chab nye reg 'thor 'thung gnyis/ /gtor nas 'bar la de thim bya/ /phyag rgya 34—1068

'khor lo dang ldan pas/ /mdun du bzhag la blta bar bya/ /de nas me yi dbus su ni/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur rab bcings te/ /mdzub gnyis mthe'u chung rdo rje sbrel1/ /rdo rje rab bsrungs 2 phyag rgyas te/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad rab bsgrub pa'o/ /sngags ni oṃ sarba bid badz+ra tsakra sidha hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdang ldan par/ /se gol ldan pas dgug gzhug bya/ /de nas sreg 4dzas bstan pa ni/ /nas dang zho dang 'bras yos dang / /til dang ku sha sngon po dang / /'bras chan me tog dkar po dang //spang spos sbrang rtsi mar rnams dang / /mi rus phye mas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rdzas de dag ni dbul ba yang / /rang gi sngags kyis brgya rtsa brgyad/ /yang na bdun bdun dbul bar bya/ /sgeg sogs mchod pa brgyad dang ni/ /de bzhin bcu gnyis mchod pas mchod/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po la sogs pa'i/ /sngags ni ci nus bzlas byas nas/ /gang ba'i sbyin sreg dbul bar bya5/ /sems can phan don ci 'dod bsngo/ /de nas gzhan yang pha rol tu/ /'phos la phan par bya don du/ /sbyin sreg chen po brtsam par bya/ /gdams pa'i sngags kyis byin brlabs la/ /thab khung rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ /che chung rim pa shes byas la/ /ci nus lha ni dgod byas te/ /rten 6bcas rgyan ldan de dbus su / /bzhag pa nyid du byas nas kyang / /ci nus par ni sbyin sreg bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sbyin sreg gi rim pa'i cho ga'o// //de ltar dang por zhugs pa nas/ /tha ma slob ma gzhug gi bar/ /zhal bsro la sogs byed dus su/ /bum pa la sogs bsdu bar bya'o/ /de nas lho yi 3 4byed1069

phyogs dag tu/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i rim pa yis/ /pad+ma dkar po'i steng nyid du/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bri bar bya'o/ /de steng slob ma gzhag byas la//gong ma'i cho ga ji lta bas/ /bum pa la sogs ji snyed kyis hūṃ/ /khyad par ci 'dod dbang rnam 2sbyin/ /de lta bu yi dkyil 'khor du/ /'khor bar bcings pa'i sems can gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di la zhugs byas nas/ /ngan song gsum las grol gyur nas/ /dga' ldan gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas mchod pas ston bzhin mchod/ /bskyed pa snying gar bsdus nas ni/ /spyan drangs lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ /khyed kyis sems can don mdzad pas//slar yang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya — nut+pan+da tāta 4muḥ/ zhes so/ /se gol lan gsum gdab 1la gshegs/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor basbu bya ste/ /'dod par gyur pa de la sbyin/ /lhag ma chu bo chen por dor/ /dkyil 'khor phul ba'i nor gang zhig /de ni slob dpon nyid dbang bar/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /rab tu brdzun 6med gsungs pa yin/ /cho ga'i rim pa rdzogs pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor rim pa'i rgyud las ni/ /grub ldan lung bstan ma thob kyang / /kun la phan phyir bdag gis byas / /bla ma nyi ma'i dpal zhabs kyis/ /sgrub pa'i thabs su gsungs pa la//'on kyang 'di la bdag gis ni/ /de yi bka' la rab brtan 8snabartsams/ /'di yis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /'gro ba 'di dag rtag tu ni/ /'phrul dga'i gnas su skyes nas su/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /ngan song thams cad rnam par spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa sdogs so// //3 4—1070

༄/ /dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga thugs rje phreng ba jes bya ba/7༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni maṇ+ḍal no pi ka kṛ ba a ba li nā ma 2/ bod skad du/ dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga thugs rje phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i rgyal bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gyi 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kun gyi sgu/ /nyon mongs mtha' dag kun bcom nas/ /'gro la thugs rjes spyan gyis rab gzigs la/ /kun nas dang ba'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal te/ /bye ba brgyud pa'i snyug bsngal gcod byed pa'i/ /thugs rje phreng mchog dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /de la bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i rnal 'byor pa snod du gyur pa rnams kyi dam tshig thams cad bsdu bar gyur pas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bsdu bar 34—/076

bya'o / /de la dang po rnal 'byor pa sems dad pas mchog tu gyur pa dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba bsgrub par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sems bskyed la/ dri la sogs pas khrus byas pas/ chos thams cad bdag med par lhag par mos par bya'o/ /de nas mgrin pa'i phyogs su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bsams la/de'i lce'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du hūṃ las gyur pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ zhes brjod do/ /yang dag pa gnyis la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ las gyur pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po rer gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra hasta/zhes brjod do/ /de'i rjes la rkang pa'i mthil 1gnyis su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ de'i steng du hūṃ las gyur pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje bsams te/de nas oṃ sarba yo ga badzā /ya hūṃ/ zhes pas yan lag thams cad rdo rjer gyur par bsamag / de nas bgegs gzhil bar bya ba'i phyir phyag rgya thams cad bcing bar 'gyur te/ de la hūṃ las sprul pa'i khro bo rdo rje nyi ma ru bdag nyid sprul la/ rdo rje me'i nyi ma rab tu bsams nas/ khros pa'i sems kyis khro bo ti rīn 4/ti ri'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ de la rdo rje mthe bong gnyis bgreng ba ni/ ti rīn thuti ri'i phyag rgya khuste/ kṛṇ+ḍa 7badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod par bya zhing / sa 'og bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i gdan phyed du 'dug la/ dang po'i phyag rgya de nyid du bcing ste9/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur bar byas la/ dar dpyangs kyis brgyan par bya zhing / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūṃ a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ ⑩saṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur 3 4—1077

gnyis bcings pa las mdzub mo gnyis mdud cing / snying ga dang / dpral ba dang / ltag pa dang / yang snying ga la sogs par mdud pa las sna tshogs go bgo 1bar byas la/ g.yon pa dkur 'dzin par byas la/ g.yas rdo rje gsor bas bgegs ma lus pa gzhom par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na 'a hūṃ sarba bisprun 2phaṭa/ ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas khro bo de nyid kyi phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la sor mo rnams nang du 'bar bar bya zhing mthe bong de bzhin du bsgreng bas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na khārka ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces /pas bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus par bsreg chopar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rdo rje bsdams pa bcings la mje bong gnyis bsgreng ste/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e 5tre sarba bispyo 4ban+dha/ zhes bya bas bgegs thams cad bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje bsdams pa bcings nas mthe bong dang mje chung so sor 7rtse mo sprad de/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha ba rak+ṣ-i sarba swā hā/ zhes brjod pas sa 'og bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur bsdams pa las g.yas pa sdigs mdzub tu bya zhing / g.yon pa lcags kyu'i tshul du byas la/ khros pa'i yid kyis khro bo de nyid nam mkha'i phyogs su spros pa las/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ces pas steng phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /mthe chung lu gu rgyud du dz+rel te rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje rtse sprad par byas la spyi bor btsugs nas/oṃ bye ban+dha8/ zhes brjod pas/ shar phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa las mkhrig ma gnyis mdud de lho phyogs su bltas te/ oṃ badz+ra pra 9sha hri phaṭa/ ces pas lho phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcings pa las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de/ srin lag gnyis tshigs bar ma 34—1078

bsnol nas mje chung gnyis brkyang bar byas te/ oṃ pa taṅgi pa taṅgi ni ra traṭa/ces pas nub phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcings la mdzub mo gnyis mche ba'i tshul du byatshi/ mthe bong gnyis kha'i tshul du byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas byang phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje sna tshogs kyi bdag nyid las lag pa gnyis rgyab sprad la mthe bong dang mthe chung so sor bsnolasnye/ sor mo lhag ma drag pa so sor rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul las sa la bstan pas sa gzhi ༄ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bya zhing / oṃ badz+ra ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nasajo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mthe chung gnyis lu gu rgyud du byas la sdigs mdzub gnyis bsgreng la phyogs bzhir bskyod pas ra pa/dang po dang / de nyid las sprugs mdzub bzhi pas ra ba gnyis pa bya zhing / oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ badz+ra hūṃ ka ra hūṃ/ zhes pas rdo rje ra ba bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa rgyas par brkyang ba'i steng du bkab la bskyod de/ oṃ pañja 9ra ṇa hūṃ—/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i gur du bya ba nyid do/ /de'i rjes la me tog gi phyag rgya'am rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa byas la/rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa las mdzub mo dang mthe chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel te/ oṃ sarba bid badz+ra tsakra hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags lan bdun brjod pas phyogs kun du bskor bas dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po sprul par bya'o/ /de nyid snying ga'am khar bzhag la sngags de nyid lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas ṭudakyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur te/ de yis dkyil 'khor mngon sum dang 'dra bar bltas la/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang ldan pa dri dang / kha dog sna tshogs pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad rgyas 34—1079

—par gyur pa'i steng du phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / khro bo la sogs pa thams cad de nyid du sprul la/ kye ma sangs rgyas kye sangs rgyas/ /kye ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song thams cad kyi/ /rgyud ni dag par byin gyis rlobs / /zhes pas gsol ba gdab ༄tepar bya'o/ /de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs sngon du 'gro bas zhabs bsil la arja 2phul te/ nye /—reg 'thor 'thung byas te/ gdan la brtan par bzhugs te/ thal mo legs par sbyar bas dpral ba'i steng du bzhag ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāñcit+ta pra ṇa me na badz+ra tsakra ban+dha rgo 5ka ro mi/ de nyid las mje bong g.yas pa rdo rje ltar bsgreng pa snying gar bzung ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ban+dha shirgo ka ro mi/ zhes brjod pas shar phyogs nas phyag bya'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo rin po che ltar byas pas snying gar bzung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na brnya 8rgo ka ro mi/ zhes brjod pas lho phyogs nas phyag bya'o/ /mdzub mo pad+ma ltar byas pas shog mar bzung tsuste / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ban+dha māṃ ka ro mi/ zhes brjod pas nub phyogs nas phyag bya'o/ /mdzub mo ral gri ltar byas pa lte bar bzung 1sna ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma ban+dha /rgo ka ro mi/ zhes brjod pas byang phyogs nas phyag bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa thams cad rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ me tog gi phyag rgya bcings la / gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na me tog gi bye brag gang dag yod pa 'di lta ste/thang las skyes pa'am/ chu las skyes pa'am/ yid las byung ba gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad ma 7lus pa sked pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /4ṭ+wāṃ7byed/080

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang 71byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs pa thams cad dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig pa'i lha mo dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir dbul bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pube+e 2pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pas mchod pa nyi shu gzhung gzhan dang mthun par dbul lo/ /gzhan yang thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi /dakhams thams cad na lha dang mi rnams kyi zhal zas kyi bye brag 'di lta ste/ bza' ba dang bca' ba dang / bldag pa dang myang ba dang / btung ba dang gzhib rjapa dang / bdud rtsir gyur pa gang dag yod pa de rnams ma phya7lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtserigs lnga dang bcas pa bzhugs pa thams cad dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig pa'i lha mo dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir dbul bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ra 7sa ā ha ra na 8pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du lha dang mi rnams kyi bzhon pa'i bye brag khyad par can rta dang glang po la sogs pa dang skyes pa dang / bud med dang / 'khor lo dang / nor bu dang / dmag mi rnams kyis nam mkha' rgyas par lhag par mos par/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sap+ta rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rang gi sems yid bzhin nor bu las byung ba'i nam mkha'i khams thams cad du gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan 3 4—1081

rnams kyis rgyas par lhag par mos par byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsha tram̐ dh+wa dza pā rda /༄teka pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad du/ ral gri dang / me long dang / me tog dang phreng ba la sogs par rgyas par byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khaṅga ā dar+sha puju mā le tshupū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad du/ rnga dang cang te'u dang / pi wang dang / gling bu dang / kar rnguko ta dang / gar la sogs pas rgyas par byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gī tirba tur ya pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de ltar mchod pa thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod nas sdig pa thams cad yang dag par bshags par bya ste/ pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis bsnol nas maze bong gnyis brkyang ste/ lhag ma gsum thal mor byas pas snying gar bzung ste/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang /las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags dang / gzungs ༄d+ngha sngags dang / bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon ming 'di ⑦zhes bgyi ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad dang / phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang /rig sngags dang / gzungs ༄8sngags dang / bcom ldan 'das ngan song 34—1082

thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyan sngar sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags par bgyi'o zhes brjod la/ yi ge brgya pa lan bdun du bzlas par bya'o/ /phyogs bcu na 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /sems can gyi tshogs thams cad kyi bsod nams la rgya cher yi rang bar bkyi/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa rnams la/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad du gsol/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 4bzhed pa de dag thams cad3/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar 'tshal bo/ /khams gsum kyi sems can thams cad/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i phyir mi ldog pa'i lam la gnas par bkyi'o/ /de nas gsum la skyabs su gsol ba la sogs pa bya ste/ me tog lag par thogs la/ 'di skad ces brjod do/ /bla med bcom ldan rkang gnyis mchog /rdo rje lta bu'i sangs rgyas te / /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi / /rnam par dag pa chags pa 4mchog /pad+ma lta bu dam chos te/ /nges gsung sngags dang phyag rgya lathu/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rnam grol gtsang ma tshogs kyi mchog /rin chen lta bu dge 'dun te/ /lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /yang dag byang chub skyed thumadzad bzhin/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med7/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas 34—1083

rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni basbu ba dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu 7phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis 2nas / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma grol ba ni dgrol bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral 4ba ni bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa'i sems can rnams/ /dbyugs thudabyung mya ngan 'das la dgod / /de ltar sdom pa bzung nas/ bdag nyid dbul bar bya ste/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi ris tresu bzhugs pa thams cad dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang 7 / rig sngags dang /dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la bdag nyid dbul gyis/ bdag dus thams cad nas rnam pa thams cad du so sor bzhes su gsol lo/ /zhes brjod la 34byed108—1

sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad du/ lus rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa spros pas so so'i zhabs drung du dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mgon po khyed rnams kyis/ dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub bdag la stsal du gsol lo zhes brjod la/ dge ba de yang sems can thams cad dang /thun mong du lkubasngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i bde ba dang / yid bde ba thams cad kyi mchog sangs rgyas su tshe 'di nyid la thob par gyur cig ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos la / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal la/ sems chen pos dmigs par bya ba dang / de las 'don par 'dod pa'i bla na med pa'i sems dang /'phags pa'i chos kyis yongs su grol ba'i sems mchog tu gyur pa dang /dngos po thams cad la 3dmigs pa med pa mthar thug pa'i sems bskyed par bya'o / /de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'od gsal ba tsam dngos po kun gyi mchog tu gyur par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sngags kyi rgyal po brjod par bya ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti tsit+ta snasarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā 4dzā ya ta thā ga tā ārta te/ samyak+shi bud+dhā 5ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ shudhe bi shur+bhe/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shudhe swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas—/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu rdo rje rtse mor gyur pa rnams kyi steng du bsams la/ de dag gi steng du rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sa bon lag pa g.yas pa la bsam pa dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug 6la sogs pa'i sa bon lag pa g.yon pa la bsam par bya 3 4—/085

ste / de la mthe bong gnyis la/ oṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ gung mo gnyis la t+t+waṃ lkuzhes bya ba bsam/ srin lag gnyis la bye zhes bya ba bsam/ mje bong gnyis la ā kyezhes bya ba bsam de ltar de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /de nyid gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das lnga dang / lha mo lnga bsams te/ thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ a spyo t+yā gnu rā ga sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod la/ thabs dang shes rab rjes su chags par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ a byo rjo n+ya sga ra spa ra a 5nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā rmye sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas thabs dang shes rab thugs rje chen po'i dbang gis snyoms par zhugs par bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las/ oṃ a tshet+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥlkuhūṃ/ zhes brjod pas / chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres shing thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po la thugs ye shes kyi 1lha dang lha mo'i tshogs bskyed pa ste/ de la badz+ra añja li bya bas/ rdo rje thal mo'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ban+dha/ zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i'o/ /de nas badz+ra ban+dha traṭaṅku/ces brjod pas snying gar sdig pa lan gsum dral /1bar bya'o/ /oṃ ⑩ā be+e sha /zhes bya bas rdo rje 'bebs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la/ a zhes pas bdag nyid la ye shes dbab par bya'o/ /phab pa de nyid 'dis brtan par bya'o//oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ phyo me bha wa sha 1 shwa to me bha ba z-i da yo me a ྾dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbadz+ra muṣ+ṭi/ zhes bya ba dang / dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rdo rje phyag rgya nang du bcas la/ mdzub mo gnyis gshibs te/ lag pa gyen du 34byed1086

'phangs 1la/ o pā paṃ 2ā kar+ṣa ni bi sho dha 4na bi sho dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa / ces brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sgo ṭa ya sarba a pā ya ban+dha ni pra mo k+ṣa ṇa sarba a pā ya ga te bh+yaḥ phyapasarba tā sa nan sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa/ces brjod la gung mo gnyis mnyam par sbyar la/ gzhan ma bzhi po rtse mo sprad de sdig pa thams cad dral bar bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad rab tu bsdu ba'i rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags lan bdun brjod de/ oṃ sarba muḥ6zhes pas dgrol bar bya'o/ /de nyid kyis ni dngos grub thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su sdogs pa'i bdag nyid can byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa'i gzugs su 'og min gyi khang pa brtsegs pa gnas pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur te/ de nas rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su/ rang gi lha'i snying gar gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su 7/ rang gi lha'i snying po dam tshig gis bris la/ de nyid la mngon par phyogs pa'i lte ba'i dbus su dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug dang bcas pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par yongs su gyur pa dang / yang de'i steng du yi ge ka la sogs pa skar ma'i rnam pa lta bur yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /de dag gcig tu gyur pa'i steng du/badz+ra zhes bya ba'i snying po dang / de las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs dang bcas par bsam par bya'o/ /ngan song spyong ba la sogs pa rnams kyi ni rang rang gi snying po las byung ba'i mtshan ma ste/ de dag gi dbus su snying po rnams bkod la rang rang gi phyag rgya'i nga rgyal du bsgo/ma par bya ba ni/ badz+repho8haṃ zhes 34—/087

pa nas ghazlo3snahaṃ/ zhes bya ba'i bar du/ rang rang gi snying po yang bzlas shing de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas par bzhugs pa rnams/ rang rang gi phyag rgya la bzhugs par bsams te/ badz+ra tsakra sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na 2hūṃ/ zhes pa zlos shing phyag rgya'i gzugs de rnams / badz+ra bai ro tsa na ra haṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pa brjod par 1de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi/ rang rang gi sgur byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbyor bas rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur bsgoms gil/ oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ne+e sarba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne+e hūṃ/ 5brjod la ma hā sa ma ya satwa shibhehaṃ/ zhes pas rang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings shing sa ma ya 7haṃ/ zhes bya'o/ /de nas snying ga la sogs pa'i gnas bzhir rdo rje la sogs pa8/ oṃ sa ma ya / sarba/ a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃrke sna/zhes brjod pas/ byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar 'khor lo'i phyag rgya las byung ba'i badz+ra tsakra/ zhes pa'i snying pos ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor de ma thag tu sprul la sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/zhes brjod pas/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings te/ de yis me tog gi phreng ba blangs nas/ snying ga'i dkyil 'khor du badz+ra sa ma ya/ zhes pas 'jug par bya zhing / oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes pas 11dkyil 'khor du dor bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ pra ti kṛt+ta 12twa me sarba ma hā ba la/ zhes bya bas phreng ba blangs la rang gi mgo la bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi ma rig pa bsal bar bsams 1 te/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyimu/ /de ring bdag gis mig dbye mdzad/ /rdo rje mig ni bla med pas/ /mig rnams thams cad dbye bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la/ mig phye la he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes 34—/088

brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad bla mar bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas lnga'i tshobyin kyis brlabs pa'i bum pa las rdo rje chu blangs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes pas/ chu'i dbang blangs nas de nas sangs rgyas dang /phyag rgya la sogs pa'i dbang budhe a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra chirat+na a dzha ṣiñca t+t+waṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bye ṣiñca dhīḥ༄ / oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca a 4 /zhes pa'i phyaspyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bde bar gshegs pa lngas dbu rgyan bya'o//de bzhin du phyag rgya dang / phreng ba dang / gsung dang / ming dang /las dang / 'khor lo la sogs pa dang / gsang ba dang / bde ba chen po'i dbang rnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du mnos la/ oṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod la/snying ga la sogs pa'i 'uganas ji lta ba bzhin du go bgo bar bya zhing / dar dpyangs kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas brtul zhugs dang / gnang ba dang /lung bstan pa la sogs pa thams cad rgyas par byas nas rang la byin kyis brlabs la/ rnal 'byor chen po la brtson par bya ste/ de la rang gi snying gar zla ba bsams la 7ma ya ā zhes brjod cing / ngan song spyong ba la sogs pa'i gnas su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ oṃ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na hūṃ/ zhes pas mdun gyi nam mkha' be+e ro tsa na a zhes brjod la dbab par bya'o / /badz+ra be zhes bya ba dang / badz+ra be+e ro tsa na haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/phyag rgya dang rnam par snang mdzad sgu mdog dkar por bsgoms te/ rang gi gnas su dgug pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas rnam par snang 8mdzad kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ḍaje9/ zhes bya bas blta bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ zla ba grub par 31—1089

'gyur te/ de'i steng du badz+repho1haṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pas gnas lngar zherdo rje la sogs phyag rgyas gyur cing / badz+ra a pā zuya sho dha ni hūṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pas / bde bar gshegs pa'i skur gyur par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ o badz+ra satwa ā/ badz+ra rā dza ā/ badz+ra rā ga ā/ badz+ra sā cidhu ā/ badz+ra rat+na ā/ badz+ra te dza ā/badz+ra ke tu ā/ badz+ra hā sa ā/ badz+ra dharma sku.ā/ badz+ra ṭīkyā 4ā/ badz+ra he tu ā / badz+ra bha ṣa ā/ badz+ra karma ā/ badz+ra rak+ṣa ā/ badz+ra yak+ṣa ā/ badz+ra sadhi 7ā/ badz+ra lā gye ā/ badz+ra mā le ā/ badz+ra gī ti ā/ badz+ra nirti tsho.ā/badz+ra dhū pe ā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā/ badz+ra ā lo ke ā/ badz+ra gadhe ā/ badz+ra e ku sha ā/ badz+ra sgo ṭa ā/ badz+ra ā /rtenyabe+e sha ā/ zhes pas snying po phab la/de nas de dag gyur par gzugs phyag rgya dag ste/ badzolhanyu haṃ/ zhes pa nas/gharnyolha1 haṃ / zhes pa'i bar gyis/ rdo rje sems dpa' nas dril bu'i bar du gyur pa'o/ /de nas de nyid so so'i bar phyag rgya chen po'i skur bsam par bya ba bzhin / oṃ badz+ra satwopho1 haṃ/ zhes pa nas/ badz+ra ghazlo3 5haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyis ngan song thams cad dang pos yongs su sbyong ba la sogs pa'i gnas su rang gi rigs las nye bar mtshon pa'i kha dog dang phyag mtshan bsnams pas gnas par gyur pa dang / lcags kyu la sogs pa'i spyor bas dgug pa dang /bcing ba dang / dbang du bya ba la sogs pa byas nas so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la/ snying po rnams brjod pas blta bar bya ste/ badz+ra satwa dṛ sh+ya/zhes pa nas/ badz+ra gaspyo dṛ sh+ya/ zhes pa'i bar gyis blta bar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi lus la phyag rgya dang / sngags kyi sbyor ba bsdus pa las/ rigs lnga'i 3 4byed/090

sangs rgyas kyis bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi lus la bcug ste/phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab par bya ba ste/ badz+ra tsakra dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ51sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i snying po lan bdun brjod la/ de bzhin du ngan song sbyong ba dang / rin chen tog dang / shākya thub pa dang / me tog rgyas pa rnams kyi snying po brjod la sangs rgyas spyan la sogs pas/ oṃ budha lo tsa ni hūṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyis sno snying ga la sogs pa'i gnas su byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor chen pos ni gzhal yas khang la sogs pa med pa yang mngon par byang chub lngas bskyed la/ cho ga thams cad sbyad par bya ste/ mngon du byed pa pos ni/de'i rjes la rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid las byung ba phyag rgya rnam pa 4bzhi la sbyar bar byas te5/ de la dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni rdo rje bsdams pa las byung bas na/ rdo rje bsdams pa bcings byas la/ /de nyid lte bar ting 'dzin gnas / /de las mje bong mthe chung mdud/ /mdzub mo srin lag rin chen 'dra / /mthe bong mje chung pad snying po/ /gzhan rnams 'dra 6ma 'dra ba ste/ /de bzhin ral gri 'dra ba dang / /mdzub mo rdo rje 'dra ba dang / /gung mo dag ni rin chen te/ /srin lag pad+ma 7'dra ba las/ /mthe chung ut+pal 'dab 'drar bya/ /mdzub mo rdo rje 'dra ba las/ /de nyid lcags kyu'i rnam par bkug /me tog mda' gzhu 'dra ba dang / /legs so zhes par brjod pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhi po yin/ /mdzub mo rin chen 'dra ba dang 9/ /mje bong gshibs te gzhan rnams bsnol/ /de las srin lag mthe chung gnyis/ /mnyam par gshibs shā1pa rgyal mtshan te/ /de las bskor te kha phyogs gzhag /34—1091

srin lag pad+ma chos kyi ste/ /srin lag ral gri rnon po yin/ /lag gnyis mjeb mdzub zlum po ni/ /'khor lo yi ni phyag rgyar grags/ /srin lag rtse sprad tshigs gnyis dgu1/ /khar gzhag pa ni gzung ba ste/ /mthe bong mthe chung rtse sprad dgyed/ /las kyi rdo rjer bshad pa yin/ /de las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang nas/ /mje bong snying gar brkyang pa'o/ /mdzum mo gnyis dgu mche ba la/ /mthe bong gung mo kha 'dra ba/ /gnod sbyin gyi ni yin pa ste/ /mje chung gnyis par mje bong 2gnyis/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyis babyur ba'o/ /snying gar mje bong mnyam par gshibs— / /rab tu brkyang ba phreng ba ste/ /thal sbyar kha yi thad kar gzhag /de las bsnol te rab bskor dang / /rdo rje bcings pa kha sbub dang / /thal mo kha phye gyen du 'thor/ /g.yas pa'i mjeb bsgreng g.yon pas 'khyud/ /rdo rje bsdams brkyang dbyug pa'o/ /mdzub mo g.yas pa bkug 4pa dang / /mazeb mdzub gnyis ni mdud pa dor/ /mthe bong mdzub mo gdu bur bcing / /rdo rje bcings pa mdzub mo bsdams/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje rtse lnga pa bskyed pa 3gsal bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ljags la chos kyi phyag rgya dgod par bya ste/zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rdo rje la dgod par bya ste/ sarba bid oṃ/sarba bid hūṃ/ sarba bid ṭ+wāṃ6/ sarba bid byāḥme/ sarba bid aḥ 8/ sarba rgo tra ā ta ma su kha/ tsan+d+ra pra bhā ba/ sarba da ro/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a na yā swa/a tshoho su kha sā dhu sā dhu/ su ma hā t+t+waṃ/ rū 7po byo t+ya/ ar ta pa ti/ ha ha hūṃ te/ sarba ka ri/ duḥ( khats+tshad/ bud+dhā bo bye/ pra ti sabe+e/ su pa shi tram̐/ni ra pā yat+t+waṃ rta/ sha t+t+waṃ nyu)bhak+ṣa/ sarba sid+dhi/ ma hā ra te/ dru pa sho bhe/bla /34byed1092

sro ta su khye sarba pū 7rtedze/ prah+la da ni/ pha la ga me/ su ti tsi ga /su garnya gre/ a ya / tsuhe dza/ a te hūṃ hūṃ/ he pho ṭa baṃ/ ghaspyo a a/ de nas las kyi phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ gung mo sbyar ba byas pa las/ /g.yas pa yi ༄ ni gung mo bsgreng / /g.yon pa'i sbu 4gur bcug nas ni/ /gzhan rnams brkyang pa byang chub mchog /ngan song kun spyong sa la reg /rin chen gyi ni sa mchog sbyin te༄ — / /shākya thub pa'i chos bshad 7mchog /mi 'jigs sbyin pa me tog gi'o/ /spyan gyi mig dang 'dra ba ste/ /mā ma shī ni rdo rje 'dra/ /dkar mo pad+ma nyid du bshad/ /a la ni sgol mar 8dgongs/ /rdo rje blangs nas gsor ba dang / /lag gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul gnas dang / /gzhu 'gengs pa yi sbyor ba dang / /legs pa'i se gol snying gar gnas/ /lag gnyis rdo rje dbang bsgur ba 9/ /snying gar nyi ma rab tu ston/ /g.yon pa'i gru mo g.yas pas gzung / /de las phyir zlog rkarab tu dgyes/ /shes rab thabs kyi 4 1pad+ma dgyes / /snying gar po ti ral gri phyaras/ /mgal me lta bu'i 'khor lo bskor/ /rdo rje gnyis ni kha 'gram gnas/ /rdo rje gar gyis bskor nas dgrol/ /spyi bor thal mo mnyam par sbyor/ /go cha'i tshul du bzung sanas ni/ /mthe chung gnyis ni mche bar gnas/ /khu tshur gnyis ni dku ru gnas/ /phreng ba blangs nas steng chedu 'phyar/ /de las pi wang mumadzub mos bskyod/ /gar ni de las rnam par bzlog /sangs rgyas mchod pa la brtson pas/ /g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma g.yon pas gzung / /g.yon pa snying ga g.yas pa yi/ /mtheb srin me tog dpral bar bzlog /de bzhin mig tu yang dag gnas/ /dung phor lta bur mu dri yis mchod/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyus mthe chung mdud/ /zhags pa 34—1093

bzhin du sbyar nas kyang / /de nyid lcags sgog tshul du bya/ /zhags pa'i tshul las rgyab gnyis mnan/ /dam tshig 'be+ebs pa yin par 'dod/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po bcing bar 1bya ste/ de nas rang gi snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' bsams la/ thams cad du rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pa las/ gong ma lta bu/byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya dang / /sa gnon dang ni mchog 2sbyin dang / /chos 'chad dang ni skyabs mdzad dang / /spyan gnyis rdo rje khar gnas dang / /pad+ma lta bu thal mo dang / /ut+pal lta bu'i sor mo dang / /dril bu dkur gtod 4rdo rje gsor/ /lcags kyus sangs rgyas kun 'gugs shing / /rdo rje mda' ni bde gshegs 'bigs/ /legs pas sangs rgyas mnyes mdzad cing / /snying po yis ni dbang bskur mdzad/ /nyi mas sangs rgyas kun snang ste/ /rgyal sras kyis ni sbyin pa rdzogs/ /bzhad pas ba spu ldang mdzad cing / /spyan gyis gti mug mun pa sel/ /rgon pos shes rab po yeti 'dzin/ /'khor los 'khor lo rnam par bsgyur/ /gsung bas ljags treni rab tu brkyang / /las kyis rdo rje sna tshogs 'dzin/ /gsung bas cho ga 'dzin pas mchog /gnod sbyin la ni mche bar ldan/ /khu tshur gnyis kyis rdo rje bcings/ /sgeg mo rdo rje gnyis dang ldan/ phreng bas /snarin chen phreng ba 'dzin/ /glu mkhan pi wang ⑩rnam par ldan/ /gar ni rdo rje rtse gsum ste/ /bdug pa yis ni spos khang 'dzin / /me tog me tog snod dang ldan/ /snang bas 1 mar me sdong bu 'dzin/ /dri ni dung phor yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin/ /lcags sgrog dril bur ldan pa dang / /phyag rgya chen po zhes su grags/ /de ltar phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab nas dngos grub la sogs 'byin par 'gyur ba kho na ste/3 4byed1091

de'i skad cig rnams la de dag gi skur bsgoms la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams la ni/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes brjod pa dang / rig pa'i lha mo rnams la ni/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur la sogs pa thams cad bya ste/ dam tshig dam pa mchog gi rdo rje glu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas tshigs su bcad pas blangs la mnyes par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra tu 6 ho/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa las/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa kyi bhā ba āt+ma ko32 haṃ/ zhes byas la/ de nyid kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i skad cig ma la dus 'byor pa ste/ yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu bsam mo/ /de'i steng du re las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa'o/ /de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po'o/ /de'i steng na lo las gser gyi sa gzhi ser po gru —bzhi pa'o/ /de'i steng du sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab zur bzhi dang / rtse mo brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa dpag tshad dang rgyar yangs par bsams la/ de'i steng du rgyu 5dkar po gyur pa las yang dag par byung ba'i dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i khang brtsegs 6bsgom par bya ste/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi dang ldan pa ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa 7rta babs bzhi dang dril bu dang /dra ba la sogs pas yongs su brgyan cing / me tog phreng ba dang / ba dan la sogs pas spras pa rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa bsam par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su rtsa ser po las gyur pa'i na'akhor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa rin po che dang /rdo rjes rnam par spras pa'i 'od sna tshogs dang ldan par bsams te/ de'i 34—1095

dbus su a sau saṃ las seng ge'i khri bskyed pa dang / de bzhin du ngan song thams cad spyong ba'i gnas su/ hūṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ las glang po che'i khri dang / rin chen tog gi gnas su t+t+waṃ a ṭ+wāṃ dzo/las rta'i khri dang / shākya thub pa'i gnas su/haṃ saṃ haṃ las/ rma bya'i khri dang / me tog rgyas pa'i gnas su a gi a las nam mkha' lding gi khri bsam par bya'o/ /de'i dbus seng ge'i khri'i steng du 2/skyil mo krung gis 'dug la/ bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa'i gzugs su bdag nyid bskyed la/ mngon par byang chub pa mngon sum du byed pa mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa de nyid 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ de nyid thugs rje chen po las byung ba'i dbang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhing 'di til gye gang bu bzhin du gang bar gyur pa dang / yang dag par sdogs pa'i byang chub de nyid 'di lta bu yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba byang chub kyi snying po na bzhugs pa ga na ba der gshegs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis de bzhin nyid kyi ched du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bstan nas/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu gang gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rtogs par dka' ba spyod pa thams cad la spro ba bskyed cing ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par bya snyam/de nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pa'i sngags kyis se gol brdabs pas slong (5bar mdzad do/ /de nas sad par gyur pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ oṃ sarba 34byed1096

ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta pra ṇa me na badz+ra ban+dha 1༄dze+e ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag rgya la ste 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bdag gis ma 'tshal na/ de kho na nyid ji lta bu lags/ ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi—/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsung gcig tu 'di skad ces bka' sprul to/ /rigs kyi bu rang gi sems la so sor rtogs la/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'di ④dga' bar bzlasas/ oṃ tsit+ta pra ti ban+dha rgo ༅ ka ro mi/ zhes bya bas phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams gzung ne+e ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog rkyepa thams cad dang bral ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med pa/ de kho na nyid kyi ngo bo nyid rtogs pa'i bdag nyid kyi sems so sor rtogs pa dang / sems rin po che de nyid snying rje chen pos brgyan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang shemanyam pa'i mtshan nyid can zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mthong ba dang / 'di skad gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bdag gi snying ga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur rtogs so/ /de nas rigs kyi bu sems ni rang bzhin kyis ⑩'od gsal bas na/ ji ltar sbyangs pa de ltar 'gyur te/ dper na ras dkar po tshon gyis bsgyur ba bzhin no/ /der yang rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i sngags zlos shig dang shāsna rab tu gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bo dhe tsit+ta ut+pā da yā shārtami/zhes bya bas shin tu gsal ba'i byang chub sems bskyed par gyur pa dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi rnam par yongs su gyur pa las rim gyis 8'phel bar gyur pa dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gyur pa las/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur 34—1097

gda' ba gang lags pa/ de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du mthong lags so/ /de nas shin tu rnam par dag pa spros pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur pa'i sems de nyid la/ dz+nyā na ri 1mi bi dza hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi ③rnam par spros te/zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de las 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs pa byung ste/ de tsachos kyi dbyings kyi gzhal yas khang du zhugs nas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi sems ri bo lta bur bcom ste slar rdo rje chen po'i gzugs rtse lnga pa gcig tu gyur nas spyi bo nas thugs kar zhugs te/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rab tu gnas so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po sems bskyed pa kun tu bzang po khyod kyis mngon du gyur gyi 4de legs par sgrubs 5shig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems bskyed pa kun du bzang po de brtan par bya ba'i phyir sngags 'dis rang gi snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i dbyibs 67su soms shig /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ snang bar byas nas sems can thams cad kyis 7de nas gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng na rdo rjer bdag gis mthong ngo / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems bskyed pa kun tu bzang pos nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du mnyam par 'jug pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang thugs rdo rje 8snyed pa de dag thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis sems dpa'i rdo rjer zhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje dbyings rdo rje dbyings tsozhes rdo rje ming gis — 1dbang bskur ro / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku ni bdag legs par mthong lags so zhes gsol to/ /sems dpa' chen po de lta bas na/ de 37(—/098
