par bya'o/ /gal te bgegs yod na bsang gtor bya zhing / rdo rje gnod sbyin kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas me rnams sbyangs te/ de nyid kyis mar gyi sreg blugs gsum mam/ bdun dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas mar kyi dgang blugs gsum mam / bdun rang gi sngags/ oṃ asna ye che ge mo shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes dbul / de nas yam shing dbul te/ oṃ badzā ya swā hā/ yam shing gi'o/ /o asna ye swā hā/ mar kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra che ge mo swā hā/til dang yungs kar gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho dang 'bras chan kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras ma grugs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zas mchog gi'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra swā hā/ ku sha'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā / drur ba'i myu gu'i'o/ /oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ asna ye che ge mo shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ma du ba'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hā/ gro'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ nas so ba'i'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma sha'i'o / /oṃ ma hā shrī ba he swā hā/ bil ba dang / star kha dang / dzā ti pha la'i'o / /sngags kyi mjug la/ shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod de/'di ni rdzas dbul ba'i rim pa'o/ /dbul ba'i gnas dang / dgongs pa ni man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /me'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'khor lo'i sngags dang phyag rgyas me 'bar ba de nyid kyi thugs ka'i rā lto ba'i nang du rin po che'i gzhal yas khang re mig dgu ste ba dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug dang / gru chad dang / khyams dang / sgo khyud dang / rta babs dang / them skas la sogs pas brgyan par bsams la/ me'i thugs ka'i dkyil 'khor kyi zla ba dang / pad+ma'i steng du lha rnams re re'i sa bon gyi yi ge 34—1209

yongs su gyur pa'i mtshan ma la sogs pa dang ldan par kun rig rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa ste/ bar 'dir sgo dbye/ bdag gi snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje bsams pa las/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i snying po/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ zhes brjod cing / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bsnol te dpung mgor bzhag la/ mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar byas la/ gung mo dang mthe bong gnyis gtogs shing /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang gi gnas nas bskul te/ji ltar bsams pa'i gnas kyi khor yug tu bzhugs par bsam/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis rang bzhin kyi phyi nas 'brang ba'i bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas shar phyogs kyi sgor lcags kyu can gyi phyag rgya bcings la/ phyag rgya de nyid shar phyogs kyi sgor lcags kyur gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ zhes brjod pas/ lcags kyus bkug pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams so so'i sgo drung du byon par bsam mo/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor zhags par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ zhags pas drangs pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams so so'i nang du zhugs par bsam mo/ /phyag rgya de nyid bkrol nas/ nub phyogs kyi sgor lcags sgog gi phyag rgya bcings la / phyag rgya de nyid nub phyogs kyi sgor lcags sgog tu gyur par bsams la/oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ zhes brjod cing lcags sgrog bsdams pa'i tshul gyis bdag ji srid 'dod par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbyer med par bzhugs par bsam/phyag rgya de nyid bkrol nas byang phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje 'bebs pa'i las kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ phyag rgya de nyid byang phyogs kyi sgor dril bur gyur par bsams la/oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya hoḥ/ zhes brjod cing / dril bu bskyod pa'i tshul gyis de 34byed 210

bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par bsams te/ phyag rgya de nyid dgrol lo/ /de dag gi sgu mdog dang phyag mtshan dang / bzhugs tshul la sogs pa so so'i lta bas yun ring du blta zhing bsam mo/ /thugs rjes bskul lo thugs mnga' ba'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /dam tshig phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /bsdams pa rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /phyag rgya 'di ni kun rig gi'o/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ / thal mo sbyar/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shudhe bi shudhe/sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shudhe swā hā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes kun la sbyar ro/ /rdo rje bsdams pas gung gnyis bsgreng / /mje bong mje chung gnyis bkyed brkyang / /mdzub gnyis pad+ma ltar bkug pa/ /ngan song rnam par spyong ba'i'o/ /oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ya sarba a bā ya hūṃ/ de las mdzub srin rin chen bya/ /rin chen tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ya sarba a pā ya sarba satwa bh+ya hūṃ t+t+waṃ/ mje bong mje chung so sor mnyam/ /lhag ma brkyang ba shākya thub/ /oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ya bi sho dha ni dīḥ/ de nas lag g.yon bsgyur byas la/ /mi 'jigs sbyin par byas pa ni/ /me tog cher rgyas phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ya sarba a pā ya tra tha aḥ/ bcings las mdzub gnyis mig tu bya/ /mthe'u chung srin lag nang du bsnol / /gung mo mnyam par bsgreng ba ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyi yin par gsungs / /oṃ sho dha ni hūṃ/ thal sbyar gung mo gnyis bsgreng nas/ /mdzub gnyis ngos la sbyar byas nas/ /rtse gsum tshul du byas pa ni/ /mā ma tī yi phyag rgya'o / /oṃ sho dha ni t+t+waṃ/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba las/ /gung mo pad+mar byas pa ni/ /gos dkar mo yi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sho dha ni tweḥ/ thal sbyar gung mo gnyis bsgreng la/ /mdzub gnyis rgyab sbyar dkris byas te/ /mthe bong gung 34—sde211

sbyar at+pa la/ /'di ni sgol ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sho dha ni aḥ/ phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa las/ /mdzub gnyis rdo rjer brkyang ba ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sarba bid badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ de las mdzub mo g.yas bkug pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sarba bid badz+ra rā dza dza/ drang por bcas pa chags pa'o/ /sarba bid badz+ra rā ga ho/ de las mdzub gnyis slar bkug ste/ /se gol gtogs pa legs pa'o/ /sarba bid badz+ra sā dhu dhu/ de las bar ma tshigs bcag pa/ /rdo rje rin chen yin pa'o/ /sarba bid tram̐/ de las sor mo 'od zer ltar/ /bkyed pa rdo rje gzi brjid do/ /sarba bid re/ de las bye bor bzhag pa ni/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan phyag rgya'o/ /sarba bidhi/ de las phab nas kha ru ni/ /bzhag pa rdo rje bzhad pa'o/ /sarba bid hā/ bcings las mdzub gnyis pa de ltar bya/ rdo rje chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /sarba bid byāḥ/mdzub gnyis dang po tshigs bcag pa/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rnon po'i'o/ /sarba bid dhī/ mdzub gnyis gdu bu ltar byas pa/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o/ /sarba bid sum̐/ de las mdzub gnyis pad+ma yi/ /'dab gnyis byas pa pad+ma'i'o/ /sarba be+ed bhā/ de las mdzub gnyis dgye byas pa/ /las kyi rdo rje phyag rgya'o/ /sarba bid shaṃ/ de las mdzub gnyis rab bkye ste/ /mgrin par 'khyud pa bsrung ba'i'o/ /sarba bid re/ de las rtse mo slar bkug ste/ /mche ba ltar byas gnod sbyin no/ /sarba bid k+ṣ-i/ de nas mdzub gnyis nang bsdus te/ /rab tu bsdams pas khu tshur ro/ /sarba bid saṃ/ rdo rje bsdams pa dam byas te//mthe bong gnyis gshibs khā gye'o/ /oṃ sarba bid ma hā badzod bhā ba dā na pā ra mi tā pū dza hūṃ/ de nas kha nas mdun du ni/ /lag pa brkyang ba mā le'o/ /oṃ 34—1212

sarba bid ma hā badzod bhā ba shī la pā ra mi tā pū dza tram̐/ thal mo sbyar ba mā le nas/ /phar drangs pa ni shīrti'o/ /oṃ sarba bid ma hā badzod bhā wa k+ṣun ti pā ra mi tā pū dza tweḥ/ gar las rdo rje thal mo ni/ /spyi bor bzhag pa narti'o/ /oṃ sarba bid ma hā badzod bhā ba bīr+ya pā ra mi tā pū dza aḥ/ bsdams pa thur blugs bdug pa'o—/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pā ya bi sho dha na dha ma dha ma dhu pa ya dh+ya na pā ra mi tā pū dza hūṃ/ thams cad du 'thor me tog go/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pā ya put+pa bi lo ki ni pradz+nyā na pā ra mi tā pū dza tram̐/ mtheb mnyam mdun 'dzin mar me'o /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pā ya dz+nyā na a ba lo ka ka ri pra ni bye pā ra mi tā pū dza s+thāḥ/rdo rje bsdams pa brkyang byug dri'o/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pā ya gan+dha u pa ya pā ra mi tā pū dza ā/ mdzub gnyis bkug pa lcags kyu'o/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba na ra ka āk+ṣa ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ mdzub rtse sprad pa zhags pa'o/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba na da ka u da ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ mdzub gnyis 'khyud pa lcags sgrog go/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba na ra ka ban+dha mo tsa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ rab tu bkod pa'i dril bu'o/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba na ra ka ghar+bhe bi sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas las kyi phyag rgya rnams/ /mdor bsdus rab tu bshad par bya/ /g.yon pa lte bar brkyang ba la/ /g.yas pa rdo rje'i tshul du ni/ /kun rig snang mdzad phyag rgya'o/ /ngan song sbyong la sogs pa bzhi/ /sa gnon mchod sbyin ting nge 'dzin/ /mi 'dzin sbyin sogs go rims bzhin/ /'gying bcas rdo rje dril 'dzin pa/ /lcags kyu g.yas kyis 'dzin pa yin/ /mda' 'phangs tshul dang se gol dang / /mdzub bsgreng dpral bar 'dzin rin chen/ /khu tshur gshibs pa nyi ma'i'o/ /khu tshur g.yon mdog g.yas gru gzugs/ /kha yi phyogs bzhag bzhad pa'o/ /g.yas kyis 34—1213

g.yon dbye chos kyi yin/ /ral gri gnyis dpung 'dzin rnon po/ /khu tshur snying gar gshibs khyod 'khor/ /kha thad nas drangs smra ba'i rgya/ /khu tshur gnyis ni gar byas te/ /'gram pa g.yas g.yon gzhag par bya/ /de nas yang bskor spyi bor bzhag /spyi bor bskor ba las kyi'o/ /khu tshur go cha'i tshul phyag rgya/ /de nas mje chung mche gnod spyin/ /khu tshur gnyis nas khu tshur rgya'o/ /de las dku gnyis g.yas g.yon du/ /bzhag nas 'gying ba lā gye'o/ /phreng ba 'dzin pa mā le'o/ /kha nas dbyung tshul gīrti'o/ /gar du byas pa nirti'o/ /de las khu tshur thur du ni/ /blugs pa ltar byas bdug pa'o/ /gyen du 'thor ba me tog go/ /mdun du gshibs pa mar me'o/ /khu tshur rtse sprad brang la ni/ /byug pa de ni gabye'o/ /mje'u chung mdzub gnyis so so ru/ /'khyud par byas nga/ lcags kyu'o/ /de las mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa/ /gdu bur byas pa zhags pa'o / /de nas gung mdzub mjeb rtse sprad/ /lu gu rgyud ltar byas pa las/ /lhag ma basbus pa lcags sgog go/ /de nas mdzub gnyis 'khyud pa las/ /khu tshur mnan bskyod dril bu'o/ /lce la pad+ma'i zla dkyil du/ /gong du bstan pa'i sngags de dag /bkod nas zla ba bya ba de/ /chos kyi phyag rgyar rab bstan pa'o//ji ltar bstan pa'i bsgoms pa dang / /phyag rgya phyag mtshan 'dzin pa dang / /thugs kar rdo rje bsgom pa ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /phyag rgya chen ngo/ra bstan nga/'o/ /'jig rten pa yi phyag rgya ni/ /mje bong mje'u chung rtse sprad de/ /lhag ma gsum ni rdo rjer bya/ /de ni brgya byin phyag rgya'o / /g.yas pa be con ltar byas pa/ /g.yon pa mgo thog bcer byas la/ /gshin rje 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa zhags pa 'dzin byas te/ /3(—/21 /

g.yon pa sbrul gyi gdengs kar byas/ /chu lha 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa snye ma 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon pa mdzub mo bkug pa ni/ /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas thal brkyang sbyar mthe bong bkug /smrang 'don lta bur byas pa dang / /g.yon pa gubye 'dzin pa ni/ /me lha 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin pa dang / /gung mo srin lag mthil bkug pa/ /bden bral srin po'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa ba dan tshul byas nas/ /g.yon pa btsir ba'i tshul byas ni/ /rlung lha 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o / /g.yas pa phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon pa zhags mig ltar byas pa/ /dbang ldan 'khor bcas phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba ni/ /pa ba sangs dang mig dmar ro/ /kha thad mdzub bsgreng phur bu'o/ /lag g.yas thal bgrad nyi ma la'o/ /zla ba g.yon pa bgrad pa'o/ /glang sna chu srin 'dra sgra gcan / /se gol gtogs pa gza' lag ste/ /spen pa g.yon pa 'dzin ltar bya / /lag pa gnyis kyi mkhrig ma bsnol/ /bkan te g.yas pa'i steng byung nas / /sor mo bsdu zhing bsnol ba ste/ /rgyu skar spyi yi phyag rgya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor lha rnams phyag rgyas btab nas/ de nas zhabs bsil gyi snod blangs la/ /yid kyis zhabs bsil dbul bar bya'o/ /sngags oṃ pra ba ra saṅka ra pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de nas mchod yon lag tu dbul lo/ /i ma ar+ghaṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/tri lan sidhidz+re pra yats+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon phyag tu dbul bar bya'o/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pas dbang bsgur ro/ /mchod pa bya ste/shin tu dri zhim pa'i me tog dang / oṃ badz+ra puste zhes bya ba dang / snying po dkar po'i bdug spos dang / oṃ badz+ra dhū pe/ zhes bya ba dang / ba'i mar 34—/215

gyi mar me dang / oṃ badz+ra di pe ā lo ke/ zhes bya ba dang / ga pur dang /tsan+dan gyi dri zhim po dkar po dang / oṃ badz+ra gadhe/ zhes bya ba dang / kha zas dkar gsum mngon par bsngags la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+padze+etāta / ces bya bas dbul te/ de dag dang pos bsangs te/ so so las kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas gtugs la byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas yang dbul ba la sogs pa'i mchod pa bya ba'i phyag rgya bzhi'o/ /de nas bdug pa la sogs pa'i las kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ snying po brjod cing mchod pa ni/rdo rje khu tshur gnyis ka thur du bstan te bkrol la dbul/ badz+ra dhū pe/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis me tog 'thor ba'i tshul du gyen du bstan te bkrol la/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/zhes/ bya bas dbul/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mar me'i lce ltar gyen du bzung la/badz+ra ā lo ke/ zhes bya bas dbul/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis byug spos byug pa'i tshul du rang gi lus la bcar te brkyang la/ badz+ra gabye/ zhes dbul lo/ /de nas yang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par byas te/ las kyi phyag rgya bcing ba ni / rdo rje khu tshur mkhal ltag gnyis su bzhag ste/ lā gye'i snying po'i don sems 'a/ bsam zhing sems dang bar gyur pas glo g.yon par mgo bo btud pa 1ni rdo rje mdzes ma'o/ /sngags oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha da/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rang gi mabo la phreng ba bcing ba'i tshul du byas pa ni phreng ba ma'i'o/ /sngags oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta ram̐/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa ltar byas pa ni dbyangs mkhan ma'i'o/ /sngags oṃ badz+ra dharma ga ya ne+e/ rdo rje khu tshur g.yon pa mdun du bkan te bzhag la/ de'i steng du khu tshur g.yas pa kha sbub ste bzhag nas / sdem bag can du lag pa gnyis phan tshun dkri zhing / g.yon pa'i 3(byed/2/6

mdzub mo la sogs pa dgrol ba'i tshul du byas te/ de bzhin du g.yas pa khu tshur la sogs dgrol ba'i tshul du byas pa ni/ gar mkhan ma'i'o/ /sngags oṃ badz+ra karma ka rod bhā ba/ da ni mchod pa nyi shus mchod par bya ste/ 'di ni mchod pa nyi shus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la kun du mchod nas/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i mtshan ma'i dbus su rang gi chos kyi phyag rgya dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid du bsams te/ yang mchod yon phul la/'thor 'thung snga ma bzhin du sbyin sreg gi yo byad thams cad bsang gtor byas la/dgang gzar dang blugs gzar lag tu blangs la/ byin za brtag ste/ mar gyis bkang ste sbar zhing / ji snyed pa thams cad me'i zhal du bstabs par bya'o//de nas gtso bo la me lha nyid dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal ba lnga dang /sems dpa' bcu drug po rnams la brgya rtsa brgyad dbul/ lhag ma rnams la nyi shu rtsa gcig dbul lo/ /rdzas rnams ni gong du rgyas par smos par zad do/ /de nas gong du smos pa'i rdo rje dril bu rnam pa gnyis pad+ma'i lag skor lnga byas te/sangs rgyas thams cad la bstod par bya'o/ /chos nyid ye shes skyon bral ba'i/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun rig la'o/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin las/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /ngan song thams cad spyong mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal spyong ba'i rgyal po la/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gyis/ /bsam pa thams cad skong mdzad pa/ /rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag /gsung rab pad+ma'i kha rgyas pa/ /khams gsum dbugs 'byen mdzad pa po/ /37(—/2/7

shākya'i rigs dbang khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nan tan ye shes phrin las bdag /sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus sems ni zhi mdzad pa/ /me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun du yang / /rigs kyi yum gyi sgu bstan pa/ /lo tsa na dang mā ma tī/ /dkar mo sgol ma khyod phyag 'tshal / /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /zhes bya ba nas/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la'o/ /zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /sgeg mo phreng dang dbyangs dang gar/ /spos ma me tog mar me dang / /dri chab la sogs lha mo brgyad / /phyi nang lha mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi phyi rim gnas pa yi/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po la/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas pa ni/ /mche ba drug pa mdog dkar ba'i/ /glang chen de ni brgya byin gdan/ /rol pas 'dug par gur kum 'dra/ /mtshan ma sha rtsi u pa sbo/ /'khor dang bcas te phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i rgyal po ni/ /ma he'i gdan can g.yo/na dkur brten/ /mchan na nag mo 'chi bdag mo/ /be con g.yon 'dzin phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nub phyogs ngos kyi chu lha ni/ /lus mdog dkar zhing 'tsher ba la/ /sbrul gyis lus brgyan chu srin gdan/ /zhags pa rin chen bsnams phyag 'tshal/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin rgyal po ni/ /gser gyi mdog 'dra rin chen dang / /g.yon pa snye ma rta yi gdan/ /mchan na chung ma bsnams/ phyag 'tshal/ /me gzugs kha dog drug 'dra ba'i/ /dkyil na na chung gnas pa yi/ /lus dmar po la ra skyes gdan/ /gudhe dbyug 'dzin phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho nub mtshams kyi bden bral ni/ /yi dwags gdan can dmar nag mdog /me bur ba ni g.yon na 'dzin/ /g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin 3 1—/2/8

phyag 'tshal/ /nub byang rlung lha'i rgyal po ni/ /nam mkha'i mdog can sha ba'i gdan—/ /ba dan gyen du bsgreng ba 'dzin/ /g.yon pa rlung sgye'u thogs phyag 'tshal—/ /byang shar 'byung po'i rgyal po ni/ /thal ba'i mdog 'dra rta yi gdan—/ /g.yas nyid rtse gsum a 'bra dang / /g.yon nyid gudhe rag sha phreng / /bgegs gdon rnams la dbang sgyur zhing / /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /de yi phyi rim phyogs bzhi na/ /bar na gza' rnams brgyad gnas pa / /pa ba sangs dang mig dmar gnyis/ /shar na gnas shing 'khor rnams skyong / /smin drug snar ma mgo dang lag /nab so rgyal skag sogs phyag 'tshal—/ /phur bu dang ni nyi ma gnyis/ /lho na gnas shing 'khor skyong ba/ /mchu dang gre dang dbo dang ni/ /me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang / /sa ga la sogs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zla ba sgra gcan nub phyogs na/ /gnas shing rang gi 'khor skyong ba/ /lha mtshams dang ni snren dang snubs hūṃ/ /chu stod dang ni chu smad dang / /byi bzhin dang ni gro bzhin dang / /nub phyogs gza' skar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gza' lag spen pa byang phyogs na/ /gnas shing rang gi 'khor skyong ba/ /mon gru dang ni mon gre dang / /khrums stod khrums smad nam gru dang / /tha skar dang ni bra nye ste/ /gza' skar tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod//sgo yi dbus su gnas pa gang / /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /dad sogs bsgoms pa las skyes pa'i/ /sgo srung rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod de/ gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub rnams gsol ba gdab pa'o// //bzod par gsol zhing gshegs te/ yi ge brgya pa nus tshad du brjod nas/'di skad brjod do/ /cho ga nyams pa gang bgyis pa/ /mgon po bdag la 34—/219

bzod par gsol/ /mi shes pa dang ma 'byor pas/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /cho ga dman pa bzod par gsol/ /de nas yang ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /dngos grub stsal nas gshegs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje sems ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings nas/ sngags 'di brjod cing gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /oṃ muḥzhes bya ba dang / sngags 'dis kyang gshegs su gsol bar bya ste/ oṃ kri to bha ba arja satwa ta sedhe ma me dad de yats+tsha nu/ nu na ga ma na yo tu / zhes brjod do/ /de nas de'i shar lho mtshams nas/ thab nang gi lus la bcug pa phyir spyan drangs te/ me lha la mchod yon la sogs pa phul te/yo byad kyi lhag ma rnams kyis lan gsum gsum du sbyin sreg byas la/ de'i tha mar yon bdag g.yon du bzhag la/ bsgrub pa'i dngos grub ci 'dod pa gsol ba gdab bo/ /oṃ asna ye ya hi ya hi swa s+t+waṃ tsi pa ra dze+e/ sid+dhi the ga gats+tsha ha bhu bhu ga ta/ zhes brjod cing spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya las mje bong be+er bkyed cing 'bar ba'i me gshegs su gsol lo/ /rje btsun gyi yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar yi ge brgya pas bshags nas/ yang me thab dang yo byad rnams bsangs nas/ de nas bdag dam tshig sems dpar bsgoms pa'i thugs kar t+t+waṃ bsams pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo phyag na rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya bar gyur te/ bzhin dang cha lugs khro bo'i tshul du bsam/ mdun gyi me thab tu yang yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpar gyur nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas / oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha a na lha ma hā badz+ra gro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba 3(—/220

bi dra ba/ sarba a pa/ nā sha ya nā sha ya ha ra ha ra/ pā shān hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i skur gyur te/ sku mdog sngon bo zhal bgrad cing mche ba gcigs pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang /ral gri la sogs pa mtshon cha grangs med pa bsnams pa/ sbrul kyis brgyan pa/stag lpags kyis smad brgyan pa/ 'khor khro bo mang pos bskor/ rig lngas dbu brgyan pa/ zhabs pad+ma lta bus ro mnan cing thabs mkhas pa'i thugs rjes sdig pa spyong bar bsams te/ mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil la sogs pa phul la/ dang por khro bo'i sngags kyis mar dang yam shing phul la/ de nas dzas rnams gcig tu bsres la/ bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags btab pa la/lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs la/ mdzub mo bsgreng ste/ brang la dpung pa dam du bcum la/ lag pa g.yas sbyin sreg bya ste/ sngags gong du smos pa dang /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /bar bar du ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing til bsreg go/ /de nas khro bo gshegs su gsol lo/ /bdag nyid phyag rgya dgrol zhing / lus bsrung ba la sogs pa bya'o / /de ltar bsregs nas thal bar gyur pa dang / rdo rje basbu ba'i sngags sam ha ri zhes brjod cing /rus pa dang thal ba rnams bsdus nas/ snod gtsang mar bcug ste/ mchod rten gdab pa'i phyogs su gzhag go/ /de nas ga pur la sogs pa'i chu dang /ba'i mar dang / zho dang / lci ba dang / gcin dang / rus pa bsres te/ngan song spyong ba'i sngags 'bum man chad bzlas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha gang yang rung ba'i gzugs su gdab pa'am/ yang na mchod rten byas te/ mchod 3 (—/22/

rten gdab pa'am/ gnyis gdab pa dang / gsum gdab pa dang / brgya rtsa brgyad man chad gdab pa'i bar du/ gzhan dang mthun pa'i tshul gyis/sngags dang phyag rgyas btab nas/ sku'am mchod rten kyi srun sngar/ ngan song spyong ba'i sngags nyis brgya man chad bzlas so/ /de nas mchod rten 'bar ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bzang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste mtshan ma de dag ma mthong na/ 'bum phrag stong man chod bzlas shing / ji srid mtshan ma dge ba rnams byung gi bar du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod cing / rtse gcig pa'i sems mnyam par bzhag ste bzlas brjod bya/ de ltar bzlas pa'i mthar/mtshan gcig bzlas pa rab tu byas na/ shi ba nges par sdig las grol zhing /mtshan ma bzang po rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro// //ngan song spyong ba'i rgyal po brtag pa yi/ /shi ba'i don du cho gar gsungs pa bya/ /'gro ba'i don du nyung zad gcig bsdus pa/ /'di yis nyam thag sbug bsngal byang bar shog /bla ma mkhas pas ston pa'i lung la brten/ /bdag 'dra rtog ges bla ma'i lung thos nas/ /mos dang goms pas shi ba'i cho ga byas / /thams cad bla med byang chub thob par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i lung las/ ro sbyong zhing sreg pa'i thabs kyi cho ga mdo dang bsres nas / slo/ba dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrad+dhā ka 1ra barma dang / bod kyi dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //

༄/ /ngan song thams cad spyong ba'i thabs zhes bya ba/༄1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na u pā ya nā ma/bod be+ed du/ ngan song thams cad sbyong ba'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad rnam par spyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dam tshig la brtan 2par gnas shing slob dpon las tshul bzhin dbang thob pa/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang cho ga'i bye brag la mkhas shing bdag dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa la brtson pa des byams pa dang / snying rje chen po'i sems kyis sems can gang dag 'chi ba'i dus byas te/ mi dge ba'i rnam par smin pas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong bar gyur pa dag /nyam nga'i gnas nas 'don cing / mtho ris kyi bde ba la dgod pa'i phyir ngan song rnam par sbyong ba'i brtag pa las byung 31—/221

ba'i shi ba'i cho ga bya bar 'os so/ /de yang rgyud las/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /de ltar yang ni gsum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab tu brtag /de nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /dmyal ba la sogs sdug bsngal las/ /de ni myur du rnam par thar rim gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung bas/ ngan song rnam par spyong ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung las smos pa bzhin du bris nas bum pa lnga bzhag pa la rigs lnga so so'i snying po bum pa re re la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/shi ba'i ro'am gzugs brnyan la tshul bzhin du dbang bskur na myur du sdug bsngal las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /thabs gzhan yang rgyud las/ de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas de dbang bskur/ /lha yi gzugs su brtags nas kyang / /mchod rten dbus su gzhag par bya/ /rang gi lha'am lha gzhan gyi/ /snying po snying gar bris nas kyang / /lha 'dra bar yang sems babyed de/ /khyim gyi nang du gzhag par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung bas/ shi ba'i ro'am gzugs brnyan ni sngags dang phyag rgyas tshul bzhin du dbang bsgur nas lha yin no bar sems kyis brtags te/ lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten chen po byas pa'i dbus su bzhag pa'am/ de ltar ma nus na ni shi ba nyid kyi yi dam gyi lha'am / ngan song rnam par sbyong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa lha gzhan gyi snying po ro'am gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar bris la/de lha yin par sems bskyed de/ dur ram mchod pa'i nang du bcug na sdig pa rnams byang bar 'gyur ro/ /thabs gzhan yang rgyud las/ de yi ming nas sgos nas ni/ /gur kum bzang pos sngags bris te/ rim kyis 'bum ni tshang 31—/225

tsam du/ /mchod rten las ni rab tu bya/ /sdig can sdog ni zad bya'i phyir/ /bye ba snyed ni tshang bar bya/ /de ni nges par dmyal ba las/ /'di byas pas ni grol bar 'gyur/ /yi dwags byol song sdug bsngal las/ /grol te lha yi gnas su skye/ /zhes 'byung bas/ shi ba'i ming dang rigs lnga'i snying po spel zhing gro ga la gur kum gyis bris nas mchod rten gyi nang du bcug cing / tsha tsha 'bum tshang bar gzhung bzhin du gdab/ sdig pa shin tu che na mchod rten bye ba tshang bar btab na ngan song gsum las grol zhing lha'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /thabs gzhan yang rgyud las/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /ji skad gsung ba'i sngags bzlas shing / /'bum phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /brgya phrag stong du tshang ba dang / /bye ba snyed du rab bzlas na/ /lha yi gnas su nges par skye/ /zhes 'byung bas/ sngags mkhan nyid lha'i rnal 'byor du byas la/ shi ba'i ming dang lha'i snying po rnams spel zhing bzlas brjod gzhung bzhin du 'bum phrag stong ngam/ brgya phrag stong ngam/ bye ba tshang bar bzlas na lha'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /thabs gzhan yang rgyud las/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni//mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya'am ni/ /yang na brgya phrag stong du snyed/ /sbyin sreg byas nga/ra gyur na ni/ /dmyal ba chen por gyur pa yi/ /sdig pa de las thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung bas/ shi ba'i ming dang snying po rnams spel zhing tshul bzhin du spyin sreg gi las byas te/ grangs 'bum phrag brgya'am/brgya phrag stong tshang bar bzlas shing sbyin sreg byas na ngan song las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na gzhung nyid las smos pa'i me'i mdog dkar zhing me lce g.yas su 'khyel ba la sogs pa ltas bzang po rnams byung ba'i bar du spyin sreg 34— 226

bya'o—/ /thabs gzhan yang rgyud las/ sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /sbyin sreg rab tu bya ba yin/ /zhes smos pas/ sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te/ dbang bskur nas me thab tu sbyin sreg bya ba dang / tsha tsha btab nas bzlas brjod la sogs bya dgos te/ 'dir gong gi cho ga'i thabs rnam par rgyud nyid las gsal bar rab tu smos so/ /de yang sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor byed par 'dod pas/ dang por shi ba'i ro'am/ gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar shi ba nyid kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i yi dam gye lha'am/ lha med na ngan song rnam par sbyong ba la sogs pa lha gzhan gang yang rung ba'i snying po gro ga la gur kum gyis bris te snying gar gdags/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par spyong ba'i snying po de bzhin du bris nas spyi bor gdags te/ snying gar bris pa'i snying po gang yin pa de lha de nyid du ro de gyur par bsam zhing byin gyes brlabs nas / gtsang ma'i nang du khri'am stegs bu'i steng du kha nub tu bstan la gzhag go / /sngags mkhan shar du kha bltas nas mdun du maṇ+ḍal byas nas zhi ba dang ldan pa'i mchod pa rnams dgram zhing / mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma cha gnyis tshul bzhin du bshams/ 'byor na 'phan gdugs ci 'byor kyang bre/ de nas bdag nyid rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor du gzhung bzhin du byas nas bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ phyag byas la mchod pa dbul zhing thugs dam bsgul ba dang / dam tshig can rnams la gtor ma phul te phrin las bcol ba dang 'gro ba la sbyin pa rgya cher spel bas lan chags bral bar byas pa la sogs pa gzhung gzhan dang mthun par byas nas bde bar gshegs pa de dag gis thugs kar bzlas bya'i yi ge na mo bha ga ba te bya ba'am/ oṃ sarba durga 34—1227

ti / zhes bya ba gang yang rung ba bkod la/ de bzhin du bdag gi snying gar yang bsams te/ gzhung bzhin du zhi 1snaba'i ming dang sngags spel zhing zhag ci nus tsam gyis bzlas brjod bya'o/ /cho ga shes pa gzhan yod na gnas de nyid dam gzhan nyid du zhi ba'i thab khung tshul bzhin du brtsigs nas phyag rgya bzhi bkod de/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dang sreg rdzas la sogs pa gzhung bzhin du bshams nas mchod pa dang gtor ma tshul bzhin du dbul zhing btang ba dang /sbyin sreg gi cho ga byas pa la sogs pa zhag ci nus kyis bya'o/ /gzhan yang sgrib pa sbyangs shing tshogs bsag pa'i phyir mchod rten gdab pa dang mdo sde zab mo bklag pa dang / sbyin pa 'byor tshad btang ba la sogs pa dge ba'i las rgya cher bya bar rigs so/ /de ltar dge ba'i phyogs ci nus pa byas nas/ sa phyogs brtags par sa'i cho ga gzhung bzhin du byas la dkyil 'khor ngos gcig po la khru drug nga/ gru bzhi dpang khru gang ba zhig byas pa'i dbus su/ me thab kho ra khor yug tu khru do pa zlum po zabs su khru gang ba/ mu ran 'phang dang zheng sor bzhi bzhi pa zlum por bskor/ lci bas skyang nul legs par bya/ sa dkar pos bsgu zhing dris byug /de nas thig skud legs pa cig gis tshul bzhin du thig btab nas/ tshon phye sna lngas bri ba ni rnge thab kyi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad nga/ gcig bya ba ni shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du sna tshogs/ rdo je rnams tshul bzhin du bkod do/ /mu ran la rdo rje rkyang pa'i ra ba rtse lnga pa'am/ rtse gsum pas bskor ro/ /de'i phyi rim gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug la shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la rdo rje dang lcags kyu dang mda' dang mgu bar ston pa rnams dgod do/ /lho'i rtsibs bzhi la nor bu rin po che dang nyi 34—/228

ma'i dkyil 'khor dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang so'i phreng ba rnams dgod do/ /nub kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la rdo rje pad+ma dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang dung rnams dgod do/ /byang phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi la rdo rje kha bzhi pa dang go cha dang mche ba dang khu tshur rnams dgod do/ /de'i phyi rim gyi gru chad 1kyi shar lhor smin ma 'degs 1pa'i tshul dang bdug pa dang / lho nub tu rin po che'i phreng ba dang me tog dang / nub byang du yid du 'ong ba'i glu dang mar me dang / byang shar du gar byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang / byug pa rnams dgod do/ /de'i phyi rim snam bu la phyag rgya bzhis gtams pa dgod do/ /de'i phyi rim gyi snam bu la shar du rdo rje gdeng po dang zla ba/ shar lhor me thab/ lhor be+e con/lho nub tu ral gri/ nub tu zhags pa dang / bum pa dang / nyi ma/ nub byang du ba dan/ byang du dbyug pa/ byang shar du mdung rtse gsum pa rnams dgod do/ /de'i phyi rim gyi sgo bzhi'i shar du lcags kyu/ lhor zhags pa/nub tu lcags sgrog byang du dril bu rnams dgod do/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gye rgyan jem skas bzhi'i phreng ba dang lda ldi dang do shal dang dril bu dang rnga ma dang seng ge dang ba lang la sogs pas brgyan pa bri'o/ /de yang rgyud las khru bzhi pa yi tshad du ni/ cho ga bzhin du khung brkos la/ /rdo rjes mtha' ma bskor ba yi//'khor lo dbus su bri bar bya/ /rigs lnga yi ni phyag rgya rnams/ /ji bzhin pa yi phyogs su bri/ /ji bzhin sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /'jig rten gtso la sogs pa bri/ /zhes smos so/ /de ltar sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor smos nas bum pa chus bkang ba/ sman dang 'bru dang rin po che dang mgul chings dang bum pa'i kha rgyan la sogs pa gzhung dang mthun par byas pa lnga yan chad dgod pa 34—/229

—dang / lha bshos snod gtsang mas bkang ba brgyad dam bcu drug snyed kyi bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang btung ba sna tshogs pa dang / me tog dang bdug pa dang / byug pa dang mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang rgyal mtshan dang / bla re dang gdugs dang ba dan dang 'phan la sogs pas brgyan pa dang / dkyil 'khor kyi me tog sil ma bkram zhing ku shas bskor ro/ /mchod yon gyi gtor ma rgyas par cha gnyis kyang bsham mo/ /de yang rgyud las/ chu sogs bum pa gang ba dang / /gtor mas snod rnams bkang ba dang / /brgyad snyed tsam du gzhag bya snyam/ /yang na bcu drug steng du gzhag /bza' ba dang ni bca' ba'i bshos/ /me tog phreng sogs de bzhin te/ /bla re rgyal mtshan dar la sogs/ /gdugs mchog rnams ni legs par brgyan/ /zhes smos so/ /gzhan yang sbyin sreg gi yo byad mar khu dang 'o ma dang til dang / nyungs kar dang 'bras chan dang / 'bras so ba dang / drur ba dang / yam shing 'o ma can dang / dri zhim po las byas pa'i sor brgyad dam/ sor nyi shu bzhi'i bar dang / bud shing 'o ma can skam po zlum po rnams dang / ga pur dang gur kum la sogs pa dri zhim pa rnams bsag go / /de yang rgyud las/ ga pur gur kum la sogs pa/ /mar dang 'o ma til bskol la/ /til dang yungs kar 'bras rnams dang / /dri yi chus ni legs/ bkang ste/ /'bras chan yos dang byur ba dang / /sbrang rtsi sha khar mar ldan pa/ /brgya phrag du mar yongs bzlas pa/ /yam shing la yang de bzhin du/ /zhes smos so/ /de ltar mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsags te/ bdag nyid rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor du byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad kun la las thams 371—/230

cad pa'am/ ngan song spyong ba'i sngags kyis gdab/ sreg rdzas kun la yang ngan song spyong ba'i sngags kyis gdab/ brgya rtsa brgya phrag du mar bzlas so/ /de nas las thams cad pa'am/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas 1 bgegs bskrad cing mtshams bcad do/ /rdo rje ra ba dang dra ba dang phur bu la sogs pa'i sngags sam rgyud dang ldan par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi snying gar sna tshogs rdo rjes bsdus pas 'phags pa spyan drangs te/ phyag rgya bzhis bzhugs su gsol nas/ yon chab la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams tshul bzhin du dbul lo/ /de yang rgyud las/ cho ga shes par bris nas kyang / /lha rnams mang po spyan drangs nas/ /sngags shes pas ni sngags phyag rgyas/ /ar+gha phul bar shes nas kyang / /mdor na mchod pa 2byas nas ni/ /lha yi spyor bar rab gnas la/ /zhes smos so/ /de nas gtor ma rnams tshul bzhin du byen gyes brlabs nas/ dam tshig can rnams la gtor ma phul te/ ming 'di zhes bya ba'i sgrib pa sbyang zhing / bdag 'gro ba'i don brtsam pa'i bstong grogs mdzad du gsol zhes brjod do/ /'gro ba spyir gtor ma bsngos nas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba'i lan chags byang zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs su gyur cig ces brjod de gtang / sngags mkhan gzhan ma zhig yod na bum pa lnga la rigs lnga'i snying po dang shi ba'i ming spel zhing cung zad bzlas la de nas ngan song spyong ba'i sngags ci mang du bzlas brjod bya/ gzhan med na bdag nyid kyis bum pa gcig la ngan song spyong ba'i sngags ci nus kyis bzlas so/ /de nas bud shing la ngan song spyong ba'i sngags kyis btab la brtsig /ro la ngan song spyong ba'i sngags kyis mang du btab ste/ bye ma'am yungs kar la bzlas shing gtor nas 2 4—/23/

bum pa'i chus tshul bzhin du bkrus te ga pur dang gur kum la sogs pa'i dri rnams la ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags kyis btab ste ro la byug /gur kum kyis sngags bco brgyad tshul bzhin du bris nas/ dpral ba dang / mdzod spu dang /rna ba gnyis dang / gtsug phud dang / dpung pa gnyis dang / sna dang /rked pa dang / pus mo gnyis dang / bol gnyis dang / long bu gnyis dang /mig gnyis dang / gsang ba'i gnas rnams su gdab/ de bzhin yid kyis kyang sngags rnams bkod de/ de dag gi 'od zer gyis sgrib pa sbyangs par bsams / ngan song spyong ba'i phyag rgya bcings shing / sarba bid bya ba'i sngags te/ snying ga dang / gog ma dang / spyi bor btags pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi bag chags dag par dmigs so/ /de nas ro la ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags kyis btab pa'i gos kyis g.yogs nas/ rgyan rnams kyis klubs te/rnge tog gi phreng ba gdags shing / sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug pas kyang bdugs te/ thab kyi dbus su stan dang bcas par bzhag ste/ nub tu kha bstan la bdag nyid shar phyogs su kha bltas te las bya'o/ /de yang rgyud las/rang gi sngags kyis btab pa'i shing / /khung bu'i nang du gzhag par bya/ /ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang / /chu mchog gis ni bkrus nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i dri yis byug par bya/ /gos dang rgyan gyis klubs nas kyang / /sngags kyis btab nga/'i bdug pas bdug /me tog phreng la sogs pas mchod/ /snying ga gog ma spyi bo ru/ /sarba bid kyis byin gyis brlab/ /de ltar gzhan du mi dge sngags/ /mchog tu dge ba rnams gzhag go/ /de nas ngan song spyong ba'i phyir / /stan dang bcas te de dbus su/ /gzhag pa nyid du bya ba yin/ /377—/232

zhes smos so/ /de nas rdo rje chos kyi bzlas brjod byas pa'i chus thab kyi nye 'khor dang yo byad thams cad bsangs nas/ sku gzugs la sogs pa mngon du phyogs par rtswa ku sha'i khri la bkra shis kyi skyil mo krung du 'dug nas/ rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor du gsal bar byas la/ rgyun bzhag gi me'am/ dka' thub la dga' ba'i khyim nas blangs pa'i me la/ rdo rje chos kyi bzlas brjod byas pa'i me bsangs te thab tu bcug la/ las sna tshogs kyi snying po brjod cing rlung yab kyi rlung gis me sbar ro/ /de nas rang gi snying gar yi ge hūṃ gzhag ste/ rnal 'byor gsal bar byas nas rdo rje me'i dam tshig phyag rgya rdo rje bcing ba dang bsdams pa byas nas/ dam tshig gi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā byu ta dzā la ya—/ bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭhan hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rdo rje me ma'i gzugs su gyur te/ rid pa ring la gzi mdangs chen po g.yas bgrang phreng / g.yon ril ba spyi blugs thogs pa/ thor tshugs ser po can/ mdog dkar zhing snum pa/ me lce stong gis dkrigs shing 'od 'bar bar bsams nas mchod yon sngags kyis byin la/ zhi ba dang mthun pa'i dgang gzar gyis mar gyi dgang drugs gsum sbyin/ de nas yam shing gi thor to gnyis mar la bsres pa bsreg ste til mar dang sbrus 1pa gung mo dang srin lag dang mje bo gsum gyis sam/blugs gzar gyis sreg blugs gsum sbyin/ de nas mchod yon gyi chus kha lag bkrus nas bsang gtor byas te/ 'di skad brjod do/ /drang srong chen po khyod rang gi 'bar ba nyid du bzhugs te/ bdag nyid ji ltar 'dod pa'i sbyin sreg byed pa'i bar du gnas par gyis shig ces smras nas/ me lha'i gzugs de nyid me'i rang bzhin 'bar ba nyid du bsam mo/ /de yang rgyud las/ de nas 34—/233

byin za dge ba rab sbar la/ /me lce stong gis dkrigs shing 'bar ba'i sku/ /zla dkar kun da'i bzhin la zhi ba'i lus/ /mtha' yas pa yi gzugs kyis me bkug la/ /ar+gha dbul bar btag nas de bzhin du/ /blo mchog ldan pa'i dbus su gzugs sogs bzhag /ces smos so/ /de nas sems dpa'i bzlas brjod byas pa'i mchod yon gyi snod g.yon rol du gzhag /mchod pa'i yo byad gzhan g.yas rol du gzhag /dgang gzar dang drugs gzar mdun du bzhag nas / rang gi rnal 'byor gsal bar byas te/ las sna tshogs kyi snying po brjod pas me 'bar ba de nyid kyi nang du rin po che'i gzhal yas khang bzang po lte ba dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa dang / gru chad dang /khyams dang / sgo khyud dang / rta babs dang / them skas dang / phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa/ dbus su seng ge dang pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan chen po dang gru bzhi dang 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang / gru chad dang sgor pad+ma'i gdan dang /rin po che'i dza'u la sogs pas bkod nas/ bdag gi snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje bsams la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i snying po/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma yā dzaḥ/ zhes brjod cing / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bsnol te/ dpung mgor gzhag /mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar byas te/ gung mo dang mje bong gnyis se gol brdabs pas/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang gi gnas nas bskul te/ji ltar mchod nga/ra bsams pa'i gnas kho ra khor yug tu bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas shar phyogs kyi sgor lcags kyu'i las kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ phyag rgya de nyid shar phyogs kyi sgor lcags kyur gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra i ku sha dzaḥ/zhes brjod cing / lcags kyus dgug pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 37—/23 /

so so'i sgo drung du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /phyag rgya de nyid bkrol nas lho phyogs kyi sgor zhags pa'i phyag rgyas bcings te/ phyag rgya de nyid lho phyogs kyi sgor zhags par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing zhags pas drangs pa'i tshul kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams so so'i sgo drung du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /phyag rgya de nyid bkrol nas nub kyi sgor lcags sgog gi phyag rgya bcings te/ phyag rgya de nyid dang nub phyogs kyi sgor lcags sgrog tu gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ zhes brjod cing lcags sgrog bsdams pa'i tshul gyis bdag nyid ji srid 'dod par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bzhugs par bsams te/ phyag rgya de nyid bgrol nas byang phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje dbab pa las kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ phyag rgya de nyid byang phyogs kyi sgor dril bur gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ/ zhes brjod cing dril bu bskyod pa'i tshul gyes de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par bsams te/ phyag rgya de nyid dgrol lo / /de dag gi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang bzhugs tshul la sogs pa so so'i lta bas yun ring du blta zhing bsam mo/ /de nas so so'i dam tshig phyag rgya rdo rje bcings pa las bskyed de/ so so'i sngags kyi mjug tu/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/zhes brjod pas/ 'phags pa rnams dgyes shing dam tshig skong par bsams te/mchod yon phul nas bde bar gshegs so zhes brjod cing mchod pa gzhan rnams kyang rim bzhin du dbul lo/ /de nas sreg rdzas rnams la lha so so'i snying po dang / ngan song spyong ba'i sngags bzlas te/ 'od zer kha dog dkar por gyur par bsams nas rdzas re re zhing / oṃ bai ro tsa nā ya swā hā/ che ge mo zhes bya ba sarba bid ces bya ba la sogs pa brjod cing rdzas rnams bsreg go/ /31—/235

bzlas pa'i mthar ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib ༄khepa rnams shārnyi ku ru zhes brjod do/ /de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi lha re re la lan brgya rtsa brgyad man chad du dbul lo/ /de nas rdzas dang me thab la sogs pa bsangs te/ngan song sbyong ba'i lha la sreg rdzas nyi shu rtsa gcig tu dbul lo/ /de ltar mchod zin pa dang / 'phags pa rnams tshul bzhin du gshegs su gsol/ de nas me lha yang thab khung du spyan drangs shing bsams la/ mchod yon la sogs pas mchod cing / yo byad kun las lan gsum dbul lo/ /de nas yang me lha me 'bar ba nyid du gyur par bsam mo/ /de yang rgyud las/ ji skad gsungs pa'i yon tan 'dod pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs sogs de ltar spyan drangs la/ /ar+gha la sogs btab ste de bzhin dbul/ /bde gshegs bsdus pa'i mchod pa gang yin bya/ /de nas bsreg bya bkang ste rim gyis ni/ /rgyal po la sogs brgya rtsa brgyad du btags/ /de nas spyong ba'i sngags kyis rgyal po la/ /bsreg bya nyi shu rtsa gcig tu ni brtags/ /de nas spyan drangs yo byad lan gsum dang / /ar+gha la sogs pad+ma dkar zhal mchod/ /ces smos so/ /de nas yang me thab dang yo/ byad rnams bsangs la/ bdag nyid kyi snying gar yi ge hūṃ bzhag pa las/bdag nyid khro bo phyag na rdo rjer yi ge hūṃ zhes pas gyur te/ bzhin dang cha lugs khro bo'i tshul can du bsams la/ me thab tu yang yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha ā na lārka ma hā badz+ra kro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sadzā pā ya nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra mā ṇa na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal bar gyur te/ sku mdog sngon po zhal bgrad cing mche ba 34—/236

gcigs pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang pad+ma dang / ral gri la sogs pa grangs med pa'i mtshon cha bsnams pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyis smad g.yogs pa 'khor khro bo mang pos bskor ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis brgyan pa/zhabs pad+ma lta bus ro mnan cing / thabs mkhas pa'i thugs rjes sdig pa spyong bar mdzad par bsam mo/ /grub na de'i sku gzugs kyang mdun du gzhag go/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pas khu tshur bcangs la/ mdzub mo bsgrengs te brang la sbyar zhing dpung pa dam du bcum la/ lag pa g.yas pas sbyin sreg bya ste/sngags gong du smos pa dang / shi ba'i ming spel zhing 'bum mam/ bye ba man chad bzlas pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /bar bar du ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nyon mongs pa'am sgrib pa thams cad/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod byung til bsreg par bya'o/ /de yang rgyud las/ phyag na rdo rje phyag na pad zhags bsnams/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs/ /zhabs kyi pad+mas sdig mnan cing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab rdzogs la//sgogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan mtho/ /bsams sam yang na bris kyang rung / /de yi snying po de bzhin du/ /brgya phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /bye ba'i tshad du sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes smos so/ /de nas lha gshegs su gsol te/ bdag nyid lus bsrung ba bya'o/ /de ltar bsregs nas thal bar gyur pa dang / rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags sa ma ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing / rus pa dang thal ba rnams bsdus nas/ snod gtsang mar bcug ste/ mchod rten gdab pa'i phyogs su gzhag go/ /de nas ga pur la sogs pa'i dri chu dang / ba'i rnam lnga dang rus pa bsres te/ ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags bzhi las gang yang rung ba'i 34—/237

sngags 'bum man chad bzlas la 'jim pa dang bsres la dkyil 'khor gyi lha gang yang rung ba'i gzugs su gdab pa'am yang na mchod rten du byas te/ mchod rten gcig gdab pa dang / gnyis gdab pa dang / gsum gdab pa dang /brgya rtsa brgyad gdab pa man chad kyi bar du gzhung dang mthun par sngags dang phyag rgyas tshul bzhin du btab nas/ sgu'am mchod rten gyi spyan sngar ngan song spyong ba'i sngags 'bum phrag nyis brgya man chad bzlas so/ /de nas mchod rten 'bar ba la sogs mtshan ma bzang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste mtshan ma de dag ma mthong na/ 'bum phrag brgya stong man chad bzlas shing ji srid mtshan ma dge ba dag ma byung gi bar du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod cing / rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis mnyam par gzhag ste bzlas brjod bya/ de ltar bzlas pa'i mthar mtshan gcig tu bzlas la/ rab tu bzlas na/ shi ba nges par sdig pa las grol zhing mtshan ma bzang po rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang rgyud las/ de nas thal bar gyur pa dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bsdu bar bya/ /thal ba de yang rus pa'i rdul/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i dri chu dang / /ba skyes 'o ma la sogs lngas/ /spyong ba'i sngags kyis blo ldan gyis/ /'bum du bzlas pa rdzogs nas ni/ /ga pur dri yis bsgos pa yis / /'jim pa dang ni bsres nas kyang / /gzugs su bya 'am yang na ni/ /mchod rten gyi ni ltar byas la/ /gcig gam gnyis sam gsum mam lnga/ /yang na brgya rtsa brgyad du bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas btab nas kyang / /'bum phrag gnyis kyi bar du bzlas/ /de nas mchod rten 'bar gyur tam/ /yang na gzugs kyi zhal 'dzum mam/ /dri dang bdug pa 'od kyang rung / /snang ngam 24—/238

yang na ngad ldang ngam/ /lha la sogs pa'i rnam pa ni/ /sna tshogs par ni snang gyur tam/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba dang / /me tog la sogs 'bar ba dang / /dung dang rnga la sogs pa'i sgra/ /dril bu pi wang la sogs rnams/ /ci ste mtshan ma de dag ni/ /sdig can blos ni mi mthong na/ /'bum gyi phrag ni brgyad stong ngam/ /ji srid mtshan ma byung bar du/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod nas ni/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bzlas par bya/ /de yi mthar ni mkhas pas kyang / mtshan gcig mi nyal thog mar bzlas/ /de nas de yi sdig pa ni/ /dag pa nyid du nges par mthong / /zhes smos so/ /shi ba'i bar du med na cho ga bya ba'i thabs kyang / de yang rgyud las/ yang na med par gyur na yang / /bzlas shing bsgom pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /ming tsam legs par bris nas ni/ /mchod rten phreng bar bya ba dang / /yang na gzugs su byas kyang rung / /sbyin sreg mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /gdon mi za bar mtho ris skye//zhes 'byung bas/ rus pa med na yang bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor du bsgoms shing bzlas brjod bya ba dang / shi ba'i ming bris pa'am/ yang na gzugs brnyan gyi nang du ming rnams kyis bsngags te/ na maḥs man+ta busgye nān/ i tsi pa ra ṇa ma no ma/ zhes bya ba bris nas bcug la/ bum pa dang / sngags dang / phyag rgyas dbang bskur ba dang / sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bya ba dang /thal ba las mchod rten mang po'am/ sku gzugs gdab pa la sogs pa gong du smos pa'i cho ga ltar byas nas/ sgrib pa rnams zad nas bde 'gro lha'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mchod rten nam sgu btab pa'i tsha tsha rnams lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten chen po byas te/ de'i nang du bcug la/34—1239

mchod pa dag gis mchod nas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la mchod bstod gsol / yon yang phul nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis che ge mo bde 'go mtho ris lha'i 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig ces brjod la/ de bzhin du 'gyur ba'am / yang na tsha tsha btab pa rnams rgya mtsho chen po'am chu klung du dor na gang dag rdul des reg pa thams cad mtho ris thob cing dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis che ge mo ngan song las thar bar gyur cig ces brjod na de bzhin du 'gyur ro zhes gzhan las bshad do/ /gong du smos pa bzhin cho ga ma nus na thabs gzhan yang rgyud las/ thal ba yungs kar bye ma sogs/ /rang gi ming smos sngags btab nas / /bzlas pa byas te song nas kyang / /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i klung du dor/ /zhes 'byung bas/ thal ba'am yungs kar ram/ bye ma'am dri la shi ba'i ming dang / sarba be+ed la sogs pa'i ngan song spyong ba'i sngags spel nas 'bum man chad bzlas shing btab ste chu klung chen por dor na ngan song las thar bar 'gyur ro / /gong du smos pa lta bu'i ro'i cho ga byas pa rnams kyi yon tan yang /rgyud las de ltar na ni sdig can yang / /ngan song las ni thar bar 'gyur/ /dge ba'i chos ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sa bon bsgred pa'i bdag /sangs rgyas 'bras bu rgyu ldan pa/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin par ldan/ /tshul dzams rgyu dang rab ldan pa/ /bzod pa brtson 'grus mnyam gzhag dang / /shes rab rnams kyi rgyu bsgoms pa'i/ /'jig rten bsod nams ldan ci smos/ /myur du de ni ngan song ni/ /bcom par 'gyur te je tshom med/ /ces 'byung ngo / /de yang rgyud las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed las/ /med par lta ba gang yin dang / /byang chub lam las rnam ldog pas/ /bstan la zhe sdang 3(—/2 0

gnod byed cing / /sdig pa'i rang bzhin ma mthong la/ /pha dang ma la snying ring zhing / /byang chub sems la brten pa dang / /'dod chags bral ba bsad pa rnams/ /ci ste lha rnams med gyur tam/ /sangs rgyas dge 'dun chos de bzhin/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i tshogs la sogs/ /shes rab thabs rnams med na ni/ /sdig can de dag mi thar zhes/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs/ /zhes smos mod kyi/ de lta bu'i mi dge ba'i mtshams med pa lnga byed pa'am/ dam pa'i chos spong ba'am/ 'phags pa la sgur pa 'debs pa yang rung ste/ las kyi sgrib pa rnams zad par 'gyur ro zhes lung gzhan dag las 'byung ngo / /ngan song spyong ba'i rgyal po brtag pa yi/ /shi ba'i don du cho gar gsungs pa las/ /'gro ba'i don du bdag gis nyung zhig bsdus / /'di yis nyam thag snyug bsngal nyung bar shog /ngan song thams cad spyong ba'i thabs zhes bya ba spyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /slob dpon skal bzang dga' bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po bla ma ni na shi dang / lo tsā ba dge slong g.yung drung 'od kyis bsgyur ba'o// //34—1241

1541༄7/ /ngan song thams cad yongs su sprung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ /༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na nā ma maṇ+ḍa la bi byeḥ / bod skad du/ ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso chen shākya seng ge la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma la ni phan gdags phyir/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud rnams las btus te / /ngan song thams cad 'jig byed pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga de bshad bya / /nyams dga' ba yi sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /bdag med par ni lhag mos pas/ /lkeg mar pad+ma rnam par bsam/ /mdun gyi 'dab mar a dang ni/ /hūṃ las zla ba rdo rje ni/ /rtse lnga bsams te de yang ni / /lce de nyid la thim par bya/ /rdo rje lce ru rnam bsams pas/ /sngags 3 7byed/2 /3

—zlos mthu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /lag pa gnyis su a las ni/ /zla ba 1hūṃ las rdo rje ni/ /ste lnga par ni rnams bskyed de/ /kha dog dkar po bsgom par bya / /lag pa'i dbus su zhu gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i lag par rnam par bsam /rdo jeje lag pa brtan byas nas/ /phyag rgya thams cad bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje 'azi gas byed nas brtsams te/ /rdo rje rtse mo mthar thug pa'i/ /kun nas bsru /nga ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /mkhas pas yongs su bsam par bya/ /kun nas yongs su zlum por ni/ /ra ba dra ba byas nas kyang / /slob dpon shin tu mnyam gzhag pas/ /rdo rje 'og ni bcing bar bya/ /de nas de rjes nyid la ni//sem sa/ can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo'i tshogs dang bcas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bsam par bya/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri dang bshos la sogs pas mchod/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags bya zhing / /de rngakuzhin bsod nams rjes yi rang / /lam ni yang dag bsgom bya zhing / /byang chub sems ni yongs bzung dang / /sdom pa thams cad bzung ba dag /dkyi/la 'khor gyi ni mdun du bya/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri yis rab tu mchod bya zhing / /de bzhin sgeg mo phreng ba ma/ /glu ma gar ma la sogs brgyad/ /mchod pa nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ /nam mkha' yi di phyogs nyid du/ /mchod par gyur par rnam par bsam lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /srin po dang ni lho 'phye che/ /'byung po yi dwags sha za sogs/ /thams cad lhags nas mchod par bsam/ /mchod pa kun kyis rab mchod nas/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rjod 4byed de/ /e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mchog mdzad legs/ /3(—/21 /

ngan song thams cad legs sbyangs nas/ /'gro bas byang chub thob par mdzad/ /'dod dang gzugs khams gnas pa'i lhas/ /thal mo sbyar cing rab btud de1/ /'khor los sgyur la phyag byas te/ /de nyid du ni mi snang gyur/ /de nas de rjes nyid la ni/ /go rims 2ji bzhin bsgom byas la/ /snying ga'i dbus su zla ba ste/ /de dbus dkyil 'khor rnam par bsam/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor bkug nas rgo / /snying ga ru ni gzhug par bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs kyis/ /dgug gzhug bcings la dbang du bya / /dkyil 'khor rnam gnyis legs bsres te/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsgom par bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni thams cad du/ /rdzogs pa'i sbyor ba las byung ba/ /de yi dbus su rang gi ngos4 / /shākya seng ge bsgom par bya/ /de nas shākya thub pa yi/ /thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de dbus ngan song sbyong zhes pa'i/ /gsang sngags gzugs ni rnams 5bsams la/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rjes dran bya / /skad cig gis ni sa bon spro/ /de 'og kun nas 'od kyis ni/ /sems can thams cad snang bar byas/ /dmyal ba yi dwags byol song yang /slar yang snang bas khyab par byas/ /de nas 'od kyi snang ba yis/ /sems can thams cad ngan song las/ /sngags kyi 'od kyis bkug nas kyang / /sngags dang phyag rgyas dral 6bar bya/ /de la sogs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /srid gsum dri ma sbyang bar bya/ /'gro ba'i dri ma bral thob nas/ /slar yang 'od kyis snang bar byas/ /sems can thams cad bkug nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug par bya/ /de la chu la sogs pa yis8/ /dbang bsgur ba ni rim bzhin sbyin/ /de ltar dbang bskur tsam gyis ni/ /khams gsum pa yi sems 3 1—/2/5

can kun/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas mthong nas/ /mchod pa kun kyis rab tu mchod/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa/ /khams gsum pa yi 'gro kun gyi/ /ngan song thams cad spyong mdzad pa/ /shākya seng ge phyag 'tshal lo /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /rang gi de nyid ston mdzad pa/ /rdo rje gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam pa'i de nyid bsgom pa yis/ /khams gsum la gnas thams cad la/ /dbang bsgur rab tu stsol mdzad pa/ /rin chen gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo/ /so sor kun rtog rang bzhin can/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pas sems can dbugs 'byen mdzad pa po/ /pad+ma gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo sems can snyug bsngal bsal bya'i phyir/ /bya ba rjes grub rang bzhin can/ /phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa po/ /sna tshogs gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum 'od kyis gsal mdzad pa/ /sems can kun gyis 'phags pa yi/ /bden pa mthong bar mdzad pa po/ /gtsug tor gzi brjid phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan rnams/ /sbyin pas sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /gtsug tor rgyal mtshan phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dag /gcod cing bdud bzhi'i stobs bcom nas / /sems can byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /gtsug tor rnon po phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum 'go ba thams cad kyi1/ /gdugs dkar gyis ni rab brgyan pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po thob mdzad pa/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu/ /gar ma lha mo bzhi po dang / /spos dang me tog mar me dang / /dri yi lha mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /34—/2/6

dad sogs ngo bo las byung ba'i/ /sgo yi dbus na gang bzhugs pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /sgo srung 1rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo bzhi yi ni logs dag na/ /khyams la sogs nga/ra bzhugs mdzad pa/ /rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad gang / /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshangs dbang drag po zla ba sogs/ /phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /me dang srin bo rlung lha dang / /'byung po'i bdag po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngags pa rdo rje dril 'chang bas/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun nyid du/ /bstod pa 'di yis yang dag bstod/ /rang gi lus ni gang yin pa/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor dag tu brtag /dang por spyor ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /de ltar rnam par bsgom par bya/ /de nas khams gsum ma lus pa/ /stong pa nyid du rnam bsgoms la/ /rlung dang chu yi 2dbus su ni/ /gser gyi sa gzhi rnams bsams la/ /sum̐ gyi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /ri rab chen po bsam par bya/ /rin chen sna bzhi'i rang bzhin las/ /gru bzhi shin tu rgya che ba/ /de yi dbus su dkyil 'khor ni/ /ngan song sbyong ba dag bsams te4/ /sa bon hūṃ 5las byung ba yi/ /gzhal yas khang brtsegs rnam par bsgoms6/ /gru bzhi nga/ la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa yis brgyan/ /sgo yi logs bzhi thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams dang / /grwa yi cha ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje rin chen dag gis spras/ / dril bu dar dang ba dan sogs/ / chun 'phyang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed kyis spras pa/ /gru bzhi par ni bsam par bya/ /31—/2 7

—'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbus su ni/ /seng ge la gnas pad+ma'i gdan/ /de la gnas pa'i zla dbus su/ /shes rab thabs ni zhu bar bya/ /sems can don gyi rgyur byung ba'i/ /sngags kyi gzugs su rnam par bsam/ /oṃ mu ne+e mu ne+e ma hā ru/ ne+e ye swā hā/ gsang sngags rgyal po 'di las ni/ /sgrib pa kun sel zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis 1rnam dag pa'i/ /shākya'i rgyal po rjes dran bya/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /gsang sngags kyang ni gsung bar mdzad/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rim kyis rnam par dbye ba ni/ /rgya 'di 2chos/ kyi 'khor lo ste/ /'khor ba thams cad gcod byed yin/ /de yi dpe ni 'di lta ste/ /ji ltar pad+ma la chags pa'i/ / bum pa la sogs bsdams pa rnams / /pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha bye na/ /bcings pa'i sbug bsngal las thar byed//de bzhin 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /srid gsum 'gro bar bcings pa rnams/ / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid shākya yi/ /seng ges bcings pa las grol mdzad / /de nas snying gar zla ba la/ /gnas pa'i sngags rnams brjod nas ni / /rdo rje gtsug tor nas brtsams te/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar du bskyed//de la sngags rnams 'di yin no/ /na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni/rā dzā 4ya ta thā ga tā ya arta te/ samyak+shi buzlu ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ bi sho dha ni bi sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shur+bhe bi shud+dhi/sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod par bya ste/de nas go rims ji bzhin pa'i/ /rim pa yang dag bshad par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ kha yi sgo nas dbyung ba ni/ /kun nas 'od zer lnga par byung / /sngags kyi 'od kyi snang ba yis/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /snang 2(—/2/8

bar khyab nas 'gro 1ba ni/ /kun kyang snyug bsngal grol bar byed/ /de nas 'od zer slar log pa/ /snying ga ru ni zhugs 2par bya/ /sngags dang 'od zer 'dres pa las/ /byung ba'i sgu ni spro bar bya/ /shar rtsibs pad+ma zla bar bzhugs / /rdo rje gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /thugs ka las byung bzhugs 4par bsam/ /sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'bar/ /sa gnon pa yi phyag rgyas bzhugs/ /sngar bshad bzhin du thams cad kyang / /'od zer spyo dang bsdu ba dang / /spros nas basbu ba'i spyor ba yis/ /rang rang sngags nas byung ba ni/ /snying ga nas ni ston 5nas ni/ /ji ltar gnas su gzhag 6par bya/ /oṃ rasgod+ma tram̐/ zhes bya bas gdon par bya'o / /de nas lho yi rtsibs la ni/ /rin chen gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs//pad+ma zla ba'i dbus su be+e/ /thugs ka las ni nges ston la/ /sku mdog sngo zhing shin tu mdzes/ /mchog sbyin pa yi phyag rgyas bzhugs/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus pa'i/ /sems can kun la dbang bsgur mdzad/ /oṃ pad+mot+ta 8dhīḥ/zhes bya bas gdon par bya'o/ /de nas nub kyi rtsibs la ni/ /pad+ma / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sa bon las ni byung ba'i sgu/ /pad+ma gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs / /thugs ka las ni phyung ste bzhugs/ /sems can kun la rjes ston mdzad/ /sgu mdog dmar zhing 'od 'bar ba/ /bsam gtan gyi ni phyag rgyas bzhugs/ /oṃ bi shot+ta ma aḥ / zhes bya bas gdon par bya'o/ /de nas byang gi rtsibs la ni/ /pad+ma la gnas zla dbus su/ /thugs ka las ni yang dag ston 1/ /sna tshogs gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs/ /sna tshogs pa yi 'od ldan pa/ /'di yi phyag rgya mi 'jigs sbyin/ /'di ni sna tshogs las 37— /2/9

mdzad de/ /'khor ba las ni sems can sgol/ /oṃ gyi sa bon las byung ba/ /gtsug tor gzi brjid de bzhin gshegs/ /thugs ka las byung me mtshams su/ /pad gnas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /g.yas pa la ni nyi ma bsnams/ /phyag g.yon dkur ni brten te bzhugs/ /sgu mdog dkar dmar 'od zer kyis/ /khams gsum par ni snang bar mdzad/ /hūṃ gi sa bon las byung ba/ /gtsug tor rgyal mtshan de bzhin gshegs/ /thugs ka nas ni byung nas kyang / /bden bral mtshams kyi rtsibs la ni/ /pad gnas zla ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /sgu mdog dmar zhing nag 1pa la/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan rnams / /'gro ba'i ser sna rnam dag mdzad/ /dhī yi sa bon las byung ba/ /gtsug tor rnon po de bzhin gshegs/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dag /gcod mdzad rlung gi rtsibs su bzhugs/ /'di yi phyag mtshan g.yas ral gri/ /g.yon na glegs bam bsnams par mdzad/ /sku mdog mkha' ltar sngo ba ni/ /pad+ma la gnas zla bar bzhugs/ /kri yig sa bon las byung ba/ /gtsug tor gdugs/ dkar de bzhin gshegs/ /chos kyi bdag por gyur pa ni/ /dbang ldan rtsibs su dbyung bar bya/ /sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'bar 'di yi phyag mtshan gdugs bsnams pa'o/ /de dag thams cad sna tshogs pa'i/ /nga/da gnas/ zla dkyil dag tu bzhugs/ /hūṃ tram̐ hri 4a yi sngags kyi 5ni/ /sgeg mo la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /phyung ste mtshams kyi cha yi ni/ /pad gnas zla dkyil ngag tu dgod/ /sgu mdog phyag mtshan rigs kyi yum/ /rgyud las ji skad gsung / bzhin bya/ /de bzhin me tog bdug spos ma/ /mar me dri yi lha mo bzhi/ /grwa yi cha ru gnas pa ni/ /go rims bzhin du dbyung bar bya/ /sngags dang 27—/230

gdan la sogs pa ni/ /sgeg mo la sogs bshad par bya/ /oṃ sarba saṃ sku ra pa ri shudha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te ma hā na ya 1pa ri bā re swā hā/ sngags 'dis byams pa la sogs pa/ /bcu drug po ni phyung nas su/ /shar kyi logs nas brtsams nas su/ /byang gi sgo yi bar du dgod/ /shar sgo yi ni logs gnyis su / /byams pa la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /pad gnas zla ba'i dbus su ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /byams pa mdog sems 2'od bzang pa/ /g.yas na klu shing me tog bsnams/ /g.yon na spyi blugs legs par 'dzin/ /byang dasems rnam dag 'khrungs las byung / /gnyis pa mthong ba don yod ni/ /pad+ma la gnas zla ba bzhugs/ /sgu mdog yongs su ser ba nyid / /g.yas na pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /pad+ma'i srun dang yang dag ldan/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /gsum pa khyab bdag ngan song spyong / /pad gnas zla ba nyid la bzhugs/ /sgu mdog dkar la 'od 'bar ba/ /phyag na lcags kyu bsnams pa yin/ /khyams kyi go rims ji bzhin pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi par bshad pa la/ /mya ngan mun pa thams cad ni/ /nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros ni/ /sgu mdog dkar ser dag tu snang / /'di yi phyag rgya dbyug pa bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten te/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /'di dag shar du bzhugs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpar grags pa yin/ /de bzhin lho yi phyogs su ni/ /sngar bshad pa yi rim nyid kyis/ /pad gnas zla ba'i dbus su ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /dang po spos kyi glang po ste/ /sgu mdog dkar ljang mdzes par snang / /'di yi phyag rgya g.yas kyi ni/ /phyag na dri ni bsnams par 37—/25/

mdzad / /phyag g.yon dkur ni brten nas su/ /sems can thams cad rab grol mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' gnyis pa ni/ /de mtshan dpa' bar 'gro ba'o/ /sku mdog dung dang kun da 'dra/ /phyag g.yas ral gri bsnams par mdzad/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ste bsgomasarmye/ /bde gshegs sras po gsum po ni/ /nam mkha' mdzod ces bya ba ste/ /dam pa chos kyi 2gang ba'i mdzod/ /sku mdog dag ni dkar ser yin/ /'di yi phyag rgya phyag g.yas na/ /pad+ma la gnas chos kyi mdzod/ /g.yon pa'i phyag ni dkur shābarten te/ /mkha' kun khyab pa'i nor 'dzin torte/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzhi po yang sa/ /ye shes tog ces bya ba ste/ /'di yi sku mdog sngon po la/ /yid bzhin nor bu rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur 'jog cig6 /sems can kun la mi 'jigs stsol/ /da ni nub kyi phyogs dag gi/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzhi po yang / /pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /dang po'i mtshan ni 'od dpag med/ /de yis 'od kyi 3rnam par mdzes/ /zla ba'i mdog can shin tu dkar/ /phyag g.yas na ni bdud rtsi yis/ /bum pa yang dag 'dzin par mdzad/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /sangs rgyas sras po gnyis pa ni/ /de mtshan zla 'od ces bya ba/ /de bzhin sku mdog dkar la bzang / /phyag rgya g.yas pa'i phyag na ni/ /pad+mar gnas pa'i zla tshes te/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsum pa yang / /mtshan ni bzang skyong zhes bya ba/ /sku mdog dkar dmar dag tu snang / /phyag rgya g.yas pa'i phyag la ni/ /rin chen 'bar ba rab tu 34—/2bya2

bsnams / /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i 1mtshan/ /dra ba can gyi 'od ces bya/ /sgu mdog dmar 2zhing 'od 'bar ba/ /rdo rje dra ba 'dzin par mdzad/ /de bzhin byang gi sgo phyogs su / /rgyal sras sems dpa' dang po ni/ /rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba/ /sku mdog sngo skya 'bar ba la/ /phyag g.yas pa yi phyag na ni/ /ut+pal rdo rje dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yon dkur ni brten pa'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan ni blo gros kyi / /mthar ni mi zad pa zhes bya/ /kun da zla ba ltar dkar zhing / /phyag rgya phyag ni gnyis ka yis/ /ye shes bum pa legs bsnams te/ /sems can kun ni rab tshim mdzad/ /sangs rgyas sras po gsum pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags 4pa'i mtshan/ /dang po spobs pa bzhag pa la/ /tha mar brtsegs pa zhes bya ba / /sku mdog zangs ltar dmar ba ste/ /phyag rgya g.yas na pad+ma la/ /gnas nga/'i rin chen brtsegs pa bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa'o / /rgyal ba'i sras po bzhi pa ni/ /kun du bzang po zhes bya ste/ /sku mdog ser zhing 'od bzang pa/ /phyag rgya g.yas pa'i phyag rgya 5ni/ /rin chen ste ma bsnams par mdzad/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /de 'dra'i tshul dang rang bzhin gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje yi/ /bdag can pad gnas zla dbus su/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs//dzaḥyi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /shar du rdo rje lcags kyu ni/ /kun du zla ba ltar dkar ba/ /phyag g.yas kyis ni lcags kyu bsnams/ /hūṃ gi 6sa bon las byung ba'i / /lho ru rdo rje zhags pa ste/ /d+ku mdog ser zhing 'od 'bar ba/ /phyag na zhags pa yang dag bsnams/ /baṃ gyi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /nub tu 3(—/253

rdo rje lcags sgrog ni/ /sgu mdog rnam par dmar ba ste/ /phyag na lcags sgrog bsnams pa yin/ /hoḥyi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /byang du rdo rje 'be+ebs pa ni//sna tshogs mdog can 'od po che/ /phyag na dril bu legs par bsnams/ /sngar bshad pa yi rim gyis be+e/ /sgo bzhi dag tu phyung nas kyang / /pad+ma la gnas zla dbus su/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /de ltar rnam par bsgom 1pa yis/ /ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyang / /'di rgo dkyil 'khor 2rgyal po mchog /ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /shākya seng ge mdun byas te/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor la bzhugs te/ /ngan song thams cad las 'don pa/ /las kyi rgyal po mchog ces bya/ /kun kyi phrin las gcig yin pas/ /des na re rer ma bshad do/ /'di ni las kyi rgyal po mchog /ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas sngags par phyag rgya ni/ /rim bzhin yang dag bshad par bya/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te 4sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te/ samyak+shi bud+dhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shur+bhe bi shur+bhe/ sarba karma ā ba ra 6ṇa bi shud+dhi swā hā/ 'di dag kun gyi sngar gyi ni/ /mdzad pa la ni sngags 'di brjod/ /shākya seng ge'i dam tshig gis8/ /phyag rgya dag ni bshad par bya/ /dbus su ting 'dzin mchog gis di/ /bzhugs pa dam tshig phyag rgyar bshad/ /rdo rje bcing ba dam byas te//gung mo gnyis kyi rtse mo 9sbyar/ /rdo rje phyag rgya dam byas pa/ /rdo rje gtsug tor phyag rgya'o/ /gung mo de nyid rin chen dang / /gung mo pad+ma lta bu dang / /gung mo de nyid rdo rje las/ /sor mo lhag ma 'bar byas nyid/ /sor mo de nyid 2(— —/25/

'bar ba la/ /gtsug tor gzi brjid phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las ni srin lag dang / /mje'u chung gnyis ni mnyam ste bsgrengasapha / /de nyid mdun du 'bebs pa dang / /de nyid mdun du bzhag nas ni/ /rdo rje dra ba'i tshul du bya/ /dam tshig phyag rgya'i spyor ba la/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje snying gar gzhag /shog mar pad+ma'i zla dbus su/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rnam par bsgom/ /sngar bshad 'byin pa'i sngags rnams ni/ /chos kyi phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ /bsams nas las kyi phyag rgya bca'/ /ji skad bshad pa'i chos 'khor lo/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya yin/ /sa gnon mchog sbyin ting 'dzin dang / /mi 'jigs sbyin sogs rim bzhin sbyar/ /ting 'dzin mchog tu gnas pa ni/ /gzi brjid phung po'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yas pa'i lag ngar dbyug par bsgreng / /ral gri 'phyar dang g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /g.yas pa bteg ste brkyang bar bya/ /lag pa gnyis ka basbus nas ni/ /gdugs dang 'dra bar gzhag par bya/ /sngar ni ji skad bshad pa yis2/ /phyag rgya gang dang gang bzhugs pa'i/ /thugs kar rdo rje bsgoms nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen por bsgom par bya/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni bcing bar bya/ /sgeg mo la sogs rnam brgyad dang / /sgo rnams bsrung ba bzhi po ni/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las mthun pas na/ /de dag khyad par ma bshad do/ /ji skad bsrung 4bzhin phyag rgya che/ /mkhas pa yis ni bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas5/ /phan tshun mnyam par gshibs nas ni/ /mdzub mo dang ni gung mo dgug /me tog tshul bzhag byams pa'i rgya/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten la/ /g.yas pa dpung pa'i thad kar ni/ /mdzub mo gung mo 34—125pya

————————brkyang nas mig /'dra bzhag mthong ba don yod rgya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /sor mo gnyis ka brkyang nas ni/ /lcags kyu 'dra bar legs bzhag pa/ /ngan song thams cad sbyo nga 1ba yin/ /g.yon pa'i 2khu tshur dkur brten pa/ /g.yas pa dbyug pa lta bu ni/ /gyen du bsgrengs nas 'jog byed pa / /mya ngan mun pa kun 'joms pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur lte bar gzhag /lag pa g.yas pa glang po che'i/ /sna yi tshul du gzhag pa ni/ /spos kyi glang po'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten pa/ /g.yas pa ral gri thogs pa yis4 / /tshul du 'jog par byed pa ni/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa khu tshur snying gar gzhag /g.yas pa steng skor 5mkha' mdzod kyi'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa lta bu ni/ /g.yon logs su ni 'dzin byed pa/ /ye shes tog 6gi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyis bum 'dzin ltar/ /'jog pa 'od dpag med kyi'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur brla steng gzhag /g.yas pa'i khu tshur snying gar ni/ /mje bong mje'u 7chung brkyang byas/ 'a// /zla tshes 'dra gzhag zla 'od kyi'o/ /lag pa gnyis be+e snying ga ru/ /pad+ma lta bu rnam phye la/ /rtse mo phan tshun sbyar ba ni/ /bzang skyong gi ni phyag rgya yin / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /go cha 'dzin pa lta bu ni/ /nu ma gnyis su/ legs/ gzhag pa/ /dra ba can gyi phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten la/ /g.yas pa snying gar bzhag nas ni/ /sor mo dbus ma bsgreng ba ni/ /rdo rje snying po'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yon nga/'i khu tshur snying bzhag g.yas / /mi 'jigs sbyin 'dra mi zad blo/ /g.yon pa lte bar bzhag nas ni/ /g.yas pas se gol gtogs pa ni/ /spobs pa brtsegs pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /3( ——/2bye6

g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur brten te/ /g.yas pa rin chen khu tshur bya/ /kun du bzang po'i phyag rgya yin/ /'di dag dam tshig 1phyag rgya'o/ /sngar bshad 'byin pa'i sngags rnams te2/ /chos kyi phyag rgyar shes par bya1/ /'byin par 4ji ltar 'dzin pa ni5/ /phyag rgya mchog mtshan 'dzin 6pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag chen gyi/ /phyag rgya chen por shes par bya/ /de las phyag mtshan med gyur pa/ /las kyi phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /de nas ngan song kun spyong ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sngags bshad bya/ /oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a be+e tiṣ+ṭha 7dz+nyā na 8sa ma ye hūṃ/ bdag la byen gyis brlabs 9pa'i sngags so/ /rdo rje phyag rgya gnyis bcing ste7/ /yan lag rnams la rim 1bzhin dgod/ /snying ga gog ma dpral ba dang / /smin mtshams mdzod spu sna dang ni/ /rna ba rked pa pus mo dang / /rkang pa dang ni byen pa gnyis/ /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba yi/ /gnas su byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ a pa rka na ya hūṃ/ sdig pa thams cad dgug pa'i sngags so / /o sarba be+eta sarba pā paṃ ཿsho dha ni hūṃ swā hā/ sdig pa thams cad spyong ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita tra tharka5/ ngan song thams cad dral skeba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba ā ba ra ṇa rta bi sho dha ni mu ne+e t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ shākya thub nga/'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bid t+t+waṃ hūṃ/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita t+t+waṃ t+t+waṃ/ rin chen gtsug 9tor gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bid dhīḥbyāḥ2 /pad+ma gtsug tor gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bid aḥ.aḥ 1/ sna tshogs gtsug tor gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bid oṃ oṃ/ gtsug tor gzi brjid kyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bid hūṃ hūṃ/ gtsug tor rgyal mtshan gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita 2 phaṭa/34—/257

byedagatsug tor rnon bo'i'o/ /oṃ sarba bita kri traṭa1/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bid ma hā badz+red bha 2ba dā na pā ra mi tā pū dze hūṃ / sgeg mo'i'o/ /oṃ sarba bid ma hā badzod bha ba shī la pā ra mi tā pū dze t+t+waṃ4 /phreng ba ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bid ma hā badz+red bha 5ba k+ṣudhi pa ra mi ta 7pū dze dhīpaḥ/ glu mkhan ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bid ma hā badzod bha 9ba bīr+ya pā ra mi tā pū dze aḥ/ gar mkhan ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pa ya gan+dha na dha ma dha ma dha ma dhu 7pa ya dh+yā na pā ra mi tā pū dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bdug pa ma'i sngags/ so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni kle sha ts+tsha da na put+pa bi lo ki ni pradz+nyā pā/ ra mi tā pū dze ṭī hūṃ phaṭa/ me tog ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pa ya bi sho dha ni dz+nyā na ā lo ka ka ri pra ṇi dha na pā ra mi tā pū dze dhī 11hūṃ phaṭa/mar me'i rka sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pa ya gan+dha bi nā sha ni badz+ra gan+dha u pa ya pā ra mi tā pū dze aḥsahūṃ phaṭa/ byug pa ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba na ra ka ga te ā kaste ṇi hūṃ dzaḥphaṭa/ rdo rje lcags kyu'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba na ra ka udrwa ra ṇi ཿhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje zhags pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pa ya bhan dha ྾bi mo tsa ni hūṃ baṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje lcags sgog gi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bita sarba a pa ya ga ti ga ha na bi sho dha ni hūṃ hoḥphaṭa/ rdo rje 'bebs nga/'i sngags so/ /oṃ mi tri ha ra rja ya swā hā/ byams pa'i sngags so//oṃ rte mo bhe a mo gha dar+sha hūṃ/ mthong ba don yod kyi'o/ /oṃ sarba a pa ya dza ha sarba / a pa ya bi sho dha ni hūṃ/ ngan song kun 'dren gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba sho ka ta mo rgo rga te na ma ti hūṃ/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros kyi'o/ /oṃ gan+dha ha ti 1 ni hūṃ/ spos kyi glang po'i'o/ /oṃ shu ram̐ 27——/258

ga me hūṃ/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i'o/ /oṃ ga gā ne+e ga gā na lo tsa ne+e hūṃ/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi'o/ /oṃ dz+nyā na ke tu dz+nyā na ba ti hūṃ/ ye shes tog gi'o/ /oṃ mi 1ta pra bha a mi ta ba ti hūṃ/ 'od dpag med kyi'o/ /oṃ tsaje tsaje bya ba lo ki te hūṃ swā hā/ zla 'od kyi'o/ /oṃ dra ba ti bha dra pā le hūṃ/ bzang spyong gi'o//oṃ dzā la ne+e ma hā dza 4la de hūṃ/ dra ba can gyi 'od kyi'o5/ /oṃ badz+ra gabye hūṃ/rdo rje snying po'i'o/ /oṃ a k+ṣa ya phu phu a k+ṣa ya karma ā ba ra ṇa 6bi sho dha ṇa spre swā hā/blo gros mi zad pa'o8/ /oṃ pra ti bha na pra ti bha ne+e kyu 9ṭi swā hā/ spobs pa brtsegs pa'i'o/ /oṃ sa man+ta bha dre hūṃ/ kun du bzang po'i'o/ /bskal pa bzang po'i sngags 'di dag /go rims ji bzhin brjod par bya/ /cho ga 'di dag nyid kyi 7ni/ /nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu/ /'bad pas ting 'dzin gsum ldan pa'i/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /sgo ni rnam par dbye bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te//mdzub mo gnyis ni rab brkyang nas/ /mthe chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ /sgo dbye ba yi phyag rgya yin/ /oṃ sarba bid badzod gha ṭa ya hūṃ/ sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i rgya bcings la/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su brtag par bya/ /oṃ sarba bid badz+ra tsakra hūṃ/ lag ngar gnyis ni rdo rje rta bcings / /rdo rje se gol bcas pa yis/ /shākya'i rgyal po spyor bdag nyid/ /sangs rgyas thams cad basbu bar bya/ /g.yon pa'i se gol brdabs pa dang / /g.yas pa yis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /g.yas pa thal mo zhes bya ste/ /'dus pa yang ni gnyis ka yin1 / /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid do / /oṃ sarba bid badz+ra sa mā dza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ 'di'i bka' tsam gyis bsgrags 377—/239

pas / /'khor lo'i tshogs ni 'khor bcas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs 'gyur na/ /gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin bgegs bsal la/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni bcing bar bya/ /'bras yos sogs dang spos chab kyi1/ /mchod yon dang ni zhabs bsil dbul/ /de nas mchod pa'i yan lag kun/ /spos chab kyis ni bsang btor 2bya/ /sngar bshad pa yi mchod pa ni/ /sna tshogs pa yis yang dag mchod/ /mchod mthar mnyam med la sogs pa'i/ /bstod pa rnams kyis legs par bstod/ /zla ba drug gam lo gcig par/ /de ltar rnam par bsgoms pa yis/ /lha yi snang ba gsal nas ni / /rdo rje dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i 4cho ga'o// //de nas de'i sa'i 5cha gsungs pa ni/ lha khang grong khyer skyed tshal gyis6/ /byang 7shar phyogs ni ji lta ba'i/ /sa yi cha ni yongs gzung 8la/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyang bar bya/ /yang na sngar ni brtags zin pa'i/ /gnas ni sbyang ba bya mi dgos / /pus mo rked pa lte ba'am/ /sgog ma nub tsam sa brkos la/ /legs par yongs su brtags nas ni/ /thal ba dang ni sol ba bsal de bzhin gyo mo gseg ma dang / /phub ma rus pa bsal bar bya/ /spyan dang rdo rje gnod sbyin sogs// /de bzhin bdud rtsi thab spyor gye/ /sngags bzlas pa yi chu nyid kyis/ /sa kun la ni bsang gtor bya/ /dri zhim pa yi chu yis ni/ /dkyil 'khor sa ni kun/ du dgang / /der gnas sa yi dbus su ni/ /sbyin sreg 1 las la sogs pa bya/ /tsher ma'i shing ni brgyad po la/ /yam shing sor brgyad byas pa la/ /dug dang skre tshes bsgos pa dang / /mi rus kyi ni phye ma nyid//3((byed/260

yungs mar kyis ni sbrus nas su/ /sa sbyang phyir ni sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas de rjes nyid la ni/ /ba ko tsam ni byug 1pa yis/ /sa yi cha ni yid 'ong bar/ /slar yang zhi ba'i las brtsam mo/ /kun nas yongs su zlum por ni/ /ba yi lci bas legs byugs par/ /dbus nyid du ni bum pa dag /cho ga bzhin du gzhag par bya/ /me yi las ni bshad pa yis2/ /zhi ba la sogs las rim bzhin / /thang shing las ni yam shing dag /sor ni bcu gnyis byed du gzhug /til nag bo dang nas thug dang / /'bras chan la sogs mar dag byugs/ /sa bdag gnas kyi bdag po dag /slob ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /zhi sogs las kyi rim bzhin du/ /sbyin sreg gi ni las rnams bya/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i don du ni/ /sa yi lha la gsol ba gdab/ /sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang / /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sems can kun la dge don du / /byams pa'i sems kyis gnas par mdzod/ /shin tu mnyam zhing snum pa dang / /tshad ldan tsha sgo med pa ru/ /rgyal pos khru ni brgya 4nyid dam/ /de bzhin khru ni lnga bcu nyid/ /blon po'i 5yang na tshong dpon nyid6/ /nyi shu lnga 'am de yi phyed/ /khru tshad de dag ma nus na/ /ci nus par ni rnam par dbye//sa yi cha rnams kun nas ni/ /ba yi lci bas byug par bya/ /spos chus bsang gtor bya ba dang / /ba yi rnam lngas skyong nul bya/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa yi char/ /tshon rtsi dgye ba brtsam par bya/ /sa sbyang pa yi cho ga'o/ /legs par khrus byas lus dris byug /ji snyed gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan/ /shin tu gsar pa'i gos bgo zhing / /me tog phreng bas gdong yang brgyan/ /21byed/26/
