bgegs kun bskrad pa rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /snying ga las spyos khro tshogs kyis/ /bltas pa tsam gyis de mod la/ /bgegs rnams kun nas tshar gcod pa/ /ma dang ṭa las/ byung ba yi/ /nyi ma zla ba 1mig gnyis sam/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba nyid / /rkang mthil gnyis su rnam par dgod/ /g.yon pas dril bu legs bzung la/ /g.yas kyis rdo rje gsor bar bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas mtshams dang ni/ /ra ba dang ni dra ba bya/ /yi ge hūṃ gi sgra sgogs pas/ /cung zad gar byed gom stabs kyis/ /bskor ba'i tshul gyis song nas ni/ /dengs 2shig ces ni brjod par bya/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las gsungs ltar/ /g.yas brkyang la sogs stang stabs bya/ / bsgying ba'i 3tshul gyis song nas ni/ /gdug 4pa'i bgegs rnams bskrad pa dang / /de nas phur bu btab nas ni/ /'og gi bgegs rnams zlog 5par byed/ /oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya sarba bispyo ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba ni phur bu la bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba dubye 6phaṭa/ shī li shī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ zhes bya ba ni brdung ba'i sngags so/ /de nas thig gdab brtsam byas te / /cho ga bzhin du rab tu brtags / /'khor 'o/sa/ sgyur bas btang nas ni/ /gtsug tor bzhi la bsgul bar bya de nas bskul ba tsam gyes ni/ /'khor los sgyur ba 7mchod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen ngo/ thig gdab phyir/ /bcom ldan rka rdo rje thig gdab rta gsol/ /de nas rang rang kha dog ldan/ /srad bu 'khor los sgyur gyis gtad/ / de 'og thig sgud bsgril bar bya/ /bsgril ba'i sngags ni 'di yin no/ /a byo n+ya a nu 31—/262

—ga ta sarba dharmaḥspa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma/ a t+yan+ta/ a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma hūṃ/ zhes so/ /skud pa bgegs bskrad bkrus nas ni/ /1de nas gser sogs snod du ni/ /gtsug tor lnga yi sngags bzlas nas/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga yis ni/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod par bya/ /bdug spos kyis ni kun nas bdug /me tog gis ni mdzes byas pa'i/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa yi char / /thig gdab pa ni brtsam par bya/ /sar pa legs par bsgril ba dang / /tshad dang ldan la mdzes pa yis2/ /thig gis ci nus dkyil 'khor du/ /mkhas pas thig ni gdab par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni rjes mthun par/ /mkhas pas nges par brtag par bya/ /ser po la sogs tshon sna bzhir/ /go rims bzhin du kha dog sgyur/ /khru brgyad pa la sor gabyug tshad/ /gzhan yang khru tshad dag gis bskyed/ /de ltar kun la shes pa ni/ /gnas ni ji bzhin brtag par bya/ /slar yang bzlas brjod byas nas ni/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags nyid dusnye/ /oṃ badz+ra sru tra ā kar+ṣa ya maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ byin gyis brlabs 4pa'i sngags so/ /bden bral mtshams su gnas nas ni/ /sgrub pa'i grogs kyis zhelag tu gtad6/ /oṃ badz+ra sru tra ā kabe+e ya mā 7ti kra ma hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ/ slob dpon shar du kha bltas la/ /grogs po nub tu blta bar bya/ /slob dpon byang du kha bltas la/ /grogs po lho ru blta bar bya/ /me dang 'byung por kha bltas te/ /shar gyi char ni thig gdab bya/ /rlung dang 5srin po'i phyogs gnas te/ /nub kyi thig ni gdab par bya/ /der gnas nas ni byang gi thig /slar yang me srin lho phyogs su'o/ /kha khyer thig kyang de bzhin te/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid du bsgomasaḍa/ /me dang rlung gi phyogs gnas te/ /srin po 34—/263

'byung po'i phyogs su blta/ /g.yas su bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyogs bzhir thig ni gdab par bya/ /gzhan du byas na slob dpon dang / /gogs kyi 1nyes pa thob par 'gyur/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /sgo khyud kyang ni sgo yi tshad/ /khyams dang 'dra ba cha yi tshad2/ /de phyed tshon sna lnga yi sa/ /rta babs kyis ni tshon gyi sa/ /sgo yi sum 'gyur tshad du bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo khyud bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed nyi ma dang / /zla ba sogs kyis brgyan par bya/ /rta babs kyi ni sa yi cha/ /ji ltar mdzes pa rnam par brtag /'khor lo'i tshul la dkyil 'khor dgu/ /go rims bzhin du bris pa yi/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mdzes par bya/ /rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo'i rgyab tu ni/ /rdo rje phreng ba yang dag bri/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbus su ni/ /shākya seng ge nges par bri/ /pad+ma dbu ma'i 'dab ma la / /rdo rje sems ma bri bar bya/ /mtshams la rin chen sems ma sogs/ /go rims bzhin du bri bar bya/ /shar kyi rtsibs la bri ba ni/ /rdo rje gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs/ /de bzhin rtsibs ni thams cad la/ /go rims bzhin du bri bar bya/ /mtshams kyi char ni sgeg mo sogs/ /go rims bzhin du bri bar bya/ /de bzhin me tog spos me 5sogs/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ste bri/ /sgo ni srung ba bzhi po dag /sgo yi dbus su bri bar bya/ /byams pa la sogs bcu drug po/ /shar sogs khyams su gnas par bya/ /sgo bzhi yi ni logs dag tu/ /glang chen dang ni seng ge bri/ /rta babs kyi ni ngos gnyis su/ /bkra shis brgyad bo yang dag bri/ /shar du dpal be+e'u 'khor lo bri/ /lho ru pad+ma rgyal mtshan te/ /nub tu gdugs dang bum pa gnyis/ /byang du dung dang nya bri'o/ /3 (—126/

'khor yug la ni 'jig rten skyong / /brgyad la sogs pa bri bar bya/ /shar du dbang po tshangs pa dang / /nyi ma dang ni zla ba bri/ /mdog dang dbyibs dang lag cha dang / /mtshon cha la sogs rim pa dang / /thams cad kyi ni gdan la sogs / /go rims bzhin du bri bar bya/ /brgya byin gdan ni glang po che/ /dkar zhing mche ba drug ldan yin/ /gur gum mdog can 'gying bas 'dug /logs na sha tsi u pa yisami/ /lag pa g.yon pa dkur 'jog cing / /g.yas pa yis ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /me yi gzugs ni bri bya ba/ /na tshod lo ni brgya pa la//kha dog dmar zhing 'od 'bar ba/ /spyi blugs dang ni dbyig pa 'dzin/ /gdan du rwa skyes dmar po ni/ /me yi lha la btag 2par bya/ /gshin rje nag po bri bya ste/ /de yi gdan ni ma he yin/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur dkur 'jog cing / /g.yas pa yis 4ni dbyug pa 'dzin/ /nag mo dang ni 'chi bdag gnyis—/ /ngos gnyis na ni 'dug pa bri/ /bden bral phyogs su srin po ni/ /yi dwags gdan la 'dug pa la/ /mdog ni dmar zhing gnag par snang / /'bar ba'i 'od dang ldan pa la/ / lag pa g.yon pa dkur 'jog cing / /5 g.yas na ral gri 'dzin pa yin/ /nub kyi phyogs su chu yi lha/ /kha dog dkar zhing cung zad dmar/ /sbrul gyi gdengs ka dag dang ldan/ /stan ni chu srin dmar po yin/ /g.yas na sbrul zhags 'dzin pa ste/ /lag pa g.yon pa rin chen 'dzin/ /klu dang klu mo rnams kyi 6ni/ /bran mo 'khor dang bcas pa bri/ /rlung ni 7phyogs su rlung lha ni/ /nam mkha'i mdog dang 'dra ba la/ /sha ba'i stan la yang dag gnas/ /ba dan rgyal mtshan thogs pa bri/ /byang du gnod sbyin bdag po ni/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra la/ /g.yon na rin chen 34—/265

snod 'chang zhing / /g.yas na rin chen snye ma 'dzin/ /rta dkar gyi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /chung ma dang ni bcas par bri/ /'byung po'i bdag po thal mdog can/ /g.yas na rtse gsum a mra thogs/ /g.yon ni 7spyi drugs ru dāk+ṣa//khyu mchog stan la yang dag gnas/ /sa yi lha mo gser mdog can/ /pad+ma'i stan la gnas pa la/ /mdun du lag pa gnyis kyi 3ni/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin par byed/ /g.yas phyogs su ni lha ma yin/ /kha dog dmar zhing nag pa la/ /go cha gyon cing ral gri 'dzin/ /nang tshangs 'jam la bri bar bya/ /g.yon phyogs su ni klu bri ba/ /mdog dkar chung mar bcas pa la/ /sbrul gyi gdengs kar bcas pa bri/ /lag na rin chen snod thogs pa/ /mchog sbyin gser gye mdog can la/ /glegs bam dang ni phreng ba thogs/ /g.yon pa mchog sbyin spyi blugs ni/ /'dzin pa nyid du yang dag bri/ /ngang pa nyid du bris nas kyang / /de yis 4snastan du rnam par brtag /g.yas dang g.yon gyi logs su ni/ /nyi ma zla ba bri bya ste/ /dbyibs mdog stan dang mtshan ma ni/ /ji ltar mthong ba bzhin du bri/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol sa yi char/ /dmyal ba brgyad po bri bya ste/ /mnar med pa la sogs pa ni/ /me yi phyogs su bri bar bya//bden bral gyi ni phyogs nyid du/ /yi dwags 'gro ba bri bar bya/ /rlung gi phyogs su byol song gi/ /'gro ba sna tshogs bri bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyogs kyi cha ru ni/ /mi yi 'gro ba yang dag bri/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+wa la pa ti tar+ya thā ā kar+ṣa ya badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥsarba man+dha le hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya sarba hūṃ dza/ 'jig rten pa'i lha spyan drangs shing dgug pa'o/ /5de nas rnal 'byor gsum kyis 6ni/ /ting 'dzin go rims bzhin du bsgom/ /tsan+dan dang 34—/266

ni gur gum gyis/ /zlum po dag ni byas nas kyang / /rang rang gi ni sngags bzlas pa'i/ /me tog gi ni ( phreng ba dbul/ /dkyil 'khor pa ni thams cad kyang / /lan ni bdun bdun bzlas par bya/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /bza' dang bcas pas rim bzhin mchod/ /mchod pa rnam pa nyi shu yi//mchod pa kun du bya ba yin/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin dang ldan pa'i/ /bum pa gang ba gzhag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor pa yi sngags rnams ni/ /bum pa la ni bzlas par bya/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gsang sngags ni/ /ci 'dod pa yi bzlas pa bya/ /de nas hūṃ ni bzhi pa yis/ /sngags shes pas ni phur bu dbyung / /de nas phur bu'i khung bu ni/ /tshon sna lnga yis dgang bar bya/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /go rims bzhin du tshon rtsi dgye/ /mdor na dkar po sngon po dang / /de bzhin du ni dmar dang ljang / /ser po nang du shes bya ste/ /'di ni tshon gyi rim par bshad/ /dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /tshon rtsi sngon pos bri bar bya/ /shar gyi phyogs ni dkar po ste/ /lhor ni sngon po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi char ni dmar po ste/ /byang du ljang gu yin par bshad/ /bstan bcos mthong zhing blo ldan pas/ /'bad de de ltar bri bar bya/ /de nas sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor steng du 'deg 2par bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis sor mo/ /bkan nas gyen du 'deg par bya/ /oṃ sarba bid ut+t+waṃṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor 'deg —pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas mchod pa lnga yis ni/ /bum pa sta gon gnas bya ste/ /gsus che 3 4— 267

1542༄khya/ /ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni maṇ+ḍa la bi bye kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba dang / /dkyil 'khor dag gi cho ga dang / /dbang thob dngos grub sgrub pa ni/ /ngan song spyong ba'i rgyud dag las/ /sangs rgyas mtshan thob bdag gis bshad/ /thun mong khyad par gnas nyid du/ /gdan bde ba la bdag gnas nas/ /lag pa rdo rje byin brlab ste/ /rdo rje'i lce dang bdag med sems/ /oṃ badz+ra hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra dzi hā/ oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a/ de nas me ltar 'bar ba bskyed/ /de la byen gyis brlab pa dang / /spyi nas dbang ni bskur bar bya/ / cho ga bsgo 371—/277

bar bya ba'o1/ /oṃ grit+na badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūṃ/a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ sum̐/ de nas rdo rje tho ba dang / /khro bo rdo rje me dang ni/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog phyag rgya sngags/ /glo bur bgegs ni bsal bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha snyepa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e tri ban+dha sarba bismyon// rang bzhin sgeg jeni khro brgyad cing 5/ /rdo rje'i can gye kye'og tu bcings④/ /oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha ba rak+ṣa sadze+e swā hā/ rdo rje 'jigs byed gnod sbyin gnyis/ /steng du rdo rje'i gur du byas / /oṃ byu lu tū sdolu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ shar du rdo rje gtsug tor dang / /rdo rje zhags pas bcing bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ bye brnya haṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha trīḥ/ rdo rje ba dan nub bcings tekhye/ /phyag rgya mdzub mo mthe shā chung bgreng / /oṃ badz+ra pa hūṃ1tai ke ni traṭa nyu / rdo rje dus mtshan byang bcings pa༄ rta/ /gnod sbyin phyag rgya kha la gzhag /hri badz+ra ka skyeli ru ṭa ma ṭa/ rdo rje rtse mos lho phyogs bcings6/ /rdo rje khu tshur ri bo 'degs/ /oṃ badz+ra shi kha ྾ru ṭa ma ṭa/khro bo gsum gye ra ba ni/ /rdo rje las ni rgya gram ste/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad sngon po la/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcing ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra karma hūṃ/ badz+ra ban+ta baṃ/ dang por mchod pa bsham par bya/ /de nas gnyis pas bsang ba dang / /gsum pas gzi byin bskyed pa dang / /bzhi pas lha ru bskyed pa dang / /lnga pas mang por sprul pa dang / /drug pas byin gyis brlabs pa'o 4 sna/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi la/ /tshogs bsags zhedamigs pa'i yul can sprul/ /mchod bsham shāshebadun bo bya ba dang / /sems ni rab tu bskyed pa dang / /sdom pa bzung byenas lus dbul byadu spe/ /gzhan gyi don du tshogs bsags mchod/ /e ma ho ༄rtasangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /34—1278

e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa lags/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la gzhag /bstod nas lha rnams phyag byas so/ /lag par rigs lnga yab yum bcu/ /mnyam pa'i thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ tweḥ.aḥnyu / sor mo thams cad bsnol ba ni/ /rdo rje thal mo rab tu bya/ /oṃ badz+ra añja 2li/ rdo rje bsdams pas sdig pa ni/ /snying gar lan gsum dral bar bya/ /badz+ra ban+dha traṭa/ rdo rje dbab pa dam tshig rgyas/ /a zhes bdag la dbab par bya/ /badz+ra ā be sha aḥ / dbab par brtan par bya ba ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /ṭak+ki badz+ra hūṃ/ dam tshig rdo rje khu tshur bcings / /dbab pa tha mi dad par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra mudhi baṃ/ snying gar zla steng dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor bdag la thim/ /dkyil 'khor gcig gyur rtsa ba dbus/ /shākya seng ge'i thugs ka'i sngags/ /'od zer lnga 'phros las 4lnga mdzad/ /bkug nas dkyil 'khor gzhug 5pa dang / /de la dbang ni skur 6bar byed/ /sgrib dag sras dgongs lha la bstod/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i skyob pa rnged/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing med par/ /gsang sngags 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /shākya seng ge rtsar gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma la/ /gzi brjid rgyal mtshan rnon pa gdugs3/ /sgeg mo phreng ba glu gar dang / /spos dang me tog mar me dri/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog sdom/ /rab dga' sa bcu'i sems dpa' ni/ / skal bzangs 8bcu drug khyams na gnas/ /tshangs pa drag po gnod sbyin klu/ /me dang srin po klu dbang bcas/ /nyi zla sa bdag tshogs ldan pa/ /ngan song spyong mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mchod nas rdo rje 34—/279

—byedadril ldan pas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun nyid bstod/ /rang lus dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /lus la lha yi dkyil 'khor gnas/ /oṃ sarba bid a byeṣ+ṭha 1na dz+nyā na sa ma ya hūṃ/ gcig tu bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor de/ /thabs kyi ngan song spyong bar bshad/ /phyag rgya chen po'i cho ga bdun/ /rim pa bzhin du bskyed par bya/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang las ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor chu dang ni/ /sa gzhi rgya mtsho rin chen ri/ / bum pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa//gru bzhi rta babs rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /cho 'phrul bzhi las byung ba'i tshul/ /shākya'i rgyal pos 'khor ba sgol/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ pad+ma'i bung ba bzhin gro'/ mdzad/ /rang gi sngags sogs thugs la 'khor/ /oṃ mu ne+e mu ne+e ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ thugs ka'i zla ba lnga dang bcas/ /de nas 4'khor rnams/ 'byung bar byed/ /rdo rje'i gtsug tor sa gnon dkar/ /spro bsdu snying ga'i sngags las byung / /oṃ sarba a pa ya bi sho dha ne+e badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ rin chen gtsug tor mchod sbyin sngo/ /sems can ma lus dbang bsgur byed/ /oṃ rah+phot+ta ma ṭ+wāṃ5/ oṃ sarba karma ā ba ra rja 6ni bhasmi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/nga/d+ma'i gtsug tor mnyam gzhag dmar/ /sems can kun la mdzes ston mdzad//oṃ nga/d+mot+ta ma dīḥ/ oṃ bye bi nā sha ya ā ba ra shā 7ni hūṃ phaṭa/ las kyi gtsug tor mi 'jigs sbyin/ /sna tshogs mdog can khong du 'bar/ /oṃ bi shwat+ta ma aḥ8 / oṃ bye be+e sho dha ya ā ba ra rja 9ni hūṃ phaṭa/ gtsug tor gzi brjid dkar dmar mdog1 /nyi ma phyag rnams 1dku la brten1 / /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha na ā ba ra rja 1 ni hūṃ phaṭa/ gtsug tor rgyal mtshan dmar zhing gnag /yid bzhin nor bu rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /oṃ hūṃ phaṭa sarba ā ba 2tsho1 ——/280

ra ṇa ni sgo ṭa yo 1hūṃ phaṭa/ gtsug tor rnon po mkha' ltar sngo/ /g.yas pa ral gri glegs bam g.yon/ /oṃ ha ra ha ra sarba ā ba ra ṇa 2ni hūṃ phaṭa/gtsug tor gdugs dkar phyag na gdugs/ /sgu yi mdog ni dkar zhing 'bar//oṃ sum̐ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra a nab ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas de dag yo byad bshad/ /bdug spos ma dang me tog ma/ /mar me ma dang dri chab ma/ /oṃ sarba a pā ya bi sho dha ni dha ma dha ma dhu pa ya ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba durga ti bi sho dha ni put+pa 5bi lo ki ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā 6ya bi sho dha ni dz+nyā na ā lo ka ka ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā ya bi sho dha ni gan+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ lcags kyu shar la zhags pa lho/ /lcags sgrog nub ste dril bu byang / /oṃ sarba na ra ka ga ti ā kaste ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba na ra ka ut+ta ra ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā 1 ya ban+dha mo tsa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pa ya ga ti ga ha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo bzhi dang byang chub sems/ /bkra shis la sogs rgyas basbus sbyar/ /oṃ sarba saṃ s+thā ra pa ri shudha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te ma hā nā ya pa ri ba ri swā hā/ de nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ /gtso bo dang ni 'khor la bya/ /oṃ bita risarba ā ba ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi ṭa bi ṭa ྾pa ya da du na ni hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas ngan song sbyang slobyas nas/ /oṃ da ha da ha sarba ra na ka ga ti he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba tir+ya ka ga te te tsu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba pre ta ga te he tsu hūṃ phaṭa/ bsgom pa sku yi phyag rgya che/ /thugs ka'i rdo rje las kyi rgya/ / bcing ba 8dam tshig phyag rgya ste/ /bzlas pa mchog gi 1‘phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya / arta te/ samyapre bud+dhā 21ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ne+e/ sarba 31—/28/

pā paṃ bi sho dha ni shudhe bi shudhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shudha ne+e tshosnaswā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur mdzub mo brkyang / /mthe'u chung dz+rel nas sgo dbye bya/ /oṃ sarba bid badzod gha ta 2ye hūṃ/ rdo rje 'khor lo phyag rgya yis/ /bzhugs pa'i rten yang khyad par bya/ /oṃ sarba bid oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ/ se gol brdabs nas sangs rgyas rnams / /byon par 'gyur te gzhan ci smos/ /oṃ sarba bita sa ma ya 5dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ bstod nas bgegs bskrad bsrung ba dang / /sgo bcad go bgo mchod pa ni/ /las brgyad rab tu bya ba yin/ /de nas bsgom par bya ba yang / /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong bsgom/ /de nas ldang bar bya ba ni/ /thun bzhir byas te rab tu bya/ /zla drug gam ni lha yi gnas/ /de nas dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya/ /dang po sa ni btsal bar bya/ /byin chen bkra shis mtshan ldan 'thad—/ /sa gnang blang dang mi gnang la/ /rin bcal snyebaden pas bsgo 6bar bya/ /spyi dang dmigs kyis blang bar bya/ /sa yi lha mo sbran par bya/ /sngon 'byung dang ni de rjes 'jug /brtag pa ngan dor bzang la dzo blang / /sa yi pra brtag ro rnams bsal/ /byin gyis brlabs shing shedabang du bya / /sbyang bar bya zhing gter sogs gzhug /sa bzhi ༄kyegazung bar bya ba ni/ /dngos grub rang gis gzung bar bya/ /gtsug tor lha mo bkra shis sems/ /sgo ba rnams la sta gon zhus/ /sbyin sreg gtor ma la sogs bsham/ /slob ma phyi nang khrus byas te/ /ku shas gtsang zhing rmi sta gon/ /srung tsoskud bgegs bskrad dngos grub chags/ /tshem 1teshing ngag dag dngos grub dag snye /rnon po bsrung ba bzhad sogs pas/ /byin rlabs shā ༄zab mos dbugs phyung nyal/ /gser dngul bum pa gas chag med/ /tshad dang mtshan ldan rdzas kyis dgang / /34—1282

mgul chings kha rgyan gzungs thag bcas/ /phyag rgyas mtshan nas spyan 1drangs bsgrub / /rtogs rig tshad med srad bu'i thig /ras bral — gtsang ma bu mos bkal—/ /bsangs nas byin brlabs slob dpon gyis/ /ye shes dam tshig thig rnams gdab/ /rgyud las byung ba'i tshon rnams la/ /byin rlabs sgrub pa smin pa yis/ /thig gdab 4 nas ni phyag rgyas bteg /dam tshig ldan pas legs par bris/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bshad pa de/ /'khor lo 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rtsibs brgyad can/ /lte bar bcas shing mu khyud ldan/ /nang gi rim pa bris nas ni/ /lte ba'i nang du shākya yi/ /bdag po thub pa gzhag par bya/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen ni/ /dpa' bo de yi spyan sngar bri'o/ /rgyab tu 'khor los sgyur ba bri/ /g.yas phyogs rgyal ba'i gtsug tor can/ /g.yon du rnam par rgyal ba bri/ /gzi brjid phung po me yi phyogs / /dbang po'i phyogs su gdugs dkar po/ /rnam par 'thor ba rlung gi phyogs/ /rnam par 'joms pa bden bral phyogs/ /bris nas phyi rol bri bya ste / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs dang ni seng ges brgyan/ /dpa' bo 5lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu can rnams gzhag /grwa yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /bdug pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /bum pa dang ni phur pa mda'/ /dar sna ral gri me long dag /gzungs thag rgyal mtshan drur wa'i 6gdan/ /ku sha rta babs mchod pa dang / /ras yug slob dpon slob ma'i chas/ /de dag dkyil 'khor dgod par bya/ /ting 'dzin cho 'phrul bsgom pa ni/ /drang zhing sngug pa rab tu dag /nam mkha' dang ni mtshung 7mnyam pa/ /gnas ngan len pa kun las grol/ /rnam par rtog pa spang ba'i 8 34—/283

mchog /oṃ swa bhā wa shusgolhahaṃ1/ byams dang snying rje las byung 33zhing / /sems can la ni phan mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs dri ma thams cad dag /zla ba lta bur mthong ba'o/ /oṃ pra ti tsit+ta be sgo ka ro mi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub skyon med pa/ /dge ba'i chos rnams kun rdzogs shing / /nyon mongs thams cad rab tu grol/ /snying po dbus na zla chen po/ /oṃ bo bye tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ /sa dang sa min shin tu mkhyen/ /ye shes dag la zag pa med/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje'i gzugs su blta bar bya/ /oṃ tsit+ta badz+ra/sangs rgyas kyi ni rang bzhin sku/ /mi chod mi 'jigs mi shigs pa/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid las byung ba'i/ /rdo rje'i sgu ni bla med pa'o / /oṃ badz+ra āt+ma kolha4haṃ/rdo rje sems dpa' ting 'dzin nam/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran de bzhin te/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yi ge 'di/ /phyag rgya chen po dze+egs pa yi/ /oṃ ya thā badz+ra satwa ta thā a haṃ/ skye med mtshon pa'i a las ni/ /yig 'bru lnga yi 'phro 'du yis/ /nam mkha' rlung dang chu dkyil 'khor/ /sa gzhi me dpung rin chen ri/ /rja 5las bskyed pa'i gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan dang bcas / /ma skyes pa yi rang bzhin las/ /skyed 6pa'i byang chub zla ba'i steng //baṃ hūṃ tram̐ bye ram̐ phaṭa haṃ sum̐/ du ru a gi/ hūṃ tram̐ hri a7/ hūṃ hūṃ tram̐ hri hri ri a a/i a pa ra pa yi/ ku ing so a pra/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ thugs kyi ye shes 'bar ba las/ /sku yi phyag rgya sdogs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /oṃ brid ta brid ta / sarba ā ba ra rja 7ni hūṃ phaṭa/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /oṃ tra tha tra tha 11sarba ā ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje ste lnga'i phyag rgya bcas/ /oṃ stson+da stson+da sarba ā ba ra rja ni hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya dang / /3 4—/28/

sngags 'dis lha rnams kun dbang bskur/ /oṃ hūṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ t+t+waṃ o tweḥ 7 / oṃ ha /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /mdzub mo lcags kyu bsnol nas ni/ /rdo rje se gol bkrol bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sā dhu 2pa ri pu ru badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ/lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /dbyangs kyis spyan yang drang bar bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ bha ga wān e bye hi/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ / dam tshig phyag rgyas 'byung rgyu bya— / /g.yas pas mchog sbyin par byas la//g.yon pa mi 'jigs sbyin pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcings la gung gnyis mnyam/ /mje bong mthe 4chung brkyang ba phyag /rdo rje bcings pa gung gnyis mnyam/ /tshigs bcag sor mo gzhan yang 'khor5/ /de nyid mthe bong mthe chung bkug /rnam par 'joms pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid 'od zer 'dra ba ni/ /gzi brjid phung po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid spyi bor bskor ba yi/ /gdugs dkar po yi phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur mdzub gnyis mthe'u chung bsnol/ /mdun nas gyen bskor 'khor los sgyur/ /gung bgreng 6mdzub mo rtse sbyar bkug /lhag ma 'od 'phro gtsug tor rgyal/ /de bzhin mdzub gnyis rdo rjer byas/ /lhag ma bsdams pa rnam rgyal rgya/ /bsdams pa mdun bzhag bdug pa ma/ /de nyid gyen gtong 7phreng ba ma/ /mje bong bsgreng bskor mar me ma/ /de nyid byug pa ltar byas dri/ /mdzub mo gnyis bkug lcags kyu'o/ /rtse mo gnyis sprad zhags pa la/ /gcig la gabyug mdud lcags sgrog go/ /de nyid las sbyin dril bu gnyis/ /dpral bar thal sbyar de bzhin gshegs / /mgrin par pad+ma gsung gi phyag /thugs ka'i thal mo rdo rje phyag /rigs rnams spyir yang phyag bya'o9/ /'dus ma byas dang 'dus byas dang / /34—/285

phyi nang rab tu gsang ba dang / /bsod nams dge dang dag pa'i don/ /bde bar tshim par bya ba dang / /spyi dang so so'i mdor bsdus mchod/ /dgyes pa bskyed de lha rnams la/ /zhal phyag sku la so sor bstod/ /chos kyi phyag rgya las byung ba/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i bzlas pa ni/ /spyi'i dang so so gang byed bzlas1/ /las kyi phyag rgya las la gzhug /dngos grub thams cad gsol bar bya/ /yongs su bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ /de nas dri zhim dri ma posogs/ /rang gi lus ni bsrungs nas kyang / /rdo rje 'dzin pas zhugs nas ni/ /de nas slob ma gzhug par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bdag 'jug 'tshal/ /slob mas rgyun bshags bdun pa bya/ /bla mas de la lan byin pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba chen bo rigs dag la/ /gsang ba chen po 'dzin pa ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /slob mas 'tshal zhes brjod par bya/ /slob mas dbang bsgur 4gsol ba gdab/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes/ bgyi bas/ ni/ /slob dpon dbang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba'i/ /mi ldog 'khor lo spyor bar ldan/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /gsang ba chen por zhugs nas kyang / /sa ngas rgyas kun gyis 5dbang bskur te/ /skal ldan chen po bdag la stsol6/ /mtshan rnams kun kyis 7rgyas gdab pa'i/ /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /bla mas de la dam 3 4—/286

tshig stsal/ /dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba yi/ /rgyud bzhin gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /'di nas bzung gyo nas byang chub tu/ /khyod kyis yang dag bsrung bar bya/ /des ⑤kyang ji ltar gnas pa yi/ /sdom pa bdag gis bsrung zhes brjod—/ /bla mas lha la gsol ba gdab/ /che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir yang 'jug par 'tshal/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yo ga bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra pra tha ya tha su khaṃ/ de nas lhar ni bskyed byas la/ /mchod pa rnams kyis mchod byas te/ /stod stigayogs dar gyis gdong g.yogs nas/ /bgegs bskrad 4bdug pa bya ba ni/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ/las kyi bum pa chus gang bas3 / /bkrus te dbang du bya ba'o⑥// /de nas lag pa nas bzung 3ste/ /sgo bzhi dag nas 'jug par bya/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs rigs bzhugs3—/ /ngas ni khyod la ye shes snang 1 / /de bzhin dngos grub grub byed de/ /de lta bu ni khrod sbyin zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyed kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha/ deng khyod lha ni nga yin te//dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub thob/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg skrupar byed/ /nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /slob dpon la ni brnyas pa na/ /bde ba spangs nas dmyal bar ldung / /oṃ di na te na ra kan/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs /mipa rgya chen nyid/ /bdag la rab tu zhu bas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la phob/ /slob ma mude zhus bla ma 'di/ /rdo rje dri bsgos snying gar gzhag /'di ni rdo rje dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems 34—1287

dpa' yin par grags/ /ye shes rdo rje bla med 'dir/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā be+e sha ya a a/ rdo rje 'chang gi —1 snying gar dbab/ /'bab par byed de ma byung sbyang / /yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ /legs par dor cig sems dpa' che/ /thar pa chen bo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /me tog gang la khrung ba de/ /de nyid khyod kyi rigs kyi lha/ /o sarba bita 2 pra tits+tsha ho/oṃ pra ti grit+na swa mi saṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ de yi phreng ba mgo la bcing / /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed pa la brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /de ring nyid du 'byed nga/ra shog /he badz+ra pā —sh+ya phaṭa/ rdo rjes gdong g.yogs dgrol bar bya/ /de nas sgo ba nas brtsams te/ /shākya seng ge'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ /dbab par bya ba gang yin pa/ /de ni nye bar bsdu bar byas/ /de nas dkyil 'khor shar ngos su/ /maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ /yi dam lha bsam 5dbang bskur bya/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar / /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis bum dbang bsgur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri 6ye hūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /rdo rje thugs su mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra a bye ṣiñca māṃ/ zhe 7sdang khams dag byed pa yi/ /dpal ldan chu yi dbang bsgur bas/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /phyag na rdo rje'i dbang thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bhe ṣiñca hūṃ/ phal pa'i sa ni gzhom pa dang / /yon tan gzi brjid bskyed pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba gtsug tor rin chen gyi/ /cod 3 4— /288

pan gyi 7ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mu ku ṭa ya a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/dpal ldan rin chen cod pan dbang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje rin chen mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na swa bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ nga rgyal khams rnams dag byed pa'i / /cod pan gyi ni dbang bskur bas/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi / /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dbang thob shog /rat+na a bye ṣiñca māṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye ṣi.ā+oṃ mi 4badz+ra swa bha wa s+t+waṃ/ chos kyi gsung rab dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung du dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra a bhe ṣiñca rmā/ 'dod chags khams rnams dag byed pa'i/ /rdo rje yis ni dbang bskur bas/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi5/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang thob shog /badz+ra a bhe ṣiñca māṃ/'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyis spyorjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho mchog tu bshad/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ7/ dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje 8lus ni mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha badz+ra swa bhā wa a rnyi ṣiñca hūṃ/ phrag dog khams rnams rnam dag cing / /dril bu yi ni dbang bsgur bas/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes kyi 9/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i sku thob shog /karma a bhi ṣiñca māṃrka/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /34—1289

sdug bsngal chen po bsal ba'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /shākya seng ge rtag tu bskyed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣidzi —1bhemi che ge mo 3 a rnyi ṣi ka ta/gti mug khams rnams dag pa yi/ /dpal ldan ming gi /dbang bskur ba/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi ye shes kyi4/ /shākya seng ge'i sku thob shog /budhe a bye ṣiñca māṃ5 / 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag la 6'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra tsit+ta swa 7bhā wa sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca ga ta ya 8mi hūṃ nyi nyi ti hi nyi phaṭa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 7mi phyed pa/ /gsang sngags bla na med pa yi/ /snying po yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /skyobs rtartapa'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma le a snyi ṣiñca rmā/ slob dpon dbang bskur gsol ba gdab / /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod cing gsol ba ltar/ /bdag kyang gsungs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol1 / /de bzhin gshegs pas dbang bskur bas/ /'gro ba bskyed pa'i gzi brjid can//ji ltar ye shes 'byung gnas gtso/ /slob dpon chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bsgur ba rgo bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi 7 rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la sprul྾/ /de nas dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /srog gcod rku dang 'khrig pa dang / /brdzun 1 dang chang ni spang bar bya/ /mi dge ba ni bcu po dag /khyod kyis nam yang ma spyad cig /be+eg pa dman la mos pa dang / /sems can 'khor ba ma spangs shig18 /mya ngan 'das la ma chags shig /lha dang mi la brnyas mi bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya rnams/ / 'gong bar tso bya ba ma yin te/ /dam tshig 31byed/290

'di dag nyams pa na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar 'tshed par byed/ /de bas dam tshig bus srungs 1shig /slob ma'i lus la lha bkod de2/ /slob dpon byed pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye ya pa ri ti ka a bhe ṣik+ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar / /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib 4rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne+e tra a pa ha ra pa ḍi waṃ dz+rīḥ5/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas me+ed pa/ /de ltar chos 'di shes nas su/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /ā nidar+sha a bye ṣiñca māṃ/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med de//bskal pa'i cho 'phrul cir yang ston/ /bdud rigs thams cad pham byed pa'i/ /ye shes kyi ni mda' 'phongs shig /dz+nyā na kā ya a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam spyor ba'i/ /sku mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /wāka badz+ra a a/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med / /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin nyid/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs / a badz+ra satwa tsit+ta a/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /di ring phan chad 'jig rten du/ /chos kyi dung ni 34—129/

bla med pas/ /sems can ma lus blo rnams la/ /kun du ma lus gang bar gyis / /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyis na/ /'jig rten 'di la rab sgrogs shig /'di nas brtsams nas byang chub par/ /sems bskyed tsam gyis don rdzogs te/ /gser gyi gdugs 'dis sems can gyi/ /nyon mongs gdung ba ma lus skyobs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyang / /phan 'dog 1drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /kun du byed la srung bar byed/ /de nas thams cad gzengs bstod la/ /oṃ 'di de khyod kyi lung bstan yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa kun du bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye de bzhin gshegs pa che ge mo/ /zhes bya ba sidhe 2sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ jur bhu ba swaḥ / de nas rjes su gnang ba sbyin/ /oṃ ngo bo nyid kyi sems can rnams/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar 4chags la sogs/ /gtsang mas sems can don bya'o/ /de nas dbugs 5 dbyung bya ba ni/ /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /de ring phan chad khyod zhugs kyi6/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol ba'i/ /khyed rnams der ni legs par gnas/ /bde chen thob pa rnams las ni/ /slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi smod pa/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis//srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /khyed rnams kun gyis 7sangs rgyas nyid/ /de nyid je tshom med par thob/ /chos gos nas gzung lung bstan pa/ /oṃ nga yis 'di ltar lung bstan pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang / /mgrin gcig rdzogs byang lung bstan 34—1292

mdzad / /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa/ /kun gyis deng khyod dbang bskur bas/ /khams gsum kun gyi rgyal po che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por ston pa ni / /de ni bdud las rnams snargyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyed rnams kun gyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /de nyid je tshom med par thob/ /de nas rgyal ba'i 37cho ga ni/ /mdor bsdu rnam par bshad par bya/ /slob ma yongs su gzung ba ni/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /slob ma'i gdong pa g.yogs pa dang / /dam tshig can du byin gyis brlabasasgo / /dngos grub las ni gsol ba gdab/ /dam tshig gnan chopar bya ba ni/ /me tog lha la dor bar bya/ /rdo rje'i mig ni dbye bar byas/ /de nas dkyil 'khor lhar zhugs te/ /lha rnams la ni mchod par sabya/ /mthong nas dkyil 'khor 'jug pa lnga/ /shar lho nub byang dbus nyid du/ /cho ga rnam grangs bcu bzhi ni / /re re dag la rdzogs par bya/ /sgo bzhi dbus nas gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub don la yid ches 'jug /'jug pa'i skal yod sgo phye nas/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /snod du rung phyir phyag 'tshal nas/ /skyabs 'og tshud phyir gsol ba gdab/ /gnang bas slob dpon lan byin bya/ /yi ge brgya pas byin rlabs skubasdu/ /sgrib pa sbyang ba'i khrus kyang bya/ /de la dam tshig dbog pa dang / /mi 'da' bar yang dam bcas la/ /mchod pa rnam lnga dbul bar bya/ /yongs su bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'o / /dkyil 'khor gnas kyi don bshad cing / /phyag rgya lha yi don bshad nas / /rgyan dang cha rkyen bshad pa'ang bstan/ /bum pa la sogs ji snyed thogs—/ /dbang bcu ci dgar bskur bar bya'o/ /spyir sbyin byang chub dbu 34—/293

rgyan dang / /kun la dbang bskur 'khor lo bskor/ /las kyi rdo rje rgya gram dang / /sgrib pa 'khru 1ba'i bum pa dang / /mdzes pa'i me tog phreng ba dang / /zil gnon bzod pa'i cod pan dang / /'da' bar dka' ba'i phyag rgya dang / /thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel dang / /mi 'bral ba yi gzungs su ni/ /thun mong min pa'i gsang ba dang / /rdo rje ming gi gsang 2mchog rnams/ /dbang rnams kun la mchog gyur pa/ /de ring khyod la bsgur bar bya/ /oṃ a bhe ṣiñca a/ rin chen bdun pa rnam grangs pa/ /gang gi rdzas su dper mi bzod / /gser gyi 'khor lo dbang byed dang / /glang po rin chen stobs chen dang / /rta mchog rin chen mgyogs pa dang / /nor bu 'od ldan re skong dang / /btsun mo rin chen gzugs ldan dang / /blon po rin chen blo gros dang / /dmag dpon rin chen rdzu 'phrul dang / /de 'dra'i rin chen rnam grangs dang / /byang chub yan lag bdun ldan dang 4/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug rkyen/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /de yang longs spyod rkyen du shog /oṃ a bhi ṣiñca a/ nye ba'i rin chen ral gri dang / /byams dang snying rje'i pags pa dang / /'dod ldan skyed mos tshal dang ni/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong mda' gzhu dang / /gos mchog yang dag skyabs ldan dang //lham mchog 'gro na stabs sdug dang / /tshangs pa'i khab skud bcas pa bdun/ /de yi rdzas mchog rnam grangs 5bdun/ /rin chen bdun dang nye bar grags/ /des kyang longs spyod rkyen 6du shog /oṃ a bhe ṣiñca a/ bkra shis rjas su rnam grags pa/ /rdzas rnams kun la bkra shis pa'i/ /mthu stobs sgrub rdzas yungs kar dang / /shin tu gtsang ba'i rtswa mchog dang / /yon tan sdud pa li khri dang //34—/294

bcud kyi dam pa gi waṃ dang / /don rnam gsal ba'i me long dang / /chos sgra sgogs pa'i dung mchog dang / /gzi mdangs bskyed pa'i zas 3mchog dang / /'bras bu smin pa'i bil ba dang / /bkra shis rdzas kyi mchog 'gyur bas/ /de yang longs spyod rkyen du shog /oṃ a bhi ṣiñca a/ bkra shis rdzas su rnams 2grags pa/ /mtshan bzang kun las bkra shis pas/ /thugs kyi don rtogs dpal be'u dang / /gzhan las dbang sgyur 'khor lo dang / /bdud las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / /skabs dang ldan pa'i gdugs mchog dang / /skyon gyes ma gos pad+ma dang / /sgrib pa sbyong ba'i bum pa dang / /rgya mtshor shugs ldan dung mchog dang / /thabs kyi 4'phyo ba'i gser nya dang / /sangs rgyas mtshan du bkra shis pa/ /de yang longs spyod rkyen du shog /oṃ a bhe ṣiñca a/dbang po lnga yi longs spyod skyon5/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi mchog /sdu 6 gu mdzes pa'i gzugs dang ni/ /mjam 7zhing snyan pa'i sgra mchog dang / /ldang ju zhing zhim pa'i dri mchog dang / /mngar zhing bcud ldan ro mchog dang / /mnyam zhing 'jam pa'i reg bya dang / /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ru grags/ /de yang longs spyod rkyen du shog /oṃ a bye ṣiñca a/ ma rig 'byed pa'i gser thur dang / /chos rnams sgyu ma'i me long ltar/ /rkang pa'i 'khor lo rdzu 'phrul ldan / /dung gis 9chos kyi sgra 'byin shog /oṃ a bhi ṣiñca a/ de sogs gzhan yang ci rigs bsgur/ /lho sgo'i cho ga bya ba ni/ /stegs bu khru gang rnams 7lngas byugs/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /bum pa rdzas bcas me tog dgram/ /mtshon cha gdugs dang smyug ma dang / /bdag nyid shākya seng ge yi / /thugs kyi mda' lnga 'phros pa yis/ /las dang nyon mongs phyir bzlog 34—/295

pa'i / /yungs kar sngags kyis brdeg ②par bya/ /ming ngam rus bu rus la brabs / /oṃ sarba a pa ya ā kar+ṣa na ⑤ bi sho dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi bi sgo ṭa ya sarba a pa ya brnya cho ni pra mo k+ṣa ya sarba a pa ya ga ti bh+yaḥ phyasarba satwa zhwasarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa/ oṃ sarba bid ā ā bi sha /oṃ bita dzotraṭa tshin+da a/ sa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te zu he rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ga 9te te rtu hūṃ phaṭa/ lha yi sngags la btags te bya/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la 'di btags nas/ /de nas khrus kyis bkru bar bya/ /sarba bispyonashwe/sarba gra te sarba dz+wa re/ sarba bya bye/ sarba u pa dra wa/ sarba a kā la za shā7t+yā pra sha ma na ya/ sarba dur rkyeswad+mā dur mi te bya ku la tshe/ shāne+e ku ru swā hā/ nub phyogs bde gnas lam bstan bya/ /lam ni bar chad bsal te sbyang / /zhag ni nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /zhag bdun dkyil 'khor gzhug par bya/ /de bzhin bcug ste dbang bskur na/ /ngan song thams cad rnam gol te/ /bde 'gro mtho ris 'jig rten dang / /sa rnams gong mar skye 'gyur te/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas su yang nges par 'grub/ /sngar bzhin las rnams thams cad byed/ /thams cad thogs pa med par 'gyur/ /byabs shā2pas rims nad gdon dug ⑫sogs/ /thams cad kun las thar bar 'gyur / /t+t+waṃ brjod tsam gyis las rnams 'grub/ /cho ga zhib mo gzhan yang 'grub / /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po sogs/ /ngan 'gro'i dbang du gyur pa yisamu / /ro 'am gzugs brnyan ming sogs bri/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg tshedabang bskur grol/ /sgu gzugs bri ba'i cho ga yang / /'jig rten gsum las 34—1296
