༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta 3 maṇ+ḍa la bi bye nā ma/bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/spang dang blang ba'i gzhi rnams shes/ /gang zag gsum gyi lam rnams shes/ /thub pa yi ni rtog 5pa'i yul/ /rten gsum gyi ni bdag nyid can/ /sangs rgyas nyan thos sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs kyis bskor ba'i yum de la/ /sgo gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs lung bstan klu sgrub dang / /de yi slob ma zla grags dang / /mkhas pa yi ge7ni bha bya dang / /de sogs yum gyi sgrub thabs ni/ /legs pa nyid du bstan kyang ni/ /sla lha zhing dkyil 'khor rgyas pa 6ni/ /mkhas pas de dag ma bstan te/ /des rgyas bdag gis sla (bar bstan/ /bdag 'dra shin tu blun gyur kyang / /bla ma yi dam drin dang ni/ /gzhung rnams kun nas bsdus nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga legs par bshad/ /34—/ /51

snying rje dang ldan rigs kyi bus/ /yum brjod pa yi mjug thogs su/ /dge ba rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bsham bya ste/ /de nas lha ༄1gnas nang par ni/ /tshangs dang zur dang logs thig rnams/ /gzhan dang mthun par gdab par bya/ /phyi dang nang du dbye bar bya/ /phyi la sgo sogs rdzogs par gdab/ /nang la yang ni tshul bzhin gdab/ /nang gi le'u n+detshe bzhi la ni/ /pad+ma ze'u 'bru ldan dgu bri/ /de phyi le'u 4tshe bcu gnyis la/ /ze'u 5'bru 'dab ldan bzhi rnams bri/ /de yi phyi yang gzhan dang mthun/ /bri 6 dang bshad pa rim gyis bstan/ /dran bzhi brda bstan gdugs bzhi bri/ / spong bzhi 7brda bstan 'khor lo bzhi/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi yi brdar/ /pad 'dab bzhi ni bri bar bya/ /nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi'i brdar/ / rta babs bzhi yang bri bar bya/ /ye shes skad cig bcu drug brdar/she /bcu gcig rdo rje bcu drug bri/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi brdar/ /re khā lnga dang dra ba phyed/ /rin chen phag dang 'dod yon snam7/ /de dag kyang ni rim bzhin bri/ /sa bcu pa yi brdar bstan pa/ /sgo yi nang yang legs par bri / /de ltar pho brang nang dag na/ /yum chen 'khor dang bcas pa bri/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /sgu mdog ser mo 1 phyag bzhi ma/ /g.yas kyi dang po pad+ma'i steng/ /shes rab kyi ni puste'os/ /g.yon gyi dang po ut+pal te / /mi shigs nga/ yi rdo rje'o/ /dang po'i 'og ma mchog sbyin dang / /gnyis pa 'og ma mnyam gzhag ste/ /de lta bu yi yum bri'o/ /phyogs bzhi —pad+ma'i 'dab steng du / /sems ma rdo rje rin chen ma/ /chos dang las kyi sems ma'o sku mdog phyag mtshan rigs dang mthun/ /mtshams bzhi pad+ma'i 'dab steng du/ /3 1byed/ 452

mā ma tī dang gos dkar mo/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang sgrol ma ste/ /sku mdog 3 phyag mtshan rigs dang mthun/ /shar gyi pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /rin chen 'byung gnas sgu mdog ser/ /sa gnon phyag rgya can dgod do/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni pad+ma la/ /sems dpa' 'od zer kun 'byung dang / /rin chen 'od 'phro rin dbang phyug /rdo rje mi g.yo sems dpa' bzhi/ /pad+ma rdo rje dbyug to dang / /rin chen lcags kyu rim bzhin thogs/ /lho yi pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /mya ngan med dpal sku mdog sngo/ /mchog sbyin pad+ma can dgod do/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /sems dpa' mya ngan med pa dang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa rgyal/ /dbang phyug rgyal te sems dpa' bzhi/ /pad+ma 'dab bzhi 5 rin chen 'bar/ /rgyal mtshan rnams te rim bzhin thogs/ /nub kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /rin chen 'od 'phro sku mdog dmar/ /mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can dgod do/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /spyod pa'i blo gros snang ba mchog /phyag rgya ༄ dang ni spobs pa brtsegs/ /pad+ma dung dang lcags kyu dang / /mnyam gzhag pusti bsnams pa'o/ /de dag thogs nas gtso la 'dud/ /byang gi pad+ma'i ste ba la/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po sku mdog ljang / /skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can dgod do/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni pad+ma la/ /rgyal ba byin dang grub pa'i lha/ /dga' ba 4ston dang 5mi g.yo ba/ /pad+ma rin chen pa tra dang / /rgya gram mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin bsnams/ /byang shar pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /ting 'dzin glang po dmar ser mdog /chos 'khor bskor ba'i phyag rgya can/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /rgyal ba gnon dang kun du bzang / /'jam dpal sgrib pa sel ba ste/ /pad+ma rin chen ga'u dang / /rdo rje me tog rim bzhin thogs/ /3 4—/453

shar lho pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /pad+mo lkudam pa dmar skya'i mdog /chos 'chad phyag rgya can dgod do/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /lag na pad+mo 3mthu chen thob / /sman gyi rgyal dang yon tan snying / /pad+ma me tog myu gu dang / /bum pa dang ni ral gri'o/ /de dag bsnams te gtso la 'dud/ /lho nub pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba'i dpal/ /dmar ser mdog ldan chos 'chad tshul/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /nyi ma rab snang rdo rje can / /gzhon nu rgyan dang seng ge'i she sgra/ /pad+ma dang ni me tog nyug /rdo rje bdud rtsi bum pa ni/ /rim pa bzhin du thogs pa'o/ /nub byang pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /gdugs dam pa ste dmar ser mdog /chos 'chad pa yi phyag rgya can/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /rin chen mchog dang pad+mo lhargyal/ /pad+ma dam pa thogs med rgyal/ /pad+ma dang ni rtse zhwalnga dang / /me tog dang ni mdzes gos dang 7/ /go rims bzhin du thogs pa'o/ /phyi rim shar phyogs lte ba la/ /dga' ba dpal te mdog dkar po/ /skyabs dang ldan pa dgod shepar bya/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /dga' sbyin dang ni bzang skyong dang / /dkon mchog 'byung gnas zla 'od gnas/ /pad+ma dang ni me tog dang / /nyi ma zla ba bsnams pa'o/ / lho phyogs 9kyi ni lte ba la/ /shāka thub gser gyi btso ma bzhin/ /bdud btul ba yi tshul can no/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /byams pa nam mkha'i snying po dang / /sa yi snying dang spyan ras gzigs/ /mod gal dang shā ri'i bu/ /kun dga' bo dang 'od srungs te/ /pad+ma dang ni rin chen dang / /bum pa khri snyan sa le rnams/ /go rims thogs te gtso la 'dud / /bzhi yi phyag mtshan lhung bzed do/ /nub kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /34byed/ /54

mar me mdzad de mdog dmar po/ /kun snang phyag rgya can dgod do/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /nyi 'od dang ni zla 'od dang / /byams pa mi tri skyes bu dam/ /kun kyang rin chen 'dzin pa'o/ /byang phyogs pad+ma'i lte ba la/ / pad+mo'i dpal de tu7mdog sngo ba/ /skyabs sbyin ldan pa dgod par bya/ /phyogs bzhi yi ni 'dab ma la/ /pad+ma dam dang ye shes tog /mya ngan kun 'joms blo mi zad/ /kun kyang pad+mo thubasnams pa'o/ /mtshams su sgeg mo phreng ba ma/ /glu dang gar de gzhan dang mthun / /phyi la me tog bdug pa ma/ /dri chab ma ste gzhan dang mthun/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /de yang gzhan dang mthun ④pa'o/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /kun gyi nang rol mthing thuba'o/ /shar du dkar po che ba ste/ /lho ru ser po che ba ste/ /nub tu dmar po che ba ste/ /byang du ljang gu che ba ste/ /dbus su mthing ga yang dag ldan/ /mchod dang gtor ma rgyas par bshams tre/ /dkyil 'khor rgyan sogs legs par dgod/ /rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug /dang po tshogs kyi lam gyi chos/ /bzhi gsum bcu gnyis bsgom rtogs bya/ /de rjes sbyor ba'i lam gyi chos/ /nges 'byed bsgom zhing rtogs par bya/ /de rjes mthong ba'i lam kyi tsochos/ /byang chub bdun bsgom rtogs par bya/ /de rjes bsgom pa lam gyi chos/ /'phags lam brgyad bsgom rtogs par bya/ /de rjes rdo rje lta bu gnas/ /de de yang ni rtogs par bya/ /de rjes bcu gcig pa yang thob / /rgyu zhe las rin chen gzhal yas bsam/ /kun gyi sa bon a yin te/ /de zhu mtshan ma lha ru bsam/ /lam lnga rdzogs pa'i pho brang du/ /yum chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gzugs nas rga shi rtogs pa'i tshul/ /sbyin 34byed1455

nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen/ /de yang spyod pa'i tshul can rnams/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /ring po ma lon de nyid kyi1/ /yum chen 'khor 2bcas spyan drangs te/ /bsam brjod yul 'das 'gro ba la/ /mtshon phyir skye med mtshon bstan pa/ /skye ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan las/ /'gro ba'i don du yum du shar/ /yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa yang yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba dang / /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis / /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /bsam brjod yul 'das pha rol phyin/ /kun rdzob 'gro don yum gyi sgu/ /yum chen pha rol phyin ma yang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba dang / /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /shar phyogs rin chen yong ba yis5/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'byung gnas la/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis / /yum chen dge ba bsnyu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /lho phyogs mya ngan med pa yi/ /dam 7pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs mya ngan med pa la/ /34byed/7 56

byang chub sems dpa' khyem pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos 1ga dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba basbu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /nyenub phyogs nye bar zhi ba yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'od 'phro la/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /3 byang phyogs rgyal ba can gyi ni/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dbang po la/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir / /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na//byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ / byang shar ting 'dzin brgyan pa yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs ting 'dzin glang po la/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i 34—/457

tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /—lkushar lho snying po byang chub brgyan/ /shin tu yid 'ong zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs pad+ma dam pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis sbyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /thulho nub rdul dang bral ba yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde bar gshegs pa nyi ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor snang ba'i dpal la ni/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bkyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ / nub byang dbang du bya ba yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs gdugs kyi dam pa la/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyem pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du 34—17158

bskor—/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis / /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol ༄1/ /steng phyogs mdangs dga'i zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs dga' ba'i 37dpal la ni/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis sbyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /5'og phyogs pad+ma'i zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs pad+ma'i dpal la ni/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bkyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol 4/ /mi mjed 5'jig rten khams 'di na/ /bde gshegs shākya 6seng ge la/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis 34—1459

pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snyeng rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol/ /4bheyongs su dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs mar me mdzad pa ni/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / /rab tu byung dang khye'u dang / /bu mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor du bskor/ /'khor bcas ma lus pa dag kyang / /yon bdag sgrib rgyun sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam chos 1ga dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /yum chen dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /byang chub sems kyis gshegs su gsol2/ /phyi dang nang na rab gnas shing / /sgo rnams skyong ba la sogs kun/ /ma lus de dag thams cad kyangarte/ /gnas 'dir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /rin chen rgyas pa pad+ma'i gdan/ /shes rab gsal ba zla ba'i gdan/ /thugs rje rgyas pa nyi ma'i gdan/ /yum chen sras dang bcas la dbulaphya/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis/ /dge ba bsdu phyir gshegs tsasu gsol/ /oṃ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā sarba de ba āt+ma māṃ nit+yā dzota yā mi/ gdan sogs dbul zhing gnyis med bya/ /de nas mchod pa 'di skad do/ /bde gshegs mnyes pa'i yon chab 'di/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag sgo nas/ /yum chen sras dang bcas la dbul / /dam chos k+kog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis— / /dge ba bsdu phyir bzhes su gsol/ /de bzhin bsgres te sgra mchod par / /rgyal yum sras dang bcas la mchod/ /bdag gi sgo gsum dang ba yis / /yum chen 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems 34byed/ 60

can rnams/ /ngag yid dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā de ba sarba a māṃ nit+yā ta yā she7 mi/ phyag byas bstod pa 'di lta ste/ /rang bzhin mnyam nyid gnyis med kyang / /'gro ba'i don phyir yum gyi sku/ /rigs kyi yum gyis yongs bskor ba/ /dus gsum rgyal yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje sems ma rin chen ma/ /chos dang las kyi (2sems ma ste/ /rigs kyi yum bzhi phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mā ma tī dang gos dkar mo/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang sgrol ma ste//mdzes pa'i yum bzhi phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shar phyogs rin chen yod pa yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'byung gnas ni/ /sku chen ༄ mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod / /lho phyogs mya ngan med pa yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs mya ngan med pa ni/ / sgu chen mtshan bzang yon tan dze+egs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing //mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /4nub phyogs nye bar zhi ba yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'od 'phro ni/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /5byang phyogs rgyal ba can gyi ni/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs 34—/46sde

rgyal ba'i dbang po ni/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /①byang shar ting 'dzin brgyan pa yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs ting 'dzin glang po ni/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod//2shar lho snying po byang chub brgyan/ /shin tu yid 'ong zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs pad+mo'i dpal la ni/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing //mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /④lho nub rdul dang bral ba yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde bar gshegs pa nyi ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'anub byang dbang du gyur pa yi/ /dag pa yi ni zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs gdugs kyi dam pa ni/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs 37(—/462

chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod//—rmesteng phyogs mdangs dga'i zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs dga' ba'i dpal la ni/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi//gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /rngu'og phyogs pad+mo'i dazhing khams na/ /bde gshegs pad+mo'i dpal la ni/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi//gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod / / mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di na/ /bde gathe/gas shākya seng ge ni—/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi/ /gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod / /37yongs su dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /bde gshegs mar me mdzad pa ni/ / sku chen mtshan bzang yon tan rdzogs/ /dam chos rmad du byung ba yi//gsung chen pha rol phyin drug gis/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar yongs sgrogs shing / /thugs chen mnyam nyid rtag gnas shing / /mdzes pa'i bde gshegs phyag 'tshal bstod / //9sems dpa' 'od zer kun 'byung dang / /rin chen 'od 'phro rin dbang phyug /rdo rje mi g.yo sems dpa' bzhi/ /pha rol phyin la rab dad de—/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo la /sprul sku shākya seng ge yis/ /dri med pha rol phyin pa la/ /chos sgra chen po sgrogs 34—1463

pa'i tshe/ /chos 'byung rtag ①chen bstan pa'i dus/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyis(pe/ /rang gis gtso la rtag zhus te/ /gtso bos tshul bzhin lung bstan dus/ /mdzes pa gser gyi pad 'dab stong / /shākya seng ge mchod pa dang / /pha rol phyin chos mnyan pa'i ched/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir byon pa'ige / /blo chen khyod sa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems dpa' mya ngan med pa dang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan bkod pa rgyal/ /dbang phyug rgyal te sems dpa' bzhi/ / pha rol phyin la rab dad de/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo la/ /sprul sku shākya seng ge yis/ /dri med pha rol phyin pa la/ /chos sgra chen po sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /chos 'byung rtag chen bstan pa'i dus/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyang / /rang gis gtso la rtag zhus te/ /gtso bos tshul bzhin lung bstan dus/ /mdzes pa gser gyi pad 'dab stong / /shākya seng ge mchod pa dang / /pha rol phyin chos mnyan pa'i ched/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir byon pa'i/ /blo chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃspyod pa'i blo gros snang mchog dang / /phyag rgya rgyal dang spobs pa brtsegs7/ /blo dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' bzhi/ / pha rol phyin la rab dad de/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bya rgod srungs pa'i ri bo la/ /sprul sgu shākya seng ge yis/ /dri med pha rol phyin pa la/ /chos sgra chen ngo/ sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /chos 'byung rtag chen bstan pa'i dus/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyang / /rang gis gtso la rtag zhus te/ /gtso bos tshul bzhin lung bstan dus/ /mdzes pa gser gyi pad 'dab stong / /shākya seng ge mchod pa dang / /pha rol phyin chos mnyan pa'i ched/ /mi mjed 34byed/464

'jig rten 'dir byon pa'i/ /blo chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gyorgyal ba byin dang grub pa'i lha/ /dga' ston dang ni mi g.yo ba/ /blo dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' bzhi/ / pha rol phyin la rab dad de/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo la/ /sprul sgu shākya seng ge yis/ /dri med pha rol phyin pa la/ /chos sgra chen po sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /chos 'byung rtag chen bstan pa'i dus/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyang / /rang gis gtso la rtag zhus te/ /gtso bos tshul bzhin lung bstan dus/ /mdzes pa gser gyi pad 'dab stong / /shākya seng ge mchod pa dang / /pha rol phyin chos mnyan pa'i ched/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir byon pa'i/ /blo chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shunyi ma rab snang rdo rje can/ /gzhon nu rgyan dang seng ge sgra/ /blo dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' bzhi/ / pha rol phyin la rab dad de//mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo la/ /sprul sku shākya seng ge yis/ /dri med pha rol phyin pa la/ /chos sgra chen po sgogs pa'i tshe/ /chos 'byung rtag chen bstan pa'i dus/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyang / /rang gis gtso la rtag zhus te/ /gtso bos tshul bzhin lung bstan dus/ /mdzes pa gser gyi pad 'dab stong / /shākya seng ge mchod pa dang / /pha rol phyin chos mnyan pa'i ched/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir byon pa'i/ /blo chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /4rin chen mchog dang pad+mo rgyal/ /pad+mo 5dam pa thogs med rgyal/ /blo dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' bzhi/ / pha rol phyin la rab dad de/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo la/ /sprul sku shākya seng ge yis/ /dri med pha rol phyin pa la/ /chos sgra 34—1465

chen po sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /chos 'byung rtag chen bstan pa'i dus/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyang / /rang gis gtso la rtag zhus te/ /gtso bos tshul bzhin lung bstan dus/ /mdzes pa gser gyi pad 'dab stong / /shākya seng ge mchod pa dang / /pha rol phyin chos mnyan pa'i ched/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir byon pa'i/ /blo chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dga' bzhin 1dang ni bzang skyong dang / /dkon mchog 'byung gnas zla 'od gzhon/ /blo dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' bzhi/ / pha rol phyin la rab dad de/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo la/ /sprul sku shākya seng ge yis/ /dri med pha rol phyin pa la/ /chos sgra chen po sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /chos 'byung rtag chen bstan pa'i dus/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyang / /rang gis gtso la rtag zhus te/ /gtso bos tshul bzhin lung bstan dus/ /mdzes pa gser gyi pad 'dab stong / /shākya seng ge mchod pa dang / /pha rol phyin chos mnyan pa'i ched/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir byon pa'i/ /blo chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+mo 2bhedam pa me tog dang / /mya ngan kun du 'joms pa dang / /blo gros mi zad sems dpa' bzhi/ / pha rol phyin la rab dad de/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo la/ /sprul sku shākya seng ge yis/ /dri med pha rol phyin pa la/ /chos sgra chen po sgrogs nga/'i tshe/ /chos 'byung rtag chen bstan pa'i dus/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyang / /rang gis gtso la rtag zhus te/ /gtso bos tshul bzhin lung bstan dus/ /mdzes pa gser gyi pad 'dab stong / /shākya seng ge mchod pa dang / /pha rol phyin chos mnyan pa'i ched/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir byon 2(byed/ /66

pa'i / /blo chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /1byams pa sa snying nam mkha' snying / /spyan ras gzigs te sems dpa' bzhi/ /'gro don brtson la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mod gal dang shā ri'i bu/ /kun dga' bo dang 'od srungs te/ /mchog bzhi nyan thos phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nyi 'od dang ni zla 'od dang / /byams pa mi tri skyes bu dam/ /thabs mkhas 'gro don brtson la bstod/ /nyams bdes bde gshegs mnyes mdzad 2pa/ /nang gi lha mo bzhi la bstod/ /mchod pa yi ni las kyis ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa mnyes mdzad pa/ /phyi yi lha mo bzhi la bstod/ /bde gshegs sgo srung ༄ snarab tu grags/ /sgo srung bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzhi gsum bcu gnyis chos rtogs pa/ /tshogs lam gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dbang po stobs kyi 3rab phye ba/ /nges 'byed rtogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sa rab dga' ba rtogs 'gyur ba 6/ /mthong lam gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sa brgyad rim gyis rtogs gyur pa/ /bsgom lam rtogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje lta bu la gnas nas/ /chos kyi sku yang rab tu gsal/ /sa bcu gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems bskyed la sogs rab ldan pa/ /rgyu dang 'bras bus rab phye ba/ /thams cad mkhyen gzhung de la bstod/ /gang zag gsum gyi lam yang bshad/ /lam shes gzhung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shes rab snying rje ldan pa 7sogs/ /spang dang blang ba'i gzhi rnam 8shes/ /thams cad mkhyen gzhung de la bstod/ /rnam pa thams cad yongs basbus pa/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs gzhung la bstod/ /'phel ba la sogs rab ldan pa/ /rtse mo'i gzhung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'og ma kun gyi mthar phyin pa/ /mthar gyi 9gzhung la phyag 'tshal bstodas/ /skad 34—1467

byug bzhi dang rab ldan pa3/ /sangs rgyas sa yang rab tu gsal/ /byang chub gzhung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde gshegs sku rnams kun dang ldan/ /sems can don phyir phrin las gzhung / /chos sku'i gzhung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'ga' zhig don du rgyas pa dang / /'ga' zhig don du 'bring dang ni/ /rgyas 'bring gzhung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de 2rnams don bsdus la yang bstod/ /gzhung rnams rgyas par ma gyur kyang / /don ni mi zhan ston gyur pa/ /don mi zhan 'a/ phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de rnams gsal bar rab 'byed pa/ /mkhas pa yis ni mdzad pa gang / /bstan bcos gzhung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad la— / /yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan ci 4snyed yod pa la/ /thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal bstod/ /smon lam bya ba 'di skad do/ /dus gsum rgyal la kun gyi yum/ /bklags 3pa dang ni kha ton bgyis/ /bgyid du sprul dang rjes yi rang / /dge ba 'di yi stobs kyis ni/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /zhing mchog gtsang mar skye bar shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum dag la/ /mchod bstod bkur 6sti bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du pal 7dang rjes yi rang / / dge ba (sgode yi stobs kyis ni/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing du ni/ /bdag dang yon bdag skye bar shog /zhing de nyid du skyes nas/ kyang / /bde gshegs bcu la mchod par shog /pha rol phyin drug spyod par shog /lam lnga rim gyis 9bgrod par shog /lam lnga rim gyis bgrod nas kyang / /mngon par rdogs par sangs rgyas shog /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /rtog pa dag ni mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i 34—/468

don phyir sprul pa'i sku/ /rgyun mi 'chad 1par ston par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum kun la/ /bdag gis dge ba ci bsags dang / /dge ba de yi stobs kyis ni/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kun/ /thar pa'i lam la 'dzeg par shog /bdag gi 2dge ba 'di dag la/ /bdud kyis bar du mi gcod 4par/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu smin gyur cig /ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa rtag tu ngus/ /lus kyi tsha grangs 5snyug bsngal mi lta bar/ /shes rab pha rol phyin don du/ /sbug bsngal sna tshogs tshol ba ltar/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can kyang / /'phags pa rtag tu ngu bzhin du/ /shes rab pha rol phyin don du/ /snyug bsngal ci spyod der spyod shog /ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa rtag tu ngus/ /shes rab pha rol phyin don du/ /sha khrag rus rnams thogs med du/ /sdug bsngal mi lta gtong ba ltar/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can kyang / /'phags pa rtag tu ngu bzhin du/ /shes rab pha rol phyin don du/ /sha khrag rus rnams gtong bar shog /sngon gyi 'phags pa chos 'phags kyis/ /grong khyer chen po spos ldan du/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /phyin ci ma log spyod pa ltar/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams / /spos ldan lta bu'i grong khyer du/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /phyin ci ma log spyod par shog /sngon kyi tshe yi tshong dus 6ni/ /mar me can gyi dbus su ni/ /sngon 'das bde gshegs mar me mdzad/ /sprul sku shākya seng ge la / /mngon par 'tshang rgya lung bstan dang / /sring mo gadhā'i 7lha mo dang / /sems bskyed lung bstan thob pa ltar/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can la//dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi8/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed cing / /34—1469

mngon par 'tshang rgya lung bstan snashog /mngon dga' phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su/ /mgon po bde gshegs bcu rnams kyis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin nga/ la/ /phyin ci ma log spyod pa ltar/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams / /mngon dga' phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ /phyin ci ma log spyod par shog /sngon tshe shākya seng ge yis27/ /kun dga' bo ni thos ldan la/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /nan gyis yang nas yang du ni/ /sgro skur bral ba gtad pa bzhin/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi4/ /kun dga' bo la gtad bzhin du/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /nan gyis yang dang 3yang du ni/ /sgo skur bral bar gtod par shog /gal te bdag dang sems can rnams / /tshe yi 'du byed byed pa na3/ /yum chen pha rol phyin pa la/ /bklags dang kha ton byas pa dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bkyis hūṃpa dang / /mchod dang bsnyen bkur ci bgyis pa/ /dge ba 'di —yi stobs kyis ni/ /gnad gcod snyug bsngal med par ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs / /sngun 9nas bsu zhing 'dren par shog /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /tshe rabs dag ni gar skyes kyang / /thos pa'i shes rab ldan gyur nas/ /the tshom yul de chod par shog /bsam pa'i shes rab ldan gyur nas/ /ma rtogs pa rnams rtogs par shog / bsgom pa'i shes rab ldan gyur nas/ /rkachos nyid don rnams rtogs gyur shog /de ltar shes rab rnam gsum kyis/ /spros 11pa rnam gsum chod par shog /yul ni mkhyen pa rnam gsu/ma la/ /dge ba'i las ni ci bsags pa/ /dge ba de yi stobs kyis ni/ /24—/(/70

bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /mkhyen pa gsum la spyod par shog /spang bya'i gzhi de spangs nas ni/ /blang bya'i gzhi la spyod par shog /lam gnyis tshul bzhin shes nas kyang / /nges 'byung lam la spyod par shog /rgyu yi mkhyen nyid rgyud la sbyar nas ni/ /'bras bu'i mkhyen nyid thob par shog /yul ni mkhyen pa rnam gsum gyis/ /mjug tu bya ba'i cho ga'o// //da ni bar gyi skabs bzhi yis—1/ /mjug tu bya ba'i cho ga bstan/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ /dbus su le tshe dgu ldan bri/ /de phyir pad+ma 'dab ldan bri/ /pad+ma de yi phyi nyid du/ /le tshe khra bos bskor ba 2bri/ /de yi phyi yi 'khyams su'o/ /sgo sogs legs par bri bar bya/ /de nas lha ni dgod bya ba/ /dbus su yum ldan shākya seng ge bri/ /phyi yi le tshe brgyad la ni/ /bzang skyong dang ni rin 'byung gnas/ /dkon mchog 'byung gnas de dang ni/ /rin chen snying po rin chen byin/ /ded dpon dam dang skyes bu byin/ /skyob chopa sbed pa de dang ni/ /chu bdag lha dang dbang po byin/ /bzang po stobs dang blo gros dam/ /tha ma bzhi ni go rims bzhin/ /shar nas bzung nas zla gam la'o/ /de phyir phyopad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /'phags pa blo gros 'phel ba dang //blo gros mtha' yas don yod mthong / /sgrib pa med pa blo gros dang / /rab tu zhugs pa de dang ni/ /rnam gzhan brtson 'grus mtha' yas dang / /rtag tu brtson dang rtag tu sbyor/ /mi gtong brtson dang nyi ma'i snying / /zla snying blo gros dpe med dang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / /bdud kyi stobs ni rab tu 'joms7/ /rdo 34byed/7 71

rje de ni blo gros dang / /lag na rin chen phyag rgya dang / /rtag tu lag brkyang de dang ni/ /snying rje cher sems rgyan chen po/ /rnam par bkod pa'i rgyal po dang / /ri bo'i zom dang byams pa ste/ /pad+ma rnams kyi 'dab ma la'o le tshe khra bo'i steng du ni/ /skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo sogs/ /lnga brgya tsam yang rang bzhin dmigs/ /khyams su mchod ldan nyan thos dang / /de sogs lnga stong tsam yang dmigs/ /dge bsnyen pha dang dge bsnyen ma/ /shin tu mang bar dmigs par bya/ /kun kyang yon tan ldan par ro/ /de nas sngon gyi ting 'dzin ni/ /sa bcu pa yi bar du bsgom/ /de nas spyan drang 'di skad do//yang dag don ldan mgon po yum/ /mdzes pa'i le che'i dbus su ni/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yi/ /dge ba bsdu phyir spyan 'dren na/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /gdan dang 'tsham 1par bzhugs su gsol/ /jeg chen chos la longs spyod pas/ /bden pa mthong zhing sa thob pa'i/ /'phags pa'i tshogs bcas de dag kyang / /rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /bya ba la sogs sngar bzhin no/ /de nas phyag bya mchod pa 'bul/ /de nas bstod pa 'di lta ste/ /yon tan 'dus pa sku gsung thugs/ /ro gcig gyur pa gtso chen mchog /gtso chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dang po byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /mos pa gnas shing lam gnyis/ 'dzin/ /bden pa mthong zhing 'phags pa ste/ /sems dpa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas byin gyis jeg chen spyod/ /nyan thos tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzhan rnams sngon dang mthun —pa ste/ /lhag par bya ba 'di skad do/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /37—/ /72

sbyor ba rnam pa bzhi po dag /rgyud la tshul bzhin sbyar nas ni/ /sku de thogs rnged thob par shog /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /rnam pa brgyad dang bdun cu gsum/ /sbyor ba dag ni bco brgyad dang / /thar dang nges 'byin cha mthun ༄1dang / /srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa dang / /slob dpon rdo rje lta bu yi/ /de yi ting nge 'dzin dang ni/ /kun kyang tshul bzhin spyod par shog /mtshan nyid dgu bcu rtsa gcig kyang / /ma nor tshul bzhin spyor bar shog /bdud las bzhi bcu rtsa drug gis/ /bar du mi chod thar bar shog /yon tan bcu bzhi thob par shog /phyir mi ldog pa'i rtag — —dang ni/ /tshul bzhin du ni ldan par shog /snod bcud sbyong ba'i mthu dang ni/ /thabs mkhas bcu dang ldan par shog /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /spyor dang mthong dang bsgom pa dang / /bar chad med pa'i lam mchog dang / /lam bzhi'i rtse mo bgrod par shog /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams / /pha rol phyin drug rjes dran drug /ngo bo nyid ni dran pa ste/ /mthar gyis lam ni bgrod 4par shog /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams / /zag pa med dang rnam par smin/ /mtshan nyid rnged dang rnam par grol / /dga' ba bzhi dang rab ldan te/ /chos kyi sgu yang gsal bar shog /de ltar spyor ba rnam bzhi yis/ /rang bzhin don la brtson par shog /spyor ba rnam bzhi'i mjug thogs su/ /cho ga 'di ni shin tu shis/ /tha ma skabs kyi cho ga bstan/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ /mdzes pa'i dra ba 'khor lo can/ /rin chen gdung gis gru bzhir bcad5/ /dbus 34—/473

dang phyogs bzhir bri bar bya/ /zur rnams kun du rin chen 'bar/ /kun gyi phyi yang rin chen bskor/ / sgo sogs lkulegs par bri bar bya/ /de nas lha ni dgod bya ba/ /dbus su yum chen dgod par bya/ /shar du chos kyi sku yi yum//mdog dkar yum gyi mtshan nyid can/ /lho ru longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yum/ /mdog ser yum gyi mtshan nyid can/ /nub tu ngo bo nyid kyi yum/ /mdog dmar yum gyi mtshan nyid dang / /byang du sprul sku shākya seng / /kun kyang legs par dgod par bya/ /de nas spyan drang 'di skad do/ /yum chen sku bzhi 'khor bcas dang sde / /rin chen dra ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dam chos klog dang kha ton dang / /yi ge 'dri sogs bgyis pa yis / /dge ba bsdu phyir spyan 'dren na/ /sngon gyi smon lam dbang gis ni/ /gnas 'dir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /gdan dang 'tsham par bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas phyag dang mchod pa bya/ /de nas bstod chopa 'di lta ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rtogs 5pa yi ni yum gyur pa'i/ /skye med tsam las chos kyi sgur/ /'ja' tshon lta bur shar ba yi/ /yum mchog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yang dag don ldan chos kyi sku/ /longs 6sdogs sku yi yul gyur pa/ /gnas 'gyur 7ye shes ldan phyag 'tshal/ /thun mong ma yin gnas chen du/ /sems dpa'i tshogs kyis 8rab bskor ba'i/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rab ldan nga// /gnas 'gyur ye shes gnyis kyi bdag /longs spyod rdzogs su spyo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bsam brjod yul 'das nyid kyi sku/ /rang bzhin mtshan ma rnam 7bral yang / /sngon gyi smon lam dbang gis ni/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mtshan byad sku/ /kun gyi thun mong ma gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi sku yi yul gyur 31—/7 7/

pa'i—/ /brjod bral ngo bo nyid kyi sgu/ /ngo bo nyid zusgu phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng / /bdud bzhi 'joms 3pa stobs kyi bdag /dang po byang chub chen po yis/ /'gyur med byang chub sems bskyed cing / /bar du brtson 'grus drag po yis/ /mi bzad dka' ba sna tshogs spyad/ /gnas gyur /ye shes bdag nyid can/ /gdul bya kun snang shākya seng / /mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzhan rnams sngar dang mthun 4pa ste/ /lhag par bya ba 'di skad do/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /ngo bo nyid sgu thob nas kyang / /gzhan kyi don phyir sku gsum po/ /thogs pa med par 'byung bar shog /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /sku bzhi tshul bzhin thob nas kyang / /mdzad pa nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis/ /gzhan gyi don la thogs med du/ /phyin byu ma log spyod par shog /chos kyi sku yi gzhung dag la/ /bklags dang yi ge 'dri sogs dang / /mchod bstod bsnyen bkur ci bsags pa/ /dge ba de yi stobs kyis ni/ /bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /brjod bral sku de thob par shog /de nas bdag dang chos 5mkhan dang / /bsngo bar bya ba'i dge ba kun/ /thams cad mi dmigs par 6bsgoms la/ /de la cung zhig gnas par bya'o/ /de nas chos skyong dang 'byung po'i tshogs tshim par bya ba'i phyir gtor ma yang gzhan bzhin du btang ngo / /yi ge brgya pa gdon par bya/ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa bsdu'o/ /'di don rin chen grags pa yis//yum chen dge rtsa bsdu ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi/ /cho ga 'di ni bstan pa yin/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 7yum kun la/ /don bsdus 3tsho1—1475

—bsdus pa zhas bya ba/kye ༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tiṣ+ṭha bi bye saṃ k+ṣip+tatsa/ bod skad du/rab gnas kyi cho ga mdor bsnyus pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs chen po'i —yon tan ni/ /rin chen 'od kyis brgyan pa la/ /btud nas rab gnas cho ga ni/ /lhag par 'dir bsdus brjod par bya/ / bde gshegs rtogs 4 med go 'phang brnyes/ /dri med mkha' 'dra'i sku mnga' zhing / /brjod du me+ed pa de dag la/ /rab gnas 'thad pa ma yin te/ /de dag sku ni kun rdzogs pa/ /brtse bzang ro las byung ba ltar5/ /de la brten nas dge ba ni/ /mtha' yas ster te 'thad pa'ang yin / /rnal 'byor de nyid shes skyon bcom/ /brtse ba'i rang bzhin rigs su skyes6/ /mdangs ldan bsgom dzapa shes rab can/ /kun la mkhas shing dad pa yis/ /chu klung chu dag btab pa yis/ /sems sbyangs mchog ni slob dpon 34—1479

yin / /bdag kun slob dpon la phul ba/ /slob ma de ni legs rnams bzhi//sgu gzugs dang ni mchod rten dang / /dam chos gtsug lag khang legs bzhengs/ /nye bar 'tshe kun sel ba rnams/ /'dir ni bla mas rab gnas bya/ /gang zhig 'jim pa rdo dngul dang 1/ /ra gan gser dang shing bzangs 2las/ /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i ngang tshul mnga' ba'i sku gzugs byed pa de/ /yun ring dus su sa bdag bde longs spyad nas tha mar ni/ /skyob pa'i go 'phang mchog la rab tu 'jug par 'gyur/ /gang na sgu gzugs bzhengs zin cing / /yun rings ma mchod bzhugs pa der/ /mi shis pa ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bla mas thog mar cha rkyen kun/ /ji ltar rnyed bzhin rab bzung nas/ /gos rgyan bdug pa la sogs pas/ /rnam bkra mchod pa'i khang par ni/ /zhag bzang po la cho ga bzhin / /dkyil 'khor dag la bri bar bya/ /bgegs bsal nas ni der sngags kyis / /mgul rgyan rin chen shing tog la/ /sogs dang kha brgyan me tog gis/ /mtshan pa'i bum pa lhag gnas bya/ /sku gzugs la sogs pa dag la/ /bsang gtor dang me tog la sogs pa mchod pa lnga la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /phyi nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i slob dpon gyis/de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' la bzhugs pa rnams la mchod pa rnam pa lngas yang dag par mchod la/ spos snod thogs te tshigs su bcad pa 'di —dag gis gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /sku gzugs sngon snyedu phyogs byas te/ /rdo rje dril bzang legs bzung zhing / /lus bsgoms gyur pas gus par ni/ /snyan gsan dbab pa'i tshigs bcad 6gdon/ /bcom ldan che ge rdo rje bzang / /rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud7/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /31—/480

slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyod 1la mchod pa bkyid slad du/ /bdag rgo rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /de phyir gus pas bdag la ni/ /bcom ldan bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /'jig rten mgon po thugs rje can/ /sangs rgyas dgra bcom byang chub sems/ /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang dag dang / /lha dang 'jig rten skyong rnams dang / /'byung po gang dag rdzu 'phrul che/ /bstan la mngon par dga' ba rnams/ /gang dag la la lha mig dang / /ldan pa thams cad bdag la dgongs/ /rdo rje can dag rte che ge mo/ /ci nus par ni mchod pa yis/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rab tu gnas pa bgyid pa lags/ /de phyir thams cad slob ma dang / /bcas pa bdag la brtser dgongs te/ /rab tu gnas pa 'di la ni/ /nye ba nyid du mdzad pa'i rigs—/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sdogs sangs rgyas kun dga' ldan dang / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums na ni/ /ji ltar rab tu zhugs de bzhin/ /sku gzugs 'di la bzhugs su gsol/ /che ge mo yi don dang ni/ /byang chub sems rab bskyed slad du/ /mgon po rtag tu 'dir bzhugs nas/ /me tog la sogs 'di rnams bzhes/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ gus pas jesnyan gsan gdab 5par bya'o// //slob dpon gnyis su med pa yi6/ /spyor ba dang ldan mkhas pa yis/ /slob ma gso sbyong bcas pa la/ /sku khrus gsol bya bgegs gzhil dang / /sa bon zla ba mtshan la 7sogs/ /bsgom dang ye shes sems sgu gzugs/ /dgod dang na bza' ser po yis/ /g.yogs dang gtor ma'i las rgyas pa/ /byas te de nas brjod par bya/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gdon/ /oṃ hūṃ dī 34—1481

zhes bya sngags kyis/ /gtsug lag khang ni lhag gnas bya/ /yi ge zlo gyis ① rnam snang las byung ba'i/ /mchod rten dam chos glegs bam rgyal yum mam/ /de bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' rnams bsams nas/ /legs 3 par gnas pa bdag ni 'dra bar bya/ /rmi lam dag dang mchod pa yang / /gus pas slob ma byed du gzhug /ji skad bshad pa'i so shing ni/ /lan bdun sngags tshu pa sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya a su sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/zhes bya bas so/ /oṃ badz+ra hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis de la chu khyor ba gsum yang sbyin no/ /lag g.yon srad bu dang bcas shing / /dag pa'i mal la gnas byas 5te/ /de la bla mas rmi lam kyi/ /mtshan ma rnams ni bstan par bya/ /lhag par gnas pa'o// //de nas rab gnas nyin par rnal 'byor can/ /rgyun du byas pa'i las ni yang dag bsgrub6/ /mchod phyir thogs dang ldan zhing dar dpyangs bcings/ /lag pa g.yas pa gser gyi sor gdub mtshan/ /legs par khrus byas lus dri zhim / /gtsang mar gyur pa'i bgo ba bgos/ /byams dang snying rje rjes su 'byel / /rtag sngags bsam gtan lhur len des/ /mchod khang phyogs 3 ni rgyas pa yis/ /mdzes par yid du 'ong ba yi/ /stan la 'dug ste bsrung ba yi//'khor los phyogs sogs bgegs med bya/ /bum pa rnams ni byin brlabs dang / /dkyi'/ 'khor man ngag bsgoms pa dang / /mchod pa byas nas sngags rnams kyi// / /mda' sogs mdzes par dgod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ tshon sna lnga pa'i sgud pa yis/ /yongs su dkri bar yang bya'o/ /de la sngags be+e 'di yin te/oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ru ṭa ma ṭa di shaṃ ༄ ban+dha hūṃ/ zhes bya'o 1 / /bse/gas zhi byas 34—/482

nas na bza' ser/ /gsal /rmyebyed de nas mkhas pa yis/ /cho ga bzhin du sku khrus gsol/ /gang 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha los 2—sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i sku khrus 'di dbul bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du gang bcom ldan 'das — zhes bya bas kyang ngo / /yon tan dam pa sgu mnga' zhing / /lha dang mi yis zhemachod 'os pa/ /sku byad lta byubs mi chog la/ /bdag gis sku khrus gsol bar bgyi/ /mchod rten rin chen chos sku'i bdag /yon tan dam pa'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /bdag gis dad pas sku khrus gsol/ /bud med gzugs kyis 'dul rnams la/ /thugs rjes rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 3pa/ /lha yi rnam pa de la ni/ /bdag gis sku khrus gsol bar bgyi/ /slob pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi gnas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gzugs bzhi/ /gtsug lag khang 'di bdag gis ni/ /dad pas khrus 'di dbul bar bkyi/ /bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi/ /zhes thams cad la yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o—/ /gang bcom ldan 'das pha rol tu phyin pa drug po bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus sku mdzes pa/ lta 8bas chog mi shes pa/9 mi mthun pa med pa/ sku'i gzugs mthar phyin pa/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi gnyen shā —sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis rab tu gnas par /1bkyi'o/ /thugs rje che zhing zhi ba ste/ /dul zhing bsam gtan go 3tsho4—1483

'phang gnas/ /thugs kar gnas pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /thugs su chud phyir sangs rgyas zhes/ /de yi mtshan can de ltar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas ni/ /sgu gzugs 'di la spyan drang bgyi/ /zhes bya 'di yis rgyal ba'i sgu/ /shin tu 'od gsal bkug byas te/ /sku gzugs la ni bzhugs par bya/ /de bzhin du/ na mo bha ga ba te ta thā ga tā ya arta te saṃ myag saṃ busgye byu1ya / tar+ya thā/ oṃ mu ne+e mu ne+e ma hā mu na nyaye swā hā/ zhes bya ba dang /tshigs su bcad pa gi wang — gis bris te/ de bzhin bsod nams mtha' yas gdung bkrus nas/ /gdan khri la sogs nang du gzhug byas la/ sngags kyi thu rdo rje'i zhal mang bya'o/ /de la tshigs su bcad pa ni 'di yin te/ ye dharmā te tu pra bha bā te tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha/ e baṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ/ zhes bya'o/ /gzhan la rang rang snying po ni/ /yang dag bris te gzhug par bya/ /sngags gzhug pa dang rdo rje zhal gyi sngags ni/ oṃ dharma dhā metu gar+bhe swā hā/ zhes bya ba dang / oṃ badz+ra dhā 8tu gar+bha 9 ya swā hā/zhes bya'o / /rol cha rnam pa sna tshogs dkrol bas rgyas pa'i glu rgyun kyis/ /gsal bar snying rgyas sem pas bud med rnams kyi gar dang ni/ /bkra shis sgra ni rnam par bde ba ster ba byung ba'i tshe/ /sngags pas rnam par rgyal ba'i 1bum pas dbang ni bsgur bar bya/ /sngags pas sku khrus tshul bzhin du/ /byas nas gser gyi thur mang gis/ /lha bshos bzang po sngon btang ste/ /spyan dag bal — gyis dbye bar bya/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu ra bi sho dha swā hā/ oṃ dī bya an na sa mā bye dh+yā na spru na ṇi swā hā/ gos mchog dri zhim bkra dang nor bu ni/ /sngags kyis dag par byas sarnams rab mchod nas/ /mchod pa'i sprin tshogs 31—1484

mang por snang spros pas/ /snying ga'i sa bon gnas te gsang sngags brjod/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ dī aḥ/ rgyal ba'i tshogs ni g.yo ba rnams / /sgu gzugs dag la bzhugs par bya/ /badz+ra gi tshota bā tre+eḥbi sa bi sa zhes bya bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par byas te/ hūṃ gis yang dag par mchod la/ phyi'i mchod pa dang / de bzhin du gtor ma dag gis tshim par byas te/ mkhas pas bstod pa dang / smon lam gdon par bya'o / /mchod rten byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ 'di ltar yin te/ oṃ hūṃ hrīḥrgyu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ de bzhin du yig 4'bru a las grub pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ oṃ prazlo prasgo shu nyi smṛ ti bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes bya'o5/ /dam chos glegs bam la sogs gzhan/ /gang gis rab tu gnas byas 6na/ /bdag po de dang de'am ni/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang dgod bya/ /de bzhin mchod rten gtsug lag khang / /sa bon la sogs legs bsgom pa/ /sngags pas 'bad de bum pa yis/ /de bzhin rgya cher bsang 7bar bya/ /oṃ 8u da ka a bye ṣiñca oṃ hūṃ tweḥ/ de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gye/ /rnam pas nag po chen po dgug /de la rgyal ba'i bka' dran bya/ /de la yun ring skyob byed 'gyur / /kha cig las ni lus ngan la/ /gtor ma rgya chen sbyin zhes 'byung / / rgyu khaṃ badz+ra 9bha ba dṛ ⑩bhā tiṣ+ṭha rgyu khaṃ/ ma tshang lhag pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /yi ge brgya pa gus par gdon/ /cho ga bzhin du ci nus par/ /sbyin sreg gis ni las kyang bya/ /'bras bu mtha' yas dge 'dun mchod bya zhing / /skye bo 'phongs dang gzugs kyang 5ma tshang dang / /sems can chu rgyu sa rgyu mkha' rgyu dang / /'gro ba dag ni yongs su tshim par bya/ /sdig med gnyen bshes dang sa31—/ /85

bcas mtshan mo sa dga' dang 1/ /glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgra snyan gyis sad dga' ba yi/ /bdud rtsis sems pa'i phyadangos po shas che'i gar ldan zhing / /'khor ba'i mtshan mo zhi bar byed la gus par 'bad/ /nyi ma bdun gyi mtshan tsam gyis/ /dga' ston cher sgrub kyirnal 'byor pa/ /mchod pas yang dag g.yeng 4ba yis/ /de nas gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang / /gang de'i sras dang tshangs la sogs/ /lha tshogs rnams dang 'byung po gang / /mthu bo che dang ltabazod pa mdzod/ /sbyin bdag la ni thams cad du/ /zhi dang bde legs cher mdzad de/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni/ /slar yang 'byon 6par mdzad du gsol/ /gang na bskal pa'am bskal pa las/ /lhag par sku gzugs 'di bzhugs par/ /sa dang chu dang me rlung gi7/ /lha rnams kun kyis srung (du gsol/ /shin tu dga' dang yid bde bar/ /gyur nas rab gnas bzang por shesatsu/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa dang / /bu dang tsha bo'ang srung du gsol/ /bla mas tshul bzhin rab 1sna gnas byas pa yin12/ /mchod pa byas la lung bstan sbyin par bya/ /de tshe slob mas bka' 'di 'dod 'jo yi/ /ba ltar rtag tu bsams te mchod las bya / /de nas 'jigs pa dag ni myur du ldog /de nas ngan 'gro ma lus chad par 'gyur/ /de nas sngon 1 'dod 'bras bu rtag tu 'byin/ /de nas nam yang mngon mtho 'jigs ngapa med/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa slob dpon dad pa'i 'byung gnas go chas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang / bod kyi lo tsā d+kub pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //34byed1486

༄ / /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul brgya lnga babyu pa'i 'grel pa/rte༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta 2na ya da sha ṭī kā/bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa/ gsung rab 'di'i lo rgyus bshad na/ sngon sangs rgyas mi yul na lo brgyad cu bzhugs pa'i tshe na/ sarba budha sa ma yo ga dang / guh+ya sa mañca la sogs pas 'dul zhing theg pa de dag gi snod du gyur pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi yul na med pas rgyal chen ris bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum dang / dga' ldan la sogs pa'i gnas na lha rnams dang bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa snod du gyur nas de'i tshe mdo sde de ni bzhugs so/ /slad kyis sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu za hor kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa ngo mtshar du chos la dad pa dag cig 'dug pa theg pa de'i 'dul skal du gyur cing snod du gyur nas/ sarba budhe sa ma yo ga la sogs pa sde chen po bco brgyad 34byed/489

phyag na rdo rje'i byin gyi rlabs rtekyis za hor kyi yul du gshegs pa dang / za hor gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis mdo sde dag bltas na brda ma phrad nas sngon gyi las kyi dbang gis na mngon par shes pa thob pas bltas na yul gyi dbus yul ma la pa na ā tsār+ya ku ku ra nyin zhing khye stong tsam la chos 'chad/ mtshan zhing ni khye de dag la dam tshig longs spyod mdzad pa khyi'i slob dpon mdzad pa zhig bzhugs pa de jeg pa'i snod du gyur la/ bdag gi 'dul skal du gyur pa yang 'dra nas rgyal pos pho nya btang ste slob dpon gshegs su gsol ba dang / slob dpon de yang sngon gyi las kyi dbang gis na mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan nas/ rgyal po de bdag gi 'dul skal du 'bab bam mi 'bab mdo sde de dag gi snod du bdag gyur ram ma gyur brtags na/ bdag gi 'dul skal du yang 'bab/ bdag kyang mdo sde'i 5snod du yang gyur/khu/ rgyal po'i the tshom yang sel bar 'gyur mod kyi / 'on kyang mdo sde dag sngar ma bltas na brgya la rgyal po'i ze tshom dag ma sel bar gyur na shin tu ma legs pas pho nya la slar spring ba/ mdo sde dag kho bos sngar blta 'tshal gyis tshur bskur cig ces spring ba dang / de nas mdo sde dag pas gshegs te bltas na mgo mjug gar lta ba'i cha ma mchis na dz+wade nyid du lus brdabs te mgon med do/ /skyabs med do zhes bos pa dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mngon par gshegs te khyod ci 'dod ces dris pa dang / bdag mdo sde zab mo 8 'di bltas pa tsam gyis shes par 'dod ces gsol ba dang /de bzhin gnang ngo zhes gsungs /nas de nas sarba budha sa ma yo ga la sogs pa'i glegs bam rnams ma phye 1 snabar de dag gi 11don yid la mngon sum du gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas slob dpon hūṃ de za hor gyi yul du gshegs nas rgyal po 'khor 34byed1490

dang bcas pa rnams la dharmā nyude dag bshad de/ 5 rdo rje sems dpas lung bstan nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ltar sgom dudu stsal te dbus su rgyal po nyid/ btsun mo dam pa bzhi yum gyi sar bkod—/ blon po bzhi rigs bzhi'i sar bkod/ sras mo rnams nang gi lha mo'i sar bkod/ btsun mo phal pa rnams phyi'i lha mo'i sar bkod/ blon po phal pa rnams sgo srung ④bzhi dang / bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' ltar bkod pa dnge / rgyal pos bsams pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rig 'dzin gyi gnas su grub pa'i phyir dang ༄5 dam pa'i chos 'di mi nub par bya ba'i phyir sras sha kra pu ti rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas/ ā tsār+ya ku ku pas khulung dang man ngag bstan pa rgyal bu de la bstan te bzhag nas bsgoms pa dang /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa stong 3la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 3rig 'dzin du grub po/ /de'i sras sha kra pu tis kyang de bzhin du bsgoms pa dang /'khor sgom pe pa bdun brgya dang yang rig 'dzin gyi gnas grub bo/ /yang rgyal bu sha kra pu tis sras ni chung ste sras mo go ba de byi la dpal dam nga/'i nang nas tshul brgya lnga bcu pa bkod de bshams nas in+d+ra byu nyu ti'i lung de sras mo yul dang sa 'dzin du stsal tshe de la bstan pa las sras mo de yang 'khor dang bcas pa brgya dang yang rig 'dzin du grub bo/ /de nas sras mo des/ rgyal bu la lung dang man ngag bzhag pa las 'phel ba ni deng 7 du 'di dag lags te/ mdo la 'di nyu2de rnams bsgrub ste rtetshun chad ni gsung rab 'di kyidon khong du chud par byas te/bsgrub 7pas sngon chad grub pa yang grangs med phyin chad kyang nan tan cher byas na gdon mi za bar grub 7par gzhung 'di nyid kyi nang nas shes nyu3pa yin no/ /34byed1491

gzhung las bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes byung 1ba ni/ bdud bzhi bcom ste yon tan drug dang ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ༄9dpal dam pa phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /yum smos pa las na de bzhin gshegs pa'i yab kyang smos dgos te gang zhe na/ yab ni tan+t+ra ta ta tā saṃ gra ha/zhes bya ba sngags kyi mdo sde zab mo yin par ston /4to/ /de bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal zhes te༄ye/ de yang mdo 4zab mo 'di la dad cing mos nas gsung rab la 'jug pa'i phyir bsnyen bkur byas te phyag 'tshal na bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur zhing 'phags pa kun gyi 3byin gyis rlob pas nyan cing sgrub pa nan tan du byed pa la bgegs dang bar chad du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes 'byung shemado sde'i tan+t+ra mgo mjug tshang ba ni ma yin na ci'i phyir 'di skad smos she na/ gsung rab 'di yang mnyan cing gzung 9snasla bar bya ba'i phyir tan+t+ra chen po'i nang nas gud du phyung mod kyi/ tan+t+ra 'di'i mgo la smos pas 7'dir brjod pa 'gal ba med do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pas gsungs pa'i don 'di skad du 11dpal rdo rje sems dpas mngon sum du thos kyis gzhan las brgyud pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa drang med mod kyi/ gzhung 'di gsungs pa thos pa de la dus gcig ces bya'o/ /gzhung las/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i byin gyi rlabs thudam tshig gi ye shes rnam pa tha dad pa'i bye brag gis 7ye shes dang ldan pa zhes 'byung ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par 34—1492

snang mdzad la sogs te phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tshogs 'dus pa yang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su med pa'i tshul mnyam pa nyid du sbyor zhing / lus dang ngag dang yid gsum rdo rje lta bu'i phyir nyurdo rje'i byin gyi rlabs tsokyis bdud dang bgegs la sogs pa bar chad du byed pa rnam pa thams cad du zil gyis mnan te rgol /thuba'i glags med pa'i phyir ro/ /spyi'i dam tshig ni byang chub kyi sems mi gtong sge ba dang / jeg pa chen po'i chos mi gtong ༄ ba dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po mi gtong 7ba dang / sngags dang phyag rgya dang rdo rje mi gtong byeb dang / rdo rje'i slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dra bar bsam pa dang / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la ngan sems mi byed pa dang /dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa dang / bzhugs hu kyang dam tshig mi srung nyu1ba la sngags kyi gtam mi bya ba dang / don med pa'i phyogs su lus chus mi gnon cing nyon mi mongs pa la sogs pa'i rnam grangs kyang mang mod kyi skabs 'dir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du spyor zhing tshul 'di ni mi gtong nyu2ba dam tshig lta bu yin te/ dam tshig gi khyad par thams cad mkhyen pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos kyi dbyings rnam par mi rtog pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / chos so sor rtog /4pa'i ye shes dang / bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes lta bu rnam pa tha dad pa'i bye brag gi ye shes thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rin po che'i nyu5 cod pan gyis khams gsum du chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba thob ces mu'abyung ba dbang bskur ba'i dam tshig ni rin po che'i 34—1493

phreng bas dbang skur 3bar byed de/ dper na 'khor los sgyur 2ba'i rgyal po yang rin po che sna bdun gyis kyergyal thabs chen por ④tshodabang bskur na gling bzhi khye la—/ dbang byed par 'gyur te/ de dang 'dra bar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i cod pan gyis khams gsum pya chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur te/ khams gsum thams cad la mnga' ba/chos thams cad la longs spyod pa phyogs bcu thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tsob/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par mdzod cig ces dbang chen 8bskur ba thob pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 9 thams cad mkhyen pa'i rdo rje ye shes rnal 'byor gyi ⑩dbang phyug chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya chen po thob pa zhes 'byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nyu4thams cad mkhyen pa chos thams cad kyi dbyings stong pa nyid du mkhyen pas ma nor ma 'khrul pa'i chos nyid ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa'i phyir rdo rje'i ye shes zhes bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba la rgyun du 'jug pas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po zhes kyang bya ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po man chad kyi longs spyod dang yang ldan la/ chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid las kyang mi 'gyur ba'i ⑫phyir chos so cog thams cad la dbang mdzad cing 'byor ba'i longs spyod chen po dang yang ldan pas na dbang phyug chen bo zhes bya'o/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na sku'i phyag rgya chen po dang rin po che'i cod pan la sogs pa'i dbang bskur ba'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / gsung thams cad du yongs su dag pas chos kyi phyag 3 1byed1 94

rgya dang / lus dang ngag dang yid thams cad rdo rje nyid kyi las mnyam pa nyid du spyod pas las kyi phyag rgya ste 'di rnams kyi tshul du gnas pas rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug ces bya'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang ldan pa longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i phyag rgya dang / lus kyi phyag rgya ni g.yon pa'i mdzub mo g.yas pa'i khu tshur nang du bcug ste rdo rje dang pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor sbyor ba bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su med pa'i tshul du spyod pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / lus las 'od zer mang po 'phros te sangs rgyas kyi sku grangs med par sprul te las kyi phyag rgya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya chen bo thob pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud cing bya ba kye sna tshogs mdzad pa na 3 ma lus thulus pa med pa'i sems dpa' lgodang / ngag sems thams cad rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pa zhes 'byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya stong pa nyid kyi ye shes snyeshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du thugs su chud cing rdo rje dang pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du sbyor ba'i don spyod pa sna tshogs ni sems can thams cad yongs su smin par mdzad pa yang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsgral ba'i thabs sna tshogs grangs med de bsam gyis mi khyab mod kyi/ skabs 'dir ni chos mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa dul ñca ba'i sems can ma lus pa gdan gelus pa med pa'i re ba thams cad yongs su bskang ba'i las mdzad pas thabs de lta bus 'dul ba'i thabs la bab pa'i sems can rnams smin par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa 34—1495

—nyid du spyor ba stong pa rnam par snang mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku chen po ni chos kyi sku la bya'o/ /rnam pa gcig tu na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su med pa'i tshul du sbyor ba yang rtag par dus gsum du mnyam pa 'di la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang sems can thams cad la 'khrul pa med pa'i yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin gyi phyir na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhung las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rab tu bsngags shing bstod de zhes 'byung ba ni rnam par snang mdzad gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / rdo rje'i rigs dang / rin po che'i rigs dang / chos kyi rigs dang /las kyi rigs kyi gtso bo sangs rgyas dang / 'khor byang chub sems dpa' phyogs phyogs na bkod pa'i tshe dam tshig la ma zhugs pa rnams la gsang ba'i tshad ni byams pa byang chub sems dpa' yang nang ky-in 'ong du mi gnang ngo zhes bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis bka' byed pa dang / byams pas gsol pa bdag ni tshe gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ dus phyi ma la mngon par 'tshang rgya bar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lung bstan na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa bdag gis mthong ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la dar las bsgribs pa tsam du bas te ci la yang gsang ba ma mchis na/ dkyil 'khor 'di mdzad pa la bdag la gsang du ci mchis zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' pa pa/ byams pa byed kyis thams cad mthong gis kyang byed kyis dkyil 'khor 'di'i dam tshig 24byed/ /96

tu sngar ma zhugs pas bstan du mi rung ngo zhes bka' sprul nas/ phyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa yang dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du zhugs pa'i tshe phyogs bzhi dang / dbus kyi gtso bo dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la gnas/ 'dod pa rnam pa lnga sems kyis gtsang mar 'du shes te yon tan du blta ba dang / pañca a mṛ tar yang khyad par med pa mnyam par spyod pa thob 3nas shin tu ngo mtshar du bzung ste/ sdangs nas ye shes kyis brtags na ⑤ chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid kyis khyab pas rnam pa sna tshogs su spyod kyang nyon mongs pa'i bcing ba yang med de/ rnam par dag pa'i spyod yul la rdul tsam yang 'gyur ba ③ med la/ sems can gyi longs spyod chen po dang yang ldan zhing shin tu rgya che zhing yangs pa'i chos shes rab dang thabs kyi spyod yul gyi sgo khyad par du ⑤'phags pa bzang bar mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa mgu rangs te mod la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ byang chub sems ni bsam mi khyab/ chos mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste shin tu ngo mtshar che zhing dge'o zhes bya ba la sogs pas skyergyas par bstod de/ byams pa gcig pus bstod par yang ma zad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang shin tu rgya che zhing yangs pa'i chos don chud mi za ba ma nor pa'i chos ④yin par rab tu bsngags shing bstod pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshesku'i tshul dang spyod lam chen po 'di lta bu yin⑫/ dkyil 'khor du bzhugs bhepa'i gnas khang ci 'dra zhe na/ gzhung las/ bzhugs pa na nor bu rin po che chen pos rab tu spras pa/ dril bu sna tshogs brgyus shing dkrol ba/34—1497

kha dog sna tshogs kyi lda ldi dres ṭ+wāpa/ dar gyi ba dan mang po'i dril bu rlung gis bskyod pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab dang / do shal dang / se rngu mo do dang / zla ba lta bus shin tu mdzes par byas pa zhes 'byung ba ste/dkyil 'khor gyi gnas khang gi yon tan ni 'di yin te/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so so'i kha dog sna tshogs dang mthun pa/ rgyan thams cad kyang zla ba'i 'od dang 'dra zhing mdzes pa'i phyir ro//khang pa'i yon tan de 'dra na yul gyi tshul ⑤gang zhe na/ gzhung las/ 'dod pa'i khams thams cad la gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha'i rgyal po'i gnas na zhes 'byung ba ste/ sems can gyi khams su ⑪ma gtogs pa ma yin kyi khams nyid ni hūṃdakyil 'khor chen po mdzad pas sems can so so na dkyil 'khor 'di mthong ba'i las yod pa rnams kyang zhugs shing dam tshig ma nor bas na ⑧don grub cing thar pa yang grangs rnged pa'i phyir ro/ /dkyil 'khor 'di'i 1tshe bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad nyag gcig gam/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas she na gzhung las/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag brgya ( 3dang /thabs cig tu bzhugs pa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjeskye/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / rdo rje khu tshur dang / 'jam dpal ⑫dang / sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang / bdud kyi stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa dang / de dag la sogs pa bye ba phrag brgya 1 /stong rnams kyis bskor zhing mdun gyis bdar te zhes 'byung ba ste/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig ma yin kyi 'khor byang chub sems dpa' de snyed yod par bstan 31—1498

to / /byang chub sems dpa' de snyed kyi nang nas nyung zad kyi ming smos pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ rdo rje'i ①rigs kyi gtso bo dang / chos kyi rigs kyi gtso bo dang /rin po che'i rigs kyi gtso bo dang / las kyi rigs kyi gtso bo nyi che'i mtshan smos pa ste/ gzhan ni grangs tsam du bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyang phyogs bzhir so so'i rigs ma 'dres par snam bu snam bur bkod de/ nang dang phyi rim du bdar zhunas kun gyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi mdun du bdar te gral rim bzhin du gnas so/ /de'i tshe dkyil 'khor so so na bzhugs par ke zad dam chos kyang 'chad ce na/ gzhung las chos 'chad pa de thog mar dge/ bar du yang dge/ tha mar yang dge/don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa/ kun du rdzogs pa/yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ tshangs par spyod pa 'ba' zhig yang dag par rab tu ston cing chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa'i sgo zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bshad do zhes 'byung ba ste/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas sems can gyi don gyi phyir dar ma dor /pyasde bcu gnyis la sogs pa grangs med pa cig bshad mod kyi 'di skad du yang /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes ④shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su med pa'i don rgya cher ston pa dang / kṛ ya'i gzhung gi brtag hūṃpa dang / kha zas gtsang mar byed pa dang / snyudus gsum du 'dzin pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ gnas la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pas bdam —du med/ kha zas la mtshan shemar mi 'dzin pas gtsang sme mi 'byed/ dus la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pas dus thams cad du mnyam par 'jog pas dus gsum du dbyer med de thams cad du dge/ shes 34—1499

rab dang thabs su 'byel pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su sdogs par 'gyur bas don bzang ba mnyam pa nyid ma nor bar ston pas tshig bzang ba/ don bzang po'i chos dang kṛ shesnaya'i cho ga mang po dang / ma 'dres pas ma nyams mipar spyod pa 'di la chos gzhan gang gis kyang bsnan mi dgos pas kun du rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa'i chos nyid pas bkru bshal bya ba ma yin/'khrul pa med pas sgrib par mi 'gyur te yongs su byang ba rngu yin/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i yang sems mnyam pa dang / bsngo ba rgya che bas tshangs par spyod pa 'ba' zhig ste/ 'di ltar yang dag pa'i chos rgya chen po ston cing chos so cog thams cad ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin gyis stong ste grub pa med pas rnam par dag pa'i sgo zhes bya ba shes rab kyi phye pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i don bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ci yod ce na/gzhung las 'di lta ste/ rab tu dga' ba'i rnam par dag pa'i tshig ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ste/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsgral bar dga' ba'i phyir nyan thos la sogs pa sems rgya chung ngu'i chos las 'phags pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor bas shin tu grol zhing dag pa'i dga' ba dang / rdo rje pad+mo'i dkyil 'khor sbyor bas 'jig rten gyi dga' ba phun sum tshogs pas bdag gi lha dang phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa thams cad la yongs su bsngos na/ 'phags pa thams cad la yang bdag dang gzhan zhes dbyer med pa mnyam pa rab tu dga' ba/ yang bdag dang bdag gir bya ba med pa'i mnyam pas 'phags pa ma lus pa la yang bsngos pas bsod nams kyi tse 34—1500

tshogs su 'gyur te/ 'di lta bu'i /lkuspyod pa la gnas pa ni byang chub 7sems dpa'i spyod pa'o/ /don ji lta ba bzhin du bstan pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go/ /tshig gi rjes su 'brang zhing nan tan bsgrub pa ni byang chub tu 'gyur ro/ /gzhung las/ 'dod chags kyi mda' rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba shesems can thams cad la phan pa dang bskyab pa'i yid kyi mda' sngon du btang ste/ rjes su bsgrub pa dang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i yid kyi mda' sngon du btang ste rjes su spyod pa dang / 'dod pa lnga'i yon tan dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs te mtshungs par byed pa dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi mda' sngon du btang ste/ longs spyod du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ sdug pa bcing ba'i rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa dngos po bsnyen par bya ba'i phyir ni sdug pa'o/ /mi gtong 4ba'i phyir ni bcing ba ste/ bdag gi shes rab dang phrad nas mnyam pa nyid kyi gzugs bsngo ba dang dpyad pa ma nor bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ longs spyod thams cad kyi dbang phyug rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi longs spyod thams cad dang ldan pa ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ste/ dbang phyug che bas na stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi 3shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor zhing 'dod pa lnga la mtshungs par spyod pa ni 'jig rten gye longs spyod thams cad dang yang ldan la nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir rnam par dag pas na/ 'khor los sgyur 5ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i 'jig rten 34—/501

pa'i longs spyod thams cad kyi yang mchog phul du byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las / lta ba rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor bas yang dag pa'i lta ba yin te/ rnam pa sna tshogs la spyod kyang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching tshosnabar mi 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ dga' ba rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni rtag tu bshad pa dang mthun 4 te/ mdor na chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa'i lta ba dang bsngo ba ma nor bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ srid ༄ pa rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid ④ ye shes kyi choshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyod pa'i sgosred pa dang /bdud rtsi lnga dang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa dbyer med par mnyam par spyod pa'i sred pa dang / sems can thams cad bla na med par bsgral 37bar bya ba'i thabs la sred pas na rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las / nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang phyag rgya chen po dang ldan mod kyi/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur te/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mnyam pa nyid pas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ rgyan rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni bdag nyid phyag rgya chen po'i sku mnyam pa nyid yin pas nor bu dang gos la sogs te/ bzang po'i bya ba'i rgyan 34—1502

thams cad kyang 'phags pa bdag gi lha nyid la yon du phul ba dang / bdag gi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas su yang khyad par dbyer med de/ 'phags pa thams cad la mnyam par bsngos pas bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur gyi nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ rtag tu 'dod chags kyi mda' bshad pa dang 'dra ste/mdor na stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba'i dus na 'dod chags su snang ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs ci spyod kyang sems can gyi ma rig pa'i spyod pa dang 'dra ste/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi ri1 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor bas sngon spyod pa rtebyed pa'i tshe/ sems can ma rungs pa 'dul ba dang / sdug bsngal gyi gnas na sdod cing bskyed pa'i bsngo bas zhe sdang du snang ba'i chos spyod kyis kyang sems can ma rig pa'i spyod pa dang mi 'dra ste/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/gti mug rnam par dag pa'i tshig 5'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang mnyam pa nyid du sbyor te/bdag dang gzhan du khyad par kyi 5mtshan mar mi 'dzin pas rnam pa sna tshogs su spyod kyang phyin ci log gi gti mug ma yin gyi mi shes pa'i tshul gyis shes pas na rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ thams cad rnam par dag pa'i 34—1503

tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i dus na dbang po drug yul drug la sogs te thams cad la spyod 1 kyang / yang dag pa'i lta ba dang bsngo ba ma nor bas nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur te/ spyod do cog kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ mda' 4rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyod pas byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang mchod pa sna tshogs 'od zer las skye snyeste/ mchod pa bstod 4pa dang dga' ba phul bas nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur te rnam par dag pa'i dga' ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa gcig tu na tshul 'di ltar spyod pa'i 'bras bu yang btsun pa rig 'dzin byang chub kyi gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gzhung las/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa'i dus na chos thams cad kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid dang rang gi mtshan nyid ci la spyod kyang de nyid dbyer med par mnyam pa nyid pas mtshan mas bcings pa'i nyon mongs par mi 'gyur te rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ yid rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba la phyag rgya chen po'i sku bas yid mgu ba dang 5rangs pa kun kyang bdag gi lha nyid la mchod pa dang yang 'dra/31byed/50/

bdag gi lha dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du yang dbyer med pa thams cad du yang dbyer 37med pas 'phags pa thams cad la yang mchod par bsngo/yid dga' ba dang mgu ba'i longs spyod sems can thams cad kyis kyang myong bar bsngos na bdag gi yid dga' ba dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching 2bar mi 'gyur bas su dga' bar byed pa rkyen po yang bsod nams thob par 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ snang ba rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i sku bas gzugs snang ba thams cad kyang bdag gi lha'i gzugs mthong ba ste/nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las lus bde ba rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dus na lus nyid bdag gi lha'i gzugs pas sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rang bzhin kyis rnged pas na lus shin tu bde ba yin te/ lus kyi spyod pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgyas bsgyur bas nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur te rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ ngag rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba'i dus na ngag gi rang bzhin thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgu'i byin gyis smras so cog thams cad sngags su gyur pas nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur gyi 4rnam par 34—1505

dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las yid rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dus na yid kyi rnam par rtog pa ci byung yang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid pas bsngo ba ma nor na nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur te rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ gzugs rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dus na gzugs so cog thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir gzugs dang kha dog dang lku/ dbyibs ji ltar mthong ba phyag rgya chen po'i sku nyid la mchod par bsngo ba ma nor bas sems can nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur gyi rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ sgra rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i dus na sgra bo cog rang bzhin med pas tshig dang ro kun snyan mi 2snyan dbyer med par thams cad rol mo'i sil snyan sna tshogs kyis bdag nyid lha'i gzugs la mchod par bsngos na sgra thams cad kyi nang na spyod kyang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur te rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro / /gzhung las dri rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dus na dri thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir dri zhim pa dang / mi zhim pa khyad par du mi byed par dri 34—1506
