mchog gis lha nyid la mchod par byed pas bsngos na nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur gyi bsod nams su 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las ro rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni stong pa ni stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du spyor ba'i dus na ro thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pas na kha zas zhim po dang mi zhim pa dang / gtsang ba dang / sme ba med de thams cad kyang zil mngar ①bdud rtsi lta bu'i lha la mchod par bsngos na nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur gyi rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las reg bya rnam par dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ chos thams cad shekyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba'i dus na bde ba dang sdug bsngal gnyi ga ma ༄ yin pa'i lus kyi reg bya thams cad rang bzhin kyis stong pas na bde mi bde'i khyad par gyi dbye ba thams cad kyang bde ba'i mchog gis bdag gi 5lha nyid la mchod par bsngos na nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba 6mi 'gyur gyi bsod nams su 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung las chos rnam nga ra dag pa'i tshig de ni 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa'i tshig go zhes 'byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba'i dus na chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis mi skye mi 'gag rang bzhin kyis stong pa yin pas chos thams cad du spyod pa la 'jug gis byang chub kyi spyod pa la 'jug pa yin gyi nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du skye mched bcu gnyis la sogs pa chos kun la spyod pa'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes 34—1507

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid la sbyor ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur tetsusna/ chos rnam pa sna tshogs la spyod cing bsngo ba ma nor ba ni bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhung las/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pas ngo bo nyid rnam par dag ste/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 4phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa'o zhes 'byung ba ni/ rtag tu smos 5pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs de la ma rtogs ༄ snapa'i chos zhes bya ba gud na med de/'phags pa'i spyod yul dang byis pa ma rab dz+wakyi spyod yul yang chos nyid 'di la spyod par bzang 8de/ chos kyi mtshan nyid shes pa dang / mi shes pa'i khyad par kyi nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba dang / rnam par dag par gyur pas bzang ngo 1 / /de'i phyir na/ rtag tu smos pa'i chos so cog thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa ste / chos nyid kyi 1 rnam par dag pas na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ji ltar chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang stong pa'i mtshan nyid de rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan ma sna tshogs la spyod pa yang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang ldan pas shes rab dang thabs dbyer med pa'i 'brel pas spyod do cog kyang chud mi zos shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs shing de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhung las/ lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag po su la las chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid rnam par dag par bsgrub pa'i sgo/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di lan cig thos na yang byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du sgrib pa dang / mchod 11pa thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa 34—1pya08

dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa la sogs pa sgrib pa chen po mang du bsags kyang sems can dmyal ba dang ngan song du skye ba tshunam yang mi 'gyur/sdig pa yang byas ma thag tu sdug bsngal med par 'gyur ro zhes 'byung ba ni/ rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo lag na rdo rje la bshad de/ su la la zhig chos rgya chen po 'di la dad pas 'jug na chos 'di ni rnam par dag pa'i chos/ 'di ni 'ching ba'i chos / 'di ni spyod pa'i chos/ 'di ni mi spyod pa'o zhes rnam par dbye ba med do/ /chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis thudag pa ni stong pa nyid de ye shes dang gnyis su med par mnyam par sbyor ba ni rnam par dag pa'i sgo mo yin te/chos rgya chen po 'di lan cig thos na yang nam byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bar du gcod pa la sogs te sgrib par mi 'gyur zhes bya ba'i chos thams cad kyi nang du bzhugs te spyod kyis kyang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid dang ldan pas sgrib ces bya ba'i chos thams cad ngo bo nyid ma bskyed 4par rang bzhin stong pas na nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba dang /'bras bu med pas dmyal ba dang ngan song du nams kyang skye bar mi 'gyur zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /sdig pa nyid kyi rang bzhin med pas spyod pa nyid kyi tshe na 'ching bar mi 'gyur te5/ sdig pa byas ma thag tu sdug bsngal med pa'i phyir ro//shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa dang nan tan ji ltar byas na 'grub ce na/gzhung las/ gang 'dzin pa dang / nyin re zhing klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa na zhes 'byung ba ste/ bcangs te mnyan nas gzungs su 'dzin pa dang 'dris par byed pa dang / stong pa nyid 3 7byed1509

dang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba nyunan tan du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i chos bsgrub ①pa'i don ji lta bu thob par 'gyur zhe na/ gzhung las des tshe 'di nyid la chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pas chos thams cad la rab tu dbang bar 'gyur—/ mos pa dang / dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' ba thams cad myong / byang chub sems dpa' — tshe bcu drug gis ④de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i ting 3'dzin rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /hūṃ zhes 'byung ba ste/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid du sbyor ba thams cad nan tan du byed pa ni thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu 'dzin pas chos so cog thams cad ni chos kyi dbyings las tha mi dad pas sems bskyed pa'i phyir dge ba dang sdig pa'i chos mtshungs par spyod kyis kyang 'ching ba'i nyes par mi 'gyur bas chos thams cad la dbang ba yin/ 'jig rten gyi 47longs spyod thams cad myong bar 'gyur rmyakyang 'ching ba'i nyes par mi 'gyur bas dus thams cad du gnod pa'i mi bde ba med pas tshe bcu drug gis de bzhin gshegs pa'am rdo rje 'dzin rab tu thob par 'gyur ba yang tshe shin tu ring ba'i gnas nas bsgrub —pa yin/ hūṃ zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad bsdus pa'i don te / thog ma med pa'i /tshun chad nyon mongs pa'i las kyi bag chags thams cad basbus nas med par bya ba'i don to/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na rdo rje'i rigs kyi snying po ste/ rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sa bon 'di las bskyed pa'i phyir bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad sdud pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na rdo rje lta bu drag shul che ba'i snying po bas sems can gdul 7 34byed/5/0

dka' ba ma rungs pa thams cad bsdus nas 'joms shing 'jig par byed pa'i don to/ /gzhung las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po zhes 'byung ba nas/ badz+ra hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/'dir yang rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshul ston te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba/chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin sngon —1thugs su chud pa gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i dam tshig dang ldan pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad ma lus pa'i sardo rje 'dzin te ༄/sems can kun las 'phags pa'i phyir na mchog go/ge /'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs kyi khams dang gzugs med pa'i khams thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba/ sems can gyi khams thams cad ma lus par 'dul zhing mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba'i don la sems can thams cad btsud nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rig 5'dzin gyi gnas thob par byas pa dang /bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thams cad dang ldan pas sgrib pa med pa'i phyir don thams cad grub pa ni lag na rdo rje ste/ dam tshig thams cad dang yang ldan la mnyam par sbyor ba'i dam tshig chen po yang mi gtong ba'i tshul du gzhugs shing zhabs 6bhe 'bring ba 'khor yang rdo rje gnod sbyin mang pos byas nas shes rab kyi dze+e pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul gyi phyadon bstan pas sems can yang de la 'dzud 1par mdzad de/ sems can thams cad 7chos rgya chen po 'di la zhugs pa rnams don chud mi za bar thugs su chud pas shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis zhal 'dzum ste/ rdo rje chen po de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rigs dang yum lnga'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lag pa g.yon pas gsor te/ cis kyang mi 'jigs mi skrag 34—1511

pa'i bsnyems pas rang gi snying gar stod ༄17pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing bsod nams dang ye shes chen po'i tshogs mnga' ba bde ba chen po'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa gnyis su med par spyor ba'i dam tshig sems can thams cad yongs su smin par 'gyur ba'i don yod pa'i chos thugs su chud nas rang gi de kho na nyid kyi snying por gsungs te/ badz+ra hūṃ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje rigs kyi snying po brtan par bya ba'i don bstan nas/ badz+ra swa bsnan to/ /gzhung las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba nas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /ā 37zhes 'byung ba'i bar du ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad sdogs par bstan te/ rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i tshul du zhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi tshul bshad do/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/rdo rje'i mtshan nyid ni sra ba'i phyir phyag mtshan rdo rje bsnams te/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo dang / gtso mo'i mtshan nyid lta bu ste mnyam par gnas so/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te rin po che'i don ni dbang bskur ba yin te/phyag mtshan yang rin po che bsnams te chos stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba yang rin po che'i rigs kyi gtso bo dang gtso mo'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rin po che lngas dbang bskur na gling bzhi la dbang byed pa bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang dngos grub thams cad sbyin pa'i dbang gis byang chub sems 3(—1512

dpa' rnams kyang rin po che'i cod pan la sogs pas hūṃ dbang bskur ba'i dam tshig gi don mdzad cing mnyam par rdzogs pa'i gnas so/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i phyir pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos pa bzhin te/ phyag mtshan pad+ma bsnams te/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor bar yang chos kyi gtso bo dang gtso mo'i mtshan nyid du ldan pa mnyam pa nyid du sdogs par gnas so/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos so cog thams cad dbyings kyis khyab ste ngo bo nyid kyis 3bhernam par rtogs /pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos grub kyi bya ba sna tshogs mdzad pas phyag mtshan yang las kyi rdo rje rgya gram bsnams te/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du spyor ba yang las kyi rigs kyi gtso bo dang gtso mo'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pas ④gnas te/ de ltar so so'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor yang longs spyod kyi tshul 'di ltar bzhugs3/dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug 'dod pa rnams kyang chos stong pa nyid dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba la goms par bya ste/ 6mngon par grub 7pa bzhi po 'di dag nyan thos la sogs pas nan tan du byas na chos so cog thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyir thams cad spyod kyang nyon mongs pa'i bcing bar mi 'gyur bas snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du ngan song thams cad las 'das par 'gyur/ chos nyid la gnas pas rnam par dag pa'i spyod yul te/bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs shing bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya'o/ /ā zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs 7pa'i snying po ste / chos thams cad ma skyes pa spros pa med pa stong pa nyid kyi don ston pa'i 34—1513

phyir ro/ /gzhung las/ de nas de skad ces bka' sprul zhes bya ba nas/badz+ra saṃ aḥ/ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste zhes 'byung ba rtag tu bstan tshopa'i dkyil 'khor bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa lus dang ngag yid gsum rdo rje ye shes kyi khu tshur yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya bas chos mnyam pa nyid kyi don bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa yang sems can yongs su smin pa'i don du 'gyur bas 'dzum mul 2te/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba nyid kyi phyir snying po/ badz+ra a thu.aḥ/ zhes gsungs te/stong pa ma skyes pa'i don aḥ'adi la brten ④par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /a zhe zhes bya ba'i don lta ba'i tshig go/ /gzhung las thams cad 'dul ba na zhes bya ba nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas yang 6sems can gyi don gyi phyir stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du spyor ba'i don ni 'jig rten thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs basbu ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen po yangs pa 'di bshad do/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum lnga mnyam par gnas pa yang chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'dod chags kyi nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba med pas 'dod chags spros pa med pa'i phyir bdag dang gzhan du lta ba rnged par mnyam pas na zhe sdang mi 'byung bas 7zhe sdang spros pa med do / /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ snying rje chen po'i gzugs kyis sems can ma rungs pa 'dul ba dang / gnas bde bar bskyed par bya ba'i phyir mngon spyod kyi dbang byed de/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong 34byed/51 /

pas na stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor bas zhe sdang gi las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas zhe sdang spros pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ gti mug gi rnga/gzung ba med pa'i phyir spyod pas gti mug spros pa me+ed do/ /gti mug gi 2gzung ba'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang ni basbung bar 'gyur gti mug med pa'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gi las spyod pa ni rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyod do4/ /rnam par mi rtog pa nyid pas mi shes pa'i tshul gyis shes pa ste/ gti mug gi rang bzhin med pas gti mug spros pa med pa'i phyir chos so cog thams cad spros pa med do/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te chos so cog thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab pas na gnyis su med pa'i mnyam pa'i tshul du spyor zhing dngos grub thams cad kyi las byed kyang / nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba med pas chos thams cad spros pa med pa'i phyir zhes bya ste/ de ltar chos so cog thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ste spros pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba yang 'grib mupar mi 'gyur bas spros pa med par rig par bya'o/ /'di ltar zhal nas gsungs pa'i — dkyil 'khor 'di'i don la 'jug cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyod pa'i tshul 'di nyan pa la sogs pa nan tan du byed na de 'dul ba'i dbang gi 7phyir chos so cog thams cad stong pa nyid pas khams gsum du skyes pa'i sems can thams cad bsad kyang ngan song du mi 'gro bar 'gyur te/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 34—/pya 10

—mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos nyid kyi tsho sdog pa rang bzhin yod la sbras 2bu bsags na sems can gcig gsad pa'i sdig pa bzhin du mang du bsad pa tshogs che bar yang mngon na/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dus na chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab pas sems can gyi rang bzhin med pa'i phyir sdig pa'i rang bzhin yang med de 'dul ba'i dbang gi phyir sdig pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur gyi bsod nams kyi tshogs rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ hūṃ zhes bya ba'i don 'di lhag ma dang 'dra'o/ /gzhung las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje zhes bya ba nas/ badz+ra hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ rtag tu gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi don bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje chos mnyam par spyod pa'i don sems can bstan pa yan chud mi za zhing rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhal 'dzum ste/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas lus gzi brjid chen po gzhan thams cad skrag cing spa bkong ri ba'i tshul du 'gyur chote/ badz+ra hūṃ zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /badz+ra hūṃ gi don ni rtag tu bshad pa dang 'dra/ gzhung las/de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag pa'i chos nyid ces pa nas/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /hūṃ zhes 'byung ba'i bar du ste/chos kyi rigs kyi byang chub kyi gtso bo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis phyabastan te/stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i chos rgya chen po yangs pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i tshul 'di ston dzito/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor de stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha 3tsho1—15/6

rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dus na 'dod chags kyi spyod yul thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ba yin gyi 'dod chags kyi nyon mongs pas bcings par mi 'gyur te/ stong pa nyid dang mnyam par spyor ba'i chos dag pa'i mtshan nyid pas nyon mongs pa'i dus snathams cad kyis gnod par mi nus pa'i phyir rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/'dod chags kyi ngo bo nyid kyi 2stong pa'i phyir bdag gi phyogs mi 'dzin pas zhe sdang mi 'byung mod kyi snying rje chen po'i gzugs kyis 1sems can ma rungs pa 'dul ba dang / sbug bsngal gyi gnas ngan pa las gdon pa'i dbang mdzad mod kyi/ zhe sdang gi nyon mongs par mi 'gyur bas zhe sdang rnam par dag pa zhes bya ste/ thams cad la dbang du spyod pas na rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kyi mtshan nyid ces bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor yin te/ zhe sdang gi mtshan nyid rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bur mi 'gyur bas sgrib pa med pas chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi dbyings yin pas dri ma thams cad rnam par dag pa zhes bya'o/ /chos nyid kyi ngo bos chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kyi mtshan nyid bstan to/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid de dri ma'i chos nyid ngo bo nyid kyi thustong ste/ sdig pa'i tshogs su mi 'gyur bas sdig pa'i chos rnam par dag pa ste/ dngos grub kyi chos thams cad la spyod cing grub pas las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid ces bya'o/ /rdo rje rigs kyi yum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid de sdig pa'i chos thams cad chos nyid kyis stong ste/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas chos thams cad rnam par dag ces bya ste/ chos thams cad yongs su dag na nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba'i 3 1—1517

bdud thams cad las rgyal ba'i phyir rdo rje'i rigs kyi yum gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o / /rin bo che'i rigs kyi yum kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid de chos thams cad chos kyi dbyengs kyis khyab ste rang bzhin gyis dag pas chos la sems can tha dad pa med de/ sems can thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /chos stong pa nyid kyis sems can dag pa'i dbang du byed pa'i rin po che'i rigs kyi yum gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi yum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid de sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste/ ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pas 1na sems can dang / ye shes stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du dbyer med pas ye shes rnam par dag pa zhes bya ste/ chos thams cad dbyings su mnyam pas chos kyi rigs kyi yum gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi yum kyi dkyil 'khor te/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid pas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba yang ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa ste/ 'ching ba med pas dngos grub thams cad grub par byed pa'i longs spyod pa'i phyir las kyi rigs kyi yum gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /de lta bas na chos thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin du grub pa med pa'i phyir ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ban/ shes rab kyi bye pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba nyid kyis kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid du chud cing rnam par grol ba yang dag pa'i spyod yul du 'gyur ro/ /'di gnyis 4kyang gcig gis gcig bskyed nga/ yin te/ chos kyi phyag rgya chen pos mnyam par don 'di nyan pa la sogs te/ grub pa nan tan du byas na 'dod chags la sogs pa chos sna tshogs kyi nang na 'dug kyang nyon mongs pa'i dri mas gos par mi 'gyur te pad+ma 34—/518

'dam gyis mi chags pa bzhin no/ /de lta nyu bas na stong pa nyid kyi 3ye shes gnyis su med par mnyam par spyor ba'i dus na chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid shes pas nyon mongs pa gsum yang mi spang ba'i dam tshig tu blang zhes 'byung ngo / /sna tshogs la spyod kyang sgrib par mi 'gyur bas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par dze+egs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /s+thāḥ5zhes bya ba be+e pad+mo'i 5rigs kyi snying po ste/ pad+mo'i trerigs kyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sa bon 'di las skyes pa'i phyir te/ don mi skye mi 'gag spros pa med pa rang bzhin gyes stong pa'i mtshan nyid du blta'o/ /gzhung las/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i zhes bya ba nas badz+ra tweḥ/ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos rtag tu gsungs pa'i don bstan par bya ba'i phyir yang gsungs te/ chos rgya chen po'i spyod yul 'di sems can rnam par dag pa'i don du 'gyur bas 'dzum mul tso7te/ pad+ma 'dam gyis mi chags pa bzhin du chos mnyam pa nyid du sprur ba la nyon mongs pa'i dri mas mi gos par mkhyen te/snying po badz+ra ha zhes gsungs so/ /gzhung las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba nas/ bde ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /t+t+waṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i rigs kyi gtso bos stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor bas khams gsum thams cad kyi byedabang pos dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan to//rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khams gsum spuchos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba thob pas khams gsum thams cad kyi chos la mnga' 34—1519

mdzad pa/ log par lta ba thams cad kyi gnyen po ste mthu che ba'i phyir rdo rje dang dra 1bas rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ sems can thams cad don dam pa man chad ci nas kyang phan pa dang bde ba thob par bya ba'i don sbyin pa'i dbang mdzad de sems can re ba thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa yid bzhin du thob par 'gyur bas rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad stong pa ma skyes pa'i don shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du spyor ba'i sems can thams cad la ston to/ /chos kyi sbyin pas kun kyang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di la 'jug cing stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang gnyis su med pa'i mnyam par sbyor ba thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor bas dngos grub kyi las thams cad thob par byed pas yid bzhin gyi rin po che las nor rdzas sna tshogs 'byung zhing rdzas kyi sbyin pa chen po zhes bya ste/ sems can dbul phongs pa thams cad lus dang ngag dang sems bde ba thob par 'gyur bas na las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /so so'i dkyil 'khor 'di rnams su zhugs shing stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang chos mnyam pa nyid du nan tan gyis spyad na dkyil 'khor gyi yon tan 'di rnams kyang thob cing dbang byed par 'gyur ro/ /tram̐ 2zhes bya ba ni rin po che'i rigs kyi snying po ste/ 'di'i sa bon las rin po che'i rigs kyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung ba'i phyir te/ mi skye mi 'gag spros pa med pa stong pa nyid kyi don to/ /gzhung las/ de nas byang 34—/520

chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba nas/ dam tshig rin po che'i snying pos smras so/ /badz+ra tram̐ zhes bya ba'i bar du tehūṃ/ rin po che'i rigs snyebyang chub kyi gtso bo nam mkha'i snying pos rtag tu bshad pa'i don 'di bstan snyepar bya ba'i phyir te dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di bstan na don yod par mkhyen pas bzhin 'dzum ste/ rang gi mgo bo zirin po che'i phreng ba 'ching ba yang gzhan thams cad la dbang du 5byed pa'i tha tshig ste/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul bshad do/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/chos thams cad du stong par byas pas stong par 'gyur ba thom yin gyi/ chos nyid kyis tsustong pas na yang dag par ma nor bas mtshan nyid la sus kyang mi 'gyur ba'i phyir rdo rje lta bu ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du spyod pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad mtshan ma med par byas pas mtshan ma med pa ma yin gyi/ chos nyid kyi 8mtshan ma med pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyod pa'i dbang du byed pas rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad smon pa med par byas pas smon pa med pa ma yin gyi/ chos nyid kyi —/smon pa med de/ gnyis su med pa'i mnyam par sbyor ba yang rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i chos nyid pas chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba yang yongs su dag pas chos nyid kyis dri ma med pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku man chad dngos grub thob par byed pas na las kyi rigs kyi 34—1521

dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /a'i don ni rtag tu smos pa dang 'dra/ gzhung las/de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas zhes bya ba nas/badz+ra a zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas kyang rtag tu bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di zi1shin tu rgya che ba'i phyir bzhin 'dzum bzhin du bstan te/ badz+ra a zhes gsungs so/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i sku'i mtshan nyid dang phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ni shes rab chen pos chos thams cad la gcod pa'i ral gri lta bu yin pas na shes rab zab mo'i don 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs shig gsungs shig pa'i bskul 2snaba'i tha tshig pas ral gris de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bde bas byezhes bya'o/ /gzhung las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'khor lo'i nang du chud pa zhes bya ba nas tram̐ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ dkyil 'khor kyi nang du chud pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzad pa la 'jug pa'i don to/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad stong pa'i mtshan nyid du mthong la gnyis su med par sbyor ba la mnyam/ par 'jug pa ni cis kyang tshugs par mi 'gyur te/ rdo rje dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te chos thams cad stong pa nyid du mthong ste/ gnyis su med par spyor ba'i /4chos mnyam pas sems can ma lus pa'i don thams cad mi gtong ba'i dbang du byed pa ni rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la 'jug 3par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa gcig tu na rin po che'i 6ni dbang bskur ba'i las byed pas dbang bskur ba 34—/522

yang 'ga' tsam la ma yin gyi sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bas na mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid de gnyis su med par mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshodus thams cad du chos nyid du ( mnyam pas na chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /gnyis su med pa mnyam par sbyor bas mnyam pa nyid du dngos grub kyi las thams cad du 'jug pas dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /tram̐ zhes bya ba ni rtag tu bshad pa'i don dang mthun no/ /gzhung las/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thag tu zhes bya ba nas/ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas rtag tu bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi don shin tu rgya che bar mthong nas bzhin 'dzum bzhin du 'khor lo yongs su bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i snying po gsungs pa yin no/ /badz+ra tsakra hūṃ zhes bya ba'i don rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bsdus pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhung las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba nas mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o//t+t+waṃ 4zhes bya ba'i bar du ste rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya ba'i phyir shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i tshul 'di bshad do/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa ste/ gnyis su med pa mnyam par spyor ba las byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgu dang mchod pa sna tshogs de'i rgyu 5las 'byung ste/ byang chub kyi sems kyang shin tu rgya che la yangs te/34—1523

mthu che ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing 'jig rten thams cad zil kyis mnan pa'i phyir rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa ste/ gnyis su med pas ①mnyam par sbyor ba las 'od zer mang po phyogs bcur 'phros te/ sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs kyi dbang du byed pa dang / sems can ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul zhing gnas bde ba bskyed de/ snying rje chen po'i dbang du byed pas rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa ste2/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang mnyam par sbyor bar dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa ste/ shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i las byed pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ger /'dri ba la sogs pa ④/ni las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /tram̐ zhezhes bya ba'i don ni rtag tu bstan pa'o / /gzhung las/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba nas/ oṃ ga ga na swa bhā 6ba badz+ra oṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu bstan pa'i don 'di dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod /dz+wadon de dang mthun 8par bsnan te smras pa'o/ /gzhung las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba nas/ sems can thams cad 'dul ba ni byang chub ho ha ha zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de bzhin gshegs pas sems can thams cad 'dul nus pa rdo rje'i khu tshur yongs su 'dzin pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mnyam par spyor ba'i don 'di bshad do/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 34—/524

'khor te/ sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa med do/ /stong pas mnyam pa'i phyir khro ba yang mnyam pa ste chos stong pa khro ba stong pa sems can stong pa bas chos nyid kyi don ma nor ba'i mtshan nyid kyis mthu che ba'i phyir rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor tshu lta bus 'dul lo/ /rin po che'i dkyil 'khor te/ sems can thams cad chos kyis 'dul zhing bla na med pa'i byang chub tu dgrol 37 ba'i dbang du byas pas khro ba 'dul te/ stong pa nyid gnyis su med par mnyam par spyor ba'i phyir sems can sna tshogs kyi don gyi phyir khro ba spyod kyang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur te/ rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ sems can thams cad stong pa'i chos nyid kyi phyir khro ba yang chos nyid de/ chos kyi don ji lta ba bzhin du ma nor ba'i mtshan nyid pas na chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ sems can thams cad kyang bzod pa kyimu med pas rdo rje dang 'dra/ khro bas 'dul ba yang de bzhin du sems can rgya che bas khro ba yang rgya che ste sems can khro ba gnyis kyang dbyer med pa'i phyir mnyam pa nyid du sbyor zhing sems can kyi don chu'i rgyun dang 'dra bar dus 4thams cad du byed pas las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /ha ha zhes bya ba'i don ni sems can thams cad yongs su dga' ba'i 5phyir spro ba'i las byed pas mgu ba'am rangs pa'i tha tshig ste dgod (6pa'i mtshan mas ha ha zhes bya'o/ /gzhung las de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba nas/ badz+ra kro dha ha ha zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/rtag tu bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di yang sems can thams cad smin par 'gyur ba'i don yin dzapas lus chud mi za bar dga' ba bsnan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje 34—1pya 25

gnod sbyin gyi gzugs shin tu pha rol 'jigs skrag par byed pa'i gzugs su thu bsgyur nas/ rdo rje khro bo zhes bya'i satshagad mo snying po 'di smras so/ /gzhung las de nas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las su rig par bya nas hri rngo zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab dang gapha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid la gnas pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyogs zhes phya7bya ba bshad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyerigs kyi dkyil 'khor de sems can thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong ste/ rang bzhin gyi skyemanyam pas shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba yang stong pa nyid do/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku'i mtshan nyid pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos so cog thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ste/dbyer med cing mnyam pa'i phyir shes rab dang zupha rol tu phyin pa dngos por grub pa med pas stong pa'i mtshan nyid de mnyam pa nyid du 'byor 1zhing chos thams cad la spyod kyang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur te/ bgegs thams cad las rgyal po'i 1 phyir rdo rje lta bur mthu che bas na rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ rin po che'i phreng bas dbang bsgur te don byed pa yang sems can 'ga' la byed pa ma yin gyi dbri bkol gred par sems can thams cad kyi don du byed pas na shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba yang sems can gyi don gyi phyir na rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te—/ chos so cog thams cad chos kyi dbyings nyid las gzhan ma yin pas shes 31—1526

rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba yang chos kyi dbyings te chos nyid pas chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las sne/kyi dkyil 'khor te chos thams cad stong pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad spyod do cog kyang las zhes bya ste/shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor ba yang dngos grub la sogs te rnam pa sna tshogs grub kyis kyang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba dang sgrib par mi 'gyur bas las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /hrī zhes bya ba'i don ni rtag tu bshad pa dang mthun kye no/ /gzhung las de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rjes zhes bya ba nas/ badz+ra a mo gha hūṃ/ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi don 'dod pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /kyepha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dam tshig mi gtong ba ste/ 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs nas mnyam par sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bdag dang gzhan zhes bya ba med pa'i snyoms par zhugs nas sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa'i don yod pa thams cad kyi dam tshig ces bya ba rang gi snying po smras so/ /badz+ra a mo gha hūṃ/ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i gdon mi za bar btus pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhung las de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba nas tram̐ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pas stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sems can thams cad la byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba 'di bshad do/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ sems can thams cad rnam par snang mdzad 34—1527

kyi sku dang thugs thams cad dang ldan pas stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba la gzhug ①nas kun kyang bla na med par mngon par 'tshang rgya bas na sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku las gzhan ma yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu dang rlabs (sheche bas rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/rin po che'i phreng bas khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas mnyam par sbyor ba'i rdo rje'i snying pos dbang bsgur nas/ sems can thams cad kyang de'i spyod lam ( —'jug cing mnyam par spyor ba'i rdo rje'i snying pos dbang byed par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig rin po che'i dbang bskur ba yin te/ lag tu rdo rje byin nas las thams cad spyod du 'jug pa'i dbang sbyin par byed pa sems can thams cad rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ste rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bstan pa 5'jug pas/ sems can thams cad ni chos kyi snying po ste/chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor bas sems can thams cad bya ba byed pa la rab tu spyor gyis kyang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas sems can thams cad las kyi snying po ste dngos grub thams cad mngon du tshospyod pas na las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /tram̐ 7zhes bya ba'i don ni rin po che'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskyed pa'i sa bon te/ rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor 31—/528

zhes bya'o/ /gzhung las de nas phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i rigs rnams zhes bya ba nas/badz+ra trī byo (peswā hā/ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rim dang ra ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang khyad par med de/ mtshungs shing 'dra bas rgya cher bstan nas snying bo tshogs sa sngags rnams byin te/ de yang gnyis su med pa mnyam par sbyor bas longs spyod chen po dang ldan pa'i dbang phyug chen pos rang gi snying po gsungs so/ /gzhung las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas mu med ces bya ba nas/ bh+yo badz+ra oṃ sarba dhan+d+ra ta/ a pra pa ni tsa/hi li nyi li/ sarba dharma ta/ mi lī mi lbo/ sarba dharma ta/ a nu rā ga gī 3 ni swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas mu med thug pa med pa'i chos kyang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i longs spyod chen po dang ldan par mdzad pas cho ga 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang mthun lta pa'i phyir cho ga 'di yang mtha' yas mu med thug pa med par yongs su byen gyis brlab nipa'i phyir chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang mnyam par sbyor bas spyod yul thams cad du rnam pa ra dag pa'i tshul 'di bshad do/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba bsam dzagyis mi khyab mtha' yas pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mtha' yas te8/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs spyod chen po nyid yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 9sku ni bdud thams cad las rgyal ba'i phyir/rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i chos thams cad du mnyam 34—1529

ste / rdo rje lta bu'i mthu dang 'dra ba nyu med cing gzhan kyi thu zil gyis mi gnon 1to—/ /dbang ‘grub pas rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba ni du ma'i don ma yin te/ mnyam pa nyid gcig tu zad pas chos thams cad kyang shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid gcig tu zad de dbyer med pas na chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid du spyor ba chos mtshan ma sna tshogs kyi spyod yul la zhugs kyis kyang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba dang sgrib par mi 'gyur bas shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mthar thug pas na chos thams cad kyang mthar thug pa yin no zhes bya ba yin te/dngos grub thams cad sbyin par byed pas las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /gzhung las/ gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba nas/ rdo rje 'dzin par myur du 'gyur/ badz+ra bh+yo zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa ra sbyor ba'i tshul 'di mnyan 5pa la sogs te bsgom pa'i bar du nan tan byas nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dag pa'i mthar phyin te/ chos mtshan ma sna tshogs kyi sgor zhugs kyis kyang mnyam nga/ nyid kyi don gyes sgrib pa thams cad zad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba yin no/ /gzhung las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 7thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa ni khams gsum gye sems can thams cad skyob pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas de dang nam du 3 4—/530

yang mi 'bral bar bya ba'i phyir gus pa zhes ri mor bya ba'i phyir phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba yin no/ /gzhung las/ oṃ bha ga bān nā nyurod pa ram̐ bid sha dha ya swā hā / zhes bya ba nas/ oṃ zhes bya ba ste sngags kyi yi ge 'bru drug po 'di rnams ni dkyil 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' so so'i rigs kyi snyeng po 'di'i don ni spyod pa thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba'i don yin no / /rig pa chen po'i snying po 'di bshad pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlobs kyis shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i don te/ ma nor bar bton pa'i dam tshig gi sgra dang sngags kyi snying po yi ge 'bru drug brjod pa bar snang la grag go/ /sngags kyi snying po 'di rnams ni rig 'dzin thams cad kyi 5rtag tu bsnyen bkur bya zhing rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te chos kyi rnam grangs snying po bstan pa 'di dngos grub thams cad thob par byed pa'i don yod pas de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyang myur du 'grub par bya bar byin gyis brlabs nas legs so zhes bya ba byen no/ /oṃ zhes bya ba'i don ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku lta bu'o/ /bar ma ni khyo ltabh+ya dang / rat+na sam+bha ba dang / a mo gha sidhi 'dus pa'i sgu lta bu'o/ /tha ma ni chos kyis a mi tā bha lta bur blta'o/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na thog ma ni pha rol tu phyin pa tha ma ni rab/ bar ñca7 ni byang chub kyi sems lta bu yin no/ /gzhung las sems dpa' chen po zhes bya ba nas blo gros chen po legs so zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ rigs kyi yum rnams kyis mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor so so'i yon tan rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni sems dpa' chen po legs so zhes bya ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' ni 34—1531

khams gsum pa thams cad kyi slob dpon lta bu ste/ stong pa nyid dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor zhing bdud la sogs pa log par lta ba thams cad zil gyis gnon par mdzad de ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul ba'i gnyen po bas de'i phyir rdo rje zhes bya ste/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid mnyam pa las ma 'gyur bar 1'jig rten gyi chos dang longs spyod thams cad la yang mngon par spyod pas yon tan phun sum tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas legs so zhes bya bas bstod do/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni bde ba chen po legs so zhes bya ba yin no/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa 3stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor bas don dam pa'i bden pa dang kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang yang 1ldan/thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel te mnyam pas bsod nams ziye shes kyi tshogs sdogs par 'gyur bas theg pa chen po'i chos kyi dkyil 'khor te/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas theg pa chen po legs so zhes bya ba yin no/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ste/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor bas dngos grub kyi las sna tshogs mdzad kyis kyang mnyam pa nyed kyi chos nyid las mi 'gyur bas sheji ltar bstod 6pa bzhin du yang grub 7la/ shes rab dang thabs chen po chud snyemi za bas shin tu blo gros dang ldan pa yin pas yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir blo gros chen po legs so zhes bya ba yin no/ /gzhung las/ cho ga 'di ni dge bar smras/ /zhes bya ba nas/ bshad pa la ni mngon par bstod/ /ces bya ba'i bar du ste/stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor bas 34—/532

'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la 'dzem pa med par spyod/ shes rab dang thabs kyi spyod yul yang ngo bo nyid kyis mnyam pa ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i sgo/ sems can thams cad kyang mos shing dad par 'gyur ba'i chos chen po yin pas dge bar smras so zhes bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mdzad pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang phyag na rdo rje bsnams te/ shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa nyid du zhugs nas/ mdo sde zab mo 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pas dkyil 'khor mdzad pa'i tshul du bstan pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 3rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya'o/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi snye stong pa nyid yin gyis kyang kun rdzob tu rgyu dang 'bras bur sbyar ba ste/ de bas na mdo sde'i don 'di bstan pas thob pa'i shes rab bskyed de chos nyid kyi rig byepa la brten nas bsam pa'i shes rab kyis don gang yin pa la gzhig 4par byas nas mnyam par sbyor ba'i don la bsgoms na/ 'bras bu byang chub kyi rig ne+e'adzin la sogs te bla na med pa'i sa man chad dngos grub ci 'dod pa thob par 'gyur te 'bras bu yod pas sems can kun kyang dam pa'i chos spyod pas 'di la 'jug cing sgom par 'gyur bas 'dul ba'i mchog ces bya'o/ /mnyam par sbyor ba'i sgo yangs pa 'di la kun kyang mos shing dad par gyur trel longs spyod dang ldan bzhin du bla na med pa 7thob par 'gyur bas thob pa'i rgyal po ste/ shes rab dang thabs gnyis mnyam par spyod pas lhag pa'i chos gud na med pas sangs rgyas kyis 5thob pa'i sa che ba las 9—bsgrub tu med pas bla na med pas bla na med pa zhes bya'o/ /sems can gang yang rung ste/ dam pa'i chos spyod lam 'di la 34—/533

nyan pa dang sems pa dang bsgom pa la sogs te nan tan du byed pa la ni gdon dang bgegs la sogs pa thams cad kyis 2spyod pa'i bar chad du mi 'gyur ba dang 'tshe bar byed mi nus so/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sa thob par bya ba dang / dngos grub dam pa ci 'dod pa thams cad sangs rgyas kun gyis ring por mi thogs par ster bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa yang mi 'gal bar myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang mnyam pa'i chos chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos mnyam pa nyid kyi spyor ba byin gyis brlabs pas gsang ba'i don 'di yang rdo rje can gyis grub par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po'i chos yangs pa shin tu 2rgya che la longs spyod dang ldan bzhin du grub 3pa'i chos bshad pa 'di la don chen po yod par mthong nas mngon par dga' zhing bstod do/ /gzhung las de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba nas/ swa rge badz+ra oṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po ni khams gsum thams cad kyi chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba yin pas gsang ba'i chos nyid pas na stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang gnyis su med par mnyam par spyor ba spros pa med pa bde ba chen po'i don yod pa mnyam par sbyor ba mi gtong ba'i dam tshig dang ldan pa chos yangs shing rgya che ba'i sgo 'di thog ma dad pas rtsom pa nas zhugs nas mjug 5bla na med pa thob kyi bar du nyon mongs pa med par sgrib pa thams cad spangs pas na thog ma dang tha ma dang dbus kyi khyad par med par dus thams cad du bde ba mnyam pa'i chos gsungs so/ /mur thug la sogs pa chos zab mo'i don ma mthong ba stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / gnyis 3 (—/53

su med pa'i mnyam par spyor ba'i chos nyid mi shes pa rnams kyis ni dka' thub pa nyon mongs pa spyad kyis kyang 'bras bu bde ba thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /des na spyod pa kun las 'phags pa'i chos kyang thugs rje can gyis bstan par zad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams stong pa nyid kyi ye shes gnyis su med par mnyam par spyor bas longs spyod dang ldan zhing / bla na med pa'i dngos grub thob pa sems can thams cad kyang byang chub tu sgol bar byed pas thog ma dad pa la zhugs nas tha ma bla na med pa la sgol ba la thug gi bar du dus thams cad du bde bas 'dod chags chen po'i dngos grub hudam pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba chen po'i dngos grub dam pa zhes bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i spyod yul du bstan nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba las longs spyod tshad 2chen po dang ldan zhing bde ba 'di yang thams cad chos kyi dbyings la khyab te ༄ / don dam pa'i mtshan nyid pas chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang gnyis su mnyam par sbyor bas bdud kyi stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i dngos grub dam pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zirin po che'i phreng bas khams gsum kyi rgyal por dbang sgur 5bar byed pas na rin po che'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang mnyam par spyor bas khams gsum pa thams cad kyi 34—1535

bdag po byed pas sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad dag pa'i spyod yul la dgod pa'i phyir 'khor ba'i nang na gnas shing sems can gyi don la brtson ri1 kyang 'khor ba'i nyon mongs pas mi chags pas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das te / sems can thams cad kyi don chu'i rgyun dang 'dra ba'i las 'jug cing dngos grub dam pa thams cad thob pa'i las spyod pas na las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsungs pa yang / dkyil 'khor la lar ni lngar gsungs la/ la lar ni bzhir gsungs/ la lar rgo gsum du gsungs pa ji lta bu zhe na/ dkyil 'khor lngar gsungs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / rdo rje'i rigs dang / rin po che'i rigs dang / chos kyi rigs dang / las kyi rigs te 'di rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang yon tan te/de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang yum lnga'i don bstan to/ /dkyil 'khor bzhir bstan pa ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bsdus te dkyil 'khor bzhir bstan to/ /gsung rab kha cig las dkyil 'khor gsum du bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi nang du rdo rje rngo37rigs bsdu/ las kyi rigs kyi nang du rin po che'i rigs sdud /pa dang / chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ 'di ltar gsungs pa/ de 7ci dang 'dra zhe na/ phyin ci log gi dbang gis 5lus dang ngag dang yid kyi 4spyod yul 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gsum byung ste/ sems can nyon mongs pas bcings pas 'khor ba'i nang du sdug bsngal ba yang lus dang ngag dang yid gsum 'khrul pa'i dbang gis gyur to/ /phyin ci log med 7stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i dag pas lus rdo rje zhes bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 34—/536

phyag rgya chen po dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /ngag rdo rje ste don dam pa'i chos kyi dbyings dang mthun 3)pas de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /yid rdo rje zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa yin pas na sems can gyi don bya ba sna tshogs mdzad pa dngos grub kyi las thams cad mngon par spyod pa'i dbang du byed cing las rnams la spyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i rigs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa las kyi rigs gcig tu bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ste/ lus dang ngag dang yid gsum rdo rjer 'gyur bas 'dod chags ni de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid du gyur5/ zhe sdang ni de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid du 'gyur/ gti mug ni de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur pas na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams kyang 5de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i mtshan nyid du bshad pas nyon mongs pa'i chos zhes gzhan gud na med pas chos so cog thams cad rnam par cho dag pa'i rang bzhin yin par mngon no/ /dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi dbus lnga dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub pa'i treye shes dang spyod yul sngar 7so sor 'gyur te/ gcig tu na spyod yul gcig las med pa ma yin gyi/ rigs kyi dkyil 'khor la yang rigs kyi lnga char gyi mtshan nyid yon tan dang spyod yul dang tshogs shing dang ldan pas ming tsam du dkyil 'khor yang lnga'i mtshan nyid du dbye bar zad do/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgu ste chos kyi dbyings nyid yin/ rigs kyi yum dang gtso bo nyid las sprul to/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug kyang rigs kyi yum las gzhan ma yin no/ /swa — badz+ra o 34—1537

zhes bya ba'i swo ni dpal dang ldan pa'am bkra shis pa'i mtshan nyid/ badz+ra ni rdo rje'i mtshan nyid/ oṃ ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba nas swa ①zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde ba chen mo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rngutha mi dad pa mnyam par spyor ba'i chos don ji lta ba 3bzhin du mkhyen pa'i chos④ chos thams cad kyi dbyings las tha mi dad pa'i phyir don thams cad bsgrub par gsungs te/ swā hā zhes bya ba ni zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang bkra shis kyi don yin/hūṃ dang phaṭa ces bya ba ni mngon spyod dang dgug pa dang 'jigs par bya ba'i don yin te/ 'di rigs kyi yum gyi chochos thams cad dge zhing bkra shis par gsungs pa'i phyir zhes brjod do/ /gzhung las/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /zhes bya ba nas dngos grub kyi phyogs 4kyang tshe 'di la thob par 'gyur ro/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ rigs kyi yum gyi dzostong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par sbyor ba la mkhas pa'i mchog thob par 'gyur zhing / sems can 'khor ba'i mtha' med pa de srid du don mdzad pas na de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs par shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam par spyor ba'i rgya chen po 'di la don chud mi za ba ramakhyen nas tshigs bcad du bstod pa yin no/ /'khor ba 9thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i phyir mtha'i mtha' yang med de/ ji tsam du 'khor ba 1nyamatha' med pa'i bar du stong pa nyid dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis ni de dang mnyam par spyor ba ma yin no/ /de ltar 'khor ba mtha' med pa'i 34—1538

don la sems dang po bskyed she)pa nas zhugs pas ni dzu/bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas kyis kyang thog ma snying rje chen po dang smon lam chen pos sems can gyi don la 'jug par bya ba'i shugs kyis sems can gyi don tshul na rgyun dang 'dra bar mdzad pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang rang bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'da' bar mi mdzad do/ /shes rab ces bya ba ni chos thams cad stong pa mnyam pa nyid du shes pa yin te.e/pha rol tu phyin pa phyo zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings kyi mtshan nyid de/de shes rab dang dbyings gnyis su sbyor te mnyam par gyur pa'i dus na/ shes rab dang yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar phyin pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya'o/ /thabs ni shes rab dang pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid la byang chub kyi sems skyes te/ sems de las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa dang / dngos grub dam pa thams cad bskyed pa dang /sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i don byas pas na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thabs su 'byel pa thabs kyis gzung ba'i shes rab pas shes rab kyang thabs shes rab kyis gzung ba'i thabs pas na thabs kyang shes rab ste/ de ltar shes rab dang thabs dus thams cad du mnyam pa'i dus na ye shes kyi byin gyis thubarlabs pa'i sa pas chos so cog thams cad rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pas na rang bzhin med pas dag par 'gyur3/ ji srid du sems can 'khor ba'i mtha' med pa'i bar du 'jig rten gyi sdig pa'i chos thams cad dang /'dod chags 9kyi nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur gyis rnam par dag pa'i 34—1539

spyod yul du gyur pas na de bas na sems can thams cad kyang mnyam par spyor ba la 'dzud cing sgrib pa med par byed pa'i phyir/ ji srid 'khor ba de tsam gyi bar du sems can 'dul zhing dge ba'i bshes gnyen byed do/ /chos thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dang mtshungs pa rang bzhin kyis grub pa med de meci la yang mi gnas pa'o/ /nam mkha' zhes bya ba yang sems can kyephyin ci log gis las kyi 'bras bu la nam mkha' yang dngos po mi snang ba'i phyir med par 'dzin gyis / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ste mnyam pa'i dus kyi (chonam mkha' la ci zhig med na med ces bya ste/ med par lta ba yang mi 'byung bas 3na de bas na nam mkha' la yang mtshan grub pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /chos so cog thams cad kyang nam mkha' bzhin te grub pa med pas mnyam/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i phyir nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas na kun gyi gyemachog mngon pa nyid sdogs zhes bya'o/ /dper na pad+ma tshogs kyis bsgyur yang sman ru gyi kha dog gis mi 'gyur ba bzhin du stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang gnyis su med pa'i mnyam par spyor bas 'gro ba 9snal phan pa'i don byed kyi rmyenyes pas 'ching bar mi 'gyur ro/ /shes rab 1pha rol kiphyin pa mnyam par sbyor bas longs spyod chen po'i nang du bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i don byed kyang rnam par dag pa'i spyod yul du gyur pas na longs spyod chen po dang yang mi 'bral ba'i phyir na don che/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang mnyam par spyor ba la gnas pas sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa med pa'i phyir ni bde ba che /7ste / de ltar na ⑩spyod pa la 7bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs lasu sdogs te/sku gsum lhun gyis grub pas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad 34—/540

mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad yongs su smin par mdzad pas na sems can gyis 3hā zhes bya ba ni chos rgya chen po 'dis sems can smin par 'gyur bas dga' ste dgod 3pa'i tha tshig go / / —stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / mnyam par spyor ba'i chos ni ༄nyan pa la sogs te bsgom pa 5nan tan chen por byas na bde ba thams cad thob pa dang dngos grub kyi mchog kyang tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur ro/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i don ni rtag tu bshad pa dang mthun 6no/ /gzhung las/ bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rje zhes bya ba nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi dam pa rdo rje 'dzin chen po dang de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgu'i mtshan nyid du byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can gyi mig chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa yongs su ston pas na/ oṃ ni chos thams cad la dbang byed pa'i phyir thog mar 'gro zhes bya'o / /de man chad ni tshig gi mjug rgyan te/ yi ge'i nang nas dngos su zer bar zad do/ /zhal nas gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni ma rab 1kun la bka' yis kyang tshig go cog gi don de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byin gyis brlabs rdepa yin no bar gzhung las mngon sum du gsungs pa'i phyir sems can gyi phyir bstan pa rnams ma nor ba tsam mo9/ /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa/sa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na mi tras mdzad nga/ rdzogs so// //34—1541

1554ra༅/ /yi ge brgya pa'i cho gatsho /sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha tāk+ṣa ra bi dhiḥn/ bod skad du/ yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /de bzhin rnam par snang mdzad dang / /khams gsum rnam rgyal nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /mkha' snying rdo rje khu tshur dang / /'jam dbyangs chos kyi 'khor lo can/ /mkha' mdzod de bzhin gnod sbyin dang / /bsdus pa dag tu yongs su bsgrags/ /zhi ba mdung gis 1mtshan dkyil 'khor/ /ma mo ming po'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sring mo rnams kyis bshad pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bcu dang lnga rnams ni/ /pha rol phyin drug las 4bshad de/ /pha rol phyin pa'i sgo nas gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje can de 5nyid/ /de bzhin bde bar gshegs pa'i dang / /rdo rje me ltar 'bar nyid dang / /'jig rten dbang dang mkha' snying po/ /bsdus 34—1547

dang ming po'i gang yin dang / /sring mo lha dang klu dag go/ /lha mo'i dkyil 'khor gzhan dag kyang / /de bzhin mchog gyur bshad pa yin/ /rdo rje can dang rgyal nyid dang / /rdo rje me 'bar pad+ma gnyis/ /rin chen ming po sring mo dang / /klu dang sdug bsngal grags bsdus pa/ /'di rnams nyid kyis ras ris rnams / /gong nas gong du bshad pa yin/ /rdo rje can dang bde gshegs nyid / /phyag na rdo rje 'jig rten dbang / /mkha' snying bsdus par bshad pa ste / /nyi shu rtsa brgyad dag tu bshad/ /dpal mchog dang po'i gsum pa las//de ni dkyil 'khor bshad bya ste/ /rdo rje can bde gshegs pad+ma/ /mkha' snying ming bo'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sring mo klu dang sdug bsngal grags/ /gsum pa bcu par bshad pa yin/ /ras ris lnga pa snang ༄1bar grags/ /lha mo lnga yi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /bsdus pa nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ /dpal mchog dang por bshad pa yin/ /rdo rje rnam snang nyi ma dang / /'jig rten dbang dang mkha' snying dang / /ming po rnams dang sring mo klu/ /sdug bsngal gdon dang bsdus pa'o / /ras ris dkyil 'khor lnga rnams dang / /bzhi pa dag tu yongs su bsgrags—/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni 'byung ba yi/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad bya bsnye/ /grangs ni bdun cu rtsa dgu ste/ /'di la rnam rtog bya mi dgos/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi grangs byas nas/ /da ni da lta nyid du yang / /phyag rgya'i dum bu bsnyus pa dang / /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ /dang po phyag rgya chen po nyid/ /de bzhin gnyis pa dam tshig ste/ /gsum pa chos kyi rgyar grags pa/ /bzhi pa las kyi rgya nyid do/ /rgya yi dum bu bsdus pa can/ /skye med nyid du shes bya ste/ /gang gi mchog tu gtsor grur snyegang / /phyi nang 34—1548

thams cad yang dag 'dus/ /'di yi legs sbyor gtso bo yang / /da ni ma lus bshad par bya/ /gang zhig gang dang yang dag spyor/ /phyag rgya rim bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /phyag rgya che dang las su grags/ /yang dag sbyor bar bshad pa yin / /dam tshig rgya dang chos kyang ni/ /'degs lha pa sbyor ba yin par 'dod/ /'di dag nyid kyi bsdus da snapa dag /byu 'dra ci phyir bshad bya ste/ /phyag rgya che dang yang dag sbyor/ /las kyi phyag rgyar bshad snyepa yin/ /gang phyir bsnams pa med ④na ni/ /nga rgyal 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ /thuphyag rgya chen po bsten 'u mi 'gyur/ /chos med par ni bsgrub bya yisa.a+yo/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bsten shemed pas/ /gang zhig bsgrub par bya sngags la/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod bya/ /lus ni gnas pa med pa dang / /dngos po med cing mtshan med la/ /skye ba med pa'i spyor ba yisatsu/ /phyag rgya 'di ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dang po zla ba byung ba la/ /de 'og yi ge'i gzugs can te/ /yi ge las ni mtshan ma byung / /mtshan las rdo rje 'dzin rang nyid/ /me long mnyam nyid ye shes dang / /so sor rtog dang bya ba'i bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa'ang nam mkha' ste/ /dngos med gnas pa lnga pa yin/ /phyag rgya chen por sbyisar gyur cing / /chu nyid dam tshig yin par bshad/ /chos kyi phyag rgya me nyid de/ /rlung ni las la rnam par gnas / /'byung dang 'byung 'gyur yang dag sbyor/ /de bzhin khams dang skye mched dang / /rgyu dang mi rgyu sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin sa dang pha rol phyin/ /'di dag thams cad stong pa ste/ /phyag rgya'i spyor ba rnam pa bzhir/ /mdor bsdus na ni 'byung 'gyur bas/ /de bas de dag nyid du dgrol/ /las ni chos la dgrol bar bya/ /chos kyang de bzhin dam tshig la/ /dam tshig kyang ni 34—1549

rgya chen la/ /rgya chen zla ba stong pa la'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' snying rdo rje/ /lce la yang ni rtse gsum pa/ /bzhi pa'ang sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig yin par bshad/ /gang gis bzhi po 'di dag gi/ /sbyor ba yang dag mi shes par/ /spro ba dang ni sdud pa nyid/ /de las dngos grub rgyab kyis phyogs/ /dam tshig ye shes sngags rnams kyi/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mtshan ma nyid/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /bzlas brjod kyang ni 'di ltar bya/ /nyon mongs thams cad zlog byed pa'i/ /yi ge brgya pa dang por brjod/ /thog ma dbus dang tha mar yang / /byin rlob byed pas bzlas par bya/ /bdag la byin rlob ①byed nyid dang / /tshe yang ring bar 'phel byed cing / /rgya rnams brtan por byed pa dang / /sku gsung thugs rnams sgrub pa po/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa zhes brjod pa/ /gsang sngags rgyal po mchog gis bstod/ /theg chen mngon du phyogs rnams la'ang / /khyab bdag ye shes lnga rang bzhin/ /gzugs dang sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /mchod rten dkyil 'khor brtag epa yang yi ge brgya sngags gcig 'dra ba/ /de 'dra'i bsod nams yod ma yin/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod pa las/ /bsod nams gang zhig legs gsungs pa/ /rdul phran gyi ni grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis brgyan pa yin/ /gang zhig sa ma ya dang ni/ /ma nu pā la ya zhes brjod/ /rjes su bdag bsrungs 4 shes pa ni/ /thams cad kyi ni thun mong gis/ /lha rnams nye bar ston pa yin/ /badz+ra satwa twe no dang / /pa tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba dang / /dṛ rto me bha ba dang ni/ /su toṣ+yo me bha ba nyid/ /a nu rasto me bha ba/ /su poṣ+yo me bha ba dang / /khams gsum sarba sid+dhim+me/ /pra yats+tsha sarba karma su/ /tsa zhes legs par brjod pa dang / /34—1550

me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru/ /hūṃ dang ho'i thog mtha' can/ /yi ge ha ha bzhi po brjod/ /bha ga bān ni shebhebadag gam kun/ /sarba ta thā ga tra 3nyid/ /badz+ra mā me muñca dang / /badz+rī spyobha ba bzhi pa yin/ /ma hā sa ma ya satwa/ /26nyid kun gyi thugs la gnas/ /de bas kun du khyab pa nyid/ /gsang sngags rgyal 'di bla thu med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po ni/ /yi ge brgya zhes bshad pa yin/ /ji srid dpal mchog dang po dang / /dpal ldan de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang bya ba nyid/ /mdo dang rtog pa gnyi ga las/ /dngos grub bsgrub par brtson pa las5/ /gsang sngags rgyal po gsungs pa rnams/ /der ni bzlas pa'i bsod nams gang / /de 'dir yi ge brgya pa yin/ /'dir bshad pa/ badz+ra satwa rdo rje can/ /sa ma ya rdor ༅rgyal po nyid/ /ma nu pā la chags pa ste/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dag legs pa/ /dṛ bye 7me bha ba rin chen/ /su toṣ+yo me bha ba gzi/ /a nu ragho 8rgyal mtshan no/ /su toṣ+yo me bha ba bzhad/ /sarba sedhim+me pra yats+tsha rdo rje chos/ /sarba karma su tsa me rdo rje rnon po/ /tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru rgyu/ /hūṃ dang ha bzhi rdo rje smra/ /ho /— bha ga bān 9ni rdo rje las/ /badz+rī 1bye bha ba rdo rje srung ba/ /rta 7sa ma ya gnod spyin/ ā ni khu tshur shes par bya/ /'dir bshad pa/ oṃ ni rig pa 1)bha ga ste/ /hūṃ ni rdo rje gyur pa yin/ /ha bzhi dag ni ye shes te/ /nam mkha' rnam dag lnga pa'o/ /shug thurag twa tse pi sha na/ /tsi tai nyid ni lnga pa'o/ /shes rab thabs dang ldan par ni/ /'di dag nyid kyis shes par bya/ /byang chub sems ni gnas med pa/ /de ni bskul ba nyid du bya/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod nas su/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni spro bar bya/ /shes rab thabs dang ror ldan pa/ /ru bye rar bcas blangs nas ni//34—1551

yi ge brgya pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /bcu drug rtsibs can rim gsum bri/ /lte bar rdo rje rgya gram bri/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu ha bzhi bri/ /bsgrub bya dngos su chud byas la/ /de nyid gsum ni bri bar bya/ /rtsibs la yi ge brgya pa yis1 / /bcu drug rkang par byas pa bri/ /dang po bskor 3ba'i nang du ni/ /yi ge ma mo lnga bcus bskor/ /gnyis pa la ni 'dod rgyal bri/ /gsum par gtso bo gnod mdzes kyi / /go ga'i gzhi'am ras la bri/ /gi 4wang dag gam snag tsha yis/ /bcu bzhi dag la bris nas ni/ /gser gyis phyalegs par g.yogs 6par bya/ /gal te bdag nyid dpal 'dod na/ /mchod cing rtag tu bcang bar bya/ /gang 7zhig yi ge brgya pa 'chang / /dus min 'chi ba nyid dang ni/ /nad dang mya ngan 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig yi ge brgya pa 'chang / /dbul dang snyug bsngal sogs mi 'byung / /rgyal po'i sgo 5ni cher mchod cing / /dgra rnams kyang ni zad par 'gyur/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /yi ge brgya pa gang zhig 'chang / /bu 'dod pas ni bu rnyed cing / /nor 'dod pas ni nor thob 'gyur/ /yul med pa ni yul thob cing / /bu mos khro ni dam pa rnyed/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas la rab dang / /de bzhin gzhan gyis mi thub la/ /gal te tshe ni (ring 'dod na/ /yi ge brgya pa bcang bar bya/ /som nyi tsoyid gnyis rnam spangs nas/ /gang zhig yi ge brgya 'chang ba/ /tshe 'dir bde bar 'gyur ba dang / /shi 'phos bde ba can du 'gro/ /gang zhig don ni rgyas pa dang / /dad dang ldan zhing dbang po thul/ /bla ma la gus dul ba dang / /phrag dog chags pa spangs la sbyin/ /gal te tshe 'di 1 ring 'dod na/ /chad lta khros sa bcas sgyu can dang / /pra ya /can dang gdug can la thu/ /sngags pas sbyin 34—1552

par mi bya'o/ /mi gtsang thams cad za ba'am/ /dgra yi nang du phyin na yang //gtsang mar gyur pas rab mchod la/ /yi ge brgya pa bcang bar bya/ /gnod mdzes mgon po'i spyan sngar ni/ /bum chu 1la brgyar bzlas nas su/ /dad dang ldan la byin na ni/ /tshe dang nad med 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal 'phrog cing dpal bskyed la/ /sdig pa thams cad bzlog pa ste/ /ngan 'akro thams cad gzhig pa'i phyir/ /yi ge brgya pa bcang bar bya/ /gang zhig yi ge brgya pa 'chang / /dag byed bkra shis dpal dang ldan/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'jig par byed/ /lha rnams kun kyi byin gyis byerlob/ /zas dang de bzhin chang rnams la1/ /yi ge brgya pa bzlas na 4ni/ /bdud rtsir byed pa'i mchog yin te/ /dug rnams ma lus sel bar byed/ /gang zhig yi ge brgya pa 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gro 'byung po ro langs dang / /grib gnon dang ni brjed 5byed kyis/ /'tshe bar byed par mi nus so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis ni/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags gsungs te/ /bdud rtsir byed pa nyid dang ni//rga dang na dang 'jig byed pa'i/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod nas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag pas sngags zlos pa/ /ltung ba che dang ldan rnams kyang / /sangs rgyas nges par mthong bar 'gyur/ /g.yul du rgyal mtshan la btags te/ /yi ge brgya pa mchod byas nas6/ /rgyal po'i mdun du bzung na ni/ /dgra las rgyal zhing pha rol thub/ /g.yul sogs 'jigs 7pa mi bzad la/ /mtshon gyi char 'bab 'khrug pa ru/ /pha rol gnod pa byas na ni/ /rgyal 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa yis/ /mtshon cha gzhon pa lam 'jug dang / /rtsed mo glu gar dga' ston cher/ /'byor pa bde bar 'byung bar 34—1553

'gyur / /gsang sngags yi ge brgya zlas na/ /blun po blo ni 'phel 'gyur la/ /skal ngan rnams kyang skal ldan 'gyur/ /byur dang sdug bsngal rnam par 'jig /gal te dngos grub sgrub 'dod na/ /dam tshig spyod pa la gnas shing / /gsang sngags yi ge brgya bzlas pa/ /sngags pa yis ni rtag tu bya/ /dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dus dag dang / /sgrub pa ras ris bri nyub dang / /rkang bsku mig sman sa 'og la/ /gus pas yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ /gsang sngags yi ge brgya bzlas pas/ /tshul 'chal brtul zhugs can 'gyur zhing / /bcings pa 'ching ba las gol 'gyur/ /bud med nyid kyang skyes 5par 'gyur/ /yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba/ /rang bzhin gyis ni grub pa ste/ /lan cig brjod pa tsam gyis kyang / /shes rab pha rol phyin 'bras mnyam/ /sems rtogs par ni gang gsungs dang / /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /gang yang rdo rje'i bdag nyid gnas/ /ji bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nga rgyal dang / /me long la blta sngon 'gro dang / /dbab dang brtan par bya ba dag /thams cad yi ge brgya pas bya/ /yi ge brgya pa zlos byed cing / /sems dang mkha' la bzhag na ni/ /dag pa'i shel dang 'dra ba yi/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni 'bab par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid ni/ /mngon sum yi ge brgya nyid de/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis gzugs 5pa yin/ /tshe dang mdog dang gzi bskyed cing / /lus ni zhi dang rgyas par 'gyur/ /ji srid nyi zla skar ma gnas/ /de srid lus ni brtan par byed/ /gang zhig yi ge brgya pa bsgrub zhe/ /srog chags gsad 7par mi bya zhing / /dkon mchog gsum ni yong mi spang / /lha gzhan dag la 34—1554

phyag mi bya/ /yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi khyad par mthu / /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin dang / /'dra ba ma byung 'byung mi 'gyur / /nad ni chen por 'byung ba dang / /mu ge dgra dang 'thab pa dang / /tshe dang gnod byed grib mas phog /yi ge brgya pa bzlas par bya/ /bdud kyi las nyid byung ba na/ /yi ge brgya pa bris nas ni/ /rgyal mtshan la ni btags nas su/ /phyogs kun du ni bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin skur1 / /bdag nyid yongs su bsams nas ni/ /rnga chen dag ni brdungs nas su/ /gu gul gyis ni bdug par bya/ /gang du spyod pa'i gnas las bye ni/ /dgra bo nges par 'byung ba dang / /der ni bdud rnams 'jig 'gyur ba'i/ /dngos grub yi ge brgya pas bya/ /be+egs las khru gang tsam kyis ni/ /zhi ba'i spos khang byas nas su/ /yu ba rin chen rdo rjes brgyan/ /kha ni sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan/ /snod nyid kyi ni nang dag tu/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i pad+ma bya/ /de yi dbus su bri ba ni/ /rdo rje rtse gsum pa nyid de/ /drag cing 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs/ /bsreg pa'i bskal pa lta bur mchog /ha ha zhes bya'i sgra yis 'khrugs / /ba yi mar dang yang dag ldan/ /sa ni legs par brdungs nas su/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i pad+mo choni/ /bris nas sngags pas 'dab brgyad dang / /dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ /spos dang me tog rnams dang ni/ /zho dang bu ram kha ras mchod/ /ba yi rnam lngas bsang bya zhing / /sha ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /'bru rnams kun dang ldan pa dang / /til dang ma sha yang dag ldan / /'byung po thams cad tshim byed pa/ /phyogs rnams kun du gtor bar bya/ /gang zhig khyim der gnas pa yi/ /'byung po ring du song nas ni/ /34—1555

byedadapag tshad brgyar ni phyin nas su/ /ha ha zer zhing sems med gnas/ /ji srid nyi zla gnas kyi bar/ /khyem dang grong rdal ljongs rnams su/ /nor dang 'bru rnams 'byor pa dang / /bya ba thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyems pa yis/ /phyogs rnams kun du song nas ni/ /skad gdangs che ba dag gis ni/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags zlos shing / /g.yas kyis rdo rje bsor 3byas la/ /g.yon gyis de bzhin dril bu gzung — sna/ /a mṛ ta hūṃ zhes brjod cing / /rtag par phyogs su tsham ngam bya/ /de 'og rdo rje bsdams pa yis / /yu ba nas ni bzung nas su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 4bsgyings pa yis / /gsang sngags yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ /rig thu'adzin 'dis ni zhi ba la/ /'byung po bzlog pa'i phyag bya zhing / /gdon rnams ma lus rnam 'jig phyir/ /zhi ba'i mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /gtso bor gyur pa brgya nyid ni/ /lus nyid la ni rten 6byed pas/ /des na 'di yi ming gi gtso/ /rgyud 'dir yi ge brgya par bshad/ /mtshams med lnga dang ldan pa yang / /yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba'i//mtshan mchog gang gis thos gyur pa/ /ngan 'gro kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /gang la dmigs te gsang sngags ni/ /yi ge brgya zhes bya ba bri/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 7rang nyid ni/ /'chi bdag sgor bzhud bsnams nas byon/ /glegs bam la ni bris nas su/ /de bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad pa ni/ /dbus su ga bur bcug nas bcang / /khyim du dus gsum dag tu mchod/ /de ni dbul por mi 'gyur la/ /nad kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /yams dang gnod byed nyid dang ni/ /'chi bdag la ni rgyab kyis phyogs/ /gang zhig gsang sngags rgyal po 'di/ /lus dang ngag sems dang ba yis/ /mos pas mnyam gzhag 34—1556

bzlas na ni/ /sangs rgyas mchog nyid thob par 'gyur/ /de ni dus byed gyur pa na/ /dur khrod kyi ni sems can rnams/ /gang zhig dri ni snom byed pa/ /bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /skye ba de dang de dag tu/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs can 'gyur/ /mthar ni thar par gzhol 'gyur zhing / /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob par 'gyur/ /las rnams thams cad byed 'di nyid/ /bya ba thams cad sgrub par byed/ /zhi dang rgyas par byed pa dang / /tshe ring mngon par 'phel bar byed/ /gro ga'i gzhi la bris nas ni/ /gang zhig 'phral la 'chang byed pa/ /tshe zad gyur pa'ang bde bar ni/ /lo ni sum brgya 'tsho bar 'gyur / /'dir bshad pa/ oṃ badz+ra satwa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas so/ /sa ma ya rdo rje rgyal po'i sgo nas so/ /ma nu pā la ya rdo rje chags pa'i sgo nas so/ /badz+ra satwa twe 1no pa tiṣ+ṭha rdo rje legs pa'i sgo nas so/ /dṛ ḍho me bha ba rdo rje rin chen kyi sgo nas so/ /su toṣ+yo me bha ba rdo rje gzi brjid kyi sgo nas so/ /a nu rak+to me bha ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi sgo nas so/ /su poṣ+yo me bha ba rdo rje bzhad pa'i sgo nas so/ /sarba sidhim+me pra yats+tsha rdo rje chos kyi sgo nas so/ /sarba karma su tsa me rdo rje rnon po'i sgo nas so/ /tsit+t+waṃ she yaḥku ru rdo rje rgyu'i sgo nas so/ /hūṃ ha ha ha ha rdo rje smra ba'i sgo nas so/ /ho bha ga bān 2sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rdo rje las kyi sgo nas so/ /mā me muñca badz+rī bha ba rdo rje srung ba'i sgo nas so/ /ma hā sa ma ya satwa rdo rje gnod sbyin 4gyi sgo nas so/ /āḥrdo rje khu tshur gyi sgo nas so/ /yi ge brgya pa bshad pa las/ /bsod nams legs par gang bsags pa/ /des ni 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /yi ge brgya pa'i bshad pa la5/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i rdo rje lcags kyus stong phrag brgya pa las ji 34—1557
