1555༄7/ /yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga—1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha tāk+ṣa ra bi byeḥrte/ bod skad du/ yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du 'dug ste/ sa phyogs der sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun kyi bar snang la dmigs te/ de rnams la dang por mchod pa dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / spyig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / lam la gnas pa la sogs pa byas nas/ de'i 'og tu bdag dang dngos po thams cad mi snang bar byas shing sngags 'dis stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shudheḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shusgophohaṃ/ de nas oṃ tsit+t+waṃ 4pra ti bya 5 sgo kā ro mi/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs can bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ bo bye 34byed/560

tsit+ta ut+pād yā kyemi/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis de nyid spro bar bya'o/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra / zhes bya bas bye hūṃ las byung ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad dang mnyam par gnas pa'i rdo rje bsams la/ de nas rdo rje'i gzugs de las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 'dus pa dang / rdo rje dang zla ba yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams par sngags 'dis bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /satwa sarba ta thā ga ta ta rngo thā ma haṃ/4 de'i 'og tu hūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa bsams la/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar jusnye dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /shar phyogs su mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag tu tremed pa/ byang du don yod grub pa'o/ /shar lhor rdo rje sems ma/ phyag gnyis pa sgu mdog nag po/ phyag g.yon pa dkur 7brten pa/ phyag rked par 'jog pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /lho nub tu rdo rje rin chen ma sku mdog ser ba phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ phyag g.yas na rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /nub byang du rdo rje chos ma sgu mdog dmar ba/phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yon pa dkur 9brten pa/ phyag g.yas na pad+ma bsnams pa'o / /byang shar du rdo rje las ma sku mdog ljang gu phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yon dkur khubarten pa/ phyag g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /'khor lo'i dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams te bskor phyogs su rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rtsibs bcu drug la bsam par bya ste/ de la rtsibs kyi dbus su thams cad kyang sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs par bya'o/ /34—1561

de la dbang ldan gyi phyogs su rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ljang gu g.yon pa bstems pas dkur /༄1brten pa/ phyag g.yas na rang gi thugs kar rdo rje bstod pa'i tshul gyis dwa bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje rgyal po sgu mdog ser po rdo rje lcags kyus 'gugs pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje chags pa sku mdog nag ③bo phyag na mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje legs pa sku mdog margad lta bu/ phyag gnyis kyis legs so zhes bya ba sbyin par byed pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen sku mdog ser po rang gi dbang bsgur ba'i gnas su phyag gnyis kyis dbang bskur ba'i phreng ba 'ching ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis kyis 5thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan sku mdog nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs 'uphyag gnyis kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje bzhad pa sku mdog pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar po phyag gnyis kyis 7so'i phreng ba gnyi ga dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gnyis bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje chos sgu mdog dmar skya phyag g.yon pas pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin cing phyag g.yas pas pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'byed pa'o/ /rdo rje rnon po sgu mdog gur kum gyi mdog can/ phyag g.yon pas thugs kar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa phyag g.yas kyis ral gri 'phyar ba'o/ /rdo rje rgyu gser gyi mdog can chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje smra ba sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yon pa na dung bsnams pa phyag g.yas pa lce'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o / /rdo rje las sgu mdog ljang gu phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum bsnams nas spyi bor 'jog cing gar mdzad pas bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje srung ba sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis kyis 8 rdo rje go cha bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog 9nag 34—/562

po phyag gnyis kyis 1mche ba gnyis rang bzhin gyis — thad kar bsnams nas gdug pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pas bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje bsnams pa dang ldan par bsam mo 4de nas rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya bcings la sa ma ya ho5/ haṃ zhes bya bas bdag nyid la bltas la/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis mdun du ye shes sems dpa' zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs par bsgoms la/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ / zhes bya ba 'dis snying gar bcug ste/ bdag dang mi gnyis pa'i bdag nyid du bsgom mo/ /de nas yi ge hūṃ las byung ba skurdo rje 'od dang ldan pa'i tshul can gyi lce bsam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rnams kyi 7bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang cod pan gyi dbang dang / phreng ba'i dbang dang / rdo rje'i dbang la sogs pa rdo rje sems ma la sogs pa — rnams kyis dbang (bskur bar bsam mo/ /yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //34—1563

1556༄ / /bzlas pa'i phreng ba'i mtshan nyid/kū sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ak+ṣa su 5tra lak+ṣa ṇa/ bod skad du/bzlas pa'i phreng ba'i mtshan nyid/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la lha mo sangs rgyas spyan mas zhus pa/ bzlas pa'i phreng ba'i don ci lags/ /mchog gi dbang phyug gis gsung du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa/ lha mo nyon cig rab tu bshad do/ /khyod kyis zhus pa de brjod par bya'o/ /de thams cad kyi gtam bshad do/ //sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don du'o/ /mi spang 1ba'i sems kyi sdom pa de bzhin du bsod nams dang ye shes mi spang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i bzlas pa'i phreng ba 'di'o/ /gang la bzlas pa'i phreng ba la dad pa mos pa 5gus pas gzung 6ngo / /sdig pa thams cad spong ngo / /sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gang du bzung 7na mgrin pa dang lag pa'i rtsa bar ro/ /des ni bya ba thams cad 34—1565

'grub par nges so/ /bzlas pa byas pas lha mo dang dpa' bo nges par grub pa rab tu ster ro/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis thob pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam par 'byung ngo / /byis pa gzhon nu rnams kyis sdig pa mang po byas pa dang / thams cad spangs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa gcig pa'i bzlas pa'i skud pa 'dzin pas/ bzlas na lha'i skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /byed kyi tshad kyis bzlas na des lha dang lha mo'i bde ba lhamathong ngo mang hūṃb yis bzlas na brdzun pa'i ngag spangs pa'o/ /dung gi la bzlas pa'i bye yon tan gcig 'byung ngo / /lung tang la bzlas pas yon tan gnyis 'byung ngo / /lcags la bzlas pas yon tan gsum 'byung ngo / / de la la sngubazlas pas yon tan bzhi'o/ /nor bu mu tig byi ru chol bzlas pas yon tan bcu dran no/ /dbang po'i dmigs la bzlas pas yon tan bcu 6'byung ngo / /pad+ma la bzlas pas yon tan bye ba'o/ /yon tan bye ba ru dāk+ṣa dze+ela'o/ /bo de tsi la bzlas pas bcu drug dang 'dra bar dus 'das pa yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo / /bzlas pa rngo phreng ba'i yon tan 'di dag rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa'o/ /mkhas pas lhag pa dang chad par mi bya'o/ /lhag pa chad pa la bgegs chen po 'jug go/ —/des na mnyam par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dus song nas sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /sdigs 1mdzub snying gar byas te mdzub mos bzlas na bgegs bkug nas tshar gcod par 'gyur ro/ /gung mos bgrangs pas the tshom med par dngos grub 'byung ngo / /srin lag gis 11bgrangs pas gnod sbyin gyi dngos grub 'grub bo/ /mje chung gis lkubagrangs pas sha za dgug pa dang bskrad pa 'grub bo/ /mdo 'dzin la bskor zhing bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i phreng ba'i 34—1566

mazurgan nyid cardogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta sa ①ra he ta dang / lo tsā 2 ba dge slong shes rab rgyal mazurngan gyis btā/rig batshe(// //bsdur mchan/1565 lhamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzlas pa'i phreng ba'i mtshan nyid bzhugs so// 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thu/ sa④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgong / 5〈〈snar 〉〉pas/trem〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung /1566 4)〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sdo/ /45〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gang / (5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉te la la/ 〈〈snar 〉〉te la—/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu ru'i/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wabacu/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phug bye ba ru drak+ta/3)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdog te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ skye6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang /1567 tu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1483)34wa 1567

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sna kru bi dhiḥ1/ bod skad du/ sku khrus kyi cho ga /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po rnal 'byor pa man ngag thob pas rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ rang dang gzhan gyi ngo bo thob pa'i phyir bsod nams 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas la sku khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /de la 'di'i cho ga ni/ ci 'byor zhing gang thob pa'i me tog bdug pa mar me dri mchog zhal zas dang / na bza' rgyan sogs 4mchod yon bum par 'bru lnga ni 5nas gro so ba til sran ma/ bo ga 'di dang / yungs kar dang star ka shri tsipha la go yu dzā ti pha la la sogs pa dang / sman lnga ni ha sa de ba kaṇ+ḍa ka ri gre ha de ba ba 7la mu tra la sogs pa dang / dri zhim po'i sman dang dri zhim po'i mar khu mar zho dang 'o ma dang / ma su ra'i phye ma dang / gro bag phye dang / dar kha dog lnga pa'i 'phan dpyangs la bum pa byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bya'o/ /34—1568

—de'i cho ga 'di'o/ /mdun du gang yin pa'i lkukha dog la sogs pas maṇ+ḍal bya'o//g.yas su ci 'byor pa'i rdzas bzhag la/ de nas maṇ+ḍa la sngon du bum pa bcu'am lnga'am 37gcig gi nang du srog chags rnged pa'i dri zhim po'i chus yongs su gang ba — 'bru dang bri 3ha de ba la sogs pa gos phrog 5can gyis mgrin pa bcings la/g.yon du snod cig yang dag par gzhag go/ /mchod yon kyi snod dri zhim po'i chu dang zho dang bo ga ling dang sman dang yungs kar nidang ko su ma dang go yu rnams yang dag par bshams la/ yi dam gyi lha'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la / de nas las thams cad pa'i sgod g.yas su dri zhim pa'i chus yongs su gang ba gzhag go/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyang bzlas te'o/ /de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum par zla ba rdo rje la sogs pa'am/ skad cig mas bsgom thupa'i rim pas 87sdogs par bya'o/ /pad+ma lnga la hūṃ gyur pa las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa she las 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa gzhug 0par bya'o/ /de zhu bas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dril bu bsgying 7bas 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ snying gar zla ba rdo rje hūṃ gi rnam pa'o/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan bsam gtan bya'o/ /de bzhin du bum pa 15rnam par snang mdzad/rin chen 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas don yod grub pa/ spyan ma/ mā ma k+ṇi/ gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma bdud rtsi 'khyil pa mtha' mar rdzogs pa ni phyag gnyis pa zhal gcig pa rang gi mtshan ma 1/'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rang gi sa bon dang mtshan ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yon brkyang ba'i bdud rtsi 'khyel pa sdigs mdzub dang rdo rje bsor ⑩ba bsgom mo//34—1569

yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod cing sor mo'i rdo rje dang / yi ge gsum gyi 1me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de2/ de nas dril bu'i sngags kyis mchod / de la sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇa ra ṇa pra ra ṇa pra ra ṇa saṃ pra ra ṇa saṃ pra ra ṇa / sarba budhe k+ṣe tra pra tsa li 5ta ma hā pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā swa bhā 3ba be+e shudhe 6badz+ra z-i 7da ya sadho ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nyid g.yas pa'i sor mos rdo rje dang spos khang bzung /la g.yon pas dril bu dkrol lo/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod do/ /oṃ badz+ra dh+rika 9yi hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ dzi na dzika āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ rat+na dh+rika ā hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ ā ro li ka āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra j-ika āḥ swā hā/ oṃ ru ru sru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sidha lo tsa ni sarba arja sā dha ni swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ 1 ka ri shādz+rī—ka ri go tra ni ⑫ga te ga te ku tra ni swā hā/ oṃ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi ni ka ṭi ka ṭi ka ro ṭi sabi ri swā hā/ oṃ tā re tuja dz+ware tu re swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāka tsit+tha badzā nyu/rde na mo/ badz+ra kro dhā 1 ya ma hā rdasgoṅka ṭa ༄ bye ra wā 1ya a se mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha hastu —rteya/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha / brnya ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/ bi sgo ṭa ya sarba bispyo 5bi nā ya shaṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dz+re bi tān+ta ka ra dziya t+t+waṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di ni spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /de nas sngags 'di rim pa ji lta bar rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pa'i bum par mchod yon me tog la sogs pa sbyin no/ /sngon du brjod pa'i dril bu dkrol zhing sbyin no/ /snang gsal mar me dri mchog zhal zas kyis gang ba'i snod sbyin no/ /de nas g.yon pa'i dril bu dkur brten la g.yas pa'i sor mo rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya bum pa'i steng du yang dag par bzhag la yang me tog la sogs 34—1370

pas mchod do/ /zhu ba'i bsam gtan gyi bum pa 1bhebyin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas thang sku la sogs pa la bcom ldan 'das ma'i yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /khrus kyi las kyi yo byad dang / shis pa'i cho ga ni sgod kyi stegs gegru gsum pa'i shing bzhag la/ de'i gru la chang ba ge gnyis dang me'i snod dang mar me gsum bzhag la sngon du g.yas④/ yungs kar las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags te/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ sngags 'dis me'i nang du blugs la sabadud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsnyen 6la lan gsum bskor te phyi rol du dor ro/ /bsang gtor gyis khrus bya ba'i thabs ni/ de bzhin du me tog la sogs pa la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bsang gtor gyis gtor te/ bsang gtor gyis ༷me long leg/sa par phyis la/ oṃ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ rig pa dang ni zhabs su ldan/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen/ /bla na med pa'i skyes bu dang / /'dul ba'i kha los 8sgyur ba dang / /lha dang mi yi ston pa ni/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid do/ /de dag la 'dir mchod pa'i rdzas rnams dang / khrus kyi yo byad thams cad thogs te sngon du mchod pa lngas mchod do/ /rim pas 'dag pa'i tshal ḍadang so shing dang bum pa'i chus bkru'o/ /zho dang 'o ma dang 'bru lnga dang bo 1 ga ling dang star ka la sogs pa'i 'bras bu dang / sman lnga dang de bzhin du sman thams cad dang / rin po che dang gur kum dang dri bzangs 1 thams cad do/ /der rdzas rnams te bum pa'i chus bkru'o/ /oṃ rang gi rdzas dang sna na pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye tri ya bri he hūṃ/ zhes pa'i 34—1071

sngags kyis so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta skyekā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ chus bkru ba'i sngags so/ /las thams cad pa'i bum pas bya'o/ /de nas lha la dbang bskur chen po bya ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags phreng rnams gedang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo'i sngags brjod cing 7/ de bzhin bltams pa rtsom ④ dus su / /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /bdag gis ltade bzhin khrus bya'o/ /zhes pas so/ /yang dag par rgyal ba'i bum pa la me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ yi ge brgya pa dang de bzhin du badz+ra j-ika la sogs pa dang / o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ye hri bi hūṃ/ zhes pas dbang bskur ro/ /de nas dri zhim po'i bdug pa la ras dag pas bdug ste/me long gi chu dag par bya'o/ /dri zhim pa'i rdzas kyis skyeme long la maṇ+ḍal lnga'i mtshan ma byas te/ der me tog bzhag ste gzhug 3par bya'o/ /dril bu dang bdug spos thogs te sngon du mchod rīpa'i bdug pa dang me tog la sogs pas mchod pa bya ste lha bshos kyi sgod dbul lo/ /yi dam kyi lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa la zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod pa phul la gtor ma sbyin no/ /bstod pas bstod de 9me tog dor te gzhag go/ /sems can kyi don du bsod nams bsngo'o / /de nas gshegs su gsol lo 'di ni khrus kyi cho ga'o// //paṇ+ḍi ta sa ra te ta dang / lo tsā ba nag tsho dge slong shes rab rgyal mtshan kyis bsgyur ba'o// //3 4—1572
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1484)34wa 1574

1558༄༅/ /mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho gasne ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ rtsa t+ya bi byeḥkye/ bod skad du/ mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo / /gang gis sgu gsum brnyes te 'gro don mthar phyin pa/ /de la phyag 'tshal nas ni de nyid bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /rang gis rtogs snepa gtsor byas lung kun tshul mi 'gal/ /rnal 'byor gzhung lugs mchod rten bshad par bya/ /de la dang por gnas dben pa yid du 'ong bar byi dor byas la ziji skad bshad pa'i sa sbyang ba la sogs pa'i 5cho ga byas te/ der stegs bu ji ltar mos pa byas la ba'i phyi ba dang tsan+dan dang gur kum la sogs pa ci 'byor pa'i dri zhim po'i chus skyang nul byas te me tog gi sil ma bkram/ nye 'khor spos chus chag chag gdab/ bla re dang 'phan la sogs pa dag dang rol mo'i rnam pa dag dang /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa dag dang / mchod pa'i bye brag rnams 34—1575

'byor tshad bshams la gzhag /gzhan yang mchod rten nam tsha tsha'i yo byad skol phor dang / sku gdung dang / rtsa ba'i snying po'am rten 'brel gyi snying po dang /gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs 1dang / 'bru mar ga bur la sogs pa 3dri zhim pos bsgyur ba dang / phag ze dang gang gi don du bya ba'i ming dang / me tog la sogs te mchod pa lnga dang / 'khor lo la sogs pa dag kyang bshams te gzhag /tsha tsha 'debs pa'i slob dpon la sogs pa kun kyang ji skad gsungs pa'i khrus dag byas te/ gos gtsang ma bgo ba dang rgyan gyis brgyan te/ shar dang nub gang bde bar stan bting ste sdig pa bshags pa 4dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed nga/ dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / sdom pa gzung ba dang /phyag bzhi pas phyag bya ste/ cho ga'i rim pa rang gi lugs bzhin byas la mnyam par bzhag nas rtag tu byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis mchod rten gdab par bya'o/ /mchod rten gdab pa'i sa gar brko 1ba'i gnas der brtag cing byin gyis brlabs te bgegs bskrad pa dang / gtor ma byin te tshom/ sgud la sngags / oṃ badz+ra su tshotra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba dang rdo rje'i skud par bsams la/ sa khyon byu ran tsam 7tshon skud kyis bskor te/ seng ldeng ngam lcags phur byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa dang sngags bzlas te gdab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra shā li tī la 9ya sarba dubyen rta hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bu'i sngags de lan bdun bzlas la dbus dang phyogs bzhir gdab bo/ /yungs kar dang spos chu bsres la sngags bzlas la phyogs der gtor ro/ /bdud rtsi thab spyor gyi sngags dang phyag 11rgya bya'o/ /de nas ci tsam 'dod pa'i sa de dag brko'o/ /sngags la oṃ badz+ra kha na kha nā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod do/ /sa gzhi de nyid rin po cher gyur 34—1576

par bsam mo/ /de nas brkos te cho ga pa dang hūṃ bzhis phur bu thams cad bton la/ oṃ ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sidha lo tsa ni sarba arba sā dha ne+e swā hā/zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur bu bkrus te bu gar drugs so/ /sa blangs pa rnams kyang phyogs gcig tu snod gtsang ma'i steng du bzhag ste/ sa brdung ba'i ༄1tho ba la rdo rje tho ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra 2 ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brdung ngo / /de nas 'jim pa sbru ba'i tshe spos chu lang/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te byen kyis brlabs la spos chu de a dkar po las yezla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te/de'i 'od zer gyis spos chu nyid khyab par 'khyil nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la sbru'o/ /sngags la oṃ badz+ra pra marda nā ya swā hā/ zhes pas so / /de nas 'jim pa de la bdud rtsi thab spyor kyi phyag rgya lag pa g.yon pa'i thal mo bang bar bkan la mje'u chung gi sen mo maze bos mnan te/ sor mo gsum nas re tsam phye ste gzhag pa'i steng du lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mo kha spub la/g.yon pa ltar byas te 'jim pa'i steng du bzhag la rig pa chen mo'i sngags3/oṃ susgre susgre sugh+ra a nu ga te nir ku le ni rba ṇi sarba budha yā nu ga te ya sho ba ti ya sho dzi ni dharma dhā 9tu gasgo/ dharma khorā dza ba shi te/ sarba busnyo a dhiṣ+ṭṛ 1 te swā hā / zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la byin kyis brlabs pas de las ye shes kyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sems can kyi don byas te slar bsdus pas 'jim pa de nyid rin po che sna lnga'i gong bu'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de nas 'bi 'bi bya ba'i sngags la/ oṃ badz+red bhā tshebā ya swā hā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas pas ye shes lnga'i 'od zer gyi sprin gyis 1 phyogs bcu mtha' yas par 34—1577

'phros shing khengs te 'gro ba mang po'i don byas nas/ slar 'dus pa 'bi 'bi'i nang du zhugs te thim par gyur pas/ ye shes lnga rgyas te shel sgong dag pa ltar bsam mo/ /rang rang gi sa bon gyis ༄geseng ge la sogs pa dang / rin po che'i gdan dang nyi zla dang pad+ma'i gdan khrir phyogs phyogs su gdan bshams la/de rnams kyi dbus su sa bon gyi yi ge dang 'byin ṭupa'i yi ges rang rang gi sgrub thabs las ji skad gsungs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gsum dang ldan pa dang /rnal 'byor gsum gyis ༄ rdzogs pa phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rim pa bzhin du rang rang gi sgrub thabs las bstan pa ji bzhin du byas te /tsan+dan gyi lde gus thig le zlum por byas la byin kyis brlab pa ni hūṃ dmar po las ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bas de penyid du rab tu sbyangs te/ gzhi de yang rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsam mo/ /de nas re re'i gdan du yang cepad+ma 'dab ma 7brgyad pa'i steng du a dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam mo/ /de'i dbus su gong du bshad pa ltar lha re re nas rang gi rtog pa las 'byung ba ltar bzhugs su gsol te dam tshig sems dpar byas la/ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te lcags kyu la sogs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang rmedabang du byas te bsgrub /zhepar bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyang phyag rgya chen po dang ldan pas snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa las ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'phro bar bsams la / ba spu'i gseb thams cad nas kyang ye shes kyi 'od zer dang / bde bar gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa sprin phung ltar mu 'byam par 'phro shing —/sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi don mdzad cing byin gyis brlabs nas slar 34—/578

'dus te/ dam tshig sems dpa' de nyid la thim par bsam mo/ /de nas mchod pa lnga la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i 1 tshogs kyis yang dag par mchod nas/lha so so'i bstod pa re re nas byas la so so'i phrin las dang dam tshig gi sgo nas smon lam gdab bo/ /de la 'di nyid kyi cho ga'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ 'bi 'bi'i 2nang du lha so so'i snying po/ oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ spyoḥ.aḥ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang snyeng po gong ma gnyis bcug la/ sngags badz+ra dharma dhā tu gasgo dz+wa la swā hā/zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes de de'i nang du zhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas skol 5phor du yungs mar ram til mar gyis bsku ba'i sngags/ o a ra dze bi ra swā hā/ zhes gsum brjod pas byang chub kyi sems bsgom trepar bsam mo/ /de nas skol 7phor du gzhug pa'i sngags/oṃ badz+ra dhā 8tu gasgo swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ thabs dang shes rab 'byel pa las chos kyi dbyings su bsam mo/ /de nas brdung ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ/ gong ma'i snying po gnyis kyang brjod la/ dbyung ba'i sngags oṃ dharma 9ra te swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa las chos kyi sgur grub par bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma kā ya ma hā su kha tsosu ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de las gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis byung bas 'gro ba'i don bsam gyis mi khyab par bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sasto ga kā ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nirma ṇa kā ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de la dang por mchod rten ni chos kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan zhes smos te/ sa dang rdo dang shing dang gser dngul la sogs pa dag las sems can kyi rtsol bas bsgrubs te/ dbyibs kyi bye brag tu 3rwa1—1579

byas pa de dag ni gzugs brnyan zhes gdags te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhung dag las/ chos kyi sku ni sku med nam mkha' 'dra/ /zhes 'byung ste/ brjod du med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin yang chos thams cad kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu'i don gyis mchog rten gyi dbyibs lta bur grub pas/ des na chos kyi sku 1ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa de la chos kyi sku zhes 'dod do/ /de bas na 'di ltar snang ba ni gzugs brnyan yin par shes par bya'o/ /yang na gzugs 'di ltar grub pa ni sku gsum gyi tshul yin te rmang dge ba bcu dang /bang rim dang po nas kha khyer gyi bar du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / srog shing shes pa bcu'i bar du rgyu'i chos bsod nams kyi tshogs yin te sprul pa'i sku yin pa dang / 'khor lo bcu gsum stobs bcu dang /ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / char khebs 2 thugs rje chen po dang / zla tshes byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa dang / me long ye shes gzhi 1dang / tog mngon par shes pa drug dang / dar gye cod pan dang gdugs kyis rmechos kyi skur mnga' gsol te chos kyi rgyal por gyur pa dang / chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan chen po ste/ nam mkha' lding gi kha nas snyebyung ba ni thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i stobs dang ye shes kyi shugs mnga' ba dang / ba dan chos kyi grags pa chen po dang / dril bu snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab pa dang / rdo rings 6mi 'jigs pa bzhi brnyes pa dang /them skas srung ༷ba med pa gsum mam so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'am rnam par thar pa bzhi ste/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa dang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal zhing rnam par dag pa'i lam 24—1580

mkhyen pa dang / dril bu tshangs pa'i dbyangs sam gsung yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas de dag ni 'bras bu'i chos ye shes kyi tshogs yin pas chos kyi sku/ra bstan pa dang / a ma la sar dzorin po che'i phreng ba dang / gzhan yang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis spras pa mdzes pa dang blta bas chog mi shes pa sems can thams cad kyi dbang po tshim par byed pa longs spyod dze+egs pa'i sku ste de dag ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos te/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba dang byang chub sems dpa' dang de bzhin gshegs pa spyi la bstan pa'i chos shin tu rgya che ba'obhe / /de bas na 'di ni sku gsum gyi dam tshig gi sems dpar byas la dus gsum kyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad dam/ dkyil 'khor gang dang gang la mos pa'i lha rnams sku gsum brnyes pa'am/ ldan pa de dag gi sku gsum ye shes kyi sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings nas spyan drangs te/ bstems 4nas bsgrub pa ni be+egs kyu la sogs pa ltasngags dang phyag rgya dang 6gong du bstan pa'i sgu gsum gyi snying pos bya'o/ /srog shing gi sngags la/ oṃ badz+ra ā 7yu ṣe swā hā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos yun ring du mi nub par gyur cig /sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun du bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig /'khor lo'i sngags la/ oṃ pra marda na ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum thob par gyur cig /rnam par thar pa brgyad thob par gyur cig/ye shes bzhi dang ldan par gyur cig /dar gyi cod pan gyi sngags la/ oṃ pa shaṃ pa la swā hā/ sems can thams cad dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dar gyi 34—1581

lhab lcub la sogs pa mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / de dag gi mchod rten dang sku gzugs dang gsung rab la sogs pa yang dag pa la mchod pa byed par gyur cig /ba dan gyi sngags la/ oṃ pā tai ke 3snaswā hā/ sems can thams cad chos kyi grags pa dang 2snyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig /chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan gyi sngags la/ oṃ kum+bhi ra dh+wa dza swā hā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi spong ba'i bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /gdugs kyi sngags la/ oṃ pra ma na ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan zhing chos kyi rgyal po chen por gyur cig /me tog gi phreng ba'i sngags la/ oṃ rat+na mā 4le tram̐/ zhes bya ba'am/ na maḥshe ya dh+wa sa nu ga ta pra tiṣ+ṭha ta/ puṣ+pe ke ta be+e ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyak+shi bud+dhā ya/tar+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe swā hā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan te blta bas chog mi shes pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig /gdan dbul ba'i sngags la/ oṃ sun+da ri dza ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu dang ldan la glang po che'i gdan dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i gdan dang / rdzu 'phrul gye rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa rta'i gdan dang / dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang / thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i shugs dang ldan pa'i nam mkha' lding gi gdan dang /dgos 'dod re ba yid bzhin du byung ba rin po che'i gdan dang / chags pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa pad+ma'i gdan dang / thams cad du rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan thob par gyur cig /de nas mchod rten la na 3 4—1pya82

bza' gsol ba'i sngags la/ oṃ dharma kyidhā tu swa bhā ba bi shudhe dharma 5te swā hā/gzhal yas khang du gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags la/ oṃ dha ra dha ra ku ṭa gar ye swā hā/ bzhugs su gsol ba'i sngags la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ rin po che'i gzhal med khang chos kyi dbyings zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs par bsams/ de nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i phyag rgya bcings la dbur bzhag ste dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /sngags la oṃ badz+ra bhā tu a bye tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ de ltar dbang bskur bas de'i ngo bo nyid du brtan par gyur pa yin no / /de ltar mchod rten gdab pa yang sngar bshad pa ltar rim pa bzhin bya ste/dang por mnyam par bzhag ste/ chos thams cad la mi gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas/ 'gro ba mtha' dag dang gang gi 4don du bya ba de la byams pa dang snyeng rjes thu'adi skad brjod par bya'o/ /ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ngo / /bdud la sogs pa phas kyi 5rgol ba bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgye'o / / sems can rnams nying 3mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rnyog pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o/ /skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcod 3do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang phyi rol ba dag dang lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bgyi'o/ /las kyi chu bo bzlog 9 par bgyi'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho bskam par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgron ma rab tu sbar bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi lam bstan par bkyi'o/ /bzod pa 34—1583

dang nges pa la gzud par bgyi'o/ /bsam gtan gye bde ba la cher tūsprul to/ /'dod chags kyi me dpung zhi bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon rnon po bcil bar bgyi'o / /bde ba la gzud do/ /phrag dog gi 'tshub trem zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub mchog sprul nas gnang 4ba dam pa mdzad du gsol/ de nas gong du bshad pa ji bzhin du byas la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa dag dang 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te/ tshul bzhin du so so'i sgu mdog dang phyag mtshan dang /sngags dang phyag rgya dang cho ga go rims phyaji lta ba bzhin du bya'o/ /yang na ye shes lnga las grub pa'i mchod rten rang bzhin gyis dag cing gsal ba de dag gi bum pa'i dbus su gong du smos pa'i snying po gang yang rung ba bcug la de dag las ye shes kyi 'od zer grangs med pa 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku grangs med pa'i sprin phung gis nam mkha'i bhematha' klas shing chos kyi dbyings mur thug par brgyan zhing bklubs 7par gyur nas 'jig rten thams cad byin gyis brlabs te 'gro ba thams cad kyi 8don mdzad cing re ba bskangs nas slar 'dus de nyid kyi dbu'i spyi gtsug dang thugs kar zim pas bsgrub 9snapar bya ba de'i las dang ༷nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag ste/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje nyid du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta ma hā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas bya ba'am/ phyag rgya bzhis brtan par 31byed/58 /

byas te/ dung phor gyi nang du dri spos sna tshogs dang / 'bras yos dang 'o mar ldan pa'i mchod yon gsol te/ ar+gha'i lkuphyag rgya'i steng du dung phor bzhag la yon chab kyi nang du a dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i 'od zer gyis yon chab nyid bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la so so'i rigs kyi snying po bzlas la dbul lo/ /oṃ a mṛ te ar+ghaṃ dhū 1pe pra tīts+tsha 4swā hā / zhes lan gsum spyi bor bzhag ste dz+reng ngo / /'phags pa thams cad mnyes par gyur byug /phyag rgya rgya mtsho 3sprin nyid kyi dbu'i gtsug tu bkram ༷ ste ye shes kyi 'od zer 'dus pa'i sku nang du thim zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang bsgur bar bsam mo/ /de nas mchod pa lnga dang mchod pa nyi shu dang / sgeg mo la sogs pa mchod pa brgyad kyis tsomachod pa dang / mchod pa thams cad rnam par sbyang zhing dag par bya ba'i sngags/ oṃ sarba pū dza ā yu ༄8 swā hā/zhes bya ba dang / oṃ las byung ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyang sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas te dbul lo/ /de nas rdo rje dang dril bu blangs la bstod pa bya'o/ /'gro ba rgyu 9lnga'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs pa'i spyod gyur kyang / /chags pas ma shā1gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sems can bkres pa chos kyis phongs gyur paskye/ /ma rig thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgon ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'khor 34—1585

ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur zhugs nas/ /zhi ba rin chen mchog nyugling skyel mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyed la rnam par 'dud/ /sems can las kyi chu bos bdas risnye pa rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing / /'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa—/ /gsung gi pre mnga' bdag khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas smon lam rgya cher gdab po/ /bdag cag gis che ge'i don du chos kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan bzhengs su gsol ④te/ mchod cing bstod de bsgrubs pa la sogs pa dag snye pa'i rtsa ba 'dis che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor bas rtematshams sbyor ba'i bag chags thams cad rtsad nas gcod 3de sku gsum yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /mchod rten gcig byas pas kyang che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs — ༄bye bar bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig la sogs pa smon lam gzhan dag kyang rgya cher bya'o/ /de ltar mchod rten grub pa'i rtags gsungs pa/ de nas mchod rten 'bar 'gyur she tam / /yang na gzugs kyi zhal 'dzum mam/ /dri dang dud pa 'od kyang rung / /snang ngam yang na ngad ldang ngam/ /lha la sogs pa'i rnam pa ni/ /sna tshogs bar snang snang gyur tam/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa dang / /me tog la sogs 'bab pa dang / /dung dang rnga la sogs pa'i sgra/ /dril bu pi wang la sogs rnams//ci ste rka mtshan ma de dag ni/ /sdeg pa'i blos ni ma mthong na/ /'bum gyi phrag ni brgya stong ngam/ /ji srid mtshan ma byung bar du/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod nas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bzlas pa bya/ /de yi mthar ni mkhas pas kyang / /mtshan gcig mi nyal thog thag /1bzlas/ /de nas de yi sdig pa ni/ /dag pa nyid 34byed/586

du nges par mthong / /zhes smos so/ /mchod rten cho ga bdag gis cung zad tsam/ /byas la bsod nams rnam pa ci yod pa/ /des ni 'gro kun skye shi rgyun bcad de/ /bla med sku gsum rdzogs te sangs rgyas shog/ //bi ma la uṭī ṣa'i gzungs las mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang bsdebs tsho—te slob dpon zhi ba'i snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1575 1mtshan byang 'di chos ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ akyo bh+ya 3sā dha rgo nā mag/ bod skad du/mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba / bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya / /dal 'byor theg chen rigs chen 4dang / /snying rje shes rab yon tan dang 5/ /byams dang snying rje ldan pa dang / /dad cing bla ma la gus pas/ /skyabs su song zhing sems bskyed pa/ /dam tshig sdom ldan dbang thob pas /las dang cho ga shes nas ni/ /dgon pa'i gnas dang grong gi mthar/ /las bya bde ba'i stan 'dug nas/ /khrus byas gtsang ma'i gos can gyis/ /rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng du hūṃ/ /de nas 6'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni mi bskyod pa/ /spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs pa la/ /bdun po rnam par dag par bya/ /tshad med bzhi dang ldan par bsgom//34—1589

chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis bsgom par byas nas ni/ /rja 1dang paṃ las sna tshogs bsgom/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon dbus bsams nas/ /dam tshig dag dang phyag rgya dag /bsam zhing de bzhin nyid du sbyar/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bsgrub par bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ /g.yon pa mnyam gzhag rdo rje dang / /g.yas pa sa gnon tshul can no/ /rgyan dang ldan par rang nyid bsgom/ /thugs kar pad zla'i steng du ni/ /de steng rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag mtshan phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ /rang nyid mi 'khrugs par bsgoms nas/ /sangs rgyas bzhi po phyogs dang bstun/ /rang rang phyag rgya ldan par bsgom/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros pad+mo snyeyi// /'dab ma brgyad la lha mo brgyad/ /phyag mtshan brgyad las sku bskyed do/ /rtsa sngags brgyad po brjod pa las / /dri za'i phyogs su pad+ma can/ /sku mdog dkar mo dpal be'u bsnams/ /me yi phyogs su 'jigs byed ma/ /sku mdog dkar mo 'khor lo bsnams/ /gshin rje'i phyogs su rnam rgyal ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /bden bral phyogs su mdangs ldan ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo gdugs bsnams pa/ /klu yi phyogs su 'od ldan ma/ /sku mdog dmar skya pad+ma bsnams/ /rlung gi phyogs su dkar sham ma/ /sku mdog dmar skya bum nga/ bsnams// /gnod sbyin phyogs su dri med ma5/ /sku mdog ljang gu 'bud dung bsnams/ /dbang ldan phyogs su yid gzhungs ma/ /sku mdog ljang gu nya bsnams pa'o/ /sgo ma bzhi po 'dod lha ste/ /phyogs dang bstun zhing phyogs skyong dang / /gzhal yas rim par bsgom snapar bya/ /de ltar dam tshig lha 34—/590

bskyed de/ /thugs ka'i rdo rje'i hūṃ las ni/ /'og min gnas su 'od 'phros pas / /mi 'khrugs mdun nam spyi bor bsam/ /rang lus mi 'khrugs bsgoms bstems 4la/ /ltag 'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /lha yi go rims ji bzhin par zhu/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /yang na rang nyid lhar bsgoms la/ /mi 'khrugs mdun du bsgom par bya/ /gzungs drang pa ④yi ting 'dzin ni/ /thugs las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /de nyid sum brtsegs jerang rang gzhan/ /lha dang bum pa mchod rten gtor/ /bum pa mchod rten la sogs nang / /rgya mtsho zla ba pad+ma la/ /lha bskyed ye shes bstem par bya/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /bdag la rab tu dgongs 5༄par mdzod / /oṃ akhyo bh+ya dza/ a bispyo khyeta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa④/ thal sbyar sor gnyis phyir bskyed 8de/ /ta thā ga to ta bha shebā ya swā hā dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ de nyid gdan la bzhugs pa la/ /mchod bstod la sogs dbul bya ste/ /oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha 7 puṣ+pe / dhū 3 pe/ ā lo ke/ gabye/ ne+e bi bye ⑫shaza/ ba lo ta pū dza 8khā hi khā hi/ chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' zhing / /phrin las rnam ba'is 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma mgron du dmigs la bsngo / /sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /yan lag bzhi dang dmigs pa gsum / /rang don du ni bsnyen pa yin/ /grangs dang dus dang mtshan ma'o//dngos grub sgrub tshupa'i bzlas pa ni/ /ngag dang shib skyebu rdo rje'i bzlas/ /yid kyis tsobazlas pa byas pa bzhi5 8/ /me dang sgra dang byu sgra mthar gsum/ /brjod pa med pa'i bsam gtan te/ /thun gsum dag tu bzlas pa bya/ /34—1591

gtong ma ༄1mchod bstod gtor ma btang ⑤/ /ye shes gshegs dang dam tshig bsdu / /de ltar thun gsum spyor ba yis/ /bsnyen pa sngon du song ba dang / /gang 'dod dngos grub bab pa'i phyir/ /de nas las la sbyar bar bya/ /bzlas brjod me la tshul khrims rlung gis sbar/ /brtson 'grus chen po'i me lces sdig sgrib sreg /pad+ma'i drod la char chu yisathu/ /kha zum 'od kyis 'byed pa dang / /nyi ma me shel me 'byung bzhin5/ /mi yi lus la dngos grub ster/ /mi gnas bsod nams ster bar byed/ /sgra yis thar pa ster bar byed/ /'di ni yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu kun gyis bkur bar 'os/ /ngan song rnams las 6thar lam 'dis sgrub bo/ /rang gzhan mdun du bsgoms kyang dngos grub ster/ /mgon po mi 'khrugs pa yi sheni/ /sgrub pa'i thabs mchog 'di bris pa'i/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las 'di yis/ /bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad ni/ /myur ba nyid du sangs rgyas nas/ /'gro la phan phyir chos ston zhing / /sems can sdug bsngal las grol shog /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa slob dpon dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā sab dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //34—1pya92

༄༅/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/thu ༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub po dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dgon pa'am grong mtha' la sogs par/ /khrus byas gtsang mar yongs byas te/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug byas nas/ /rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng du hūṃ/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni mi bskyod pa/ /spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs pa las/ /bdun po rnam par dag pa bya/ /tshad med bzhi — bhedang ldan par ni/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis bsgom par bya ba yin/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /rang rig sa bon de dbus su/ /bsams nas dam tshig phyag rgya bca'/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag mtshan phyag rgyas de byin brlab/ /de rnams gyur pa mi 'khrugs pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ /g.yon pa pad gzhag rdo rje dang / /g.yas 271byed/594

pa sa gnon tshul can bsgom/ /ltag 'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /rang nyid rang lhar bsgoms nas ni/ /mi 'khrugs mdun nam spyi bor bsgomadzo/ /rang lus mi 'khrugs bsgoms la bsnyim//thugs kar pad zla hūṃ las ni/ /dbus su mi 'khrugs pa nyid bsgom2 / /phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas bzhi bsgom bya/ /mchod dang bstod dang bzlas pa dang / /gnyis su mchod bstod gtor ma sbyin/ /de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pa ni/ /bsnyen pa sngon du song ba yis/ /gang 'dod pa yi don du ni/ /sgrub pa las la sbyar bar bya/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis 1mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā 4ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //34—1595

༄ / /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa jes bya ba'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga1 sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba karma cho.ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ni maṇ+ḍa la bi byeḥ— sna / bod skad du/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'joms gepa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /bden par gsungs la phyag 'tshal te/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bri bar bya/ /gang du las ni yod gyur na/ /las kyi cho ga rnams med pa/ /de ni spyi yi rgyud dag las/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga mkhas pas brten5/ /dkyil 'khor sum stong dag dang ni/ /lnga brgyar gsungs pa gang yin pa'i/ /spyi yi cho ga bshad par bya / /yid dang mthun trepa'i gnas dag tu/ /sngags mkhan gzhan la phan brtson pa/ /snying rje ldan pas dbang bskur ro/ /grangs sam dus sam mtshan ma'am / /bsnyen pa tshul bzhin byas pa yis/ /sa yi cho ga tshul bzhin bya/ /lha dang bum pa lhag gnas dang / /gson gshin slob ma gang rung bas/ /34—/597

bdun bo rnam par dag pa dang / /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sbyin par bya/ /so shing srung skud ku sha dang / /chos bshad pa ni byas kyang rung / /gtad dang drag po'i las dang ni/ /sbyang dang byen rlabs kyebya mi dgos/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi thig btab la/ /de yi dbus su pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa khru do bri/ /dkyil 'khor lhag ma'i tshad dang ni/ /ci 'dod pa ni nyid du bri/ /yo long 2chung ngu dag gis rngo kyang / /bzlas brjod byas pas dkyil 'khor bri/ /phyi nas gcig nyid kyis kyang ni/ /tshig rkyang ④du ni bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun du zlum por bya/ /de nas phyogs mtshams skyong ba dang / /'dod pa'i lha rnams bri bar bya/ /so so'i sngags kyi rim pa bzhin/ /de nas spyan yang drang bar bya//bdag po rnams kyi snying po yis/ /de yi 'og tu mchod par bya/ /bum pa gang ba de steng du/ /cho ga bzhin du rdzas gzhag go/ /las kun byed pa'i dkyil 'khor de/ /bsang 5ba gsang ba'i bdag po gsung / /dkyil 'khor 'di ni kun bris nas/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa dang / /sgrub pa po ni dbang bsgur ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'di dag nyid du bya/ /mchod pa la sogs thams cad kyang / /rgyud las bshad pa bzhin du bya/ /zhes bshad pas 'dir khyad par ni/ 'dab ma brgyad pa 6dbus su ni/ /rdo rje chen po bri bar bya/ /'dab ma brgyad la bkra shis brgyad/ /shar du dpal be'u 'khor lo ste/ /lho ru pad+ma rgyal mtshan gnyis/ /nub tu gdugs dang bum pa ste/ /byang du dung dang nya bri'o/ /phur pa ra ba dra ba gzhag /srung 7ba rtsa ba'i sngags sam ni/ /yang na de yi snying pos bya/ /bla re ba dan sku gzungs dā sogs/ /mchod dang gtor ma la sogs dgram/ /'bru sman rin chen lnga ldan pa'i/ /bum pa de yi 34—1598

dbus su gzhag /khrus dang chos gos ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyam bzhag pas/ /bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung / /shaṃ gis thams cad stong pa las/ /baṃ mam rgyu 1las gzhal yas khang / /de nang pad+ma zla dbus su/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs bskyed pa las2/ /pad 'dab brgyad la lha mo brgyad/ /pad+ma can dang 'od can ma/ /mdangs ldan ma dang dri med ma/ /dkar dang dmar dang sngo dang ljang / /dpal be'u pad+ma gdugs dang dung / /dbang po gshin rje chu bdag dang / /gnod sbyin phyogs su bsgom par bya/ /'jigs byed ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dkar sham ma dang yid gzhungs ma/ /dkar sngo dmar skya ljang ba'i mdog /'khor lo rgyal mtshan bum pa nya/ /me dang srin po rlung lha dang / /dbang ldan ngos su rnam par bsam/ /kun kyang sems dpa'i 4skyil mo krung / /zla ba'i rgyab brten 5rin chen brgyan/ /g.yon pa thams cad dku la gtad/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi sngags/ /oṃ oṃ ga la shrī yi 6dza da ma dza swā hā/ oṃ dze+e ga la pad+ma swā hā/ oṃ saṃ ga la tsha tram̐ 7swā hā/oṃ oṃ ga la shaṃ kha swā hā/ oṃ mo ga la tsakra swā hā/ oṃ saṃ ga la dh+wa dza swā hā/ oṃ oṃ ga la ka la sha swā hā/ oṃ oṃ ga la maṣ+ṭha swā hā/ spyan drang bsnyim dang mchod bstod bya/ /de yi snying ga'i zla ba la/ /gsang sngags dmigs te ci nus bzlas//mchod dang bstod dang gtor ma gtang / /khrus byas brtsam pa'i slob ma rnams//dkyil 'khor de yi mdun nyid du/ /bdun bo rnam par dag pa dang / /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de la sbyin/ /gshin la brdeg dang brab pa dang / /'byor ba yod na sbyin sreg bya/ /denas bum pa'i dbang bskur spyin/ /'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /serasna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /sbyin pa dri yi 34—/599

legs bsgos pas/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar pha rol phyin drug la/ /gson po bkra shis rdzas brgyad bri/ /rak+ṣa zhes pas bsrung bar snabya / /a pa na yas byab par bya/ /mchod rten rab gnas tsha tsha gdab/ /ngan pa bzlog la las 'di bya/ /'di ni yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur ba'i 'os/ /chos bka' rgya chen zab mo 'di/ /rgyal po bzhin du mnyes par dka'/ /mnyes par gyur na de bzhin du/ /yon tan mchog gi nor sbyin byed/ /'di bris pa yi dge ba yis/ /ngan song rnam sbyang thar 4lam sgrub/ /kun gyis bzang po mthong bar shog /slob dpon mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa'i dedakyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā 6ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1597 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sngalas kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam nga/ra sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉karmā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jo nga / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasten/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mothun/1598 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyang /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smi ra 〉zosas nga / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 brgyad/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhan/ /bsrung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thazugs/1599 1〈〈pe 〉tham bye/ 〈〈snar 〉ram bru/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉dz+ra/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpa'—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rten/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mgo 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jom/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rdegs/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i dri yis/16༷༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zlog 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskur/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyong thal/34byed/600

༄7/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 1 ༄go/ /mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bum pa la/ /brdeg dang bdug dang mtshan ma dgod/ /nang 2 du bcud rnams blugs la yang / /mgul chings kha rgyan la sogs bcas/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas pa'i steng / /bzhag la mchod sogs rim bzhin bsham/ /bdag dang gnas sogs bsrung byas la/ /mchod pa bsangs shing sdebyin gyis brlab/ /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsams nas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sngags brjod pas / /bum pa sbyangs te baṃ las bskyed4/ /rgya mtsho pad+ma zla stengs su/ /mi 'khrugs rgya'/ po spyan drangs la/ /bgegs bskrad rgyas btab mchod yon sogs//phul te dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsaṃ 5dgug /gdan la bzhugs gsol mchod bstod bya/ /'phro 'du tshul gyis bzlas brjod bya/ /brgya stong la sogs ci nus par6/ /byas te mchod bstod gtor ma gtang / /de ltar thun dang spyor ba yis ji 34byed/602

srid 'dod kyi bar du bya/ /khrus kyi dus su bum nang lha/ /mchod bstod byas te mkha' la bzhugs/ /de yis dbang bskur bsams la bkru/ /rang nyid lha yi sbyor ldan pas/ /rgyun gcod sngags la che ge mo/ /sarba pā paṃ zhes sogs pa'i1 / /brjod cing bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bkru zhing de nas rma bya yi/ /sgo yis byab cing a pa na/ /zhes sogs brjod pas mi mthun phyogs/ /bsal bar bsams la slob ma de/ /mdun du gnas pas maṇ+ḍal bya/ /bla ma la phul bla ma yis/ / srung skud srung 2'khor gdags pa dang / /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas bsrung / /lha la mchod bstod bzod par gsol/ /gtor ma byin la phrin las gzhol/ /smon lam btab la gshegs su gsol/ /a kā ro yi sngags brjod cing / /maṇ+ḍal mchod pa me tog bsdu/ /'di yis yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /mi mthun phyogs sel 'dod pa 'grub/ /slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'o/ /rdzogs so// //34—1603

1563༄ga /tshi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/7 ༄7/ /mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya / /rgyud las rigs kyi bu zhes pa/ /sgrub pa po yi mtshan nyid de/ /dal 'byor theg chen rigs can no/ /snying rje shes rab yon tan ldan/ /byams dang snying rje ldan pa dang / /dad cing bla ma la gus dang / /skyabs su song zhing sems bskyed pa/ /dam tshig sdom ldan dbang thob pas/ /las kyi cho ga shes nas ni/ /dgon pa'i gnas sam grong gi mthar/ /las byas bde ba'i stan la 'dug /khrus byas gtsang ma'i gos can kyis/ /bdun po rnam par dag pa dang / /tshad med bzhi sogs ldan par bsgom/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med par/ /sems kyis 2bsgom par byas nas ni/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon dbus bsams nas/ /dam tshig dag dang phyag rgya dang / /bsam zhing de bzhin nyid du bya/ /rnal 'byor pas 34byed1605

ni bsgyur bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgya phyag rgyas de byin brlab/ /lha yi go rims ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bsgur ro/ /rang nyid rang gi lhar bsgoms nas/ /mi 'khrugs mdun nam spyi bor bsam/ /bdag nyid mi 'khrugs par bsgoms nas / /de nyid gsum sogs rang dang gzhan/ /bum pa mchod rten la sogs nang / /rgya mtsho pad+ma zla ba la/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'disate/ /bdag gi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ bigha nān+ta kṛta 3hūṃ phaṭa/thal sbyar sor mo gnyis phyir bskyed/ /ta thā ga tobye bā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs 4de nyid gdan la bzhugs pa la/ /mchod dang bstod dang bzlas pa bya/ /sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /yan lag bzhi dang dmigs pa gsum/ /gzhan don bsnyen pa byed pa ni/ /grangs dang dus dang mtshan ma'o/ /dngos grub bsgrub bya'i 5bzlas pa ni/ /ngag dang shib gyebu rdo rje bzlas/ /yid kyi bzlas brjod bcas pa bzhi/ /me dang sgra dang sgra mtha' gsum/ /brjod pa med pa'i bsam gtan te/ /thun gsum dag tu bzlas pa dang / / bstod nas mchod par 7gtor ma gtang / /ye shes gshegs dang dam tshig bsdu/ /mi gnas bsod nams ster bar byed/ /sgra mthar thar ba ster bar byedarme/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa byon nas zhes pas rang lhar bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor pas spyan drang ba dang / mchod pa dang bstod pa dang / bzlas pa dang / bsgom pa byas pas dngos grub sprul /byebar gyur pa'o/ /chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes gtan du mya ngan mi 'da' 34—1606

zhing / /phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzlas brjod me la tshul khrims rlung gis sbar/ /brtson 'grus chen po'i me lces spyig pa sreg /nyi ma me shel zhugs la me 'byung ltar / /mi yi lus la dngos grub khrul bar mdzad/ /'di ni yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu kun gyis bkur bar 'os/ /ngan song rnam sel thar lam 'dis 'grub bo/ /rang gzhan mdun du bsgoms kyang dngos grub ster she/ /mgon po mi 'khrugs pa sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon dze+e 〈tā ris mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma gnyan gyis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/16༷5 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉lhar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐/16༷6 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradir/ 2〈〈pe 〉thasgrin ta/ 〈〈snar 〉thaghin ta kṛd/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thakyed/ /ta tha—/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub rgyu'i/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shub/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ratong na mchod dang / 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasol// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mda'—/16༷7 tsho〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉stag/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7gnyan/34byed1607

༄ga /mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/7 ༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub po dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dgon pa'am grong mtha' la sogs par/ /khrus byas gtsang mar byas pa yis/ /las byas bde ba'i stan la 'dug /rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng du hūṃ/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni mi bskyod pa/ /spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs pa la/ /bdun po rnam par dag pa bya/ /tshad med bzhi dang ldan par ni/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis bsgom par byas nas ni/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsams nas dam tshig phyag rgya bca'/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag mtshan phyag rgya de byin brlab/ /de rnams gyur pas mi 'khrugs pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgu mdog sngo/ /g.yon pa pang gzhag rdo rje dang / /g.yas pas sa 34—1609

gnon tshul can bsgom/ /ltag 'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /rang nyid rang lhar bsgoms la ni/ /mi 'khrugs mdun nam spyi bor bsam7/ /rang lus mi 'khrugs bsgoms la bstem/ /thugs ka'i pad zla'i hūṃ las ni/ /dbus su mi bskyod pa nyid bsgom/ /phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas bzhi bsgom bya/ /mchod dang bstod pa bzlas pa pebya/ /sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /yan lag bzhi dang dmigs pa gsum/ /gzhan dang rang don bsnyen pa ni/ /grangs dang dus dang mtshan ma'o/ /dngos grub bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ /ngag dang shib bu rdo rje bzlas/ /yid de brjod dang bcas pa bzhi/ /me dang sgra dang sgra mthar gsum/ /thun gsum dag tu bzlas par bya/ /gnyis ni mchod bstod gtor ma sbyin/ /de ltar thun gsum spyor ba yis/ /bsnyen pa sngon du rab song bas/ /gang 'dod dngos grub bsgrub 4pa'i phyir/ /de ni las la sbyar bar bya/ /pad+mo'i 'od la char chu yis / /kha zum 'od kyis 'byed pa 'am5/ /nyi ma me shel me 'byung bzhin/ /mi yi lus la dngos grub ster/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du 6ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing / /sems can sbug bsngal gzir las sgrol bar shog /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //34byed1610

sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ho ma bi dhiḥ5/ bod skad du/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin sreg chen po'i rim pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su ni/ /thab khung zlum po khru do bya/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bri/ /yang na ma bris pa yang rung / /bud shing brtsigs te sreg rjas bsogabye /mchod dang gtor ma la sogs dgram/ /bla re byes pa'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste bsgom/ /rab tu rdzas la brab brdeg 4bya/ /me sbar me lha bskyed pa ni5/ /ram̐ las me lhar (6drang srong ni/ /bgrang phreng ril ba phyag na 'dzin/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /dgang blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ agha ye dz+wa khā 7ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ gnyis su med par bstems pa la/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes/34—1612

bsangs te mar gyi dgang blugs dbul/ /mchod bstod sreg 1rdzas rim par dbul / /de nas mchod bstod me lha ni/ /gshegs pa'am 'bar ba'i rnam par ro/ /de nas pad+ma zla ba la/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'dir/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ bigha nān+ta kṛta 3hūṃ phaṭa/thal mo sbyar la mdzub gnyis dgyed / /oṃ ta thā ga tobye bā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ mchod dang bstod pa byas nas ni/ /mar dang gro dang sran ma dang / /zho dang sman dang dūr wa dang / /ku sha yam shing me tog dang / /til dang yungs kar la sogs bsreg /thams cad rgyun gcod sngags kyis bya/ /khyad par las su bya ba ni/ /til dang yungs kar dag la ni/ /brgya 'am stong ngam khri ru bsregasku /sdig sgrib sbyong 6ba'i las su bstan/ /de nas mchod bstod gtor ma gtang / /bsngo dang bzod par gsol te gshegs/ /rdzas lhag me yi lha la dbul/ /mchod bstod bzod par gsol te gshegs/ /khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol 7 / /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon 9par mdzad du gsol//dman pa 7bsnyu zhing a kār rkabazlas/ /ji ltar grags pa'i bkra shis brjod/ /ske yis sbyangs pa'i nor bu bzhin/ /rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur/ /sbyin sreg gi cho ga dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //34—1613

)566ra༅/ /rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 1༄7/ /'phags pa rdo rje chos kyi ni/ /rnal 'byor gcig pa sgom pa'i thabs / /kun dga' snying po'i rjes 'brangs 2nas/ /rang la phan phyir 'di brtsam mo / /de la rnal 'byor pa gang zhig byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing 4dbang thob pa/ rig pa'i sdom pa yongs su bzung 5ba/ ri bo'am nags sam/ chu 'gram mam/ byed mos tshal lam/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa yid dang rjes su mthun 6pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ dang por re zhig bdag med pa la lhag par mos pas nang gi bdag nyid can gyi khrus byas la gog ma'i phyogs su yi ge dhīḥ7las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsams pa'i lce'i pad+ma'i 'dab mar hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po bskyed la/ badz+radzihwa 8zhes bya ba 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis su yang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bsams la/34byed/615

—de gnyis kyi steng du hūṃ gnyis las rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis bsam zhing lag pa'i sor mo rnams kyang rtse mor bsams la bgegs gzhom pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje me ltar 'bar bar bdag nyid bsams te/ khro bo ti rīn+ta ri'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ dzaṇ+ḍi 2badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ baṃ/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lārka hūṃ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgreng bas masor mo'i steng nas dgab pa'i tshul du gzhag pa 'di ni ti rīdhi 5ri'i phyag rgya ste/ 'dis spyi bo nas brtsams nas phyogs bzhir rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba blangs nas/ oṃ sum̐ zhes pa'i yi ge gnyis kyi go chas 6go bgos la/ oṃ badz+ra dzā lā 7na khārka hūṃ/zhes brjod cing g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag nas g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur bsor zhing bgegs thams cad la bsnun par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas bgegs bsreg par bya ste/ hūṃ badz+ra a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod par bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la sor mo rnams nang du 'bar ba lta bur byas te/ mthe bo rdo rjer / 'greng ba 'di be+e me'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te mthe'u 1 chung gnyis lcags kyur sbrel la khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i mdzub mo gnyis sdigs 1mdzub tu bsgreng ba ni rdo rje t+t+waṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ/ kṛ1 tsopa ya kṛ1 5pa ya hūṃ/ ā spyon ya ho bha ga bān bibyā 1—rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i sngags dang bcas pas rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba rnams bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 9'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor sprul par bya 3 4byed16/6

ste / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /mdzub mo mthe bong rdo rjer mdud/ /rdo rje 'khor lo zhes grags te/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sgrub byed yin/ /'dis phyogs thams cad du g.yas phyogs nas bskor bas dkyil 'khor thams cad sprul par bya'o/ /'di nyid khar bzhag la blta 1bzhin du rdo rje 'khor lo'i sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro / /de nas dkyil 'khor blos mngon sum lta bur dmigs la me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka 2 tsit+ta pra ṇa me na badz+ra ban+ta ṭ+wāṃ 1ka ro rmā4/ de nas phyag bzhi bya ste 'di ltar shar phyogs nas rdo rje thal mo brkyang ba la lus thams cad phab ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pas+thā 5nā ya āt+ma māṃ nit+yā 6ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/zhes bya ba 'dis phyag bya'o/ /de nas lho phyogs nas de bzhin du gnas pa las rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag ste 7dpral ba sa la reg par byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya āt+ma māṃ nit+yā ta yā mi 9badz+ra ra a bhi ṣiñca rmā/ zhes bya ba 'dis phyag bya'o/ /de nas 1 ji skad du bshad pa'i rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bzhag ste kha sa la reg pa dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta nā ya āt+ma māṃ nit+yā ta 11yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra warta ya rmā/ zhes bya ba 'dis phyag bya'o / /de nas byang phyogs nas de bzhin du gnas pa las rdo rje thal mo spyi bo nas phab nas snying gar sbyar la spyi bo sa la reg par bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karmā ṇi āt+ma māṃ 7nit+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māṃnyu / zhes bya ba 'dis phyag bya'o/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / mchod pa nyi shus yang 34—1617

dag par mchod pa dang / bdag dbul ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang / sdom pa la 1gnas pa'i bar du byas la / de nas lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mo la oṃ mdzub mo la hūṃ/ srin lag la t+t+waṃ2/mthe'u chung la byāḥ mthe bo la aḥ4bsam zhing / g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams la yang de bzhin du bkod de/ g.yas par gnas pa'i sa bon rnams la rgo rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sgur bsam mo/ /g.yon pa la gnas pa'i sa bon rnams 5ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa'i skur bsams nas phan tshun thabs dang shes rab dag bcas pa'i mngon par 'dod pas thal mo mngon du phyogs par byas te/ a byo n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmaḥ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas sor mo rnams shin tu yang bcer te/ lha de rnams lha mo de dag gi thugs kar zhugs par bsams la/ a t+yan+ta a nu pra biṭ+wāḥsarba dharmaḥ6/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ thal mo dam du bsdams pa las sor mo thams cad bsnol ba ni/ /rdo rje thal mo bka' stsal te/ /rab tu bsdams phyir rdo rje bsdams7 / /badz+ra añja 8li zhes bya ba ni rdo rje thal mo'i sngags so/ /badz+ra ban+dha zhes bya ba ni rdo rje bsdams pa ste/ badz+ra brnya traṭa ces brjod cing snying gar lan gsum dral bar bya'o/ /badz+ra ā 9snabe sha zhes bya bas rdo rje dbab pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings nas aḥ/ zhes bya bas bdag nyid la dbab par bya'o/ /dbab nga/ de yang 'dis/ brtan par bya'o/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha ba shā shwa to me bha ba z-i da yo me a bye tiṣ+ṭha sarba sed+dhim+me pra yats+tsha hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi/zhes bya bas dam tshig gi rdo rje khu tshur bcings la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /oṃ badz+ra mubye baṃ/ de yi rjes la/ oṃ sarba a pā ya rta.ā kaste ṇa bi sho dha na badz+ra sa 37‘—/6/8

ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba phyag rgya dang bcas pas ngan 'gro thams cad dgug par bya'o/ /rdo rje phyag rgya gnyis nang du/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni bcings nas su//legs par gyen du 'phangs pa 1ni/ /be+eng ba slong ba'i dam pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi sgo ṭa ya brnya na ni pra mok+ṣa ya/ sarba a pā ya ga ti bh+yaḥsarba satā 2ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa/ ces brjod cing sdig pa dral ba'i phyag rgya bcings la sdig pa thams cad dral bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bcing ba 4bsdams byas te/ /gung mo gnyis ka sbyar nas ni/ /tha ma bzhi yi rtse mor sbyar/ /sdig pa 'joms par grags pa yin/ /de nas mdun kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams badz+ra muḥzhes brjod nas snying gar dgrol bar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su rang gi snying po badz+ra dharma 5zhes dam tshig gis bris la chos thams cad bdag med par bsgocha/ par bya'o/ /de nyid dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug dang bcas pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par yongs su gyur par bsams la/yang de'i steng du de nyid dang / yi ge ka la sogs pa skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gzugs can gnyis pa nyid du bsam mo/ /de las byung 6ba gang yin pa de la ni yang de'i tshe snying po dang bcas pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od zer kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa bsam mo/ /de nas de las byung ba ni rang gi phyag rgya pad+mo'o/ /de nas rang gi phyag rgya'i dbus su rang gi phyag rgya'i nga rgyal du bsgom par bya ste pad+molha7haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /rang gi snying po yang bzlas shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgu dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dbyings phyag rgya la zhugs par bsams la bstems pa dang bcas pas rdo rje bsor zhing badz+ra satwa 9haṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas 34—1619

rang gi sngags badz+ra dharma zhes brjod pas rang gi lha rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar skya sangs rgyas thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ stod dang smad pa ti'i tshi gu mnabs pa/g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis thugs kar pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin cing phyag g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs par rang nyid bsams la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya satā 1haṃ/ rang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces kyang brjod par bya'o/ /sa ma yolhahaṃ / de nyid kyis snying ga dang / dpral ba dang / gog ma dang / spyi bor byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /sa ma ya satwa a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ de nas rang gi lha'i phyag rgya chen po bcings la rang gi snying po badz+ra dharma dang sngags oṃ badz+ra dharma dīḥ sna zhes bya ba yang bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas sa ma ya aḥzhes brjod de/ mdun du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sprul la badz+ra dharma a 4/zhes bya ba 'dis de'i steng du pad+mar bdag nyid dbab par bya'o/ /de nas pad+mopho5haṃ / zhes pad+ma'i nga rgyal du rnam par bsgoms la/ pad+ma de nyid badz+ra ṇi tro36haṃ/ zhes zlos 7shing rdo rje chos su bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgrog dang /'be+ebs pa'i las kyi phyag rgya dang / snying bo de rnams kyis de nyid du dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / babyung ba dang / dbang du bya'o/ /badz+ra saṃ gu sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi 9hoḥ/ de rnams kyi las kyi phyag rgya ni/ mdzub mo lcags kyu bcing ba ni/ /mthe'u chung las te lcags kyu che/ /mkhrig 4 ma mdud pa mdzub gnyis 1 gdub/ /rgyab gnyis kyang ni bsnyems te mnan / /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chos kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya rdo rje 3(7—/620

bsdams pa las/ mabe+e bo gnyis gshibs te mdzub mo gnyis bkug la nga/d+ma lta bu dang / badz+ra dharma dṛ sh+ya zhes bya ba 'dis blta bar bya'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' de mthong nas/ /rang gi lus la rab tu bsgom/ /yang dam tshig gi phyag rgya de nyid dang / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes brjod pas rang gi lus la dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang ba/bang du bya'o/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ —1 zhes brjod pas/ rgyab tu zla ba grub 2nas ni/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ brjod/der bdag sems dpa'i lus su bsgom/ /badz+ra dharma zhes bya ba'i snying po dang /oṃ badz+ra dharma dhīḥzhes bya ba'i sngags kyang brjod par bya ste / de nas lce la rdo rje bsams la sarba kā ri zhes chos kyi phyag rgya dgod par bya'o/ /de nas snying gar zla ba la rdo rje sna tshogs bsams la/ las kyi phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings te gar byas nas g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin cing phyag g.yas pas pad+ma kha 'byed pa'i tshul du mdzad pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o / /de nas phyag rgya chen po bcing ba ni rang gi snying gar sems dpa'i rdo rje bsams la sku mdog dang / phyag mtshan dang / bzhugs tshul la sogs 5ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom mo/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing ba la ni su ra ta s+t+waṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi lus la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcings te/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ6/ zhes brjod de/ yid kyis legs par spyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzhug 7par bya8/ /de nas spyor ba 'dis/ de rnams kyi 9rang gi dam tshig dang / chos 7las dang / phyag rgya chen pos rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la/ badz+ra dhā 1tu dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas 31byed/62/

badz+ra dhā tu/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gi ༄1shwa ra hūṃ / zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sngags lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang /'od dpag tu med pa dang / don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /badz+ra dhā tu dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/zhes bya ba dang / badz+ra dhā patu zhes bya ba ༄ spyi'i snying po lan gsum brjod par bya zhing / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ zhes bya ba mi bskyod pa'i snying po dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na t+t+waṃ4/ zhes bya ba rin chen 'byung ldan gyi snying po dang / oṃ badz+ra dharma tweḥ/zhes bya ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i snying po dang / oṃ badz+ra karma aḥ5/ zhes bya ba don yod grub pa'i snying po yang lan gsum brjod par bya'o/— /de rnams kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa ltar byas la/ /gung mo myu gu ltar mnyam bsgreng / /gung mo nang du gshibs pa ni/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i yin par bshad/ /gung mo rin chen 'dra ba dang / /gung mo pad+mo 'dra bar dgug /sangs rgyas lnga pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /de bzhin mdzub gnyis bkug pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing ba la ni/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ljags la chos kyi phyag rgya dgod par bya ste/ badz+ra dz+nyā na zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi 7phyag rgya yin no/ /snga ma bzhin du ljags la rdo rje bsams la sbyar ro/ /de nas/las kyi phyag rgya bcings pa 8ni/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings te/ /mnyam par bzhag pas gnyis su dbye/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnyis bcings te/ /de nas bcing bar rab tu bshad/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje mdzub mo ni/ /g.yas pa'i nang 31—1622

du bsgreng bar bya/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sbyin byed pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba yi sa reg pa/ /rin chen gyi ni mchog sbyin pa'o/ /tshe dpag med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /gdon mi za ba'i mi 'jigs sbyin/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po bcing ba ni snying gar sems dpa' kyerdo rje bsgoms te/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ni sku mdog dkar po seng ge'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa bsnams pa nyi ma'i 'od mnga' ba/ dar la'i 2stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mnabs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / dar dpyangs kyis dbang bsgur ba dang ldan pa zhal bzhi nga// zhal dkar po shar phyogs su gzigs pa'o/ /de bzhin du mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa yang sku mdog sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / lngang gu'o/ /gdan ni glang po che dang / rta dang / rma bya dang / nam mkha' lding la go rims bzhin du rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs bsdams pa/ nyi ma'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyis 4dbang bsgur ba dang ldan pa/ zhal gabyug pa'o/ /de la rnam par snang mdzad kyi gnas ni spyi gtsug yin no/ /mi bskyod pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa'i gnas ni snying ga dang / dpral ba dang /gog ma dang / spyi bo rnams yin no/ /de nas rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya dang /satwa badzi a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā zhes bya bas snying gar byin gyis brlabs la/ snying ga'i zla ba la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i gzugs su de bsam par bya'o/ /rdo rje rin chen ma'i 34—/623

phyag rgya dang / rat+na badz+re a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ zhes bya bas rdo rje rin chen ma ni dbang bsgur ba'i gnas su rdo rje rin po che'i rnam par ro/ /rdo rje chos ma'i phyag rgya dang / dharma badz+re a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa 1māṃ zhes bya ba dang rdo rje chos ma ni gog ma'i phyogs su rdo rje pad+ma'i rnam par ro/ /rdo rje las ma'i phyag rgya dang / karma badz+re a bye 2tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes bya bas rdo rje las ma ni spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang ldan par bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/badz+ra dharma ya twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su/ poṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sed+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku twe hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho / bha sa/ bān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma dz+re 4muñca / badz+rī bha ba ma hā 5sa ma ya satwa a6ཿ zhes bya ba yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzlas pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje rgyu'i las kyi phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor sprul la/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod de/ rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya bcings la / de nyid kyi gung mo gnyis kyis phreng ba blangs te/ sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya zhing /phreng ba de yang / pra ṭīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes bya ba 'dis rang gi spyi bor dor bar bya'o/ /de nas phreng ba des/ oṃ pra ti kṛṇ+ḍa two 7mi saṃ satwa ma hā ba la/zhes bya ba 'dis rang gi mgo la bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ satwa swa / yan te tsak+ṣu sa ṭa na/ tad nga/ ru ta 7gha ṭa ya ti sarba sgo/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu ra nut+ta ra/he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes bya ba 'dis gdong g.yogs dgrol bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor blta bar bya'o/ /yang rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya bcings te/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes zlos shing snying gar dkrol mubar 2(byed/62/

bya'o / /de nas rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa las rdo rje khu tshur gyis chu blangs la/ badz+ra a bhe ṣiñca/ zhes bya ba 'dis chu'i dbang bskur ba blang bar bya'o / /de nas sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan dang / dar dpyangs kyi dbang bsgur ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pas blang bar bya'o/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad bskyed la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dh+wa t+t+waṃ shwa ri hūṃ a bye ṣiñca māṃ/ mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ yi ge hūṃ las dpral ba'i steng du mi bskyod pa ste/ oṃ badz+ra badz+re ni 1a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyi phyag rgya bcings la/ yi ge t+t+waṃ las rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du rin chen 'byung ldan no / /oṃ rat+na badz+re ni 2a bhi ṣiñca rmā/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ yi ge dhīḥlas rgyab tu ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /o dharma 7 badz+re ṇi hūṃ a bhi ṣiñca rmā/ don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya bcings la yi ge a las don yod par grub par 4bskyed la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ karma badz+re ni 5hūṃ a bhe ṣiñca māṃ/ rdo rje thal mo rab 6bcings la/ /mthe bong gnyis ni bsnol byas la/ /mdzub mo'i rtse mo bkug nas ni/ /gung mo bsnyams pa'i tshigs su sbyar/ /rdo rje dbyengs kyi dbang mor bshad/ /de nyid gung mo rdo rjer bya/ /7gung mo gnyis ni rin chen 'dra/ /pad+mor srin lag mthe'u chung gung / /lag pa'i sor mo rab tu brkyang / /zhes bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ sum̐ zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis snying gar mdud pa bcing ba'i tshul gyes 8go bgo bar bya zhing de bzhin du mgrin pa dang / ltag pa dang / yang snying ga dang / nu ma'i bar dang / yangasnying ga dang / mgrin pa dang rgyab 34—1625

dang / dpral ba'i steng du bzhag /dar dbe+engs bcings pa'i tshul du byas te sgeg pa dang bcas nga/sa mtha' ma la sogs pa nas bkrol te/ badz+ra tu gyi hoḥ/zhes bya bas mnyes par byas te/ de nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /di ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab 'grub phyir//rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣispya 7mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis rang gi rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba blang bar bya'o/ /rdo rjes rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur ba yang rdo rje de rang gi mgo la bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ 2a bye ṣispyo mi badz+ra nā ma a bhe ṣe ka ta/ kye rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba 'dis blang bar bya ste/ rang gi ming yang gang yin pa de la kye zhes bya ba dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi 5badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa t+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis rdo rje brtul zhugs blang bar bya'o / /oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha da/ badz+ra rat+na ma nutwa 6ram̐/ badz+ra dharma gā ya nai/ badz+ra karma ka robye 9ba/ zhes bya ba de glur blang zhing / re re zhing rdo rje'i gar byas la/ rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa brgyad kyi las kyi phyag rgyas yang dag par mchod de/ lag pa g.yon pas dril bu blangs la/g.yas nga/sa rdo rje gso/ra zhing / rdo rje'i tshig tu 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /ṭak+ki hūṃ dza / yang rdo rje de rang gi snying gar stod 7pa'i tshul gyis 'jog cing /ṭak+ki dzaḥhoḥ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /yi ge hūṃ nyid kyis 1/gzung bar byas la /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /37(byed/626

kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems 1bdag bdag po'i bdag /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya'o/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa'i mchog ni mdzad pa yin/ /dharma aḥzhes bya ba ni dril bu'i sa bon no/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sbug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod pa ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha rnams spyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya'o/ /de nas dril bu dkrol zhing dam tshig gsum kyi glu'i mchod pa bya ba ni 'di yin te/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba'i mtshan nyid phyir/ /thog ma mtha' 2ma med pa'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' deng grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos po chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa 4khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi 5rjes chags la/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod / /shin tu dag pa kun kyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs / /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems pa bdag mdzod cig /de nas rdo rje chos kyi phyag rgya chen por gnas te/ oṃ badz+ra āt+ma kopho6haṃ / zhes bya ba 'dis rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i mos pa byas la/ oṃ sarba sa mophohaṃ / zhes bya ba 'dis bdag med pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyi rang gi 83 4—1627

lha'i ngo bo nyid du bsams la/ ji srid mngon par gyur pa de srid du thun bzhir rim pas bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgom pas skyo na snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la kun nas 'khor ba'i tshul du yid kyis bzlas pa'i sngags bris la/ bsam gtan gyis ni gsang sngags bzla/ /myur ches pa dang bul ches dang / /mi gsal gug skyed nyams pa dang / /rnam rtog spangs te bzla bar bya/ /zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis ji srid skyo bar ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du brjod par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po'am sngags gtong 'dod na yi ge brgya pa rdo rje'i tshig gam yid kyis bzla'o / /de nas ye shes sems dpa' yid kyis mdun du bzhugs par bsams la me tog la sogs pa dang / sgeg mo la sogs pas tshul bzhin du mchod la bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub spyod/ /3slar yang gshegs par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥzhes brjod de rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya gyen du bgrol bas gshegs su gsol lo/ /srung ba byas nas mdo sde zab mo bklag pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /bdag 'dra rmongs pa gang dag gis/ /'di 'dra legs par ga la 'gyur/ /mkhas pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i phyir/ /'di la the tshom mi bya'o/ /'phags pa rdo rje chos kyi rnal 'byor gcig pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //3 4—/628

sngag /rgyan dam pa sna tshogs pa rim par bye ba bkod pa bzhugs/ 1༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//bzhi bcom drug ldan mtha' gnyis 'das/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i dpal mnga' zhing / /rnam pa rnam med rnam snang mdzad/ /sku gsum che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten pa la 'jig rten 'das pa dgos/ /dkyil 'khor dam tshig sgrub la yo gar 'brel/ /skubazhi lha lnga yang sgos 2byang chub sems/ /dga' dang don bsdebs 4spru ra ma tis bshad/ /spyir ni ston pa rnal 'byor nas / /ma 'ongs pa dag sgrub thabs la/ /sde snod gsum gsungs snying po lnga'i / /gsang sngags rdo rje rgyud mchog las/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i 'khos 5 dag ni/ /bar 'dir ma lus mdo gdon pa/ /rlung bcad dang po sa gzhi ༷twe rdordo/sa tha/rdoṭ+wāṃ rdzu rdo ṭ+wāṃ~Xn badhidīdīr/ bya//sa ste/shādī dīsu snarngo t+t+waṃ k+ṣiṃg rdoṭ+wāṃ/'o/ //34byed1631
