thig le bdun bris rlung rgyal dud/ /sha zhon 1ba dan dgug sogs bya/ /kham por lo dang hre yis bcad/ /g.yogs 2pa bal mig dong gzhug bcing / /phur bus btab phyung 'o mas bkru/ /zhag bdun bdun nas bya bar bshad/ / mtsher sa'i dbyangs las 'byung ba bzhin/ /brtag dang bslang dang gzung phur rin/ /bskrad dang bsrung zhing sbyang dang bdun/ /de bdun ldan na las rnams 'grub/ /phyi nang brtag pa rung mi rung / /bslang ba mngon nyo mi mngon nyo'o/ /de dus dbang bcom sbran par bya/ /gzung ba rnam rgyal khro bo phur / /bstan pa skyong ba'i bdag po lnga/ /rin chen la sogs nyi shu lnga/ /gus bcas rin du sbyin par bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje drag /bdud rtsi 'khyel pas bskrad par shis/ /hūṃ swā s+t+waṃ hā gsum du ni/ /phyogs bzhir mtshan bsgyur rtse gsum 'gros/ /ma dang ṭa las nyi zla'i dkyil/ /shin tu khros byas mgo bstod de/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gi nga rgyal bya/ /lha dang lha min la sogs pa/ /'di na ma gnas mgo 'gas dengs/ /hūṃ rdo rje rigs mchog pho nya mang po'i tshogs / /rig pa mang pos bsten pa'i lha mo de/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis bgegs rnams phung ba dang / /rngam pa 'thon cing phyogs bcur 'bros par 'gyur / /ral gri spu gri nags tshal gtams pa yi4/ /lcags bsregs sa gzhi rdo rjer nges shes pas/ /phyogs 'di nas ni myur du 'bros par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mgon ngo/ 'jig rten phan phyir gshegs/ /ngas ni gnas mchog 'di dag kun bsrungs pas/ /gnod byed bgegs kun 'di na ma gnas shig /hūṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃ na maḥs man+ta badzā 5rde sarba ta thā ga te a nu ga te/ ban+dha se na/ ma hā sa ma ya nir dzā te/ sma ra ni a pra ti ha ta/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ tsa ra tsa ra/34—/632

ban+dha brnya/ da shi ti da sha na sarba ta thā ga te༄1/ a nu gadhe/ pra ba dharma la ma ta bi dzā ya/ bha ga ba ti ku ru bi ku le/ le lu pu re swā hā/ de yis bdud srin rod rod por/ /rigs lnga'i phra 2men g.yog bcas kun/ /ci bgyi zhes su brjod pa dang / /khyed kyis bgegs bskrad tshar gcod par / /las kyi bdag po'i grogs bya'o/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mngag gzhug pho nya'i las mdzad pa/ /khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis/ /bgegs kyi spyor ba rgyun chod cig /na mo badz+ra rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥbyeṇ+ḍa phyabadz+ra pā ṇa ye/ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 6pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā tsuya/ ma hā rdastso da ka ṭa bhe 3ra bā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha hastu 9ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/kha kha khā hi khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha bad+dhā/ ha na ha na ha na/kṛhā kṛṇ+ḍa kṛhā/ gardza gardza gardza/ sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bibyān ma hā ga ṇa pā ti/ dzi biṭ+wān+ta kā rā ya swā hā / de bzhin du swa dang oṃ dang hās bsgyur te/ rat+na pad+ma karmas mtshams gcad do/ /srung saba'i las dag bya ba yang / /de bzhin stegs bu brtsigs nas su/ /lugs ma'i phyag rgya'am bdag gnas te/ /rgyan ldan de yis bdag gzhan srung / /srung chen mo dang phyag rgya lnga/ /brtan rgyal brjid legs bde bar gnas/ /badz+ra ྾bzhi yis bsrung bar bya/ /sa rnams gzhan gyis ma gtses dang / /'bab chu rgya mtshor ma gyur la/ /nyi zla'i mig dang yig 'bru'i tshogs / /sbyang zhing spel ba'i las bya'o/ /kun rdzob don dam gnyis su brtag/gleng gzhi rgyu dang bsnyen pa dang / /nges pa'i tshig dang byang chub sems/ /sta gon gnas dang phan yon rnams/ /mdor basbus yan lag bdun bshad rigs//34—1633

ci don gang la gang zhus bshad/ /chos rnams don bsgrub 1bstod gleng gzhi'o/ /ngo mtshar don zhus bshad thos langs/ /dran pa dang skyes gleng gzhi rgyu/ /mtshan ma dus dang grangs la brtson/ /thabs 2la ma reg bsnyen pa'o/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan gsum/ /sngags dang de don maṇ+ḍal te/ /dga' ba chen po de nges tshig /byang chub mchog gi sems ldan bskyed/ /sbyangs pa don dam kun rdzob bo/ /lha dang mi dang yo byad gsum/ /ting 'dzin nan tan sta gon bya/ /lha rnams sta gon je gnas te/ /gnyis pa mi rnams sta gon no/ /tha ma yo byad sta gon bya/ /rim pa de yis 4las rnams 'grub / /dkyil 'khor dag la las kyi skal yod gang / /de bzhin gshegs dang 'khor gyi lha rnams dag /bsgrub 5pa'i don phyir lhag par sngar mchod la/ /dri zhim maṇ+ḍal gsol btab sta gon gnas/ /rtse gcig dul ba'i sems ldan slob ma rnams/ /chos gtam rim pas shin tu dbugs phyung ste/ /ku sha tshems shing phyag rgya mchog rnams dang / /dag pa'i chus reg gtsang byas sta gon gnas//ston pa rdo rje gdan dag la/ /nam gshegs zhes ni brgya byin zhus/ /ku sha phul dang dbang ldan gyi ‘/ /tshod 'dzin bzhud 7ces de bzhin no/ /phyag na rdo rjes ston pa la/ /bil ba phul nas u dum dang / /a shwaṅga yis tshig dbang sprul / /phyag rgya rgya gram sgu gsum mam/ /yang na cho ga'i phyag rgya dang / /ldan nga/sa pho g.yas mo g.yon dpung / /de yis bdud las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bdag po sngags g.yog dam bcas te/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ku sha brlag /oṃ badz+ra tsakra tik+ṣa dī / oṃ s+dzahūṃ a bhi ṣiñca 9a/ 'khor lo ral gri pad+mar gyur//bshad dang bsrung ba tshems shing brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra ha sa pa sha tram̐ tram̐ 1/ tshig 3 ‘—163 /

dbang lha mos bkra shis rgyal/ /khro bo bcu yis srung skud brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ban+ta ༄rkerak+ṣa haṃ/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i go char ldan/ /'jig rten 'di'am 'di nas gzhan/ /yod med ming nas bos nas bri/ /'phan dang nor bu gdugs ldan byung 2/ /cho ga ma rdzogs bar du ni/ /khams gsum bdag po rnam rgyal la/ /gtad pa'i las rnams byas gyur na/ /de ni bde gshegs 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de ltar gtad pa ma byas na༄ / /slob dpon de yi las rnams ni/ /myur du 'grub par mi 'gyur zhes/ /thub pa'i gtso bo nyid kyis gsungs/ /bcom ldan khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi/ /mtshan nyid bdag gis bsgrubs pas na/ /thugs rje bskul lo mthu mnga' ba'i/ /rgyal bas 'di la byin gyis rlobs4/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha tre+e lokya bi dza ya/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab byang chub sems/ /spyan ras gzigs dang nam snying ngo / /dz+warnam rgyal las rnams ma byas na/ /sdig can de dag mi thar zhes/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis 6gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gdan du brlabs7 / /oṃ badz+ra drur ba oṃ ga la tiṣ+ṭha tsakra s+thā / lha grangs bzhin du dbus nas dgod/ /ku sha'i steng nyal rmi ltas gdab/ /gzhan bsrung tshig dbang lha mos brlab / /oṃbadz+ra ha sa pa sha tram̐ dī / mo ga la tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ngag gi nyes bzhi dag par byed/ /srung ba chen po chen mos brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra ban+dha rak+ṣa haṃ/ badz+ra ka ba tsa man+d+ra/ lus kyi nyes gsum dag par byed/ /mchod pa'i yo byad bzhugs —gnas brgyan/ /bla re 'phan gdugs rgyal ba dan/ /lda ldi tshon dang tshon skud bcas/ /mda' dang ral gri phur bu bum/ /ci bgyi khyad par che rtags so/ /dar dang do shal dril bu rnga/ /nor bu me long spyan nyi 34—1635

—zla / /yon chab bdug spos me tog dri/ /me bshos 'o sbrang mar bu ram/ /bza' btung bca' ba sbyor legs bsog3 /gtor ma nas kyi thug pa dang / /til dang yungs kar yos 'bras dang / /'bras chan nas gro ma du pa/ /ga pur gtsang 'bob yam bud shing / /shag te'u shug te'u 1dgang drugs gzar/ /phur bu gtun shing zhi ba'i dzas/ /'o ma'i thug pa zho 'bras chan ③/ /nas ngar chan til sbyar gsum dang / /nā 4ga pus pa bil ba'i 'bras/ /'bru rnams rnam/ lnga bur sbrang ser/ /sgron shing shag te'u cho sgon the'u dgang / /blugs gzar yam shing bud shing rdzas/ /ba dang ra lug zho dag ni6/ /bsrubs ma thag gi mar gsar dang / /zangs phye tsha rnams yungs kar dang / /skye tshe til dang zhim 7thig le/ /la phug yungs nag rdog chung dang / /skyer ba'i shing tos 9 thams cad dang / /sbang ma'i gtor ma skyar ba dang / /dmar po'i shing ngam tsan+dan dmar/ /shag te'u 11tsan+dan yam bud shing / /dbang gi phye ma ri lu sogs/ /btsag dang rgya skyegs kyis byugs te/ /dbang gi mchod dmar dgang blugs gzar/ /sha dang rus pa khrag dang skra/ /yungs kar yungs nag ske tshe dug /dur khrod thal ba rdo rje lcags/ /ko ba gtub pa'i dum bu dang / /mgal dum seng ldeng tsher nag la/ /yam shing bud shing a ri sta/ /shag te'u tsher te'u ཿrtsub par bya/ /drag shul spyod pa'i dgang blugs rdzas/ /rnam gsu ma phur bu gtun shing ni/ /so so'i shing la bya ba'o/ /zlum po gru bzhi zla gam/ dang / /gru gsum por ni bya bar bshad/ /zhi rtse rgyas par dbang gi spom//drag po brdungs pa dag gi'o/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi yis bstan/ /pad+ma ku sha khri dang gsum/ /drag po sa gzhi nyid las sashis/ /rgyal thabs las rnams 3tsho(byed/636

kun kyi mchog /rnam rgyal la sogs khro bo rnams/ /sbyin sreg kun gyi dang por mchod / /rten yang phyogs phyogs khro bo la'o/ /sbyin sreg bum rgyan ldan bzhi yum / /dpal rtse rtse gsum mda' gzhu sogs/ /kha dog chas gos g.yab dar dang / /zhal khebs 1la sogs byang phyogs bsog /gzhan yang las bzhi hom shing sogs/ /bsog /pa nyid du bya ba yin/ /rgyu bzang gser las nyis 'gyur ro/ /kha dog lnga las 'brel pa yi/ /bde gshegs gtso bo'i sku tshad do/ /gdugs chen gser gyi yu bar ldan/ /dkyil 'khor yog po'i sor phran can/ /dkar nag 4dmar ser le brgan dung / /khra bo ljang ser brgyan pa'o—/ /khru brgyad dpangs la khru bzhi lce/ /yu ba drang po ring po la/ /btags pa brgyad ni rgyal mtshan tshul/ /kha dog so so ci 'dra'o/ /kha dog sna tshogs nas 'bras tshul/ /bcas 5bcag rtsibs su 'brel pa'o/ /dkar po dmar po de bzhin ser/ /sngon po dang ni gnag dang lnga/ /tshon 6sna lnga po de la ni/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor gang yin bsgom/ /thig sgud dkyil 'khor gang yin pa'i/ /yum grangs bzhin du bsgril bar bya/ /rta babs brgyad dang dri zhim shing / /chu srin khas gzung zlum sa gzugs/ /khru phyed bzhi mgo rgya mdud can/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni zur bzhi la/ /chags pa'i mtshan ma chags pa ni/ /rdo rje mda' bzhi khru do gzugs/ /thugs rje chags pas 'gro ba 'dren/ /mi shes rgya mo 'dra ba yis/ /mtha' gnyis gcod dang mi gnas phyir/ /khru do zur bzhir legs par bri/ /seng ldeng tsher ma can la sogs / /sor ni brgyad pa cod pan can/ /khro bo lngas sngags bar chad sel//bum 7pa nag po ra ri med/ /nyi shurtsalnga'i cho gar ldan/ /dkyil 'khor dag 34—1637

gi tha ma yang / /sngon po dmar po gang yod pa'i/ /mu tig me tog la sogs pa//bsdogs pa'i dbus na rin chen can/ /tsong tsong dag la dpyad ༄1par bya /rta babs bar ni tsong tsong las/ /gser dngul zangs 'khar dpyangs 2pa'i sgra//dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan yang brjod/ /gtsang ma'i sru dang a shwad ④shun//dar dkar dag dang gsum la ni/ /rnga yab dar shing gser dngul sogs/ /tsong tsong dag la dpyad 5par bya/ /rin chen yid 'ong phreng ba'i tshogs/ /tsong tsong dag la dpyad 6par bya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'gro ba ma lus rang bzhin mtshon/ /gzugs brnyan chu zla smig rgyu zhes/ /rtogs par bya phyir sbyang bar 7bya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i phyir/ /mkhas par 8rin chen la sogs pas/ /sa gzhi snying po can du bya/ /'phan phran 9nyid la skal —bzang dang / /bkra shis tsa ka lis brgyan pa/ /nyi zla pad+mas mtshon pa yang / /gtso bo dag la dpyangs 1 pa'o/ /yon chab bdug spos dri chab bye/ /me tog mar me khal dag dang / /lha bshos khur ba lha grangs so/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi bu ram mar/ /bye re btung ba bca' ba'i tshogs/ /gtor ma'i rgyu cha sna tshogs dang / /'byung po'i kha zas bsog —par bya/ /gzhan yang zhi ba'i mchod rdzas ni/ /til dang yungs kar 'bras yos 'bras/ /nas dang gro dang ga pur rnams/ /phul gang yin no nas thug dang / /'bras chan ma du bye gang shis/ /gzhan yang rgyas dbang drag po yi/ /thug pa thams cad bye re'o/ /gzhan ma kun la phul re'o/ /lha bshos khur sab dog gu rnams/ /lha grangs bzhin du bsog 7par bya/ /pad+ma 7lhor bting ku sha nub/ /khri ni shar te gru gsum byang / /las bzhi'i 3 4byed/638

gdan ni dgod par bya/ /rnam par rgyal lam khro phyogs hom/ /spyan sogs yum bzhis lhag chad 'bum/ /dbang po zhi ba zla ba 'dra/ /dbang po rgyas pa pad+ma 'dra/ /dbang po dbang ni nyi ma 'dra/ /dbang po drag po dud pa 'dra/ /dbyig lku pa bgrang phreng spyi drugs gzung / /dang po ting 'dzin gyis bskul nas/ /bum pa zla ba pad+ma dang / /btud ༄2pa'i mdangs ldan bsil ngabyed yum/ /bdud rtsi 'o ma bu ram zho/ /bkang ba'i bum pa so so la/ /rin chen 'phan byang gdugs ldan te/ /rnam snang mdzad dang gsum dag gis/ /zhabs kyi drung du gzung ba dang / /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /las dang snyug bsngal zhi bar byed/ /oṃ ga 5na ga ga ne+e lo tsa ne+e/ tsa le tsa le tsu na te/ga tang gu tang shāṅgi ku ru swā hā/ dpal rtse rnon po rtse gsum pos/ /dug gsum 'joms pa'i las rnams mdzod/ /lus ngag yid gsum sbyang ba dang / /btab pas gshegs chags brlab 6par byed/ /hom zlum lham pa 7zla gam e/ /rdo rje pad+ma mda' gzhu dang / /rtsang thod rgyan gyis mdzes rgyan gdengs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag lha rnams mchod/ /yo baṃ e yi dkyil 'khor drang / /phying bu'am ni dar gtsang 'bob8/ /du yod pa la zung re'o/ /yam shing dkar ser dmar nag la/ /khung ni khyad par rang sor gcal/ /brgyad dang bcu drug nyi shu'i gzhi9/ /bud shing khru gang do gsum mtshungs 7 / /spom phra sngags mkhan mdzum mo tsam/ /zhi ba yi ni lha grangs bzhin/ /yam shing mdzub gang bcag khru gang / /brkyang khru gang du shes par bya/ /bud shing khru gang ngo bzhi ni/ /rgyas pa yi ni lha grangs bzhin/ /dbang gi yam bud zhi ba'i tshad/ /drag po'i yam bud rgyas pa'i tshad/ /zhi ba'i dris bsgu rgyas sbrang rtsi/ /dbang btsag 31—1639

tsan+dan /tshobasres pas bsku/ /drag po khrag spos bsres pa bsku/ /zho can ser sgyur 2rtsub shing la/ /sor bzhi yar rtse ral gri bzhin/ /rting zlum zur bzhi zor 'dra dang / /zur gsum rdzu thur tshad du bya/ /lo ma sor bzhi so so'i shing / /sor gnyis rtsa ba bshus lha grangs/ /thab kyi bye brag che chung las/ /zho can ser skyur rtsub shing la/ /yu ba sgoms su mthe bong tsam/ /srid du khru do gang phyed gang / /sor bzhi bsgyur 5kha ran sor gcig /zabs sor gnyis la so so'i dbyibs/ /de dbus gtso mo'i phyag mtshan bri/ /kha ran phyogs bzhir phyag rgya gzhag /bar bar rdo rje pad+ma gzhu/ /thod pas mtshan pa tredagang gzar bya/ /srid khru gang la dkyus sor gnyis/ /zabs su sor gcig de'i dbus su/ /gtso bo'i phyag rgyas mtshan blugs gzar/ /blugs gzar steng phub 7mdun du gzhag /zho can ser sgyur rtsub shing la/ /mdud pa dag la gtso yum dgod/ /rtsibs la 'khor gyi yig 'bru dgod/ /rked mdud sgo ba khru khyud 8gang / /rtse mo ya ma baṃ e phaṭa/ /gtso bo'i phyag mtshan spyir bris te/ /rtsibs la chos kyi sig 9'bru 'bar/ /khru gang tshad bya srid du'o/ /spom phra mtho gang sor bzhi bya/ /dkyus sor bco brgyad zabs su ni/ /sor ni brgyad pa de dbus su/ /ri rab rgya mtsho bri bar bya/ /ngos sal ri bdun mtsho yang dgod/ /so so'i gtun gyi kha ran la/ /rdo rje pad gzhu me 'od 'bar/ /thod rtsang 1 me 'od 'bar gling mtsho/ /ji bzhin dkyil 'khor dag la'ang brgyan/ /las bzhi sngags pa'i chas gos ni/ /thugs kyi ze'u ldir mustod g.yogs dang / /brjid /pa'i chos gos smad dkris dang / /gar gyi gtsang gos so so'i mdog /g.yab mos spyan 'dren phyag mtshan rgo/ /so so'i kha dog dar dag la/ /ba 34byed/6 0

dan bzhi yang dar 'drar bya/ /dkar po ser po dmar nag la/ /ho ma'i 'gab ma 'khor ba'o/ /dri zhim ser sgyur rtsub shing gi/ /sa phyogs de dag nye ba ru/ /shing gi lha ste mdog dkar la/ /rin chen sna tshogs dri zhim bcas/ /phul la snying rje byams bsgoms la/ /rten 'byel brjod de rin phul la/ /me yi 1phyogs nas gcad 3par bya/ /srid du ho ma gyur mnyam la/ /sgom phra khru gang yod pa'i shing / /bzhi gnyis sum gnyis mchog tu gces/ /gzhan yang ro bsregs shing dag la/ /spom phra khru do yod pa yi/ /shar nub gnyis su re re yang / /sred du mchod snam yang na ni/ /dngos grub gsol bsgor gzhab shing gnyis/ /shing rgyu phra sgom do dang gsum/ /theg pa'i khyad par bstan pa ni/ /kri yog ma hā yo ga gsum/ /gang gi sgor 5zhugs de lhas sbyang //goms pa'i dbang du shes pa mchog /rim pa gsum du shes par bya/ /de steng 6khang pa lus mgo tshad/ /phrag non bzhi yang bzhir dmigs la/ /'tshogs 7 nas shing gi bdag po la/ /mchod nga/ gtor ma sna tshogs ni/ /stegs bu khru gang pad+ma bre8/ /de dbus shing la 'bag bris gzhag /las kyi skal ldan gang dag gis/ /dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa ni/ /yo byad thams cad tshang ba mchog /che chung mang nyung rgyu las tshad/ /ci yod yid 'ong mdzes pa dgram/ /de dag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal dang / /bdud rtsi 'khyil pas byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra gro dha 9tre+e lokya bi dza ya/ oṃ āḥ⑫hūṃ/ a a ā11/ bla re gtsug tor rnam rgyal brlab/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥd+kut+t+waṃ ā1 /ba dan 'phan tsho des byin brlab/ /oṃ gtso bo'i sa bon/ oṃ s+dzahūṃ ā/gdugs ni gtsug tor gdugs dkar brlab/ /oṃ sum̐ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rgyal mtshan 34—1641

ke tu des byin brlab/ /oṃ rat+na ke tu oṃ 66hūṃ/ lda ldi so so las rigs brlab//oṃ sarba karma tre+e lokya bi dza ya oṃ āḥhūṃ/ tshon rmye sna bde gshegs lnga yis brlab/ /de yang dkyil 'khor gang yin nyid/ /ser po oṃ oṃ oṃ ā ri —hūṃ/ bsgyur te smon lam gdab par bya/ /dkar po oṃ hūṃ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ nag po oṃ swa oṃ āḥhūṃ/dmar po oṃ oṃ saṃ āḥhūṃ/ ljang gu oṃ ha oṃ āḥhūṃ/ srad bu gang yin gtso bos brlab4/ /oṃ oṃ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rta babs phyag rgya bzhis byin brlab/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mda' bzhi rdo rje chags pas brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra ra ga oṃ āḥhūṃ / ral gri rdo rje rdon pos brlab/ /oṃ pad+ma tikyā oṃ aXhūṃ/ phur bu khro bo lngas byin brlab/ /oṃ a pa ra tsi ta 5/ ya man+ta ka h+ya 1 ba ༄ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ma hā bha la oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bum pa gang yin yum gyis brlab/ /oṃ dhā tu shwa ri oṃ ā hūṃ/ 'gab 'khor srung 9ba chen mos brlab/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ a pra ti ha ta oṃ āḥhūṃ—/ do shal gtsug tor rgyal bas brlab/ /oṃ t+t+waṃ oṃ aXhūṃ/ dril bu ku lan dha 7ras brlab/ / oṃ ku lan+dha ri prazlo 11ba ba ba sho yo ga shu dzha po.oṃ yi hūṃ/rnga yab rgyal po bzhis byen brlab/ /oṃ dṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa bi ru snya ka /bi ru pak+ṣa/be shra ba ṇi/ o āḥhūṃ/ nor bu kun gyi yon tan brlab/ /oṃ sarba rat+na ku la oṃ aXhūṃ/ me long rdo rje sems dpas brlab/ /o badz+ra satwa ā dar+sha oṃ āXhūṃ/spyan snying sangs rgyas spyan gyis brlab/ /oṃ budzha sarba ku la tsit+ta dz+nyā na oṃ āḥhūṃ/nyi zla thabs dang shes rab brlab/ /oṃ srur+ya 12tsan+d+ra du na pradz+nyā oṃ āḥhūṃ/btung ba mā ma tīs byin brlab/ /oṃ rat+na badz+ra oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdug pa me tog dri chab me/ /oṃ badz+ra dhu pe puste sa.ā lo ke gadhe oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lha bshos khur sab bca' ba'i tshogs/ /ku lan dha ras 7byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra ku lan+dha —ri 3 7byed167 2

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phung po lnga nyid rnam grol lngar/ /bsgyur zhing oṃ skan dha shu da nya oṃ āḥhūṃ / 'o ma la sogs mngar gsum ni/ /mā ma shīs ni byen gyis brlab/ /oṃ mā ma tī oṃ a hūṃ/ gtor ma thug pa grangs ldan brlab/ /oṃ swasnyi badz+ra oṃ ༄1āḥt+t+waṃ / 'bru rnams mā ma gīs byin brlab/ /oṃ mā ma shī oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'bras yos ma du gos dkar mo/ /oṃ pad+ma badz+re oṃ aXhūṃ/ ga pur sman rnams las thams cad/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gtsang 'bob sangs rgyas spyan gyis brlab/ /oṃ lo ke shwa 2snar ti dhā tu 1oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yam shing bud shing thams cad ni/ /me lhas byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ asna ye oṃ āḥhūṃ/shag te'u shug te'u cang te'u chosogs/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ dze+e badz+ra oṃ aḥ5hūṃ/ zangs phye ske tshe til la phug /gro ti shwa ri sangs rgyas spyan—/ /oṃ kro ti shwa ri swa 6ta badz+re oṃ āḥhūṃ/ tsher te'u 7la sogs mā ma tī/ /oṃ mā ma tī oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dgang gzar gang yin yum kyis brlab/ /blus/sa gzar gang yin yab kyis brlab/ /phur bu gang yin gtso 'khor khro/8 /gtun khung gang yin de yum 'khor/ /mda' gzhu ma mo tso 1ris brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra tso ⑫ri oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan rnams bdud rtsi 'khyil pas brlab/ /g.yab dar rlung lhas byen gyis brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ya bya oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhal kham mā ma tīs byin brlab//sreg shing hūṃ gyis 11brlab par bya/ /oṃ zlo 2e baṃ ma yā / sbyar/ /oṃ yi hūṃ/chas gos 'bru lngas byin brlabs —gzhag /ku sha bting 7ba'i stan steng du/ /sngags g.yog shar bltas ponyal du gzhug /lha rnams kyis ni legs dgu ster 7 / /byen gyis brlab pa ma byas na/ /las rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas nan tan bskyed de bya/ /yang na rnam rgyal lam bdud rtsi/ /'khyil pa 34byed/67 3

nyid kyis brlab kyikyang rung / /dkyil 'khor ci yang bzhengs pa la/ /phrin las bzhi yi hom ldan bya/ /yang ni ting 'dzin bye brag las/ /las bzhi'i cho ga rdzogs pa mchog /cho ga ma tshang las mi 'grub/ /de phyir sta gon rdzogs par bya/ /u dus+thā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /ston pa po ni shin tu yang / /de bas kyang ni 'jig rten du/ /'byung ba yang ni shin tu dkon/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ston pa dka'/ /dam pa'i chos ni ston srid kyang / /gsang sngags ston pa shin tu dka'o/ /gal te gang 1sngags ston kyang rung / /dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug pa dka'/ /bskal par yang ni sngags spyad gepa'i/ /las dbang gis ni deng mthong nas5/ /rgyal po yang ni ma yin yang / /rgyal po nyid ni chen por gyur6/ /bde gshegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /yon tan gyi 7ni mchog kyang 'thob / /tshe ring zhing ni longs spyod kyang / /phun sum nyid ni tshogs par 'gyur/ /las rnams kun ni thams cad kyang / /btang snyoms pa ni yan lag go/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las dag dang / /cho 'phrul bzhi yi che ba dang / /gang zhig dkyil 'khor nang gzhug pa/ /gsum po de ni gzhan don gsungs/ /dang po las gsungs rim pa ni/ /tshes grangs chos klog gzhi bdag 9dang / /srad bu tshad ldan bgegs bsal bsrung / /thugs dam bskul g.yog dbang bskur sbyang / /rang bzhin thig gdab slar bsdu dang / /tshon dgye phyag rgya rgyan rnams/ dgod/ /gsum lnga bdun dang bcu gcig dang / /bcu gsum bco lnga yar gyi shis/ /zhi dang rgyas pa mchog tu bshad/ /bcu bdun nyi shu gnyis brgyad do/ /dbang dang drag po'i dkyil 'khor mchog /dus dang mtshan ma kri ya'o/ /nyi ma dge zhing rgyu skar bzang / /mtshan ma'i 3 1byed/61/1

sems rtog 1mi dmigs pa/ /de ni chos dbyings gnas pa yin/ /de ltar dus dang mthun pa dang / /phyogs bzhir dge bsnyen gtsang sbra canag/ /sha dang chang bcad bud med spangs/ /tshul du shis pa snargyun mi bcad/ /shar du sbud pa tshigs su bcad/ /lhor ni bzang po spyod pa'o/ /nub tu snang brgyad gsang ba'i mdo/ /byang du gser 'od dam pa gdon/ /gus par mchod cing bden pa bklag /tshon sna lnga skud bu mos bkal/ /de nyid kyis ni brgyar bzlas te/ /rgyu bzang tshad la phebs pa dang / /bzang po'i lta stangs sbyar nas ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /lag na rdo rjes bgegs bskrad bya/ /srung 4ba chen mos bdag gzhan bsrung / /phyogs bcu gtso la sogs pa yi/ /thugs dam bskul 5nas srad bur thim/ /de lta'i rigs bzhi'i thugs las phyung 6 / /gtso bo gang yin thugs zhugs phyung / /de nas gtso bo gang yin gyi7/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams sbyang ba dang / /myur du sems can don bsgrub dang / /las kyi dngos po gang byed pa'i/ /las rnams ma lus khyod kyis byos/ /las kyi rdo rje don yod grub/ /kha dog sna tshogs byung ba la / /oṃ āḥt+t+waṃ swā hā/ karma zhes ni dbang bskur ro/ /bdag nyid shar lho mtshams 'greng 8ste/ /sngags g.yog byang shar mtshams su ni/ /pus btsugs thal sbyar 'dug pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor gang bzhengs las rnams ni/ /gang bzheng 9gtso bo'i bka' bzhin du/ /las kyi byed por bdag gyur pas/ /thams cad ma lus bdag gis bgyi/ /de nas thub dbang bskul byas nas/ /de nas sbyang bar bya ba ni/ /bdag po gang yin ting 'dzin las/ /yo gyis phrag dog gtor lud dkyil/ /de na rdo rje ste lnga 'bar/ /'od 'phros dngos 371byed/615

po'i mtshan ma bsregs/ /bdag nyid yi ge khar —1gyur gtso/ /mnga' bdag de yi byen brlabs thuchu/ /rgyun gyi khams dag de nyid rang / /de yi byin brlabs yon tan bcu/ /de mthu las byed las rnams 'grub/ /mkhas pas thig btab tsa bhā'i dmigs / /lha mos gshegs bsgul skud la thim/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lngar gyur/ /bhe ba'i thad kar thal bkan la/ /g.yas pa bkan gzhag mtheb ngos sbyar/ /de nas sbub ldog ④nam mkhar gdab/ /lan gcig gnyis gsum btab pa'i mthus/ /rang bzhin byon dang ting 'dzin gsal/ /ngan song gsum bde zhus bshad bstod/ /mchog gsum lha tshogs mchod phyag 'tshal / /oṃ rgyu 5shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā khuwa ā kolhañjuhaṃ/ zhes pas —rang bzhin thig gdab bya/ /bdag nyid shar lho mtshams song ste/ /las bdag byang shar mtshams 'dug ste/ /de nas dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa/ /dam tshig bsgul dang las bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tram̐ mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ tshad ldan sngags g.yog med phur chogs9/ /sems can don byas bdag nyid kyi/ /slar yang thugs kar bsdu bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sgu dang gsung dang thugs dang ni/ /yon tan phrin las rigs lnga yi/ /gtso bo gang yin de nyid la/ /gsang gsum zhes su bsgrags pa'ang mchog /tshon ni dri dang pa tsan dang / /rin chen phung po gsum du bstan/ /yon tan sgu 'dra las thugs bzhin/ /dbus kyi pho brang bskor ba yin/ /'khor lo rdo rje ra ba ni/ /phye ma dkar pos nyis rim bri/ /lhas 7kyi lha las ma gtogs pa/ /phal pa dang ni bsrung 1 bkra shis/ /phye ma dkar bo chig rkyang bri/ /sgo yi khutshon sna pañca'o / /gnyis pa tri la sgo gong brtsig /rkyang bris phyag rgya dgod pa yang //3 4byed/646

gtso bo gzugs la 'khor phyag rgya/ /phal la sogs pa yig 'bru'o/ /tha mal pa dag thig le'o/ /tshon la sogs pa'i las rnams kun/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas bya bar shis/ /dbang ldan 'dren pa'i lha dbang phyogs/ /tshon ni nang nas dgye bar bya/ /de nas phyag rgya nor bu bum/ /dgod pa nyid du bya ba yin/ /gzungs thag slob dpon gzung 1ba shis/ /de 'og tshon rnams rim gyis gtang 3/ /de nas phyag rgya'am yig 'bru gzhag /thog mar sgo yi tshon dgye chonas/ /de 'og sgo yi phyag rgya dang / /glang seng rnams kyang dgod par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal thams cad byi dor ni/ /dang po ba lci de 'og tu/ / rnam lngas bskus nas de 'og tu/ /5dri yi chus ni byug par bya/ /tshon dgye tsu/dus su thugs dam bskul//sems can khams ni zhi byed pa'i/ /'di ni chos dbyings ro yin pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngon gsungs te/ /de bas bdag gis bka' bzhin du/ /tshon 'gyed pa yi las bgyid na/ /rgyal ba kun byin dbang bskur cig /phyag rgya dgod phyir thugs dam bsgul/ /sku gsung thugs rtags mtshan ma 'di/ /'gro la phan phyir dgod do zhes/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngon gsungs te/ /rgyal ba kun gyis dbang bskur cig /rgyan rnams dang po nor bu ste/ /de la sogs pa dgod par bya/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i rin po ches/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /sngags rnams gong ma de las ni/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra bsnan par bsams/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyu las byas/ /kha dog dbyibs su ldan pa yi/ /shes rab yum kyi bum pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyes zlobs/ /rten gyi 'bras bu mtshon 'brel rtags/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin pas/ /thugs rje gzungs 7thag chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la 34—1647

byin gyis rlobs/ /phrin las yon tan lhun grub pa'i/ /bla re kun bzang dang nyid rtags/ /'bras bu rtags kyi phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /sku yi phyag rgya mtshon mdzad cing / /mtshan dang dpe byad 'phan chen gyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis zlobs/ /nyon mongs gdung ba sel byed 1pa'i/ /gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu bar ldan/ /skyabs chen byams pa chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis zlobs/ /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal ba rgyal mtshan te/ /rtags kyi rgyal mtshan chen po 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /phrin las cho 'phrul bzhi bzhi yis/ /las rnams rgya mtsho rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /snyan pa'i ba dan gsung sgrogs pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byen gyis rlobs/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'brel pa'i rtags/ /kha dog sna lnga 'bar ba yi/ /lhab lhub lda ldi chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs rje gzungs 2thag ye shes bzhis/ /sangs rgyas bzhi yi phrin las thugs/ /thugs rje 1srad bu 'phel gzungs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /tshad med bzhi dang bsdu ba bzhis/ /'gro ba'i don rnams rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dri zhim rta babs phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /mgo rmongs 'khyams pa'i mun sel mdzad/ /gti mug go bral shes rab mdas/ /gting dbugs byang chub lam 'god pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin kyis rlobs/ /'khor ba'i dra ba chags pa'i rgyun/ /mtha' gnyis gcod mdzad byams pa'i mgon/ /shes rab rtags kyi ral gri 'dis / /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis zlobs/ /khro gtum rngam pa'i tshul 374byed16 8

'chang bas/ /log par lta ba'i zhe sdang 'dul/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i tī 1la yas / /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan ma'i yul rnams sel mdzad cing / /srung dang mtshams kyi las mdzad pa/ /'gab 'khor srung ba chen po 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /dpe byad rtags kyi do shal chun2/ /yid 'ong me tog 'bar ba yis / /dkyil 'khor 'di la byen gyis rlobs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i rtags / /rin chen mchog gsum mtshan brjod pa'i/ /gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan dril 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan ma'i bag chags kun sel ba'i/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rgyal chen bzhis phul mchod mchog gis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan 'dra ba yi/ /rang bzhin dag pas rtog pa med/ /ma rmongs ston pa'i me long 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis zlobs/ /zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas shing / /'jig rten kun dang mthun 'jug /rtags/ /thabs dang shes rab nyi zla 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rgyan 'os dang / /lha bshos phyogs kyi 4gtor ma yis/ /rgyu drug 'gro tshim byed mthu yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /gnyis pa bdag zhugs cho 'phrul gyis/ /che ba'i don thabs bstan phyapas 'dzin/ /ting nge 'dzin dang byin gyis brlab6/ /dbang bskur mchod pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /bdag nyid dang po rnal 'dug dang / /ting 'dzin zhugs pa rnam gnyis so/ /bdag shar sgor 'dug 'dzin pa la/ /dam bca' dbang thob snying rje yis/ /thabs dang shes rab don byed par/ /'phags pa kun mkhyen spyan drangs la/ /34—1649

oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā lnga yis/ byin gyis brlabs la swas dbang bskur/ /phyag rgya'i go cha haṃ gi bgo1/ /tu6 ho dang sarnyi 2tiṣ+ṭha dang / /ya thā ༄ badz+ra satwa tiṣ+ṭha tai 4a haṃ baṃ/ /dgongs pas grub pa zhugs dang bskyed/ /de nas khro bos bgegs mtshams bcad/ /zhugs pas de bzhin nyid kun snang / /rgyu las 'byung ba rim la 5bskyed/ /de steng gzhal yas khang rgyan ldan/ /nang du gdan dag bskyed pa'i steng / /'khor lo yid 'ong gru chad dang / /sgo dang sgo khang bya dang bcas / /sems can pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /ci rigs par ni mdzes par bya/ /de steng sems nyid dag pa yis/ /rgyu las chos nyid mngon byang chub/ /de gzugs zla ba yig 'bru dang / /phyag mtshan dang ni sku rdzogs pa/ /'bras bu dang ni 6bskyed pa lnga/ /stong 7pa'i cho 'phrul lnga rgyu lnga/ /chos nyid rgyu las rnam snang mngon byang chub/ /gzugs brnyan zla ba mi bskyod mngon byang chub/ /yig 'bru rin chen 'byung ldan mngon byang chub/ /phyag mtshan snang ba mtha' yas mngon byang chub/ /gzugs sku don yod grub pa mngon byang chub/ /snang ston sra brtan sreg byed dang / /gyes 'dzin shugs bskyod zad par lnga/ /nam mkha' sa me chu rlung gi/ /de yi byin rlabs 9 thams cad mngon byang chub/ /rgyu las bag chags gnas gyur chos dbyings bskyed/ /zla ba kun gzhi gnas gyur me long bskyed/ /yig 'bru nyon mongs gnas gyur mnyam sems bskyed/ /phyag mtshan yid gyur so sor rtog sems bskyed/ /sku ni sgo lnga bya ba nan tan bskyed / /rtag chad gzung 'dzin bdag gzhan bya ba grub/ /chos nyid rgyu las rnam snang mngon bstan pas/ /bsam gtan tshul te sangs rgyas rjes dran sku/ /oṃ tsit+ta pra ti be 7t+t+waṃ ka ro yā mi/ e ma'o/ /don dam rang bzhin spros med 371—/650

sems kyi dbyings/ /rgyal ba rgyal 1mtsho'i thugs dang ye nas mnyam/ /mngon par byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /chos kyi dbyings nyid mi gnas ji bzhin dang / /gzugs brnyan zla ba mi bskyod mngon 3bstan pas/ /ye shes tshul te dge 'dun rjes dran sku/ /oṃ bi 1bye tsit+ta tsan+d+ra ut+pā rid yā mi/ e ma'o//bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen yongs rdzogs pa/ /zla ba nya ba bzhin du snang ba ste / /kun du bzang po ye nas dag pa'i don/ /mngon par byang chub rang bzhin 'od kyang gsal/ /yig 'bru rin chen 'byung ldan mngon bstan pas/ /spyin pa'i tshul te gtong ba rjes dran sku/ /oṃ hūṃ swā 5aḥha tiṣ+ṭha e ma ho6 /ma rig sel cing yang dag rig bskyed pa/ /gsung gi rang bzhin che ba'i byin rlabs 7te/ /gsang ba bsgrub pa'i mchog tu bsngags pas na/ /don gyi snying po spros med byang chub dbyings/ /phyag mtshan so so mtha' yas mngon bstan pas/ /tshul khrims tshul de gnyis rtog 8chos dran sku/ /tsakra badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma swā bhā wa āt+ma kolha9haṃ/ e ma'o / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs nyid ye shes lnga yi rtags su snang / /mi g.yo mi ldog mchog gi rang bzhin pas/ /ji bzhin mnyam pas byang chub chen bo'i ngang / /skur gyur gzugs las don yod skur ston pas/ /brtson 'grus tshul te lha rjes dran pa'i sgu/ /oṃ hūṃ swa āḥha ya tha satwa tiṣ+ṭha lta a / haṃ/ e ma'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /ma skyes ye shes mnyam pa nyid/ /thabs la mkhas dang thugs rje yi/ /de nyid phyag rgya chen por snang / /sngags ni sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs/ /tshigs thubacad don grub rtog / tshad gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis / /dgyes pa'i phyag ni spyi bor gzhag /byin gyis brlab phyir oṃ s+dzahūṃ/ /dbang 34—1601

bskur swa 'bar rin po che/ /yongs su grub dang gzhan dbang dang / /kun brtags 3pa ni thams cad la'o/ /yongs su grub pa zhes pa ni/ /rnam snang mdzad chen de nyid do/ /gzhan dbang rjes su bstan pa ni/ /sangs rgyas mang pos sngags gsungs rtogs/ /kun brtags zhes su bstan pa ni/ /'og min gnas dang ri rab zom/ /rdo rje gdan la sogs ston pa'o/ /'khor rnams thams cad sgo mdun 2bskyed/ /'bras bu lnga ni yongs su grub/ /bskyed pa gzhan dbang yin par bshad/ /ston pa'i cho 'phrul kun brtags so/ /snyan gsan gsol spyan drang la gzhug /dam tshig phyag 'tshal mchod bstod chos/ /byang chub sdom go byin rlabs 1dang / /mtshams bcad dam tshig dbog rig bya/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na / /rgyal ba gang bzhugs 'khor dang bcas / /mgon po dam can ji snyed po/ /thams cad kun nas dgongs su gsol / /gnyis med rnam dag dbyings phyamachog na/ /mnyam nyid gnas pa de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgul ba'i sa la bzhengs nas kyang / /sems can don la rab brtson pa'i/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /byang chub sems dpa' lcam dral dang / /khro bo khro mo la sogs kun/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can sbyang ba dang / /khyad par bdag dang yon bdag dang / /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin rlob don/ /rang bzhin rdzogs 6chen bzhugs 3gnas nas/ /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan gzhal yas 'dir/ /thugs rjes byon dgongs spyan 'dren spyon/ /e bye hi budha dhā tī 8shwa ri bo bye satwa sarba sa mā 9 dzaḥ/ chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa na/ /rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas khyad par can/ /rab 'byams mchod pa'i bklubs 7shing ni/ /nyi zla pad sogs 34—/652

gdan steng nas/ /mi mjed 'dzam gling 'jig rten 'dir/ /bkra shis dpal mchog lkugazhal yas khang / /bla med mchod pa'i rgyan bshams nas/ /'gro ba'i don phyir spyan 'dren na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i 'jig rten sgon/ /thugs rje dam can smon lam gyis/ /sems can don phyir chos sku las/ /gzugs sku longs spyod sdogs skur snang / /thugs rjes sprul sgur gshegs pa bzhin—/ /dkyil 'khor ma nyams dam pa 'dir/ /byin gyis rlabs 3 kyis gshegs su gsol/ /dkyil 'khor gang lhags lha tshogs kun/ / tshom tshom mtshams bsdebs 4spyan drangs la/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang mi yi seng ge spyon/ /gti mug mun sel 'jig rten sgron ma spyon/ /nyon mongs nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po spyon/ /bdud rigs 5pham mdzad thar pa'i lam ston spyon/ /dbang mdzad rgyal po 'dir spyon mchod pa bzhes/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus gnas 'dir spyon/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag spyan 'dren bstan 6pa'i bdag /gang phyir bdag gis spyan drangs pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la brtan par gyur/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rin chen zhags pa dam po'i bdag /rdul phran bzhugs pa thams cad kun/ /slar yang bdag gis drang bar bgyi/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /pad+ma be+egs sgog dam pa'i bdag /bcings pa kun las grol ba rnams/ /sems can don du bcing bar 'dod/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgya gram dril bu dbab brtan bdag /kun kyi chos bdag gyur pa yang / /bran du yang ni gyur cing zhugs/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e bye hi bha ga bān7/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ 8sh+ya hoḥs ma ya dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ la sogs pa'i lha rnams sngags/ /rting la a ka dzas 34—1653

brgyan cing / /so sor sgu gsung thugs kyi lha/ /ma lus pa rnams spyan drang ngo / /mdor na 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+me chodang / /rgya gram 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /thams cad kun mkhyen rgyud rig pas/ /'dul ba'i thabs ni sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i don rnams mdzad du gsol/ /gtor ma las rnams kun gyi mchog /las kyi sna la bstan pa ni/ /shar du bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /lhor ni srid pa mnyam pa yin / /nub tu klu gdug bzlog pa'o/ /byang nas las la gzhug pa'o/ /de nas so sor srung mtshams gcad/ /e bye nuhis bos 4las la gzhug /byin gyis brlab byas mchod bstod cing / /smon lam gdab cing slar gting gtong 5 //lag pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas ni/ /snying po 'jug la gdags pa ni/ /badz+ra satwa sa ma yo karma/ /gdags shing dbyangs dang sbyar ba'o/ /thugs brtse 6phan pa'i dgongs pa can/ /ji ltar phrin las bcol ba bzhin/ /'khor ba yun ring de srid du/ /don rnams mdzad cing brtan por ni/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas ni/ /snying po 'jug la gdags pa ni/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya hoḥ7sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ā gats+tsha dzaḥ / //(oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+da na ka ro mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pā sha āt+ma ṭ+wāṃ nit+yā 11ta yā mi —/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa saṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū 7dza a r+bha ṣekā 7ya/ a dzā nit+yā 7ta yā mi phre/ oṃ na maḥ 7sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhe ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya āt+ma māṃ nit+yā /nata yā mi/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra brta ya rmā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma rte/3 4byed/654

āt+ma māṃ nit+yā dzota yā mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru rmā/2 de nas mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ /dang po sbyin sreg las bzhi ste/ /de nas lhag pa'i mchod skyabs gsol/ /de nas thun mong mchod rnam lnga/ /de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas 4mchod sprin bya ba bshad/ /de kun ngag yid gdungs dbyangs mchod/ /mchod pa'i dang po 'di yin no/ /de 'og rdzas kyi mchod pa la/ /sbyin sreg mchod sbyin rnams kyi mchog /sdeb sbyor mchog ni nyi ma'i lha/ /mi yi mchog ni rgyal po ste/ /rgya mtsho chu bo rnams kyi mchog /zla ba rgyu skar rnams kyi gtso/ /nyi ma snang byed rnams kyi gtso/ /bsgrub pa'i mchog ni gsang sngags te/ /las kyi mchog ni rnam bzhi'o/ /gnas kyi mchog ni dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /steng dang 'og dang thad kar yang / /'gro ba'i 'gro ba ji snyed pa/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /smra ba'i mchog ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bstan pa'i mchog ni sgogs chen po/ /rdo rje rgyud du bsngags 5pa yin/ /bzlas pa'i mdun dang bar skabs dang / /de bzhin bzlas pa'i 'og tu yang / /sngags pas spyin sreg bya ba ni/ /thams cad du yang bsngags pa yin/ /sbyin sreg byas nas bzlas bya ba/ /dang por shin tu 'dod pa yin/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg 'brel pa ni/ /de ni bar du 'dod pa yin/ /bzlas pa'i mjug 6gi sbyin sreg gang / /de nas shin tu gtso bar bshad/ /dang pos bu lon rtog pa bsal7/ /bar du lha rnams tshim bya'i phyir/ /tha mas lhag chad bskangs 8pa'i don/ /baṃ gyis tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /dang byams yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /las rnams brtsam par byas nas ni/ /gtum chen rngam po'ang lhan ne+er 'gyur/ /lha 3 4—165pya

rnams dkar po byams dang ldan/ /zlum po dkyil 'khor rtsibs brgyad par/ /lha rnams 'khor bcas brgyan par bzhugs/ /ho ma mchog zlum gdengs pa la /rdo rje pad+mas rab brgyan te/ /phur pa dkar po drug btab par/ /yid la shin tu gsal byas te/ /byin za dge ba rab snasbar bstan/ /yam shing dkar po rnams kyi me/ /rab sbar rdo rje khro bo yi/ /dang byams gzhag ste snyoms zhugs la/ /til bsregs bzhin du sdig bsregs shing / /che ge sarba pā paṃ da ha na hūṃ phaṭa dz+wa la ram̐/ /shar lho kha khyer de nyid la/ /dam tshig nyid kyi ram̐ spros te / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zla dkar bzhin/ /zhi ba'i lus dang lta ba'i thabs / /skyin chen dkar po'i gdan bzhugs 2bsam/ /ye shes asne'i thugs dam bsgul/ /oṃ na mo badz+ra pā ṇa 1ye/ na mo dz+nyā na 4asna ye de ba dz+wa la ram̐ / lan gsum brjod pas zhal phyogs shing / /spyan gzigs thugs dgongs de nyid la/ /dam tshig pa yi lcags kyu bcas/ /gnyis min dbyings las bskul pa yi/ /ye shes drang srong chen po nyid/ /sngon gyi smon lam thugs rje yis/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e h+ye he5/oṃ badz+ra ha ri bi ga /pa ta tsi ba lo ke ti/ ya sha de hi de ba bta ye swā hā/na mo badz+ra pā ṇa gye/ oṃ dz+nyā na asna ye/ ki li ki li/ dadhe la po tra/ i ha i ha ā gats+tsha hūṃ ta sha nā 6ya swā hā/ ye shes me lha byon nas ni/ /dam tshig bskyed dang gcig gyur nas/ /mdun du bzhugs pa de nyid la/ /gnyis med drang srong abhe la/ /bdug spos chur byas bsang ba ni/ /stong gsum kun du dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /spos lnga sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus/ /ye shes sprin phung mkha' las cher 7'be+ebs pas/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs kun 31—/656

dag gyur cig /swa bhā ba sarba dharmāḥshurnyopho kyehaṃ/ dag pa nyid du byas nas kyang //mchod pa lnga yis thumachod de gzhag /gnyis min drang srong asne la/ /bdug spos me tog me dri bshos/ /yon bdag don du 'bul lags na/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ na mo dz+nyā na 3༄sa ma ya satwa asna ye dhū pe puste pe.ā lo ke gadhe/ ā 5 ha ra sarba dharmāḥ 4 pū dza pañca swā hā/ de nas mchod bstod shing rta la/ /bzhugs pa nyid du bya ba'am/ /kha khyer bzhag la las mchod bstod / /de nas me yi dngos nyid pa'i/ /rang bzhin rnam rgyal khro bo phyogs//de la sogs pa gong nyid du/ /spyan drangs mdun du gsol bsgoms la/ /ting 'dzin gsal bas de nyid sbyang / /rnam par rgyal ba bos nas ni/ /gzugs brnyan shar g.yas sam dpral ba'i/ /rnam rgyal de yi lus gnyis gcig /de nyid na ni bzhugs par bsam/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs khams gsum rnam rgyal gtso/ /'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs nas ni/ /sreg ༄3blugs zhal zas bges me sbyangs༄ / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e bye hi/ oṃ tre+e lokya bi dza ya sa ma ti mu dra t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ ā gats+tsha/ de ltar spyan drangs de nyid kyis/ /gdan mchog dam pa bstab pa ni/ /me tog lag tu thogs nas ni/ /mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje'i ngang / /nyon mongs mi spong gos pa med/ /ma chags rang bzhin dag pas na/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la 9 ye s+t+waṃ/ de ltar gdan la bzhugs pa yang / /yang dag nyid du dag mod kyi/ /dri ma'i mtshan ma med mod kyang / /'jig rten srid zhu'i tshul gyis su/ /phyag dang zhal ni bsil mdzod cig /ā rkaha ra bi shudhe swa bhā /geb/ de nas mchod pa 'bul zheb ni/ /khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal kyis/ /che ge mo yi sdig 34—1657

bshags nas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang bskur te/ /yang dag nyid du sgrub pa la/ /bar chad byed pa'i log rtog 1ni/ /gnod sbyin skar ma 3gdong la sogs/ /chad pas bcad cing bka' phab ste/ /bka' 'am sngags kyi tshig tsam gyis/ /zhi ba la sogs rnam bzhi ni/ /bran bzhin du ni byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir dang po khro bo mchod/ /de phyir rnam par rgyal sogs la/ /mar khu shag te'u shu tse'u 'di/ /yon bdag don du 'bul lags na/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes du 4gsol/ /snying ga'i thad nas dbul bar bya/ /oṃ tre+e lokya bi dza ya kro dha ya dī bya dī 5bya na pū dza ye swā hā/ lag g.yas mtheb srin nyi ma a/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis/ /blangs te sku gsung thugs mnyes phyir / /mchod pa'i gnas dang mchod rdzas dang / /mchod mkhan nyid las byang chub sems/ /dkar po shel dag byung ba yis/ /gang la dmigs pa der bstems pas/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags zhi/ /khro rgyal khams gsum rnam rgyal la/ /mngar gsum 'o thug nas kyi thug /'bras bu lag pan 'bras yos dang / /'bru sna lnga la sogs pa 'bul/ /bdug spos me tog me dri bshos//oṃ tre+e lokya bi dza ya kro dha ya dhū 6pe puṣ+pe ā lo ke gadhe ā 7 ha ra sarba dharmāḥpū 8dza pañca swā hā/ a dī bya dī bya ti ye swā hā/ de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu dbyangs ldan la/ /sgu yi 'gying 'gyur dang bcas par zhi rgyas gnyis las rdor dril nang / /dbang drag rdor dril phyir bskor gsil9 / /ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i bdud khams thams cad sreg /sprin gnyis 'thibs bzhin khro gnyer brjid pa'i zhal/ /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' 27byed/658

mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po bgegs kyi mtha' gnon pa'i/ /khro bo'i rgyal po dug gsum 'joms mdzad pa/ /khams gsum sems can ngan 'gro las sgrol ba/ /mdog sngo rdo rje pad+ma zhags pa bsnams/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal sogs/ /me nyid sbyang ba'i las mdzod bzhugs/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdud rtsi lnga 1'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma 3 ming du bcas par bya//bkug nas rdo rje phur pas gdab/ /dum bur byas la tshogs la bstabs/ /oṃ tre+e lokya bi dza ya shī 1li a mṛ ta pañca pū dza swā hā/ bde gshegs khro chen rnam par rgyal / /thugs rje che dang bdag 'byel pas/ /gzhal yas nyid du bzhugs nas kyang / /me nyid sbyang ba'i las bcol ba'o/ /de nas lag g.yas kha phar bstan—/ /g.yon pa tshur bstan mkhrig ma bsnol/ /mtheb gnyis mthil gzhag sor brgyad bskyod/ /oṃ tī li chotī la badz+ra bi ma la ro thutri pra kṛ ti/ ma hā po dha badz+ra ya na dza ha 4kṛt+ta ta hūṃ phaṭa/ spyong dz+waba'i las ni lha tshogs kyis8/ /mdun du bya bar yang dag bshad/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum po ste/ /sbyang dang spyan drang gdan dag dang / /mchod pa la sogs rnam rgyal bzhin/ /mgon po thugs rje cher /ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho yon tan gzhi/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dag pas sna'adod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan 'gro las sgrol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan gzhi/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla med dkon 34—1659

mchog gsum po yis/ /zhi ba la sogs grub par gsol/ /bde bar gshegs so dkon mchog gsum/ /khyod kyis byams pa'i las kun mdzad/ /dang ba'i yid kyis bskyed pa yi/ /gzhal yas nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e gā 1kra ma ya hi ga dza/ me lha gnyis ni spyan drang ba'i/ /mdun du tī — lis me nyid spyong 4/ /de nas g.yas pa'i mje bo yis/ /mthe'u 5chung mdung tshugs 6g.yabs nas ni/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs zhes ni bos nas ni/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e bye hi/ ma hā bhā ta 7de ba ri ṣi/ dī dza sa ta ma ni/ hi twa a hu ti ma hā ram̐/ asmi san+ni hi to bha ba/ asna 4 ye ā gats+tsha/ ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/ de nas bzhugs par bya ba ni/ /lha yi drang srong kun dang ni/ /sreg sbyin btab par khas 'ches pa/ /thugs rje dam tshig brtan pa ni/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs 1 su gsol/ /asna ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha/ swa bhā 4wa bi ga ta bi dza lo hi ta ā kā sasha dī pa ya shudhe swā hā/྾phyag zhal bsil ba byas nas ni/ /gnyis min drang srong me lha la/ /shag te'u 1 la sogs bdun gsum dbul/ /oṃ ram̐ ram̐ agha ye ha bya ka bya dī bya dī /bya na ya pū dza swā hā/ dhu pe puste ā lo ke ghadhe pū dza pañca swā hā/ de nas rdo rje dril bur bcas/ /'akying 'gyur bcas la bstod pa ni/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs la bskyab nga/'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sgu sprul la/ /rig par grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs/ /bgrang phreng 'dzin cing rig sngags gsung / /bdud 3 4byed/660

rtsi bcud ldan ghun+de lkubasnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil5/ /nyes nga/'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /asne chen po'i thugs dam bzhin/ /rnge nyid geye shes mer byin rlobs/ /las kyi lha rnams mchod pa yi/ /sreg rdzas stobs pa'i las mdzod bzhugs/ /shing rta gcig la bzhugs 3gsol la/ /phyogs mtshams lha la bskor zhing mchod/ /agha ye ging ka ra pū zhwadza tiṣ+ṭha/ las kyi lha rnams mchod pa yi/ /me sbyang spyan drang gdan dbul bsil7/ /las brtan phyag mchod bstod dang dgu/ /nang 8 ston mchod rten chos nyid mkha'/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam dag sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la'o/ /sra brtan rdo rje gzugs brnyan sa/ /me long ye shes thugs kyi sku/ /sa gnon chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal sems dpa' mi bskyod la'o/ /sreg byed rin chen yig 'bru rnge/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan sku/ /mchod sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal 'byung ldan 9dpal khyod la'o/ /dgyes 'dzin pad+ma phyag 'tshal chu/ /kun rtog ye shes gsung gi sku/ /chos sgrogs chen po phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la'o/ /shag bskyod rgya gram sku ste rlung / /nan tan ye shes phrin las sku/ /skyabs mdzad chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o/ /baṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du 'brel bsdams bskyod/ /bcings 'gyur bskyod pas phyogs bcur g.yo/ /thams cad g.yo ba med par 'gyur/ /shārnyi ku ru swā hā / dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya skrumadud rtse zlum po/ /371—1661

ngos su lha rnams 'khor bcas bsgom/ /btab na gdug rtsub zhi bar 'gyur/ /tī li tī li shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ lha mo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lha yi grub pa bsgom bya ste/ /byams bcas zhi ba'i tho ba yis/ /brdungs pas gdug rtsub zhi bar 'gyur/ /shalba ta shāṅgi ku ru swā hā/ dngul phye 'bras chan hūṃdakar po la/ /'o mas sbyar ba'i gtor ma yis/ /thams cad ma lus zhi bskongs nas/ /gtor mas gdug rtsub zhi bar 'gyur/ /sga ra ṇa shā— kyiku ru swā hā/ las rnams bya ba'i don bstan pa'i/ /bdag nyid byams pa chen po can/ /dkyil 'khor hom khung mchod rdzas tshogs/ /dkar po nyid du bsgom par bya/ /lha rnams thams cad dkar po ste/ /sku yi gzi 'bar yon tan brjid/ /thams cad kun kyang 'tsher zhing zhi/ /byams par bcas pa'i lag pa nas/ /gtong ba thams cad byang chub sems/ /rgyun mi 'chad par kun khyab sgom5/ /drang ba zhi 'gyur phur bu rgyas/ /brdungs pas dbang mdzad gtor ma drag /de ni spyi yi las su gsungs/ /phyogs bcu gdug pa ma lus kun/ /gdug pa'i sems ni rab bor te/ /lhan ne+e dkar po'i 'og tu 'gyur/ /bde ldan byang chub 'od 'phro 'bar/ /'jig rten gsum dang 'das gtum la/ /'bru lnga byams ldan byas nas ni/ /gsol ba gdab par bya ba ni/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin dri za grul / /lto 'phye dang ni nam mkha' lding dang 6'dab/ /lus sru la srin ngo/ gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /sa'am mkha' la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ / bu smad 7g.yog 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/ /de rnams sdug bsngal zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /dad byams yid kyis lha rnams mchod byas te/ /lha yis byin brlabs sprul pa'i 'phro 'du yis/ /las dang nyon 3 (byed1662

mongs sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā hūṃmāṃ/ oṃ āḥm hā shāk+ṣiṃ ka ra shāk+ṣiṃ ka ra pra sha ma dharma nirdza ta/ a bhā ba dharma chosatwa/ bra ba ta shārnyithu/shi baṃ ku ru swā hā/ de ba shārnyi 6ku ru swā hā/ nā ga dz+washārnyi ku ru swā hā/ rāk+ṣa sa 8shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ yak+ṣa shādz+rī ku ru swā hā/ gra 9bheha shādz+rī ku ru swā hā/ mi tsi mi tsi 7shādhi ku ru swā hā/ gung ing shāk+ṣiṃ shā1ku ru swā hā/ ra tang ra tang pra tang pra tang shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ ka rā 7lan be+e ra lan shābye ku ru swā hā/ bi ha sa nan shādz+rī ku ru swā hā/ i ba nan 4 shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ na mo shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/a dṛ 5su du bye tri shādhi ku ru swā hā/ gung ka ri kung ga dzi/ri shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mi tsi mi tsi 7ra ra sre sri/ shaṃ shaṃ sum̐ hūṃ/ e saṃ i i a 1nya.a ra lan shāṅgi ku ru swā hā/ shi dur na mye tre shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas las sbyar rnam rgyal thabs/ /phyag mtshan nam mkhar phyar nas kyang / /gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas pas /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams 19kun/ /skad cig yud la zhi mdzad de/ /zhi bar gyur pas dbyings su rol/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /dad pa'i yid kyis bskyed pa yi/ /gzhal yas nyid du re zhig gshegs/ /slar yang 'gro ba'i don la dgongs/ /de bzhin lha tshogs mang po kun/ /go rims de bzhin las bya'o/ / me yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /snying rje dga' bas mchod byas nas nye/ /las rnams brtsam par nabyas nas ni/ /tshe dang longs spyod dpal 'phel 'gyur/ /puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ ya yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tshe ba la/ /dga' chags yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /las rnams brtsam par byas nas ni/ thams cad ma lus dbang du 'gyur/ /e yi 34byed1663

tshogs kyi tshodakyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la /btang snyoms khros pas mchod sbyin bya/ /las rnams brtsam par 5 byas nas ni/ /thams cad ma lus brlag par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rgyud las byung —ba'i las /sdig pa sreg dang tshe 'phel hom/ /srung dang ro sreg sgrub pa kun/ /cha shas tsam du bstan pa ni/ /hūṃ gi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /ye shes tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /haṃ gi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /re gyi byatshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /dkyil 'khor hom gyi 'tshad bstan pa/ /gsung — gsum dkyil 'khor tha ma 'bring / /rab ni bcu gnyis dgu dang bdun/ /khru gang thams cad sgo gang bya/ /yan lag thams cad tshad bstan pa/ /de khru gang nas brtsams nas ni/ /ji srid dpag tshad thug gi bar/ /'dul ba'i dbang gi khyad par gyis/ /yang na tshad la nges pa med/ /hom khung tha ma 'bring dang rab / /khru gang khru do khru gsum ni/ /'byor pa'i dbang bya pad zla kham/ /gru gsum dang ni 'khor lo rtsibs7/ /brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba'i 'od/ /dkar po dgod de dbus rdo rje/ /rtse lnga shar ro rin chen lho/ /nub tu pad+ma byang rgya gram/ /de steng kha 'khor sor bzhi rdo rje ra/ /sems dpa' sems dpa' pad+ma dang khong yon/ /'jig rten pa ni ci rigs mdzes par bya/ /nub phyogs 'dug ste zhi las bya8/ /bram ze'i khyim du yang dag bshad/ /lho phyogs rgyas pa nub tu dbang / /byang du drag po hom du bshad/ /dkyil 'khor drug gam yang na ni/ /grong khyer phyi /rol rje'u rigs dang / /rgyal rigs smad 'tshong dmangs ma'i khyim/ /sngags pa nub dang lho shar byang / /'dug la mchod pa'i don dag ni/ /gang gi gtso dang thabs dang ni/ /shes rab tshul 34—/664

du ldan pa'i don/ /hom khung dag gi bye brag kyang / /de ci rigs par bya ba lkubashad / /de la sogs pa 2gtso yum ni/ /khung gi mthil du lhag par dgod/ /me 'od ngos la rdo rje kha/ /'khor rnams phyi rol yang dag dgod/ /ro sreg maṇ+ḍal khru bcu gnyis/ /khru bzhi pa na khru do zabs/ / brko ba'i dbus su 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad pa la'ang byang chub kyi/ /mchod rten kun rig phyag rgya sogs/ /rigs bzhi dang ni yum bzhi'o/ /de mtha' rdo rje rtse lngas bskor / /kha la me 'ong bri bar bya/ /de mtha' pad+ma pad+ma la/ /sems dpa' bskal bzang la sogs rnams/ /bri bya gro la lha mo bri/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams kyang / /phyi rim phyogs phyogs dag tu bri/ /gzhung dang 'gal byas nyes sdig bshad/ /sdig pa chen po sgur btab yin/ /ston pa'i bstan dang dge ba'i las/ /pha ma mkhan po slob dpon dang / /mched dang lcam dral rnam lnga yin / /dge ba mi dge mi dge dge/ /rgyal ba'i chos la sgur btab yin/ /sdig can de ni mi thar zhes/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i thub pas gsungs4 / /dkyil 'khor 'jug 'byung byed pa'i phyir/ /ri mo'am yang ni de bzhin gzhan/ /ci bgyi tshad med bzhi bsgoms te/ /sha dang chang dang sgog btsong dang / /rku dang bud med spyad byas na/ /de ni yan lag sgur btab yin/ /de las bshags pa byar yod thabs/ /ji bzhin dam la gnas byas sam/ /theg chen sde la mchod byed na/ /sdig can de ni myur du grol 5/ /pha ma gsad dang 'phrog trebacom dang / /chos kyi mkhan po gsad 7pa dang / /dam tshig lung dang shes rab rgyud/ /man ngag dbang gi slob dpon gsum/ /snying nas smad cing gsad pa dang / /theg chen sde la gnas pa yi/ /mched dang lcam dral 34—1665

dbyen byas shing / /dam las log cing 'khus lkupa ni/ /de ni mtshams med lnga zhes bya/ /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra bar/ /las bzhi sdig bsreg byas bcug na/ /sdig can de yang myur du 'grol / /sngags dang phyag rgya yig 'bru rnams / /lhag dang chad par byas pa ni/ /de dang nye ba'i sdog pa yin/ /ci phyir dbyings dang rnam thar gyi4/ /sgo rnams gzhan du gyur pas na/ /bskal par brjod kyang dngos grub ni/ /thob par mi 'gyur dpa' bos gsungs//shes bya'i sdig pa thams cad ni/ /mi shes sdig las bcur 'gyur che/ /shes bya'i sdig bshags thams cad la/ /'bum lnga dag gis 'byang ngo zhes/ /tsha tsha bskor sab phyag dang ni/ /srog 'don mdo sde lnga dag las/ /'bum 'bum dag tu gsungs pa yin/ /de nas sdom pa gnas pa yin7/ /mtshams med lnga la sogs pa yi/ /sdig can de dag rnams dang ni/ /skad cig yud tsam smra mi bya / /shes nas dam tshig gang nyams pa'i/ /de yi sdig pa brjod mi lang / /gso la nye bar mi brtson na/ /de dag dang yang smra mi bya/ /skad cig yud tsam smras pas kyang / /don gye dngos po gang yin spangs/ /dmag 7la sogs don gcig pa bzhin/ /de yi bshags pa rgyud lngas so/ /bus 'gros thal 'bud tsher lcag dang / /'greng phyag srog sdom dag gis so/ /lhag dang chad pa'i kha bskong sto ni/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po mnyes pa dang / /tshe rabs ḍasnaslob dpon pha ma dang / /slob ma'i sdig zhi dbang bskur dang / /mtha' yas sems can don byas pas/ /de yi sdig pa nges 'byang ngo / /ho ma bzhi yi gtso bo gang / /bsreg 1rdzas bdun gsum nyi shu gcig /mnyes par bya phyir dbul bar bya/ /de nas tshe rabs slob dpon don/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdun gsum gsum//34byed/666

dbul ba nyid du bya bar bshad/ /tshe rabs pha ma'i don gyi phyir/ /rigs kyi gtso bo rnams la'o/ /de nas slob ma rim gyis ni/ /bgegs bsal phyir ni spos chus bkru/ /de nas g.yon phyogs tsog pur gzhag /lag g.yas slob dpon lag g.yon gyi/ /byams par byas snepas bzung nas ni/ /gtso bo dag gi sngags bdun bzlas/ /de nas sdig pa zad bya'i phyir/ /rigs yum lnga la bdun bdun no/ /de yis 2dbang bskur bsrung bar 'gyur/ /mtha' yas sems can don slad — du/ /lha rnams kun la dbul bar bya/ /de dag bkra shis bya ba'i phyir/ /yum bzhi gzungs kyis 4bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan ni tshim byed ma/ /dbang po zhi ba zla ba 'dra/ /bstod tshig gis bskul sngags ce brjod bya/ /de nas bshags pa gus par bya/ /de nas sngags pas kha gyephyogs nas / /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe )no pa tiṣ+ṭha/dṛ 8ḍho me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/sarba sirnyim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ gre sheyaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān khesarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñca badz+rī ( bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa mus+dza/ rigs ldan dbye zhing brjod nas ni/ /skar ma rab rib mar me dang / /sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang / /rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bur/ /'dus byas chos kyang de ltar blta / /de ltar bsdu ba byas nas gzhag /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /bltas te lhag pa'i mchod pa dbul/ /e ma bdag nyid slob 4zibacas pa'i/ /dri zhim ngo bo thams cad kun/ /sngon 'das dbyings kyi dhū 7 par ni/ /byin rlabs skyemachod 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /de bi puṣ+pe pū dz+wa dza ho/ /e ma bdag nyid slob bcas pa'i/ /gsal dro ngo bo 34—1667

thams cad kun/ /byon ma rag ston ā lo ker/ /byin zlobs mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /de be+e ā lo ke pū thusnadza ho/ /e ma bdag nyid slob bcas pa'i / /rlan bcas dri zhim thams cad kun/ /ma byon kun gyi gnas der ni//byin rlobs mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /de bi garnyi pū dza hothu/ /de ltar mchod nas skyabs gsol ba/ /dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas rten nyid de/ /rnam dag sku las ting 'dzin dag pa'i sku/ /sprul sku phyag rgya mtshon pa'i lha tshogs kyi/ /grags pas 'jig rten gsum bkang lham 1me ba/ /mgon po mchog nyid la ni skyabs su mchi/ /smra bsam brjod med gsung gi sprul pa'i tshogs/ /mtshan nyid so so ye shes kun ston pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum//dam chos mdo sde bzhi la skyabs su mchi/ /rab tu lam stor 'khor bar mig zum pa'i / /'gro ba skyabs med kun gyi pha ma mdzad/ /phrin las bzhi yis rtse gcig don mdzad gtso/ /theg chen dge 'dun tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gus dang bcas pas phyag byas mchod/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar bsham 4pa'i rdzas/ /khrus byas gdugs tog me dri bshos/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol / /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 5dzā/ ga ga na sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ bi shwa bi shur+bhe swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta busgye 6māṃ/ dharma tā 7nu ga te swā hā/ na 8maḥs marnya bud+dhā dzā/ ma hā mai tre byuṅka ṭi swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta busgye kimāṃ/ dartse be+e ra ṇa a ga sa ga ne+e /dha rā ya swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta busgye 2ṭ+wāṃ/ bi shur+bhe garnyobye sa ba ya swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ྾ṭ+wāṃ/ a ra ra sba ra ra ka ra ra ba lo te ma ni swā hā/ snang stong —mchod rten chos nyid mkha'/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam 34byed/668

dag sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la'o/ /de lta'i yon tan bcas pa la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byams pa'i mchod/ /spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa 'phro/ /gtsug tor rgyal ba gdugs kyis khebs1/ /byams pa'i thabs dang shes rab kyis/ / badz+ra dhū rnyipe mchod pas 1rol/ /rin chen 'byung ldan snying rje'i mchod/ /ut+pal mthing ga me tog thodage/ /rin chen zla gam 'od du sbyor/ /snying rje thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /rat+na puste mchod pas 5rol/ /snang ba mtha' yas dag pa'i mchod/ /dpal gyi sgon 6ma phyag na bsnams/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan rab 'bar 'dzugs/ /dga' ba thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /pad+ma ā lo mchod pas 8rol/ /don yod grub pas btang snyoms mchod/ /tsan+dan bdud rtsi char 'be+ebs ma /dkyil 'khor gtsang ma'i thig ler 'be+ebs/ /spos sbar thabs dang shes rab kyis / /karma gabye mchod pas /rol/ /de ltar rigs la nye ba'i gzugs7/ /mchod pa phul ba'i lan dag tu/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rtogs pa'i yul/ /dung mdog sgeg mo rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems dpa' dkar po'i ye shes 'bebs/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes la/ /badz+ra khā sra mchod pas 1rol/ /rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam pa'i yul/ /yid bzhin rin chen gtsug 'bar ma/ /'jam dpal rnon po'i dngos grub 'dzin/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la/ /rat+na mā le — 2mchod pas rol/ /snang ba mtha' yas mkhyen pa'i yul/ /pad+ma dbyangs mkhan rma bya'i mgrin/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi shes rab bskyed/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la/ /pad+ma gī ti mchod pas rol / /don yod grub pa las kyi yul/ /gar mkhan 'gying ma gzi dang ldan//34byed1669

las kyi 'khor lo rnam par bsgyur/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes la/ /karma nirti mchod pas rol/ /de ltar gzungs kyis mchod byas nas/ /rigs bzhi tshad med bsdu ba bzhis/ /mchod phyir dpal gyis gsungs pa'o/ /sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags/ /byams pa chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba rnam tsho dag la/ /badz+ra e gu sha yi mchod pas rol/ /don mthun phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags/ /snying rje chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /rin chen phyag rgya shes pa la / /rat+na pā sha'i mchod pas rol/ /don spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags/ /dga' ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab sgon ma mdzad pa la/ /pad+ma sgo ṭa'i mchod pas rol/ /snyan pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags/ /btang snyoms chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /mchod rten chen mo kun rig la/ /karma gadhe'i mchod pas rol—/ /de ltar tshad med mchod byas nas/ /rigs rnams byin gyis rlob pas mchod/ /zhe sdang ma skyes rdo rje dam tshig ma/ /ye shes me long pha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /gnyis med rgyas 'debs drin lan phyag rgya ma/ /satwa badz+ra dbyings phyug 2mchod pas rol/ /nga rgyal bdag med rin chen dam tshig ma/ /ye shes mnyam nyid pha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /mi 'gyur rmongs med drin lan phyag rgya ma/ /rat+na badz+ra dbyings phyug mchod pas rol/ /'dod chags mi dmigs chos kyi dam tshig ma/ /ye shes kun rtog gepha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /mi rtog za byed drin 'a/na phyag rgya ma/ /pad+ma badz+re dbyings phyug mchod pas rol/ /phrag dog ma grub rgya gram dam tshig ma/ /ye shes nan tan pha rol phyin pa'i ngang / /mi skye tshe 'phel drin lan phyag rgya ma/ /karma badz+re dbyings phyug mchod pas rol/ /de ltar byin rlabs 57mchod byas nas/ /rgyan gyi mchod par gsungs pa ni/ /34—1670

bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas ni/ /mchod gnas dam pa dpal gyi gyezhing / /yid du 'ong ba'i mchod sbyin 2dang / /rol mo sil snyan 'phan gdugs dang / /bla re rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dang / /me tog phreng dang bdug spos sogs/ /mar me byug pa la sogs pa'i/ /mchod sprin sna tshogs phyogs bcur sprul/ /mchod sprin rig sngags bden pa dang / /nam mkha' mdzod sngags ting 'dzin mthus / /sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byams su— / /mchod sprin sna tshogs bklubs 4gyur cig /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sa ra pra mazlu 5ni ta thā ga tā 6ya/ arta te sarmyaka saṃ bud+dhā 3ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+ra/ ma hā bī r+ya dwabadz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ma hā bo dhi sa madho ba saṃ gra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shwa dha ni badz+re swā hā/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba tat+t+waṃ at+pa 1 te spa ra ṇa hi saṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ de nas yum lnga la brten 1 mchod/ /shes rab dbyings phyug rigs thuyum lnga/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs la byin rlob cing / /thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur mas/ /'gro ba'i don rnams mdzad du gsol/ /shes rab dbyengs ma rigs kyi yum lnga ste/ /chos dbyings ye shes mkha' sogs gsal ba la/ /gsang chen bde ba'i longs spyod sgogs pa'i ngang / /thabs ltar rol cing brtan par bzhugs 1 su gsol/ /yum rnams dag la mchod thabs ni/ /sgrub mchod bcu drug gzhung bzhin bya/ /bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad chen gyi/ /chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i yul/ /yum chen budha lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par mkhas dbang bskur4/ /bde gshegs kun kyi yum chen mo/ /phyag 'tshal kun du bzang mo la'o/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /me long 34—1671

ye shes chen po'i yul/ /yum chen badz+ra lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par sas dbang bskur/ /rdo rje rigs gtso mang po'i yum/ /phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas spyan khyod la'o/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi/ /mnyam nyid ye shes chen bo'i yul/ /yum chen rat+na lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par mes dbang bskur / /rin chen rigs gtso mang po'i yum/ /phyag 'tshal na bza' dkar mo la'o/ /bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /kun rtog ye shes chen po'i yul//yum chen pad+ma lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par chus dbang bskur/ /pad+ma rigs gtso mang po'i yum/ /phyag 'tshal mā 1ma tī la'o/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa yi/ /nan tan ye shes chen po'i yul/ /yum chen karma lo tsa na/ /thams cad zad par rlung dbang bsgur/ /las kyi rigs gtso mang po'i yum/ /phyag 'tshal dam tshig sgrol ma la'o/ /de nas sems dpa' bcu drug kyang / /ci rigs pa'am yang na ni/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa yis thumachod/ /de nas lā gya la sogs brgyad/ /phyi nang gnyis kyi lha mo dam tshig ma/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi ye shes gsal ba la/ /rol pa chen pos 4mchod pas gtso bo yis/ /dgongs pa skongs la 'gro ba'i don rnams mdzod/ /ye shes dus bzhi gzungs nye gzungs/ /sprul sgu 'khor bar mi ldog cing / /mya ngan 'das la mi chags pa'i / /don rnams mdzad cing brtan por bzhugs/ /rdo rje sgeg mo byang chub sem/sa/ kyi ngang / /mchog sbyin smon byed gzi brjid 'bar cing sdud/ /mdog dkar gser gyi khu tshur dkur brten te/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje smon byed sgeg mo la'o/ /rin chen dpal phreng gzungs 5dang ting nge 'dzin/ /yid bzhin mchog 'byung gzi brjid 'bar zhing skong 6/ /sngo bsangs rin chen phreng 3(—/672

bas re 'dod skong / /phyag 'tshal bdud rtsi char 3'be+ebs phreng ba la'o/ /pad+ma dbyangs mkhan gsung rab rgya mtshor sgogs/ /snyan pas yid 'phrog gzi brjid 'bar ldan skong / /mdog dmar gser gyi pi wang phyag na bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal thabs kyi yid 'phrog gī 2ti la'o/ /las kyi gar mkhan phrin las rgya mtsho sgol/ /gzugs mdzes bskyod pas rol mo phyogs bcur mdzad/ /mdog ljang sna tshogs skur ston gzi brjid 'bar/ /phyag 'tshal ba'ang mdzes spyod 1ni rti la'o/ /spos kyi sprin ldang 4bdug pa 'phro/ /kun du tshim byed dri bsung tshim/ /mthing 5skya gser gyi spos phor bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal rnam dag bdug pa la'o//lta mdzes rin chen phung po 'gro / /byang chub yan lag me tog brgyan / /mthon mthing me tog gzhong bu bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal skyon med me tog tsula'o/ /'od gsal 'phro bas kun du khyab/ /gti mug 'thibs trepo sel mdzad pa/ /dmar skya chos kyi mar me bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal sgron 1 'bar mar me la'o /tsan+dan bdud rtsi char 7'apebs ma/ /bdud rtsi bsil dro 'jam pa'i dbyings // /ljang sngon dung phor phyag na bsnams/ /phyag 'tshal reg bya dri chu la'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i bskal bzang dang / /phyogs skyong bcu dang bkra shis brgyad/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'gugs byed dang / /rin chen zhags pa gsol ka dang / /pad+ma lcags sgrog —pho nya'i las/ /rgya gram dril bu shes rab mchog /dpe med rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom rgyal chen lha chen dang / /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding / /mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /sa bdag gza' skar rig 'dzin dang / /srin po log 'dren sha za dang / /rgyud drug dag gi mthu can sogs/ /thams cad ci rigs pa yis mchod/ /371—1673

dkyil 'khor bdag po de nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi ting 'dzin zhugs/ /lce thog 1a las zla dkyil steng / /oṃ bsgoms thurdo rje ye shes bsams 1 / /rdo rje be+egs kyu 4bsgoms nas ni// /chos kyi phyag rgya can gyis ni/ /slob ma de la bshad par bya/ /oṃ dharma hūṃ dharma t+t+waṃ dharma ṭīḥdharma āḥdharma5/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dharma/a na ya sa dharma/ a haṃ 6su khaṃ dharma/ sā mudhu sā dhu dharma/ su pa ha swā dharma/ru pu ho de dharma/ a tha pra ba ti dharma/ ha ha hūṃ ha dharma/ sarba ka ri dharma/duḥkha ts+tsha da dharma/ budzha bo bye 8 dharma/ pra ti shaja dharma/ su ba shi s+t+waṃ dharma/ni ba ya dharma/ sha t+t+waṃ 9bhak+ṣa dharma/ sarba sed+dhi dharma/ ma hā ra tre+e dharma/ rū 7pa sho bhe dharma/ shu nyu1rod tra bai nyurtadharma/ sarba pu dze dharma/ pra ha da ni dharma/pu te dharma/ tsa kri dharma/ su garnya ni dharma/ a ya hi dza dza dharma/ a ya hi hūṃ hūṃ dharma/ ma sbo ṭa baṃ baṃ dharma/ ghaṇ+ḍa a a dharma/ de ltar lha tshogs sgu gsung thugs/ /dkyil 'khor gang yin thams cad kyi/ /so so'i snying po tha mar ni/ /dharmas btags la brjod pas ni/ /lha rnams thugs dgongs dngos grub stsol/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam gyi/ /byang chub sems rgo bskyed par bya/ /sdom pa yi ni dam tshig dang / /dag pa'i chos rnams sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed bcas pa yi/ /rnam pa gsum dang ldan par bshad/ /rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya bcas/ /oṃ badz+ra ka ba tsa rak+ṣa a bye tiṣ+ṭha haṃ/ de nas sku gsu/nga thugs byin brlab/ /kā ya oṃ wāk+ka 7āḥtsit+ta hūṃ/ 'khor lo phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags/ /bar du gcod pa bsal labar bya/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsakra phaṭa/ nga yis bshad phog thams cad ni/ /dam pas gsungs pa'i tshig yin pas/ /khyod kyang de las ma 'da' shig7 /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya haṃ 18tha/ byang chub rigs 34byed/674

can nyid du ni/ /sngags 'di brjod par 1gyur pa'o/ /oṃ bo bye tsit+ta a sa me — 7ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor 'jug gzhug pa/ /slob dpon zhugs dang slob ma 'jug /bshags pa lhag chad kha bskang /ba/ /mthun par slar gshegs gsol dang lnga/ /las bzhi mchod nas bdag nyid kyis//dkyil 'khor sems kyis nam mkha' la/ /bteg nas byang chub sems kyis ni/ /zhugs pa nyid du thub pas gsungs/ /bdug spos lag tu thogs nas su/ /blo gros ldan pas lha rnams la/ /gus pas gsol ba legs par gdab/ /de 'og sgo bzhi dbye bar bshad/ /zhugs la gnyis su med bsgoms la/ /'gro ba dran pa'i las bya'o/ /bcom ldan nam mkha'i sangs rgyas kun/ /thugs rje chen po mthu rmeldan lags/ /bdag nyid rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan lhas/ /bdag la dbang mchog deng stsol cig /dkyil 'khor la ni 'khor lo bshad/ /de nyid dam tshig yin par bshad/ /sangs rgyas bka' yi dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'jug lags na/ /dkyil 'khor bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /bsod nams can du bdag nyid gyur//sngon kyi las kyi 'brel pa lags/ /thugs rjes sras su dgongs par mdzod/ /āt+ma kophodehaṃ maṇ+ḍal sarba ā be sha swa bhā 6wa/ /rdo rje mdzub sogs legs par ni/ /sbyar la bkan te bsdams nas su/ /khros nas rab tu dbye ba ni/ /sgo dbye ba yi mtshan nyid do/ /gnas rab sgo bzhi zhe sdang dang / /nga rgyal 'dod chags phrag dog bzhis/ /sngon med dus nas bcad lags na/ /tshad med bsdu rgyas tsurigs bzhi yi/ /thugs rje thabs las sprul pa yi/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags 34—1675

sgrog dang / /dril bu phyag rgya mchog nyid kyis/ /deng 3nyid thar sgo dbye ru gsol / /oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kro dha gha ṭot+ma k+ṣem ya tsa tur/ pra be sha bi kran smra —ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas/ bdag nyid rdo rje rin chen dang / /pad+ma rgya gram shugs kyis ni/ /rab tu brgal te zhugs nas ni/ /gnyis su med par sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /snying rje slob ma la sogs la/ /lha mo sprul sras bsgom byas drang / /de nas sngags g.yog dag gis ni/ /slob ma'i las rnams brtson bya ba/ /phyag 'tshal gsol 'jug khrus bkra shis/ /dam bca' me tog dor mig dbye/ /slob dpon lan stsal lhas dbang bskur/ /dam tshig dbog dang dbang bskur dang / /smon lam lha ngo bstan yul dbul/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'o/ /de nas shar sgo dag tu ni/ /bdug spos lag tu thogs nas su5/ /shar phyogs mngon dga'i pho brang 'di'i byu/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' 3la/ /skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /ngag yid dang bas gus phyag 'tshal/ /lho phyogs dpal ldan pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan la4/ / skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /ngag yid dang bas gus phyag 'tshalaḍa/ /nub phyogs bde ldan pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas la bye/ / skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /ngag yid dang bas gus phyag 'tshal lte/ /byang phyogs gser mdog 6pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa la / / skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /ngag yid dang bas gus phyag 'tshal⑫/ /bcom ldan snying po'i pho brang 'di'i/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad la/ /skal ldan rgyal sras dag pa zhig /ngag yid dang bas gus phyag 'tshal/ /bdag ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin 34—1676

pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje bla na med pa 1'di/ /di ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /bdag ni dam tshig rin chen te/ / rin chen 'byung ldan yin pa'i phyir/ /rin chen bla na med pa 'di/ /di ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/2 /bdag ni dam tshig pad+mo ste/ / snang ba mtha' yas yin pa'i phyir/ /pad+mo bla na med pa 'di / /di ring bdag la dbab tu gsol / /bdag ni dam tshig rgya gram ste/ / don yod grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ /rgya gram bla na med pa 'di/ /di ring bdag la dbab tu gsol4/ /bdag ni dam tshig 'khor lo ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad yin par grags/ /'khor lo bla na med pa 'di/ /di ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /shar phyogs mngon dga'i pho brang 'dir/ /bla med byang chub sems bskyed de/ /dngos grub dam pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis dad pas 'jug par bgyi/ /lho phyogs dpal ldan pho brang 'dir/ / bla med byang chub sems bskyed de/ /dngos grub dam pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis dad pas 'jug par bgyi5/ /nub phyogs bde ldan pho brang 'dir/ / bla med byang chub sems bskyed de/ /dngos grub dam pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis dad pas 'jug par bgyitre/ /byang phyogs rnam dag pho brang 'dir/ / bla med byang chub sems bskyed de/ /dngos grub dam pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis dad pas 'jug par bgyidzo/ /bcom ldan snying po'i pho brang 'dir/ / bla med byang chub sems bskyed de/ /dngos grub dam pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ / /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu rnams su lta 9ba'i phyir/ /mtha' las 'das pa gnas par bgyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long yul/ /kun bzang phyag rgya'i bum pa ste/ /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /zhe sdang rnam 34—/677

smin dag gyur cig /rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam shes yul/ /na bza'i phyag rgya'i bum pa ste/ /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /nga rgyal rnam smin dag gyur cig /snang ba mtha' yas kun rtog yul/ /mā 3ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste / /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /'dod chags rnam smin dag gyur cig /don grub nan tan ye shes yul/ /sgrol ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /phrag dog rnam smin dag gyur cig /rnam snang chos dbyengs ye shes yul/ /spyan gyi phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis min byang chub sems rtags chus/ /gti mug rnam smin dag gyur cig /mi 'khrugs rgyal po srid dang gti mug rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis dang / /dge mnyam bsam sems ldan pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni ding 'dir zhi byed legs gyur cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rgyan gyis brgyan byas shing / /yang dag 'byor ba'i sbyin pas spyin mdzad mi slu ba/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya'i bkra shis gang yin pa / /bkra shis des kyang ding 'dir zhi byed legs gyur cig /bsam gtan dam pa ting 'dzin pha rol phyin pa'i gnas/ /ye shes pad+ma'i steng bzhugs dpag med tshe ldan zhing / /tshe grangs med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir zhi byed legs gyur cig /sems can don phyir las la thugs ni spyor mdzad cing / /'gro ba thams cad bcings pa bcings las grol gyur pa/ /thub mchog don yod grub pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir zhi byed legs gyur cig /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan/ /zla ba nya 'dra sgu mnga' srid pa'i 34—1678

mthar 'byin pa/ /dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir zhi byed legs gyur shog /ya na mo ga lan/ shu bha sha madho/ sa ya dzi ༄1na ta ka sha gye a khyo bh+ya rā dza/ bi shi na ta gye / sarba kun / saṃ ga la gye / 8 mo ga la da/ bha ba 4tu shādhe/ ka sa prasnyo ༄5sta babye h+ye/ ya saṃ ga lan/ ma ni ku lan hi na bu ha ra/ pa ba shu sha sha tsi na se ta no to de/ kha la na be+e pi pu ti na/ tan saṃ ga lan/ tan saṃ gā lan bha ba tu 6shādhe/ ka ra na bad hūṃ yan saṃ ga lan/ a ga ni/ ā 7yur byid ta rus gye / ma ne+e bu ra ta li (yas gye/ gārna badz+ra/ pa ri ga te gye/ ta thu rkag te smi11/ tan saṃ ga salan/ bha ba tu shādhe1 / kar nar+ya phaṭa tram̐/ yan mo ga lan/ ma ma mu ne+e pa ra sha sre/ a mo gha sid+dhi satwa twa 7ra gar ma na de/bhu na sha ba na/ sha ta le gye yo tsi ta man sa sa gye mu na sa gye/ ban+ta bha bha bye bya/tan saṃ ga lan/ bha ba tu shādheki/ rna ta bye/ yan saṃ ga lan/ sa ka la mā 7tor ta sa gye/ be+e ro tsa na gye/ be ra ta nyi rna/ ma hā ra rna ba gye/ ma hā ra rna 7byu ra ra rna/ tsa tra bhu she he ban+ta ka gye/ tan baṃ ga lan/ bha ba tu shādhe naka ra ta babye/ de la de bzhin gshegs gtso dang / /chos rnams kun la dbang bskur ro/ /rdo rje rigs gtso chen po dang / /khams gsum bdag por dbang bskur ro/ /rin chen rigs gtso chen po dang / /lha mis mchod par dbang bsgur ro/ /pad+ma'i rigs gtso chen po dang / /chos kyi rgyal por dbang bsgur ro/ /las kyi rigs gtso chen po dang / /las bzhis tsagazhan don spyod dbang bsgur/ /bkra shis brjod pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'jig rten dag tu mi rnams kun/ /grags pa rnam 1spel bgegs kyang med/ /sems nyid bde 34—/679

'gro nges byed la/ /mthar yang nges pa kho nar ni/ /zhi ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /de nas dam bca' bya ba ni/ /dpa' bo chen po rgyud dag pa'i/ /sdom pa legs par blang bar bya/ /de la sdom pa'i yon tan ni/ /dang po sdom pas 1rgyud gnyis sbyong / /tha ma'i sdom pas lha min spyong / /rdo rje rin chen pad+mo 2yi/ /sdom pa yis ni ngan 'gro spyong / /de bas sdom pa mnos pa mchog /de 'og dam bca' yang dag bya/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed brtan par bzung / /de ni spyi yi tshul khrims so/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bkyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin ni lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spong ngo / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /de nas shar sgor gnas pa de/ /na bza' stod smad dar dmar dkri//rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyar 'char/ /bcug la lag tu rin chen dang / /me tog phreng ba la sogs thogs/ /gdong g.yogs dar dkar gyis g.yogs nas/ /34—1680

a sa me tri sa me ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a ba tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/sngon gyi tshe rabs grangs med nas/ /dge ba'i las kyis bsnyen pa'i lha/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang yin pa/ /da lta nyid du 'bab par shog /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser 1dgongs nas kyang / /'gro la phan pa'i gtso chen gyis/ /sman par dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra t+t+waṃts+tsha 2sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bo bye tsit+ta pū —dza ho4/ me tog rin chen la sogs pa/ /gang la bab pa rigs kyi lha/ /gtso bo rigs de bsgrubs 5na ni/ /dngos grub myur ster je tshom med/ /de nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /rin chen lhar bcas blangs nas ni/ /slob ma'i spyir bzhag thim gyur nas/ /mi gnyis gcig pa'i ltar bsams nas/ /oṃ sa ma ya z-i da ya me/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ6 da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /khyod ni jeg chen 'di nyid la/ /gsang ba chen po'i snod du gyur/ /rnyed pa mnyam med di ring rnyed/ /thob pa mnyam med di ring thob/ /dam tshig gong 'og ma 'da' zhig /bla med byang chub chen po 'thob/ /oṃ badzā 7ha phyoṅgha ṭa ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha hūṃ phaṭa/ slob dpon lan gnyis dbyangs sbyar te/ /rdo rje 8phyag rgya legs bcas la/ /nga ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med 'di/ /di ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca a a9/nga ni dam tshig rin chen te/ / rin chen 'byung ldan yin par grags/ /rin chen ye shes bla med 'di/ /di ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ rat+na sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca a a / nga ni dam tshig pad+mo ste/ / snang ba mtha' yas yin par 34—1681
