grags / /pad+mo ye shes bla med 'di/ /di ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ pad+ma sa ma ya a t+ta ṣiñca a a ri1/ nga ni dam tshig rgya gram ste/ / don yod grub pa yin par grags/ /rgya gram ye shes bla med 'di/ /di ring khyod la sbyin par bya—/ /oṃ karma sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca a ardu/ nga ni dam tshig 'khor lo ste/ /snying po'i 'khor lo yin par grags/ /'khor lo ye shes bla med 'di/ /di ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ tsakra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca a yi/ / a bhi ṣiñca a a sa ma ya s+thāḥ3tha/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam las 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs bye na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'dis 'grub/ /ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni/ /de ma thag tu bkas nas gshegs—/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /bdun brgyud 7rigs ni brlag par mdzad/ /de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang / /sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'/ /shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya / /ma rtebyin par yang blang mi bya/ /brdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams / /dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing / /sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ /sems can gnod pa'i sgyu/rngosbyor ba ni/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin te/ /dkon mchog gsum ni yong mi spang / /dus kun du na dz+wa byang chub sems/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /lha dang bla ma de bzhin no / /sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang / /bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /lha la phul ba'i rnying pa dang / /de yi grib ma 'gom mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin no/ /sngags dang lha la smad mi bya/ /gdon gyi las ⑪sogs bya ba min/ /mu stegs can la'ang smad mi bya/ /mdor na yid gnyis dogs mi 34—1682

bya / /bdag gi de nyid sngags dang ni/ /thams cad 'dra bas de bzhin no/ /de nas dbang mchog bskur ba ni/ /pa— ma yi phyogs dag tu/ /khru gang ba yi dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri/ /tshon ni dmar pos legs bris laṣ+ṭṛ/ /bkra shis brgyad kyi phyag rgya dgod/ /dbu rgyan cod pan me tog phreng / /phyag rgya bzhi dang rin chen bdun/ /gser byas thur ma 'khor me long / /dung dang bkra shis ras thogs gzhag /bdug spos ras sar gdugs sham can/ /rnga yab bsil yab zho phor gang / /bum pa bzhi sogs mi res gzung 3/ /mchod pa la sogs bkra shis brjod/ /oṃ j-i ta z-i du ta sarba ā ceb ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ bi dra 3 ba bi dra 7 ba sarba a pa ya tang dwa thon hūṃ phaṭa/ sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab / /de nas thur ma me long dung / /'khor lo rtsa ba'i yig 'brus bskur/ /phreng ba bum pa nyan pa dang / /gsang sngags phyag rgya cod pan dang / /'khor bsgyur — ming dbang dbu rgyan dang / /las dang bcu'o gzungs rje'o/ /bcu gsum pa byeni nor dbang bskur/ /'khor lo rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /sa bcu kun la dbang ba dang / /theg pa mtha' dag ston pa yi/ /chos kyi rgyal po chen por shog /glang po rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /theg pa kun gyi byedon rtogs nas/ /stobs bcu kun la dbang thob cing / /byang chub 'bras bu thob par shog /rta mchog rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi'i dbang thob nas/ /nyon mongs rgya mtsho rgal ba yi/ /thar pa'i 'bras bu thob par shog /nor bu rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /'jig rten dag tu de bzhin gshegs / /dpe byad mtshan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /gser gyi sku mdog thob 34—1683

par shog /dmag mi rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /mi 'jigs 3bzhi yi dbang thob nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod 1pa'i/ /go cha chen po bgos par shogablon po rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang phyug rje/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i brgya byin gyi/ /lha yi rgyal po thob par shog /btsun mo rin chen bstabs pas ni/ /shes rab yum gyi dbang thob cing / /skye 'gag med pa'i don rtogs nas/ /bla med 'bras bu thob par shog /de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i grub rdzas dpa' bo 'dis/ /bar chod bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rnam 'jig cing / /skye 'grub mchog thob deng 'dir bkra shis shog //ji ltar lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtsa mchog pu ta na/ /dūr ba'i gdan la bzhugs thunas bdud btul ltar/ /deng 'dir bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /ji ltar sngon gyi drang srong a ga stas5/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyugs kyi dngos grub 'di/ /khyim bdag dbang phyug che la byin pa yis/ /skye dgu'i gsos gyur bcud ldan bkra shis shog /rdo rje dang ni rin chen chu skyes dang / /de bzhin las kyi sems dpa' dbang bsgur ba'i/ /li khris 'jig rten gsum po dbang bsnyus shing / /dngos grub mchog thob ding 'dir bkra shis shog /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis zhwachos kyi dung / /na ra ya nar dung sgra bsgrags pa ltar/ /bu khyod dam/ nga/'i chos sgra rab sgrogs shing / /'gro ba 'dren mdzad deng 'dir bkra shis shog /chos rnams thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /smig rgyu lta bur yang dag rtogs pa'i mthus/ /ma rig mun sel ye shes thob gyur nas/ /dngos grub mchog thob deng 'dir bkra shis shog /ji ltar glang po chen po aka 34byed/68 1

ta'i2 / /gi'u wang srog gi dbang por gyur pa ltar/ /de bzhin bu khyod tshe srog 'dzin gyur nas/ /dngos grub mchog thob deng 'dir bkra shis shog /ji ltar rgyu dang sa bon chung ba las/ /'bras bu cher smin shing thog bil ba ltar/ /de bzhin bsod nams rgyu tshogs chung ngu las/ /'bras bu bla med byang chub thob par shog /gtsug tor spyan ljags go chas bskur/ /lag gnyis bcings te gung gshibs snyebasgreng / /mdzub gnyis bkug sbyar gtsug tor ro/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ lag gnyis bcings te gung srin lag/ /brkyang ste mje bo nang bcug mig /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ ga ga na ba ra la k+ṣa ṇa/ gu ru na ma ya ta thā ga ta tsak+ṣu swā hā/ lag gnyis thal mo khong stong sbyar/ /mdzub gnyis dkris la srin lag gtugs4/ /mthe bo gnyis gshibs 5ljags su bshad/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 6dzā/ ta thā ga ta dzi hwa )sarba dharmā pra ti tiṣ+ṭha/ lag pa gnyis ni khong stong sbyar/ /mdzub gnyis ngos nas dkres pa ni/ /go cha'i phyag rgya zhes su bshad/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ pra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra la 9bi yu ra hūṃ/de nas slob ma'i thog dag tu/ /gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ /theg chen chos kyi ngo bo ste/ /nyon mongs gdung ba sel byed pa'i/ /dbang mchog dam pa bskur bar bya/ /sum cu rtsa lngas legs dbang bskur/ /de nas dag pa sgo bzhi nas/ /sgra yi rjes su legs sbyar zhing / /blo dang ldan pas smon lam gdab / /shar phyogs sgo la pū rbas bsdu/ /sngon dang thog ma phur pas bsnyu/ /de mthun rdo rje sems la sogs/ /sgrib gnyis byang bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /de bzhin slob ma tshogs sgogs nas/ /me long ye shes thob par shog /lho sgo dak+ṣi ṇas ⑩basbu'o/ /sbyin gnas la yang dak+ṣi ṇa bsdu'o/ /nub sgo pabye mas 34—1685
